american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Complete cook-offs by earning stars and cashing out, then win three to start the Meat Coma mini-wizard.

steps.t: Complete the Main Recipe orange shots
steps.d: Shoot the lit orange shots (starting at 3) to finish the main recipe; BOSS/CHEF completions and FIRE hurry-ups raise recipe value.

steps.t: Earn extra stars in the cook-off
steps.d: Fill the sauce bottle with spinner hits, find the correct spice with mild/spicy post targets, and complete the drop target sets for Side Dish 1 and 2.

steps.t: Cash out your trophy at an open saucer
steps.d: Hit any open saucer to collect your trophy and cash-out award, with +1x per star.
Win 3 cook-offs to start Meat Coma Multiball immediately afterward.
Hit and unlight all six red areas (both ramps, both orbits, 2 stand-up banks), then shoot or Bash Lock a saucer for the jackpot; the first three award add-a-balls.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Lock balls in the side saucers, start the multiball, and climb the jackpot ladder to the progressive jackpot.

steps.t: Build recipe value with orange shots
steps.d: Hit orange shots during cook-offs; each one increases the base multiball jackpot by the recipe value.

steps.t: Lock a ball in a side saucer
steps.d: Lock at least one ball in either of the side saucers.
Hit the saucer further back on the right side (upper right saucer) with a ball locked.
Shoot lit jackpots; they rise from 1x, 1.5x, 2x up to 10x at the 19th and 15x at the 20th. Upper-right saucer relights jackpots.
Send one ball to a saucer then lock another before time runs out for super; lock at all three saucers for mega.
Collect the 20th jackpot to get a chance at the progressive jackpot.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Bash locked balls to collect fireworks and start Firework Frenzy, then build jackpots.

steps.t: Lock a ball at the left or lower right saucer
steps.d: Have balls locked for Pitmaster Multiball at the left or lower right saucer.
Hit the locked balls to collect fireworks; 10 starts Firework Frenzy.
Increase jackpots at the left ramp or by collecting saucer jackpots, keeping the saucer countdown from expiring.

steps.t: Lock all remaining balls for a super jackpot
steps.d: Lock all remaining balls in saucers before the timer runs out to add a ball and award a super jackpot.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Complete the drop targets repeatedly to collect all inserts, start the multiball, and score jackpots.

steps.t: Complete the side dish drop targets
steps.d: Complete the drop targets near the right orbit; sweeping them doubles the effect.
Complete the drop targets three times to collect all inserts and start Side Dish Multiball.
Hit red shots for jackpots; complete the drop targets to relight all jackpots.

steps.t: Start the second Side Dish Multiball
steps.d: Collect two complete sets of the side dish inserts.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Qualify and start challenges at the saucers, then complete them for perks.

steps.d: Hit the orbits with flashing Qualify Challenge inserts.
Hit purple arrow shots or complete drop targets with increase challenge value lit before starting; draining loses it.
Hit an open saucer with the Start Challenge insert lit.

steps.t: Complete the challenge for its perk
steps.d: Finish the timed purple-shot objective to earn its award, such as Hot Rod Ramps or Super Saucers.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Complete CHEF, then BOSS for recipe boosts and awards including Playfield X.

steps.d: Use the flippers to change the bottom lanes and light all CHEF letters for recipe value and a lit orange arrow.
Complete BOSS in the upper lanes, which requires CHEF letters already lit on the lower row.
The first award each ball is the Playfield X Ramp Upgrade, then others are random.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Start FIRE hurry-ups and chain them for multipliers up to 5x.

steps.d: Light the FIRE lanes to start the hurry-up; starting with an outlane saves your ball.

steps.t: Shoot a blue orbit to finish it
steps.d: Make either blue orbit shot before time runs out, or recipe value is halved.
Each completed FIRE adds +0.5x to the next, up to 5x.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Hit different skill shots across the game to raise their values and multipliers.

steps.t: Select and make a skill shot
steps.d: Choose a skill shot with the flippers before plunging and hit it.
Hitting different skill shots across the game raises value and multiplier.

steps.t: Hit the left outlane skill shot
steps.d: The 3M skill shot boosts FIRE hurry-ups by 1M.

american-pinball/barry-os-bbq-challenge.s: Chain combo shots to reach Combomania.

steps.t: Hit shots in succession for combos
steps.d: Make shots in succession along the white arrows.
Start the 60-second Combomania where 1-way combos score; later ones need more combos.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Destroy the five tanks in the center target bank to qualify the Tank Zulu mini-wizard, which feeds the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot the flashing center target bank, aiming at the red center target for the most damage.
Time your shot at the red target as it moves left to right across the bank.
Hit any target to drop the shield's health bar, then finish with a standard battle on the red center target.
After all five tanks are destroyed, fight the sixth tank, Tank Zulu.

steps.t: Complete Tank Zulu to progress toward the finale
steps.d: Tank Zulu is one of the two mini-wizard modes that must be completed to qualify the final wizard mode.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Play all five missions to gather ingredients and build the Sundae mini-wizard, which feeds the final wizard mode.

steps.t: Start the first mission at the right saucer
steps.d: Shoot the right saucer to get briefed; the first mission needs only one saucer shot. Later missions require completing the return lanes to light the saucer.
Shoot the pink flashing shots: spinner for Sprinkle Desert, lab or saucer for Fudge, ramp for berries, moving green shots for walnuts, and 15 cows for Udder Madness.
Complete Sprinkle Desert, Drilling for Fudge, Buckets O'Berries, Where's Walnuts? and Udder Madness.

steps.t: Complete the Ice Cream Sundae mini-wizard
steps.d: Combine the ingredients from all five missions into the ultimate treat.

steps.t: Count the Sundae toward the final wizard mode
steps.d: Sundae is the second mini-wizard that must be completed to qualify the final wizard mode.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Spell AIR to lock three balls, start the multiball, score all jackpots and destroy the Juggernaut for a medal.

steps.t: Spell AIR to light the lab saucer lock
steps.d: Hit the green AIR standup targets (two near the left ramp, one near the right saucer).

steps.t: Lock 3 balls in the lab saucer
steps.d: Shoot either orbit into the lab saucer or get a lucky bounce off the bumpers. The third lock starts the multiball.

steps.t: Score jackpots at all four spybot shots
steps.d: Hit both orbits, the left ramp and the right saucer, and destroy all the spybots.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot on the UFO target
steps.d: Shoot the lit moving UFO target to destroy the Juggernaut mothership; this earns a medal.
After the super jackpot, all shots are lit for the rest of the multiball.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Power up the reactors with bumper hits, play the 2-ball Meltdown, and finish it at the lab for a medal.

steps.t: Hit the pop bumpers to charge the reactors
steps.d: Bumper hits turn the blue inserts above the bumpers red; left flank targets can advance Meltdown too.

steps.t: Start Meltdown at full reactor power
steps.d: Full power launches another ball for 2-ball multiball.

steps.t: Raise the jackpot at the flashing green shots
steps.d: Shoot the flashing green shots to increase the jackpot, which scores with each bumper hit.

steps.t: Shoot the lab to complete the Meltdown
steps.d: After enough bumper hits, shoot the lab to end it and earn the Meltdown medal.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Rescue the available cows at the UFO target, then start Cow-A-Bongo multiball for a medal.

steps.t: Advance cows with the right flank targets
steps.d: When the cows feature is lit, completing the right flank attack targets advances it.

steps.t: Rescue the cows at the moving UFO target
steps.d: Shoot the moving UFO target to save the cows from Annoya.
After saving all currently available cows, shoot the target again to start the multiball and earn the medal.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Earn all five medals and complete both mini-wizards to qualify the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Earn the first medal by finishing Meltdown.

steps.t: Start 4x scoring with the quantum accelerators
steps.d: Complete one hidden standup bank for 2x, then the other while 2x runs for 4x.

steps.t: Defeat the Juggernaut in Air Strike Multiball
steps.d: Score all four jackpots and destroy the spybots, then hit the UFO target.
Earn the fourth medal by starting Cow-A-Bongo multiball.
Advance rank to the top to earn the fifth medal.
Both mini-wizard modes must be completed along with all five medals.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Advance rank through skill shots, lanes, flank targets and lab awards up to maximum rank, which earns a medal.

steps.t: Make the advance rank skill shot
steps.d: Plunge into the flashing advance rank rollover lane to instantly advance in rank.

steps.t: Complete the two advance rank rollover lanes
steps.d: Completing both lanes advances your rank.

steps.t: Complete the right flank attack targets
steps.d: Do this while advance rank is lit to gain another rank.
Keep advancing rank to earn the medal; higher rank raises bonus multiplier and mission shot values.

american-pinball/galactic-tank-force.s: Light the lab for mystery awards, boost scoring with shot multipliers and playfield X, and save balls with Lucky Break.

steps.d: Plunge into the flashing LAB rollover lane to instantly qualify Plotnik's lab for a mystery award.

steps.t: Complete the LAB lanes and shoot the lab saucer
steps.d: Complete the top LAB rollover lanes to light the lab saucer, then shoot it for a mystery award.
Complete both left and right flank attack target banks, then shoot any shot to lock in the multiplier for the ball.
Complete one hidden target bank for 2x, then the other during 2x for 4x.

steps.t: Destroy a tank to light Lucky Break
steps.d: Destroying a tank lights a lane under a flipper that saves the ball.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Climb the race positions from 12th to the checkered flag, then play Victory Lap Multiball and collect its jackpots for a hero car.

steps.t: Start the race from the left orbit
steps.d: Hit the left orbit with the flashing 12th place insert; the ball stops on the loop magnet and the race starts.
Shoot each blinking place insert in order: left ramp, left loop, right ramp, right orbit and so on down the list.
Hit the left orbit for the checkered flag; the ball is caught on the loop magnet and the race finishes.
In the 4-ball mode, shoot the lit left ramp, left orbit, right ramp and right orbit to build the jackpot multiplier.
Hit the kickback shot for the super jackpot, which resets all jackpot values.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Qualify with loop shots, start at the left orbit, rack up crashes and score the super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the alternately lit red left inner loop and right orbit to qualify; later qualifications need up to 12.
Shoot the lit left orbit to start the three-ball mode with a 15 second ball save.
Hit the left orbit, right orbit, or a pop bumper to award crashes until the left orbit lights green.
Shoot the left orbit to catch the ball on the magnet, then knock it off with another left orbit shot before it releases.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Build tracks to qualify, start the multiball, add a ball, then chain super and mega jackpots.

steps.d: Hit the Track Builder drop target or left saucer four times; each hit builds the base jackpot.
Shoot the green-lit left saucer lock to begin the two-ball mode.
Hit the lit right saucer within 15 seconds to add a ball and double the base jackpot values.

steps.t: Collect jackpots and the super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the light blue orbit and loop arrows, then the lit left saucer for the super jackpot.
After the super jackpot, hit the right kickback shot before the held ball is kicked out.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Collect cars to qualify Car Chaos, start it via a Collector Case Award, and earn the Twin Mill.

steps.t: Collect cars with the car targets
steps.d: Hit any of the 4 car standup targets; each hit collects one car and fills the Collector Case.
Collect 40 cars by hitting the car standups.

steps.t: Start Car Chaos from a Collector Case
steps.d: Fill the Collector Case and get the Start Car Chaos award on the right scoop.
Hit any flashing car target to enable the yellow arrow jackpot shots.

steps.t: Complete Car Chaos for Twin Mill
steps.d: Finish the mode to be awarded the Twin Mill hero car.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Qualify and win four battles, then face Draven for the Roger Dodger hero car.

steps.d: Complete all six BATTLE standups; the right saucer's clock tower drop target or spinners help cycle lights.
Shoot the right saucer, or the left saucer for the first two battles.

steps.t: Complete a Battle before time runs out
steps.d: Finish the mode objectives (Gorilla, T-Rex, Cobra or Triceratops) and shoot the lit saucers within the 90 second timer.
Win Gorilla, T-Rex, Cobra and Triceratops to unlock the Draven battle.
Clear all six waves, ending with the remaining BATTLE letters and a saucer shot, for the Roger Dodger hero car.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Light EPIC letters to qualify features, complete all four, then the Ultimate Epic for Bone Shaker.

steps.d: Hit the inlane and outlane rollovers to light E, P, I and C.
Hit the EPIC start standup to begin all lit features (Cars, Loops, Pops, Ramps).
Hit 8 cars, 5 loops, 20 pops or 5 ramps depending on the features lit.
Hit the lit EPIC collect target to complete the feature and bank the bonus.
After all four features, requalify EPIC, hit 40 cars, loops, pops or ramps, then hit EPIC complete for Bone Shaker.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Max out the tach to trigger the mini-wizard, collect jackpots, and raise your gear.

steps.d: Make shots and hit flashing RPM targets; plunge and skill shots also add wedges.

steps.t: Max the tach to start Red Line Mania
steps.d: Reach the maximum tach value; Turbo boost does not count.

steps.t: Collect jackpots on lit red arrows
steps.d: Hit each red-arrow shot during the 45 second timer with four balls.

steps.t: Complete all shots for the super jackpot
steps.d: Clear every lit shot to score a super jackpot and restart the cycle.

steps.t: Finish the mode for gear and Rip Rod
steps.d: Survive until the timer ends to raise your gear and earn the Rip Rod hero car.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Collect all five hero cars to reach the final wizard mode.

steps.t: Collect Twin Mill and Rip Rod
steps.d: Complete Car Chaos and Red Line Mania once.

steps.t: Collect Roger Dodger and Bone Shaker
steps.d: Complete the Draven battle and the Ultimate Epic.
Complete Victory Lap, Loop Crash and Track Builder Unlimited multiballs.
With all five hero cars, hit either saucer to start the two minute six-ball mode.

steps.t: Collect all super jackpots for the legend jackpot
steps.d: Clear all lights for each shot to score super jackpots, then collect them all for the legend jackpot.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Progress from the soft plunge skill shot to the super skill shot and a timed rev bonus.

steps.d: Plunge softly past each rollover to add tach wedges without falling through the gate.
After a successful soft plunge, shoot the yellow-arrow left orbit before it clears.
Hold the left flipper to rev and release the plunger at 10 without going over for a launch multiplier.

american-pinball/hot-wheels-rulesheet-wi.s: Light an extra ball through hero cars or car collection, then collect it at the left saucer.

steps.d: Collect two Hero Cars or a total of forty cars, or win a Collector Case extra ball award.

steps.t: Shoot the left saucer to collect
steps.d: Hit the left saucer to collect the lit extra ball, up to the default limit of four.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Collect all seven HOUDINI letters from the major areas to reach the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Play and complete all 10 Stage illusions to earn the Stage letter.
Complete all 5 Movie Modes for a Houdini letter.
Light the Magic Shop with spinner spins and collect 8 mystery awards at the Jail hole.
Spell ESCAPE and shoot the Jail hole to start hurry-ups; complete 5.
Start missions at the scoop and finish all 5 combos.
Play Trunk Multiball and collect 3 jackpots for a letter.
Play Seance Multiball and collect 2 jackpots to get the final letter and reach Master Magician.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Open the curtain, start illusions, and finish all 10 to cash in the Encore Bonus.

steps.d: Bash the curtain 4 times, make a clean Stage Alley shot, or shoot the Key Lane and back red Key Target without hitting a bumper.
With the curtain open, shoot the Stage; a clean Stage Alley shot starts it at 2X.
Finish the illusion's shots before the 45 second timer runs out.
Complete every illusion to earn the Encore Bonus and the Stage letter.
Shoot the Stage to collect total Stage points plus 10% per completed mode; Stage modes then reset.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Play and complete the five movie modes to earn a letter and start Movie Binge.

steps.d: Open a Movie via the skill shot or Magic Shop award, or by hitting the Magic targets for film letters.
Finish one of the 5 films such as Haldane, Grim Game or Terror Island before the 45 second timer burns it.
Complete all five films to earn a Houdini letter.
Completing all 5 starts Movie Binge; your results in each film affect its scoring.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Spell ESCAPE to run jail hurry-ups, ending in the Great Jail Escape mini-wizard mode.

steps.d: Hit the E-S-C stand-ups and use pops for A-P-E, then shoot the Jail hole to start a hurry-up.
Completing 2 escapes lights the Escape Death outlane mode.
Completing 3 escapes lights extra ball.
Finish Paris, London, New York, Sydney and Chicago for a Houdini letter.
Complete ESCAPE again and land a ball in the Jail hole; complete all 5 restarted hurry-ups.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Complete five progressively harder combos from the scoop, leading to the Ultimate Secret Mission.

steps.d: Shoot the scoop to begin, then make Ramp then Scoop.
Finish three combos to light extra ball.
Finish all five combos, ending with Milkcan Loop, Ramp, Right Orbit, Scoop, for a Houdini letter.
Shoot the lit scoop to start the mini-wizard mode.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Lock three balls in the trunk, then score jackpots and the super jackpot.

steps.d: The lock is lit at game start; a Stage Alley shot relights it afterward.
Shoot the right inner loop to catapult each ball into the trunk to start Trunk Multiball.
Complete the 3 lit jackpot shots to earn a Houdini letter.
After the jackpots, shoot the trunk via the inner loop to score the super jackpot and relight jackpots.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Spell SEANCE to light multiball, score jackpots, and earn the Return From Beyond outlane save.

steps.d: Collect S-E-A-N-C-E letters to light Seance Multiball at the scoop.
Shoot the lit scoop to start the 3 ball multiball with magnets engaged.
Spell SEANCE for jackpots; 2 earn a Houdini letter and light Return From Beyond.
Spell SEANCE in order, which is very hard.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Plunge for a roving award, then go for the super skill shot.

steps.d: Plunge to hit one of three roving ESC targets for its award.
Soft plunge to the left Magic target to collect all 3 listed awards.

american-pinball/houdini.s: Chain Milkcan Loop and ramp combos to raise the playfield multiplier up to 8X mode starts.

steps.t: Shoot the Milkcan loop then ramp
steps.d: Hit the Milkcan Loop immediately followed by the ramp to start 2X playfield scoring.
Each repeat of the combo advances the multiplier from 2X to 3X to 4X.

steps.t: Start a mode via Stage Alley at max
steps.d: Starting a mode via Stage Alley with a max multiplier gives 8X scoring.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Lock balls in the Viking ship for War at Sea, then repeat for Viking MB, and collect Raiders to qualify Viking Raid.

steps.d: Hit 3 purple lit side targets or get the lock qualification from a mystery award.
steps.sec: WAR AT SEA - SEA MB (6 shots and a super) - GREEN ship lighting

steps.d: Lock 3 balls in the ship. It can stack with any battle.
steps.sec: WAR AT SEA - SEA MB (6 shots and a super) - GREEN ship lighting

steps.d: Complete 6 shots, then hit the right ramp for the super jackpot. Completing it extends War at Sea for another 6 jackpots and a super.
steps.sec: WAR AT SEA - SEA MB (6 shots and a super) - GREEN ship lighting

steps.d: Lock balls in the ship a second or later time. It has 10 shots and a super, and no continuation after the super.
steps.sec: VIKING MB - 2nd sea MB (10 shots and a super) - can be battled multiple times. BLUE ship lighting.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Collect Raiders to qualify Viking Raid, then raid Viking cities by completing all shots.

steps.d: Complete R-A-I-D rollovers to add 1 raider each, or get 5 from a mystery award.
steps.sec: VIKING RAID - 3rd sea MB (qualified by # of RAIDERS collected) RED ship lighting.

steps.d: Collect enough raiders for your ship (default 20). A message tells you to shoot the ship.
steps.sec: VIKING RAID - 3rd sea MB (qualified by # of RAIDERS collected) RED ship lighting.

steps.d: Shoot the ship to start raiding a random Viking city.
steps.sec: VIKING RAID - 3rd sea MB (qualified by # of RAIDERS collected) RED ship lighting.

steps.d: Complete all shots in a city to move to another. Complete all cities to end the mode.
steps.sec: VIKING RAID - 3rd sea MB (qualified by # of RAIDERS collected) RED ship lighting.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Build blood on the axe through shield of the gods ball saves, then destroy villages in Rage multiball.

steps.t: Light the shield of the gods
steps.d: Complete the blood/rage targets twice to light the shield of the gods kickbacks.

steps.t: Save a ball with the shield
steps.d: Get a ball save to add a step to Rage qualification. Repeat 4 times total to fill the axe.
Rage begins as a 6 ball multiball frenzy with 4 villages.
Complete 6 shots per village for an add-a-ball and the next village. Destroying all villages ends Rage.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Play War on Land and Legend battles with a weapon, using helpers, to qualify the Ragnarok wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot the ramps, loops or spinner for the Jotnar, Trolls or Dwarves, and hit Berzerker for 10 more seconds.
Get at least 1 weapon to play a Legend battle. Later battles need 2, 5, then 9 weapons.
steps.sec: LEGEND BATTLES (16) (1 weapon needed to play):

steps.d: Complete each legend's shots. Thor's Hammer (100 spinner hits) or a Valkyrie (5 combos) can speed this up.
steps.sec: BATTLE HELPERS - THORS HAMMER and VALKYRIES

steps.d: Play every Legend battle to qualify Ragnarok.
Shoot all 19 shots on each of 3 levels with 6 balls to complete Ragnarok.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Complete 8 tasks to qualify Valhalla, then defeat Odin with all 9 weapons.

steps.d: Tasks include weapons, army, combos, War on Land, a sea battle, god of thunder, legend destroyer and conquest.
Shoot the scoop or shooter lane to begin single ball play with a 60 second ball save.
Shoot the left ramp to light a weapon, then shoot the weapon shot to collect it.
Deliver the final blow at the center ramp after collecting all weapons.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Collect the 8 Viking qualities to finish the Conquest task and earn 25 million.

steps.d: Fidelity: 1 right ramp. Self-reliance: 3 Berzerkers. Discipline: 25 spins. Honor: 10 center ramps.
Perseverance: hit blood and rage twice. Courage: 10 loops. Hospitality: 5 under-ship hits. Truth: 10 left ramps.
Collect all 8 qualities to award 25 million and count as a task.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Features that build toward the Kraken and Rampage, with an extra ball reward.

steps.d: Hit the center ramp to spell R-A-M-P-A-G-E outside other modes, then shoot lit shots for multipliers.
Hit the blood/rage target 4 times, then hit as many green shots as possible in 10 seconds.
Make 10 loops under the ship.
Hit the under-ship target to score the value before it counts down. Playing it awards an extra ball at the scoop.

american-pinball/legends-of-valhalla.s: Chain shots into combos and use right ramp hits to double scoring.

steps.d: The right ramp arrow turns yellow when 1 more hit is needed.
Chain the listed shot pairs to add to the combo jackpot and combos task.
Make a listed unique combo such as the Asgard Combo for the biggest bonus.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Spell TENT to light a Tent Mode, play modes (ideally with matching steins), and finish all 13 to reach the Flipper Miestro wizard mode.

steps.d: Light E, T, N and T through the left inlane, left outlane, right inlane and right outlane to light a Tent Mode at the scoop.

steps.t: Select and start a Tent Mode
steps.d: Shoot the Tent scoop, scroll through the modes with the flippers and hit both buttons to select one.
Make the required lit shots within the 46-second timer (Juggler is a multiball instead). Playing with the matching stein doubles scoring.
Win every Tent Mode; replay failed ones by spelling TENT again.
Completing all 13 Tent Modes starts the Flipper Miestro wizard mode.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Open the Bar and collect steins, repeating them for stronger powers, until you have them all for the Stein Slinging wizard mode.

steps.d: Time your plunge to send the ball into the open Bar for 10K and a beer stein.

steps.t: Bash the Bar and shoot inside
steps.d: Hit the Bar doors enough times to open them, then shoot the ball inside and pick a stein with the flippers.
Collect the same stein up to 3 times to improve its power and raise its Tent Mode multiplier.
Collect every stein in the list to start the Stein Slinging wizard mode.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Complete PROST to light side ramp locks, lock three balls, then score jackpots and super jackpots.

steps.d: Hit all five PROST standups to light locks on the side ramp.

steps.t: Lock three balls in the Beer Barrel
steps.d: Shoot the lit side ramp with the upper right flipper three times to start multiball.
Hit lit shots for jackpots; completing PROST relights all jackpots.

steps.t: Score Super and Double Super Jackpots
steps.d: During multiball, lock a second ball for the Super Jackpot and a third for the Double Super Jackpot.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Spell OKTOBERFEST to light the Corkscrew locks, lock three balls, and score jackpots and the super.

steps.d: Complete the OKTOBER and FEST standup banks to light the locks and lower the left ramp.

steps.t: Lock three balls in the Corkscrew
steps.d: Shoot the lowered left ramp three times to start multiball.
Hit the few lit shots that move across the playfield from left to right.
Spell OKTOBER or FEST to light the left ramp for the super; a last-chance super is offered at one ball.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Collect ducks to light Duck Derby, then win the race and reach the Victory Lap.

steps.d: Hit the four duck standups, win Tent Modes, or get Mystery awards to build your duck count.

steps.t: Reach 50 ducks to light Duck Derby
steps.d: Every 50 ducks lights Duck Derby at the Tent scoop.

steps.t: Start Duck Derby and advance your duck
steps.d: Shoot the scoop, then make green shots and select your duck by hitting its standup.

steps.t: Win the race for the Victory Lap
steps.d: Beat the opponent ducks to start the Victory Lap where all duck targets and lit shots score.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Hit all four ducks, then cash in at the Tent scoop for a Mystery award.

steps.d: Hit each of the four duck standups around the playfield.
Collect a Mystery award such as lighting Corkscrew lock or adding MagNab grabs.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Make the four skill shots, including the super skill shot.

steps.d: Hit the Bar (10K), Tent scoop (20K, starts a Tent Mode), or ? target (75K).

steps.t: Make the left inlane skill shot
steps.d: Score 20K to light the one-shot Super Skill Shot.
Shoot the right ramp while it is lit.

american-pinball/oktoberfest-pinball-on-.s: Qualify and play the Food Stand modes in order to build calories for multiball scoring.

steps.d: Hit the center drop target or spinner to qualify, then shoot the Food Stand scoop.

steps.t: Play Pretzels, Cake and Ice Cream
steps.d: Make orbits for Pretzels, slings and pops for Cake, and ramps for Ice Cream, in order.
Sausage combines the previous three modes; Food Coma weakens flippers until you work off calories at the spinner.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Fight one Harvester per day cycle, destroy it, and feed the Worm, leading to extra balls, DUNE letters and the Hunter-Seeker.

steps.d: Make shots to collect water, since water acts as the Harvester Battle timer.

steps.t: Start a Harvester Battle during the day
steps.d: Battle one of the 6 Harvester inserts per day cycle. A timed-out battle resumes the next day.
Hit red shots for soldiers, roving yellow shots for ornithopters, and the Worm area to damage the Harvester. Use a Lasgun on a blue shot for massive damage.
Make the final yellow shot by jumping into the area below the Harvester toy, or use a Lasgun on a lit blue shot. Destruction earns a DUNE letter.

steps.t: Feed the Worm for the sacrifice jackpot
steps.d: Collect slain soldiers on blue shots for water and feed them to the Worm before it arrives.

steps.t: Win the 2nd Harvester for an extra ball
steps.d: Destroying the 2nd Harvester awards an extra ball by default.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Complete a Harvester Battle, qualify the Hunter-Seeker with the jump ramp, then catch the roving shot.

steps.d: Finish a battle so the Hunter-Seeker insert flashes white.
With no battle ongoing, make the jump ramp shot so the ball hits the harvester switch.
Shoot the roving lit shot before it escapes at the end of the 9 positions. Avoid flipper presses and target hits to keep its value high.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Play night-time Prophecy modes, continue past the cash-out for DUNE letters and perks, and complete the hurry-up.

steps.d: Collect spice during the day, since it is consumed at the cash-out to boost the jackpot.

steps.t: Start a Prophecy mode at night
steps.d: Pick the next mode with the left or right orbit, then enter the scoop. Modes are prevented during multiball.
Finish the first part of the mode to reach the cash-out decision.

steps.t: Continue to earn a DUNE letter
steps.d: Choosing Continue reaches the second phase and gives a DUNE letter.

steps.t: Make the final hurry-up for a perk
steps.d: Shoot the last-shot hurry-up for a 5x reward and a perk for the rest of the game.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Light locks with the Thumper bumper, start at the Worm, and collect jackpots into the super jackpot.

steps.t: Activate locks at the Thumper bumper
steps.d: Hit the Thumper bumper the required number of times. After the first multiball, also hit the blue Thumper drop target.
Make the lit left and right orbits to qualify the multiball.

steps.t: Build the jackpot in the pit
steps.d: Send a ball into the desert power field and hit pit walls, spinners and the Thumper bumper to raise the jackpot.
Shoot the Worm before the jackpot decays to start the multiball.
Hit the orange jackpot shots, moving the side shots with the Worm switch for 2x, 3x or 5x.
Send a ball into the desert power field, bash the captive ball until the meter empties, then hit the spinner in the field. The first one gives a DUNE letter.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Open and lock the Sand Trap, start the multiball, and score the first jackpot for a DUNE letter.

steps.t: Hit the drop target to open the Sand Trap
steps.d: Hit the drop target the number of times shown by the red bars.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the Sand Trap
steps.d: The first ball into the Sand Trap is locked and another is auto-plunged.
Shoot the Sand Trap twice more, with the count growing for each later multiball.
Shoot the Sand Trap once more while the light flashes.
Shoot the Sand Trap, then hit the upper right ramp. The first jackpot awards a DUNE letter.
Shoot the green-lit Sand Trap to add a ball, up to 3 added.

barrels-of-fun/dune.t: Bene Gesserit Awards and Feyd's Arena
barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Collect the left ramp award each cycle, reaching Feyd Rautha's Arena Battle on the 4th award.

steps.d: Shoot the purple-lit left ramp after each day/night cycle (not the first).
It is the 4th award, replacing the first Special pool draw.
Complete a 3-shot combo ending at the side ramp while avoiding target hits and drains that lower defense.
Complete the second 3-shot combo to win and earn a DUNE letter. Keep defense at 10 for the Flawless Victory bonus.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Chain sandwalks at the side ramp to light the timed Run and earn a DUNE letter.

steps.d: Shoot the gold-lit side ramp, then continue with the left orbit.
Finish 3 sandwalks by default to light the side ramp solid gold.
Make 5 side ramp shots within the time limit to earn a DUNE letter.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Light all four DUNE letters to play the three chosen mini-wizards, then the final Voice From the Outer World.

steps.d: Earn letters from Harvesters, Prophecy continues, multiball jackpots, awards, Pain Box, the Arena, or a Run.
Shoot each of the 6 shots twice in a row, then hit the Harvester jump shot for the hurry-up.
Spin spinners to reveal lit shots and kill 6 soldiers. Then retreat to the Sietch and save Fremen.
Call the worms, ride into battle, collect all jackpots, fight the Fedaykin, break into the throne room, and defeat the Baron.

steps.t: Play Voice From the Outer World
steps.d: Relight the DUNE letters after the third mode. Trap the ball in the pit and damage Feyd; win with the final hurry-up.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Collect items from the drop targets and use them for ball saves, Harvester damage and multipliers.

steps.d: Choose an item with the right flipper and knock down all 3 drop targets before the timeout.
Shoot the yellow-lit left ramp to enable the left outlane ball save.
Press the action button to deploy all thumpers and call the worm for a worm jackpot.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Make selectable skill shots, then secret ones from the plunge.

steps.d: Choose Scoop, Sneak or Left Spinner with the right flipper and hit it with no other switch triggered.
Make the shot without flipping to double value and award.
Plunge directly into the tunnel, left outlane, center spinner, or upper right ramp.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Light the Pain Box ball save and pass the test for a DUNE letter.

steps.d: It is available at the start of ball 2 by default, or via the Rare Bene Gesserit award.

steps.t: Drain left and hold the action button
steps.d: When the ball is captured in the apron, hold the action button without flipping both flippers together.
Hit the left ramp with the new ball to complete the Pain Box and earn a DUNE letter.

barrels-of-fun/dune.s: Lock a ball in the Sand Trap and qualify a dream to collect points and permanent spice capacity.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the Sand Trap
steps.d: Lock a ball while Fedaykin Multiball is not running.
Hit the Sand Trap drop target while locked, up to 6.

steps.t: Qualify and collect the Spice Dream
steps.d: Hit the left inlane, then shoot the Sand Trap within 5 seconds.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Spell LABYRINTH to light mode start, play modes to light orbs, and play them all to unlock Goblin City.

steps.t: Spell LABYRINTH with white arrow shots
steps.d: Complete shots with white arrows to collect letters; each mode played collects more letters (one for the first, up to six for the sixth).

steps.t: Start a mode at the U-turn or wiseman scoop
steps.d: When both Mode Start lights flash, hit either side of the U-turn or the wiseman scoop if the target is down.

steps.t: Complete the mode's goal to light its orb
steps.d: Each mode has its own orb condition, such as completing Knockers, popping 5 Fiery heads, or completing 5 Oubliette doors.

steps.t: Play all three upper or all three lower modes
steps.d: Finish Knockers, Four Guards and Fireys, or Cleaners, Oubliette and Bog, to light Poisoned Peach.
Playing all six modes makes Goblin City multiball available at the left orbit.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Play a full row of modes, start Poisoned Peach, and break the spell for a time bonus.

steps.t: Play all three modes of one row
steps.d: Play Knockers, Four Guards and Fireys, or Cleaners, Oubliette and Bog, to automatically light Start Mode.
Hit either Start Mode shot or the wiseman scoop.

steps.t: Build value with ramps and collect it
steps.d: Shoot ramps (combos raise it more) and hit the Wiseman or left orbit drop target to collect the value.

steps.t: Break the spell before the clock hits 13
steps.d: Hit both drop targets 2 times each for a time-remaining bonus.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Light the locks, start multiball, and score super jackpots, which also feed orbs.

steps.t: Complete green targets to light lock
steps.d: Light lock at the left orbit first, then the center ramp.
Shoot the right orbit once lock is lit there.
Collect a jackpot to light the super jackpot on the left orbit; each relight needs one more jackpot.
Knock the captive ball into the spinner; spins increase its value.

steps.t: Collect 3 super jackpots for an orb
steps.d: Super jackpots count across multiple attempts.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Find friends, collect items and jackpots, and then play Friend Multiball.

steps.d: Complete the combo of shots for the friend until its insert is lit solid (level one needs no combo).
Hit that friend's color shots; the first jackpot needs 2 items and 10 items light extra ball.

steps.t: Collect a friend jackpot at Helping Hands
steps.d: Collecting it raises the friend's level and resets them to not found.

steps.t: Collect a jackpot for Hoggle, Ludo and Sir Didymus
steps.d: After all three, you can start Friend Multiball when the left scoop arrow flashes green.

steps.t: Collect a Friends jackpot in multiball
steps.d: Hit all three colors, then the flashing left scoop, to light the orb.
Each friend's Level 4 jackpot lights an orb.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Complete quests to earn bonus, extra ball, Wiseman Multiball and an orb.

steps.d: Knock down the drop target under the wiseman and shoot the scoop.

steps.t: Complete the quest at the scoop
steps.d: Make the required count of the random shot, then collect at the wiseman scoop; odd-numbered quests start friendzy.

steps.t: Complete two quests to light extra ball
steps.d: Collect the extra ball at the left scoop.

steps.t: Complete the fourth quest for Wiseman Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the wiseman scoop to score jackpots.

steps.t: Complete six quests to light an orb
steps.d: Collect the orb under the upper right flipper.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Light mystery, collect awards, and use one to start Tea Time Multiball.

steps.d: Hit the targets on either side of the wiseman scoop.
Shoot under the upper right flipper when lit; the third award is always an extra ball.
Hit the Ello/Worm shot when the purple arrow flashes, and hit the left-ramp hurry-up before it times out.

steps.t: Collect the third jackpot for victory laps
steps.d: Use the left ramp to collect, the orbits to increase and the U-turn to multiply tea time value.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Play all six modes, then beat the three phases of Goblin City.

steps.d: Finish all six modes to enable Goblin City at the left orbit.
Alternate shots between the two ramps and the left orbit within 10 seconds, then shoot the left ramp.
Shoot flashing blue shots four times, then lock balls in the side ramp, wiseman scoop and helping hands scoop.

steps.t: Collect 5 jackpots in the Attack Phase
steps.d: All shots are lit for jackpots and the wiseman scoop lights for super jackpot after one jackpot; five jackpots light the orb.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Collect all 13 orbs from modes, friends, multiballs and quests, then escape the Labyrinth.

steps.t: Collect orbs from modes, friends and multiballs
steps.d: Complete modes, friends, quests and multiballs to light orb collect and place multipliers on rainbow shots.
Make the multiplier assignment shot after the 13th orb.
Shoot either lit orbit to the back left corner.
Complete growing sets of yellow shots, each followed by a red shot, for six red shots.
Repeat the six red shots in order before losing all your orbs.

barrels-of-fun/labyrinth.s: Progress from basic plunges to the combo super skill shot.

steps.d: Short plunge into the Ello Worm staging area.

steps.t: Make an upper flipper skill shot
steps.d: Medium plunge to the upper flipper, then hit the change mode target, center ramp, or bridge loop.
Plunge to the end of the shooter lane wireform and drop into the scoop under the right ramp.

steps.t: Make the super skill shot combo
steps.d: Follow the Wiseman skill shot with the bridge loop.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Pick a room, travel while building shot value, then play the room's mode and complete it to earn a memento.

steps.t: Select a room with an Advance Tour shot
steps.d: Hit any shot with a lit "Advance Tour" insert to choose a room from the list. Use a key with the action button to unlock extra rooms listed as "Use Key to Unlock".
During the travel timer, hit shots, drop banks, spinners and targets lit dim white to build shot value. Combo the flashing white shots to add more.
When the timer ends you are outside the door. Hit any lit Advance Tour shot to start the mode, or use a key to skip to another room and keep your shot value.
Finish the room's requirements to light a Memento at the captive ball (lit cyan). Hit the captive ball to collect it.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Collect mementos to reach the Grand Ballroom, play Echoes through three phases, then unlock the post-Echoes Daisy Bedroom mode.

steps.d: Complete modes or other feats to light the captive ball cyan and collect mementos. Collecting three takes you to the Grand Ballroom.
In the Grand Ballroom, shoot any cyan shot to start Echoes.
Hit the red shots (2 base, plus one per angry spirit in the house), then hit the cyan spinner shot to the Stairs to Nowhere. Draining during the yellow ball save also advances.
steps.sec: Phase 1: Expel Spirits and Escape the Basement

steps.d: In the 2-ball phase, hit a blue shot to light the Door to Nowhere ramp red, then hit it to light the right ramp Super Jackpot. Drain to one ball to move on.
Make the single shot up the right ramp and behind the tower. Hitting any other switch lowers the value.
Visit the Daisy Bedroom after completing Echoes to play The Shattered Threshold and build three salt barriers.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Light the captive ball, lock a ball in the seance room, then collect jackpots up to the super and mega super jackpots.

steps.d: Hit musical instrument targets or collect spirits at the drop targets to light the captive ball green.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the seance room
steps.d: Hit the green captive ball to drop all inline targets, then shoot the seance room to lock and start multiball.
Collect jackpots at blue shots to qualify the super jackpot.
Hit the red lit captive ball to add the red super jackpot arrow at the right ramp, behind the fallen tower.

steps.t: Collect 13 jackpots for the mega super
steps.d: Collecting 13 jackpots lights a mega super jackpot at the spinner for 13 seconds.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Light OPEN, run the Wheelbarrow hurry-up for locks, then play the boiler multiball up to super and mega jackpots.

steps.d: Light all four OPEN inlanes to put pulsing cyan shots on the left and right ramps.

steps.t: Hit a lit ramp to start the hurry-up
steps.d: Hit the left or right ramp to spin the turntable and start the Wheelbarrow hurry-up timer.
Hit the cyan turntable shot to collect the remaining hurry-up value and earn a lock. On default settings your first lock starts the multiball.

steps.t: Manage the boiler and collect jackpots
steps.d: Shoot the spinner loop to raise jackpot value and lower pressure, and hit red shots to banish spirits. Survive the countdown to earn a jackpot, then hit the front hall scoop to relight the spinner.

steps.t: Collect a Super or Mega Boiler Jackpot
steps.d: This qualifies a memento at the captive ball.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Fill the five Thirteen counters to 13 each, play their mini modes, then unlock the Thirteenths wizard mode.

steps.d: Build each count: summons via the annunciator target, webs via mystery at a lit spider web, instrument targets, inner loops, and combos. The skill shot at the bottom target awards +3 to all five.
After 13 actions in a category, shoot the right orbit to start its mode. Starting several at once multiplies scoring.
Once all 13th modes have been played, the mansion floods with yellow light and Thirteenths becomes available.

steps.t: Start Thirteenths at a yellow arrow
steps.d: Hit any lit yellow arrow shot to start the multi-ball Thirteenths mode.

steps.t: Complete two sets and cash out
steps.d: Clear all five lit shots to complete a set and raise the multiplier. After two sets, press the action button to collect.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Fill the spirit meter, start 2x and 3x playfield, then collect the banked points.

steps.t: Fill the spirit meter past half
steps.d: Hit the lit spinner (lit by hitting any ramp) to fill the meter. A Mystery award, a skill shot or a memento can also fill it.
Hit the pulsing X target to start 2x and freeze your score into a bank. Hit it again for 3x.

steps.t: Collect the bank at the right orbit
steps.d: Once the meter empties, hit the right orbit within 20 seconds without draining.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Two stackable mini-modes: super-saturate the spinner and bank-and-cash-out at the right ramp.

steps.d: Hit a lit spinner while the spirit meter is already full, then keep hitting the spinner for super spinner points.
Hit your third right ramp of the game (4 for later ones) to start it.

steps.t: Cash out at the right ramp
steps.d: Switch hits build the bank. Cash out at the right ramp, with Left Ramp then Right Ramp for 2x, or Center/Side Ramp, Left Ramp, Right Ramp for 4x.

steps.t: Cash out 3 Stair Madnesses in one game
steps.d: This lights the captive ball for a wildcard memento.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Fail modes to release spirits, then battle them, survive ambushes, and clear Reckonings.

steps.t: Expel a spirit in a Spirit Battle
steps.d: During travel, hit the red shot in time to add 5 million to your next mode value.
Hit the red shot to start it, then expel 3 spirits at the red shot. Hit the blue shot early to double the value.
With three angry spirits in the house, you must play a Reckoning that plays like an Ambush. Completing it awards a wildcard memento.

barrels-of-fun/winchester-mystery-house.s: Plunge the lit drop for a skill shot, then clear the upper left bank for keys.

steps.t: Hit the lit drop target first
steps.d: Plunge the lit drop as your first switch hit for the award shown. The top is Complete OPEN, the middle Max Spirit Energy, and the bottom Advance 13ths +3.

steps.t: Complete the 3-bank to bank the award
steps.d: Hitting a drop locks in the award shown, which is given when the entire bank drops.

steps.t: Clear the upper left drops for keys
steps.d: Complete the upper left 3-bank to earn a key. You can hold up to 3.

capcom/airborne.s: Light and lock balls in any lock to start the 3-ball Air Frenzy and collect its jackpots up to the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Complete the SHOW targets to light the left saucer lock, complete the AIR targets to light the back lock, or hit both left yellow standups to qualify the left outlane lock.
Lock 3 balls in any of the locks around the playfield to start Air Frenzy.

steps.t: Collect the tower orbit and reverse scoop jackpots
steps.d: Shoot the jackpots in order: tower orbit (4M), right reverse scoop ramp (5M), then left reverse scoop ramp (6M).

steps.t: Score the right ramp Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp for 10 million. Jackpot values are doubled while three balls are in play.

capcom/airborne.s: Lock two balls in the pilot's seat, then shoot down both opposing pilots with the reverse scoop ramps.

steps.t: Make the injector skill shot or time the injector
steps.d: Use the Injector so the ball falls into the center lane, the pilot's seat, to lock a ball.
Lock 2 balls in the pilot's seat to start the 2-ball multiball.
Shoot a reverse scoop ramp three times for 1.5M jackpots; that ramp is then worth 4M.
Shoot each reverse scoop ramp three times before a ball drains.

capcom/airborne.s: Complete the airshow stunts through Spain, then shoot a lock to collect Ace payoffs and play the 4-ball wizard multiball.

steps.t: Complete the stunts in an airshow
steps.d: Finish each country's stunts in order, starting with USA, to advance countries and build Ace status.
Complete stunts toward Ace status: every 6 stunts reaches an Ace, which increases the World Frenzy payoffs.
Make each drop target, standup target, and ramp once in any order to finish Spain.
Shoot a ball into any lock to collect the Ace payoffs and start the 4-ball multiball.
Tower ramp scores 5M, a weak right ramp into a jet entrance scores 10M, and a full right ramp scores 15M.

capcom/airborne.s: Complete the AIR targets, then the SHOW targets, to start the timed mode that freezes the airshow timer.

steps.d: Complete the three AIR drop targets to qualify the SHOW targets.

steps.t: Complete the SHOW targets in time
steps.d: Complete the SHOW targets before their timer expires to start Night Flying; otherwise requalify with the AIR targets.

steps.t: Shoot lit shots during Night Flying
steps.d: Collect 500,000 for each lit shot during the 30-second mode while the airshow timer is stopped.

capcom/airborne.s: Complete all three jet entrances with the Injector to earn upgrades in order, ending with the Engine Upgrade.

steps.d: Use the Injector to send balls into the left jet, pilot's seat, and right jet entrances.
The first upgrade adds a copilot, who becomes active after the first stunt in a country.
Adds 20 seconds to the current airshow and 5 seconds to future ones.
Hit each randomly lit shot in the timed hurry-up; the first has 20 seconds and later ones 2 seconds less.
Multiplies Mach Spinner values by 3, up to 1.5 million per spin.

capcom/airborne.s: Earn Extra Balls and Specials through the left scoop, formation awards, Mystery, and Ace status.

steps.d: Each completion raises the left scoop award; the 4th level awards 5 million and lights Extra Ball.
Make all five shots, then hit the center standup; the 3rd formation lights Extra Ball and the 4th lights Special.

steps.t: Complete AIRBORNE for a Mystery award
steps.d: Hit the green standup to collect letters in AIRBORNE; Mystery can light Extra Ball or Special.
Shoot the left saucer when Extra Ball is lit.

capcom/airborne.s: Build ramp Fly-By values and spinner Mach speed for big scoring.

steps.d: Shoot the tower ramp or right ramp when it isn't lit for a stunt.
Successive Fly-Bys start at 3M and increase by 1M each, to a maximum of 6M; the highest chain earns Fly-By King.

steps.t: Reach Mach 1 and Mach 2 at the spinner
steps.d: Hit the spinner enough times to raise the value from 200k to 350k.
Keep spinning to raise the spinner value to 500k.

capcom/airborne.s: Score the injector skill shot and build the end-of-ball bonus multiplier with the JET lanes.

steps.d: Plunge and press a flipper to send the ball into the left or right jet entrance for 1M or 4M.

steps.t: Lock a ball with the skill shot
steps.d: Time the Injector to drop the ball into the pilot's seat.
Complete the three JET rollover lanes to advance the bonus multiplier.
Keep completing the JET lanes up to a maximum of 10x.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Unlock and lock three balls at the briefcase, play the multiball through its payoffs and super payoffs to light the objective.

steps.d: Shoot the three drop targets in front of the left kicker to unlock the briefcase.
Shoot the kicker behind the drop targets to lock balls; locking 3 starts Briefcase Boogie.
Shoot the flashing shots for payoffs, then the left kicker to advance a phase, up to three payoffs.
After the final green payoff, shoot the briefcase drop targets and scoop for 250k each; this lights the objective solid.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Lock three balls in the pawn shop, then work through payoffs to the super payoffs.

steps.d: Shoot the center drop targets to open the pawn shop sinkhole.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls at the pawn shop
steps.d: Shoot the sinkhole to lock balls; the third lock starts Pawn Shop Panic.

steps.t: Open and collect the pawn shop payoff
steps.d: Shoot the center drop target bank 3 times, then shoot the pawn shop for the payoff.
After the final green payoff, shoot the lit major shots for 100k each to light the objective solid.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Play the four timed Scenes and collect them, then start The Shot multiball.

steps.d: Hit it to light outlane ball save and qualify the saucer behind it.

steps.t: Start a Scene at the right saucer
steps.d: Shoot the saucer for a 40-second Scene: Twist Contest, BMF Wallet, Gold Watch or Clean the Car.

steps.t: Cash out in the final 10 seconds
steps.d: Shoot the saucer in the last 10 seconds to collect the built value plus prior collects.
Complete all four Scenes to make The Shot available.
Shoot the saucer for the untimed 4-ball multiball; right drop target shots score payoffs. This completes the objective.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Qualify and collect all five characters to start Cast Chaos multiball.

steps.d: Drop into the top saucer via the skill shot or an unlit orbit to qualify a flashing character.

steps.t: Collect characters at the right saucer
steps.d: Shoot the saucer behind the right drop target to collect qualified characters; hit the left standup for hold cast.
Collecting all five starts Cast Chaos 4-ball multiball and completes the objective.

steps.t: Score the Cast Chaos super payoff
steps.d: Shoot all five lit shots for 100k, then the top hole for the 500k Super Payoff.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Spell PULP FICTION with target bank completions, then play the switch-hit multiball.

steps.d: During single-ball play, complete the left or right standups or center drop targets to add letters.
Reach 11 target bank completions to complete the title.
Shoot the pawn shop to start the 4-ball multiball and complete the objective.
Score 99 switch hits to spell the title again, then shoot the lit pawn shop.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Complete all five objectives, then survive and finish all six phases to double your score.

steps.d: Finish the objectives above the flippers: Briefcase Boogie, Pawn Shop Panic, Roll Scene, Cast Chaos and Pulp Fiction Frenzy.
Shoot the left kicker or the saucer behind the right drop target.
Briefcase, pawn shop x3, right drop target x5, top saucer x5, all seven red arrows, then the target above the bullseye magnet.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Complete the 1-2-3-4 lanes to score the hurry-up and cash in bonus and super spinners.

steps.d: Light all four lanes to raise the bonus multiplier and light the far-left yellow standup.

steps.t: Score the Royale with Cheese hurry-up
steps.d: Hit the lit yellow standup on the far left.
Shoot the spinners, worth 1k per spin after the hurry-up.
Shoot the target above the bullseye magnet to collect gun bonus.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Raise playfield X and light extra ball through lanes or MPH bonus.

steps.d: Shoot the two flashing standups near the bumpers during single-ball play.
Hit the target above the bullseye magnet to add +1x playfield multiplier, up to 6x.
Roll the lit 3 or 4 lane and shoot the lit opposite orbit repeatedly.

steps.t: Collect 146+ MPH to light extra ball
steps.d: Collect the MPH bonus at the hidden standup near the pawn shop; then shoot the right standup near the bumpers.

chicago-gaming/pulp-fiction.s: Make the skill shot, then the super skill shot.

steps.d: Plunge with as many arrows lit as possible; 3k each, 100k for all 5.
Hold the left flipper while plunging, then hit a Payoff shot before the timer expires for 100k.

data-east/robocop.s: Complete standup banks to light locks, lock three balls at the right ramp, start multiball, collect the jackpot, then light the Special.

steps.t: Complete a standup bank to light a lock
steps.d: Complete a bank of standups, which lights a lock and raises the spinner value. Spinner and top lanes help: an unlit top lane whose color matches an uncompleted target spots you one standup of that color.

steps.t: Lock three balls at the right ramp
steps.d: When suspect inserts are lit at the right ramp, shoot it once for each lit suspect to lock 3 balls.

steps.t: Start multiball and build the jackpot
steps.d: Once the third ball locks, multiball starts. Shoot the spinner at least once and get bounces off standups to raise the jackpot toward its 1M max.
Shoot the ramp for the jackpot. Only 1 jackpot is available per multiball.
After the jackpot, if Special is set to points, shoot 5 targets during multiball to light Special at the ramp, then shoot it for 1M.

data-east/robocop.s: Plunge for the lit lane, then lane-change so the ball goes through an unlit insert lane.

steps.t: Plunge to the lit lane between the lit lane guides
steps.d: Plunge for the lane surrounded by two lit lane guides. If the center or left lane is lit, power plunge.

steps.t: Lane-change into an unlit insert lane
steps.d: Use lane-change so the ball goes through an unlit insert lane for 100K x ball in play. The lit lane guides cannot be changed.

data-east/robocop.t: Double Playfield and Everything is Lit
data-east/robocop.s: Use the right ramp and jump ramps to start Double Playfield and light Everything is Lit, which lights Special.

steps.d: Make two consecutive right ramp shots. This is based on switches, not a timer.
Make enough cumulative successful jump ramps in your game to tie the Jumpmaster record (default 14, as low as 5).

steps.t: Collect Special at the right ramp
steps.d: Special on the right ramp is worth 1M if set to points. It can be lit by Everything is Lit or during phase 2 of multiball.

data-east/robocop.s: Complete a standup bank, bounce into the cycling crosshair targets to start ED209, then cash in at the right ramp.

steps.d: Completing a bank makes a lit crosshair insert cycle between the targets.
Bounce into enough standups (4 on default) to start ED209 mode. Don't aim for them.
During ED209's short timer, quickly shoot the right ramp for 1M.

gottlieb/shaq-attaq-rules.s: Qualify all four modes and Multiball without starting them, then start them together at the ramp for the Multimode level 5 hidden feature.

steps.t: Qualify the four main modes and Multiball
steps.d: Use the first two balls to qualify all 4 modes and Multiball, and avoid starting any of them so they can run simultaneously.

steps.t: Plunge for Alley Oop to save mode start
steps.d: Plunge a ball for Alley Oop when you want to hold off the mode start. Each Alley Oop shot also awards 1 Game Ball.

steps.t: Shoot the ramp to start the modes
steps.d: With all 4 modes and Multiball qualified, shoot the ramp to start them together. A hidden feature appears at mode start.
Run all 4 regular modes and Multiball at the same time. This counts as a hidden feature.

gottlieb/shaq-attaq-rules.s: Relock balls in the ramp during Multiball to score Jackpot and light Super Jackpot, ending with a hidden feature.

steps.d: Qualify Multiball and start it, ideally alongside the running modes.

steps.t: Relock all balls in the ramp
steps.d: During the modes, relock all balls into the ramp. Any Regular Multiball relock awards Jackpot and lights Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Relock all active Multiballs in the ramp
steps.d: Relock all active Multiballs in the ramp during regular Multiball to earn a hidden feature.

gottlieb/shaq-attaq-rules.s: Play the four main modes, stock up on Game Balls, then start the Finals and choose your risk level.

steps.d: Complete the 1-2-3-4-5 feature, shoot Alley Oop and hit the Vari Target. Always say NO to a trade.
Playing all four main modes lights the Finals.

steps.t: Start the Finals with 5+ Game Balls
steps.d: Answer the risk prompt. No is worth 100M. Yes lets you spend 5 Game Balls for 300M or 10 for 500M.

gottlieb/shaq-attaq-rules.s: Find hidden features for escalating end-of-game awards from 10M up to 1B.

steps.d: Take the 5000 offer twice in Tip Off (3 times on Hard). Tournament Mode always offers it first on each ball.
Hit the Drop Targets after 5X to get a Rebound.

steps.t: Get a ball into the Hole in Drop Target MVP mode
steps.d: Put a ball into the Hole during Drop Target MVP mode.
Finding 1 to 5 hidden features awards 10M, 30M, 100M, 300M or 1B at End of Game.

gottlieb/shaq-attaq-rules.s: Build up Game Balls through the 1-2-3-4-5 feature and refuse trades until you hit exactly 14.

steps.d: Complete 1-2-3-4-5 to earn Game Balls. Hit the Vari Target for more.

steps.t: Say NO to the trade prompt at 5
steps.d: Keep saying NO to the trade prompt until you have exactly 14 Game Balls.

steps.t: Reach 14 Game Balls for Double Your Score
steps.d: Having exactly 14 Game Balls awards Double Your Score.

gottlieb/shaq-attaq-rules.s: Spell SHAQUILLE and enter Tip Off to start a three-ball wizard mode.

steps.d: Complete the letters of SHAQUILLE.

steps.t: Shoot the Tip Off hole to start Slammin Jammin
steps.d: Enter the Tip Off hole after spelling SHAQUILLE. This starts a three-ball wizard mode where each switch scores 5M (3M Hard, 10M Easy).

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Hit major shots three times to start Sivako challenges, complete them for meuia and a PANDORA letter, and play all eight.

steps.d: Hit one of the eight major shots (e.g. Spider target, left ramp, left orbit) three times to start its Sivako mode.
Finish the mode's objective, such as surviving 30 seconds in Spider or hitting the roving shot twice in Omatikaya. This awards a time bonus and a PANDORA letter.

steps.t: Replay the starting shot for meuia
steps.d: After completing one, hit the shot that started it three times again to get +5 meuia.
Play every Sivako mode; they cannot repeat until all eight have been played.

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Find tokens with shots to light the left scoop, play A1 and A2 songcord modes, and earn PANDORA letters toward the wizard mode.

steps.d: Make shots to find tokens; press the action button to scrap unwanted ones.

steps.t: Start a songcord mode at the left scoop
steps.d: Once enough tokens are found, the left scoop lights to start a mode based on those tokens.
Finish an Omatikaya (A1) or Metkayina (A2) mode to award a PANDORA letter.

steps.t: Play three modes in one set
steps.d: Play three modes in the same songcord set (A1 or A2).

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Lock three balls for A1 multiball, then work through its jackpot sequence to the super jackpot for a PANDORA letter.

steps.d: Complete Jake & Neytiri's center targets to light the lock at the infinity mirror.
steps.sec: Battle of the Hallelujah Mountains (A1 Multiball):

steps.d: Lock balls at the left orbit, upper loop, or right orbit, or via the infinity mirror lockup.
steps.sec: Battle of the Hallelujah Mountains (A1 Multiball):

steps.d: Hit the flashing red shot: Jake/Neytiri targets, reverse scoop, scoop, home tree VUK, spider target.
Hit the RDA ramp for the super jackpot, which awards a PANDORA letter.
steps.sec: Battle of the Hallelujah Mountains (A1 Multiball):

steps.d: Lock all 3 balls again for each next stage.
steps.sec: Battle of the Hallelujah Mountains (A1 Multiball):

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Raise the scoop ramp, defeat RDA's crab suit on the lower playfields to start A2 multiball, and score the super jackpot.

steps.d: Hit a lowered scoop ramp entrance to raise it and enable the dive shot.
Shoot the raised scoop ramp from the lower flippers, then complete the targets above the Pandora reef pop bumper.
On the second playfield, hit targets and orbits to defeat the crab suit and start multiball.
Work through the jackpot sequence to the RDA ramp super jackpot for a PANDORA letter.
Defeat the tougher crab suits in stages two and three.

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Build meuia through shots and collect awards at the home tree VUK up to eclipse and extra ball.

steps.d: Meuia rises with every shot; skill shots and the high camp loop add more.
Shoot the lit home tree VUK once enough honor is earned.
Cash in 50 meuia, or get three PANDORA letters or enough tulkun ramp shots.
Cash in 100 meuia to start eclipse.
Hit the right ramp for an eclipse jackpot of 5M+ to earn a PANDORA letter.

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Complete EYWA for a mystery award and find all eight bonds for the bond jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the two targets flanking the upper left ramp four times total.
Shoot the lit upper left ramp for a mystery award.
Shoot lit shots in quick succession to establish each of the eight bonds.
Combo into the scoop for the bond jackpot and a PANDORA letter.

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Earn PANDORA letters from many features, then complete the seven tasks twice in the wizard mode.

steps.d: Complete modes, score a super jackpot, cash out 25 meuia, or collect an eclipse or bond jackpot.

steps.t: Start Eywa’Eveng at the left scoop
steps.d: Spell all of PANDORA to light the wizard mode at the left scoop.
Finish tasks P, A, N, D, O, R, A; each scores a jackpot and lights a letter.
Light all seven letters for a super jackpot.

jersey-jack/avatar-the-battle-for-pandor.s: Plunge to skill shot targets, then use the action button super skill shot for bonus awards.

steps.d: Plunge to a listed shot to add +1 meuia to that shot for the ball.
Press the action button to enable it, then hit your chosen shot for its award and a longer ball save.
Score the left outlane super skill shot, or play a Sivako or songcord mode.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Charge the phone with QED shots, start and complete disaster modes, and collect SIM Cards, leading to Armageddon after all 11 are played.

steps.t: Charge the phone by hitting the QED
steps.d: Hit the QED to charge the phone and light a mode at the phone scoop. Later modes need up to 4 QED shots.

steps.t: Start a Disaster Mode at the phone scoop
steps.d: Shoot the green-lit phone scoop. Use the flipper buttons to choose which mode icon starts next.
Make all required mode shots, or use Big Bang to insta-complete. This scores the 30K completion bonus and lights a SIM Card.

steps.t: Collect the SIM Card at the side scoop
steps.d: Shoot the lit side scoop before the ball ends. SIM Cards multiply the scoring of future modes.

steps.t: Play all 11 disaster modes to qualify Armageddon
steps.d: Play all 11 disaster modes, then shoot the phone scoop to start Armageddon.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Collect SIM Cards to spell D-I-A-L-E-D-I-N, then start Showdown and defeat D.I.E.

steps.t: Complete a disaster mode to light a SIM Card
steps.d: Completing disaster modes or quick multiball requirements lights a SIM Card for collection.

steps.t: Collect SIM Cards at the side scoop
steps.d: Collect lit SIM Cards at the scoop below the Side Ramp. Each one lights the next D-I-A-L-E-D-I-N letter.
Collect 8 SIM Cards to qualify the Showdown wizard mode.
Shoot the Theatre to begin a multiball with unlimited ball save and health meters for you and D.I.E.
Hit the red-lit jackpot arrows to drain D.I.E.'s health, while avoiding losing balls. Then score victory laps.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Light lock, lock balls, start the multiball, and score jackpots and Super Jackpots by repelling attacks.

steps.t: Light lock by shooting both ramps
steps.d: Shoot both ramps to light lock at the side ramp. Later rounds need the ramps shot as a combo.

steps.t: Lock balls at the side ramp
steps.d: Lock the required number of balls (1 to 3, rising each time) to light the multiball.

steps.t: Start Under Attack Multiball at the phone scoop
steps.d: Shoot the phone scoop while it is lit. No Disaster Mode can start while UAMB is lit.

steps.t: Collect jackpots on the red arrows
steps.d: Hit the Left Orbit, Left Ramp, Theatre and Right Ramp. The Side Ramp is worth 2x.

steps.t: Repel an attack to score a Super Jackpot
steps.d: Once the Super Jackpot is qualified, hit the origin of an attack line (QED, Theatre or Pop Bumper Target).

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Collect Kilowatts, Spiders, Drones and Transits to start four features, then play the multiball for the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Build and collect awards at the Theatre
steps.d: Hit QED, the Spider target, the Drone target or any ramp to build values. Collect at the Theatre when the matching image shows.

steps.t: Collect 2 of an item to start its feature
steps.d: 2 Kilowatts start Kilowatt Drops, 2 Spiders start Spider Spinner, 2 Drones start Drone Captive Ball, and 2 Transits start Train Bash.
Starting all four features qualifies the Theater for Quantum Theater Multiball.
Shoot the Theater. It can start even during other multiballs.

steps.t: Collect all four jackpot types for the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collect jackpots at the ramps, Spider target, Drone target and QED. Then shoot the Theater for the Super Jackpot.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Complete the B-O-B targets to light Crazy Bob's and cycle through Crazy Modes, bonus multipliers, quick multiballs and extra ball.

steps.d: Each completion lights the kickback and lights Crazy Bob's. Up to 3 are stacked.

steps.t: Collect Crazy Bob's for a Crazy Mode
steps.d: The first award is a Crazy Mode: Emoji Overload, Selfie, or Lottery Frenzy.

steps.t: Collect Crazy Bob's for a Quick Multiball
steps.d: Every other odd collect starts a quick multiball: Drones Gone Wild, High Voltage, or Quick Monkey Wrench.
Drones Gone Wild needs 3 super jackpots, High Voltage 15 jackpots, and Monkey Wrench 3 jackpots. This lights a SIM Card.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Make the plunge skill shot, then the super and super duper skill shots from the upper flipper.

steps.t: Make the skill shot behind the theater
steps.d: Drop the ball just behind the theater and take the lit insert's award. The first scores 5000, each later one 500 more.
After the skill shot, hit the side ramp from the upper flipper.

steps.t: Make the Super Duper Skill Shot
steps.d: Hit the Scoop/SIM Card from the upper flipper for the biggest award.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Collect drone deliveries or a Drone Combo to light and collect the Drone Mystery award at the Theatre.

steps.d: Drone Standup hits give 2 deliveries and Drone Rubber hits give 1.

steps.t: Complete a Drone Combo to light the Mystery award sooner
steps.d: Go through the lit inner left inlane and immediately hit the Drone Target.

steps.t: Collect the Drone Mystery award at the Theatre
steps.d: Once all delivery lights are filled, collect the award at the Theatre.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Hit Light Big Bang targets to light Big Bang and use it to score big or insta-complete modes and jackpots.

steps.t: Hit the Light Big Bang targets
steps.d: The first Big Bang needs 3 hits, rising by 1 each time up to 6.
Scores 50K (rising by 10K) in the base game.

steps.t: Use Big Bang during a mode or multiball
steps.d: In a disaster mode it completes the mode; in a multiball it scores all lit jackpots.

jersey-jack/dialed-in-rulesheet-wiki.s: Chain major shots into combos to light extra ball, with other routes to extra ball.

steps.d: Link orbits, ramps and the phone, following the blinking yellow arrows to keep the combo going.

steps.t: Reach 35 combos to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Extra Ball lights at the trap door after 35 combos, and again after 100.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Light and make locks at the crocodile, start the multiball, score super jackpots and earn a milestone toward Final Tour.

steps.t: Light lock at the Tiny Dancer target
steps.d: Shoot the Tiny Dancer target on the left side to light lock at the crocodile VUK. Selecting Adv. Croc MB on a skill shot also lights or awards a lock.
Lock 2 balls the first time (3 on later plays) at the crocodile VUK to start Crocodile Rock Multiball.

steps.t: Score jackpots to light the super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the flashing shots for jackpots until the crocodile lights for a super jackpot.

steps.t: Score super jackpots for the Crocodile Rock milestone
steps.d: Collect two super jackpots, or one 2x super jackpot by locking a second ball within 10 seconds, to earn a milestone.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Collect fuel, start Rocket Man Multiball, build perks and score the super jackpot for milestone progress.

steps.t: Collect fuel to fill the first tank
steps.d: Complete tasks around the game to add fuel; making the rocket adds 50 units. The first tank takes 500 units.
Shoot the lit rocket kicker once the tank is full.
Each 100 units grants a perk; 300 units adds a ball and awards a milestone, and 400 units lights all jackpots permanently.
Shoot 7 unique jackpot shots to light the super jackpot at the rocket kicker, then collect it.

steps.t: Start with all fuel tanks for the milestone
steps.d: Start Rocket Man Multiball with all fuel tanks to earn the Rocket Man milestone.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Spell ELTON JOHN, lock balls in the piano, play each tour multiball, and reach Super Stardom.

steps.t: Spell ELTON JOHN to light lock
steps.d: Collect all 9 stars at the 9 major shots, or spell STAR in the inlanes/outlanes to spot a letter.
Make the side ramp locks, then pick a Signature Stage multiball with the action button.

steps.t: Score jackpots in the tour multiball
steps.d: Shoot the lit jackpot shots in 1970 Hollywood, 1975 Los Angeles, 2009 Las Vegas or 2023 London.

steps.t: Loop the side ramp for super jackpots
steps.d: After enough jackpots, loop the side ramp to score super jackpots with a growing multiplier; a 3x super jackpot earns a milestone.

steps.t: Play all four Signature Stage multiballs
steps.d: Start all four tours in one game to light Super Stardom.
Shoot the side ramp when the E-ticket flashes; this awards a milestone.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Fill the Rocka-Box for albums, unlock and play all five encore modes, then start Champ Multiball.

steps.t: Collect an album at the drop targets
steps.d: Fill the 9 squares at the center drop targets, or full-plunge into a drop target for the skill shot.
The fifth album award unlocks the encore modes.

steps.t: Start and play each encore mode
steps.d: Hit the Tiny Dancer 8 times, shoot 6 orbits, backstage 5 times, spin spinners 1000 times, or shoot the piano ramp 5 times.
Finish all five encore modes to qualify Champ Multiball.
Shoot the side ramp when the E-ticket flashes.
Complete the jackpot grid, then shoot the left saucer, crocodile or rocket for the super jackpot; drop targets raise its value.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Progress song note levels to collect all wardrobe items for Victory Laps and the Song milestone.

steps.t: Collect notes to complete a song level
steps.d: Shoot the lit note shots until the level counter is done, advancing Yellow, Orange, then Red.

steps.t: Collect a wardrobe item at Backstage
steps.d: Shoot the Backstage shot (inner loop) to collect the lit item; the first starts Double Song.

steps.t: Collect the second item for Double Notes
steps.d: Collect a second wardrobe item for 2x progress on the next 5 note shots.

steps.t: Collect all three items for Victory Laps
steps.d: The third item makes all shots score 3M+ for the rest of the song and earns the Song milestone.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Complete hurry-ups to earn kickbacks and a milestone.

steps.d: Shoot the target near the left eject.
Shoot the left eject, then the random lit shot from the left flipper to score the value and qualify a kickback.
Complete three hurry-ups for a milestone; later ones need more target shots, up to 3.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Make 3-shot combos for a milestone and then an extra ball.

steps.d: Make a recognized 3-shot combo; the first shot lights follow-up stars yellow. This counts as a milestone.
Repeat the yellow-lit final shot to collect Combo Extended.
This lights extra ball at the Tiny Dancer target.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Make the plunge skill shots and then the super skill shot.

steps.d: Time the plunge so the lit insert is selected as the ball passes the opto.
Short plunge and shoot the backstage shot or side ramp for an added perk.
Full-plunge and shoot any drop target to collect an album.

jersey-jack/elton-john.s: Earn four unique milestones to unlock Final Tour, then cash out regions and finish at the side ramp.

steps.d: Complete any four of the ten milestones such as Jukebox, Combos, Song, Honky Cat, Crocodile Rock or Rocket Man.
Shoot the side ramp when the E-ticket flashes.
Shoot lit city shots and press the action button to cash out Europe, Australia, Baltic and North America.

steps.t: Shoot the lit side ramp to finish
steps.d: After all regions are cashed out, the side ramp awards the total again.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Collect all seven band members, lock balls, and shoot the center scoop to start a song, with an optional song choice.

steps.d: Make each member's shot enough times (Axl: A-X-L lanes, Slash: record spins, Duff: left ramp, Richard: center spinner, Melissa/Dizzy: keyboard inserts, Frank: jets or right ramp) until the revolver inserts turn solid.
Spell J-A-M at the right inlane, then hit the JAM target by the scoop to collect 1 to 6 missing members.
After collecting a member, shoot the lock shot (LE) or the left ramp twice (Pro). More locks raise song start value and ball save.
Hit an album standup target to change the song, or use the action button just before it starts (costs 15 song level).

steps.t: Start a song at the center scoop
steps.d: With all seven members collected, shoot the center scoop. Locking all 6 balls also starts the song automatically.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Progress through song stages, cash in the Applause Jackpot, and keep the Rock-It Meter full to earn Encores.

steps.d: Make the lit shots or required switch hits until the center scoop flashes green/white, then hit the scoop to advance and add a ball.
Make lit shots during the song to raise the meter and avoid cradling the ball, or the song ends early.
Shoot each band member's lit shot to boost every member; Band Frenzy then raises the Song Jackpot for each switch hit.
Shoot the scoop during the last 10 seconds of the song.
Complete the song with the Rock-It Meter full; the next album song plays with Song Level, scoring and locks carried over.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Start each of the four Booster Multiballs and max them out to boost your song.
