steps.d: Spell NOISE with skill shots, then shoot under the upper right flipper when Noise is lit.
Hit the Lights target on the upper playfield 3 times in a row (LE/CE), or make successive left ramp shots (SE).
Hit the Pyro target behind the spinning record four times.
Complete A-M-P at the far left inlane, then complete the hurry-ups to light jackpots.
Score a super jackpot in a Booster Multiball for +50 Song Level.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Play enough songs from an album to qualify its Album Mode, then complete it for a bonus.

steps.d: Playing a minimum of 3:00 of songs from one album qualifies its Album Mode and a silver record.
Hit the robot with lit shots, repeating shots up to three times, and press the action button for the power attack.
Wipe out all 7 band member racers by shooting their lit shots and using the action button for turbo.
Shoot lit shots to raise poster multipliers, then use the action button to destroy undamaged posters with the cannon.

steps.t: Finish Shall We Play a Game?
steps.d: Shoot blue/white shots to build a streak while avoiding red/yellow shots.
Play more songs from the same album to upgrade the record and increase Album Mode scoring.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Collect patches for benefits, then complete patch sets for bigger rewards.

steps.d: Spell G-N-R on the left inlane, or drain from the upper playfield on the LE.

steps.t: Collect a patch for song level
steps.d: Collect the patch tied to a song for +30 Song Level.
Collect all patches in a set, such as Vater, Marshall, Gibson, Fender to light Extra Ball.
Collecting all four album patches gives 2X Album Levels.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Spell GUNS N ROSES to light Mystery at the center scoop.

steps.d: Shoot the GNR logos around the playfield to spell GUNS N ROSES.
Shoot the lit center scoop for an award such as patches, extra ball, locks, or a song start.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Earn Coma ball save, empty the IV bag, and hit two shots to start Coma Multiball.

steps.d: Hit the Coma target multiple times to light Coma as the left outlane.
When Coma starts, hit 100 switches to empty the IV bag.
Hit the two lit shots within 40 seconds.
Hit the lit shots for jackpots.

jersey-jack/guns-n-roses-jjp.s: Collect cities with the loops, play On the Road, and visit all cities to qualify Tour Multiball.

steps.d: Shoot the left, right and inner upper flipper loops to collect cities on the map.
Hit a certain number of cities to start the timed mode with the loops lit.

steps.t: Visit all cities to qualify Tour Multiball
steps.d: Visit all 53 cities to qualify Tour Multiball.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Start school-year lessons, finish all ten, play the Final Exam, then start O.W.L.s Multiball and score its super jackpot.

steps.t: Light and start a school term at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop when lit to start a term; if Start Term isn't lit, shoot the spinners to light it. Pick the year with the flippers and action button.

steps.t: Complete lessons by hitting their shots
steps.d: Finish each lesson's shots before the hourglass runs out; a time bonus is awarded for each lesson completed. The right time-turner spinner adds time.

steps.t: Play all 10 lessons and start Final Exam
steps.d: After 10 lessons are played, shoot the scoop to start the Final Exam, which has six more lessons.

steps.t: Start O.W.L.s Multiball at the center lane
steps.d: After the Final Exam, shoot the center lane to start this 2-ball multiball with a 30-second ball saver.
Shoot 5 red jackpot shots to light the super jackpot. 65 switches light triple jackpot.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Spot all eight banners, start the multiball, and score the super jackpot to earn the Ring horcrux.

steps.t: Spot banners with center and right ramps
steps.d: Shoot the center ramp for left banners and the right ramp for right banners of the indicated colors. Green and yellow are already spotted at game start.
Once all eight banners are spotted, shoot the right ramp to start the multiball.
Shoot lit Secret Passages, Classrooms, Castle Grounds, or Towers jackpots. Four jackpots light the super jackpot at a roving shot.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot for the Ring horcrux
steps.d: Shoot the roving super jackpot shot; extra jackpots raise its value. It stays lit after the multiball if not yet scored.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Light and lock three balls at the wand, start the multiball, then earn the wand jackpots and super jackpot for the Cup horcrux.

steps.t: Spell HARRY, RON and HERMIONE to light locks
steps.d: Complete the return lanes, left standup targets, and Hermione targets; each spellout lights one lock at the wand.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start Golden Trio
steps.d: Shoot the lit wand lock at the right orbit and inner loop three times to start the multiball.

steps.t: Score three same-color jackpots for a wand jackpot
steps.d: Collect three jackpots of one color (two with Easier Wand Jackpots), then shoot the lit right orbit, center lane, or inner loop for the wand jackpot.
The second wand jackpot scores 2x and the third scores 3x.

steps.t: Re-lock balls and hit the super jackpot
steps.d: Within 45 seconds, lock the remaining balls and shoot the randomly chosen super jackpot shot for the Cup horcrux.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Defeat Death Eaters to light and start the multiball, which earns the Nagini horcrux and an extra ball.

steps.d: Shoot the left drop target in front of the Death Eater to light the battle.
Shoot the hole behind the drop target twice in 20 seconds for 20M. The first defeat per game lights an extra ball.

steps.t: Defeat the second Death Eater and start the multiball
steps.d: Defeating the second Death Eater lights the hole; shoot it to start Death Eater Multiball, which earns the Nagini horcrux.
Progress through hurry-up, green jackpots, and the right-side super jackpots, then the red-shot frenzy.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Take Quidditch tryouts, win three matches, start the World Cup multiball, and score the loopable super jackpot for the Diadem horcrux.

steps.t: Make the first left ramp to start tryouts
steps.d: The first left ramp shot of the game starts Quidditch tryouts and sets your position, which can be advanced via upper playfield shots.
After tryouts, make enough spinner hits on the upper playfield to start a match.

steps.t: Catch the Golden Snitch in three matches
steps.d: Shoot the lit snitch insert or the left ramp during a match, once per rival house. Each snitch is worth 150 Quidditch points.
After three snitches, shoot the left ramp to start the multiball.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot for the Diadem
steps.d: Collect five green or red jackpots, then shoot the upper playfield ramp, looping it for up to 5x.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Play four different multiballs to qualify and then complete the Battle of Hogwarts stages.

steps.d: Play four of the five: Explore Hogwarts, Golden Trio, Death Eater, Quidditch World Cup, and O.W.L.s.
Once qualified, begin this multi-stage mode, which starts with 6 balls in stage 1.

steps.t: Complete badge features to advance stages
steps.d: Complete 3 to 5 feature badges (spinners, targets, ramps, jets, orbits) per stage. Stages 1, 2 and 3 award 25M, 50M and 75M.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Earn the Cloak, Stone and Wand to light the mode, then collect all three items for the Harry horcrux.

steps.d: Spell H-A-R-R-Y at the return lanes 3 times.
Earn 200 Quidditch points.
Complete 4 lessons in a school year term.

steps.t: Start Deathly Hallows at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop once all three Hallows are collected. You get 90 seconds and 18 seconds of ball save.

steps.t: Collect cloak, stone and wand for the Harry horcrux
steps.d: Shoot 5 blue, 5 purple and 5 red shots. The third item awards 100M times the multiplier and the Harry horcrux.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Collect all seven horcruxes, then destroy them in movie order and defeat Voldemort.

steps.d: Visit Flourish & Blotts at Diagon Alley and succeed at spell training.
Collect 10 total allies through the allies target.
Score super jackpots in Explore Hogwarts (Ring), Golden Trio (Cup) and Quidditch World Cup (Diadem), and start Death Eater multiball (Nagini).
Collect all 3 Deathly Hallows in the Deathly Hallows mini-wizard mode.

steps.t: Start The Boy Who Lived at the center lane
steps.d: With all seven horcruxes collected, shoot the center lane to start the wizard mode.

steps.t: Destroy all seven horcruxes and defeat Voldemort
steps.d: Destroy the horcruxes in movie order with their colored shots, then fight Voldemort in the final battle.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Hit the allies target to play the four timed ally modes and earn the Locket horcrux.

steps.d: Shoot the allies target below the inner loop to qualify a timed mode at the inner loop or right orbit.

steps.t: Play an inner loop or right orbit ally mode
steps.d: Shoot the inner loop for Luna Loves Loops or Hexes & Jinxes, or the right orbit for Loopin' Lupin or Heart's Desire.
Keep hitting the allies target, playing all 4 timed modes along the way, to reach 10 allies.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Light Diagon Alley with the center lane, pick a shop, and use its perks.

steps.t: Shoot the center lane to light Diagon Alley
steps.d: Shoot the center lane three times (+1 per shop, up to six) to access a shop.
Hit the Hagrid target or press the action button to change the lit shop.
Choose from Ollivander's, Flourish & Blotts, Owl Post, Weasley's Wizard Wheezes, or Borgin & Burkes.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Light and use Fawkes and Protego, and trigger Potter Frenzy by spelling HARRY.

steps.d: Spell HARRY at the inlanes to light the right outlane Protego save.

steps.t: Light Fawkes with right orbit shots
steps.d: Shoot the right orbit enough times to light the left outlane.
Drain left and hit three unique shots in 20 seconds. A super jackpot is available after all three.
Spell HARRY at the return lanes 4 times for 40 seconds of random-value switches.

jersey-jack/harry-potter.s: Build combos to advance wizard travel and light extra balls from several sources.

steps.t: Make combos to light the scoop travel insert
steps.d: Hit lit shots in quick succession, then shoot the scoop when the insert flashes to collect the travel award.
Level 3 (Flying Car) lights an extra ball.
Shoot the hole behind the upper flipper. Other sources: level 3 skill shot, Death Eater defeat, Potions, or Deathly Hallows.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Qualify a mode through one of the six shots, start it from the right ramp, and eventually earn an Arkenstone Mode.

steps.d: While not in a mode, shoot the left ramp (Gandalf), right ramp (Bilbo), right VUK (Radagast), or complete the ELF, DWARF or MAN banks.

steps.t: Cycle to a mode with BOOK
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp when BOOK is lit to move to the next qualified mode.
Shoot the right ramp when MODE is lit. Modes can't start if a Smaug lock is lit or the start is postponed.
In timed modes, shoot the left ramp when TIME is lit blue for 10 seconds, or purple for 3 seconds.

steps.t: Complete a mode and earn an Arkenstone Mode
steps.d: Complete a mode, start Smaug and Beast Frenzy Multiballs, start Super Spinners, and collect all dwarves to light an Arkenstone Mode.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Light locks with the LOCK rollovers, lock balls at the right ramp, then play a 3-ball multiball for jackpots.

steps.d: Hit the center LOCK rollovers to qualify a lock. The first multiball qualifies all 3 locks at once.

steps.t: Lock balls at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit lock on the right ramp. The ball is virtually locked and Smaug sends it out the left VUK.
After the 3 locks are made, the 3-ball multiball begins with a minor ball save.
Shoot the lit Loops, VUKs, Ramps and Captive ball for 3,500 each. Jackpots re-light once all are collected.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Light the inlanes, defeat all four beasts in hurry-ups, then play Beast Frenzy Multiball.

steps.d: Roll over unlit inlanes or shoot each beast's shot (Right Ramp, Right Orbit, Left Orbit, Left Ramp). Later rounds need the shots.
Go through a lit inlane to raise a beast, then hit it with its bash target.
Bash the Warg, Orc, Goblin and Spider targets to start Beast Frenzy Multiball.
Hit beasts for 1,000 each, and trap them up to change them for mode shots.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Collect all 13 dwarves to start Feast Frenzy.

steps.d: Hit the touch targets behind the drop banks, the spinners, the left VUK (Balin), and the captive ball (Thorin).
Hit each dwarf shot to start Feast Frenzy.

steps.t: Score drop targets in Feast Frenzy
steps.d: Hit the drop targets for points before it ends, then collect the dwarves again.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Spin the spinners to reach Erebor, then cash in the Super Spinner jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the left and right spinners for 11 points per spin and to progress the map toward Erebor.

steps.t: Reach Erebor to start Super Spinners
steps.d: Keep spinning until the trail reaches Erebor, starting Super Spinners for 60 seconds.

steps.t: Cash in the Super Spinner jackpot
steps.d: Build the jackpot by spinning, then shoot the captive ball to collect it and end the mode.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Cross a left and right inlane to advance the Mystery through four levels.

steps.d: Pass through one left inlane and one right inlane, then hit the Mystery target for an award.

steps.t: Spot a dwarf with the Captive Ball
steps.d: With Mystery lit, shoot the blue captive ball to spot a dwarf.
With the left outlane lit, stop the power meter with the Ring at the next mode start and hit the MAN bank from the kickback.
Drain through the lit right outlane and stop the line in the blue region to keep playing.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Build pop bumper hits into Super Jets, then kick over dwarves toward the Extra Ball.

steps.d: Shoot the Bag End pop bumpers enough times.
Use the upper right flipper to hit the flashing DWARF target and kick over barrels.
With Extra Ball lit, hit both the Left and Right VUKs.

jersey-jack/hobbit-pinball.s: Make one of the four skill shots at ball launch.

steps.d: Hit the raised DWARF drop target for 10,000 plus 1,500 per prior success.
Hit the gold LOCK rollovers for 1,500 (+500 per success) times the rollovers hit.

steps.t: Make the Elf or Inlane Skill Shot
steps.d: Hit a lit ELF drop target or the gold lit inlane.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Load and fire the Cannon to qualify Multiball 1, play it, then reach the Cortés wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot the right ramp to reach the Black Pearl Ship and spin the two orbit spinners to qualify the Load Cannon targets.
After enough spins, hit a green Load Cannon target to qualify the Cannon, then shoot it and press the action button at the right time to fire at the opposing ship.

steps.t: Hit the hole to qualify Multiball 1
steps.d: A shot into the hole destroys the opposing ship and qualifies Multiball 1 at Port Royal.

steps.t: Start Curse of the Black Pearl MB
steps.d: Shoot Port Royal to start it. Collect Jackpots with ship shots and Super Jackpots by hitting the hole using the action button.

steps.t: Start The Cursed Treasure of Cortés
steps.d: Play 5 yellow chapters and the multiball, then shoot Port Royal and collect 882 pieces of Aztec gold.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Lock three balls at the Chest, play the multiball, then fight the Kraken.

steps.d: Complete the two green targets on either side of the Chest to qualify each lock.

steps.t: Lock three balls in the Chest
steps.d: Shoot the Chest to lock a ball; locking three starts Multiball 2.

steps.t: Collect Jackpots and the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Hit an X target to light that many Jackpots (2X is best); collecting them all lights the Super Jackpot at the Chest.
Play 5 green chapters and the multiball, shoot the Chest, hit the upper loop 20 times, then shoot the Captain’s Quarters.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Collect all nine Pieces of Eight, play the multiball, then escape the Locker.

steps.d: Make each of the nine major shots with a red arrow lit; one is spotted each ball.
Shoot the Maelstrom into the whirlpool.
Shoot the Maelstrom for Jackpots; a Super Jackpot lights at the Bayou after each.
Play 5 red chapters and the multiball, shoot the Maelstrom, then make 8 blue shots within 90 seconds.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Loop the Fountain of Youth to start the multiball, then the Fountain wizard mode.

steps.d: Make about 8 or 9 successive shots to the Fountain of Youth.
Shoot the Fountain of Youth once more.
Collect enough Jackpots, trap a ball behind the post with a orbit, chest or inner loop shot, then knock it out with another ball.

steps.t: Battle for the Fountain of Youth
steps.d: Play 5 blue chapters and Multiball 4, then shoot the Fountain of Youth and clear the 5 phases.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Spin the Devil's Triangle spinner to start the multiball, then reach the compass wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot the spinner in front of the Devil's Triangle to progress toward the multiball.
After enough spins, shoot the Devil's Triangle; the ball must reach the u-turn switch via the left orbit.

steps.t: Hit the roving jackpot, then the Super
steps.d: Shoot the roving purple Jackpot to light the Super Jackpot at the Devil's Triangle.
Play 5 purple chapters and Multiball 5, then shoot the Devil's Triangle and hit the unlit shots while avoiding red ones.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Gather gold to light Tortuga, then build the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Collect gold with the action button
steps.d: Spawn gold via GOLD targets, chapter shots, PIRATE awards or Mystery and press the action button to collect it.
50 gold (+50 for each later multiball) qualifies the right saucer.
Shoot the lit Tortuga saucer.

steps.t: Collect Jackpots and the saucer Super
steps.d: Jackpots at major shots raise the Super Jackpot collected at the saucer; complete GOLD targets to add a ball.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Qualify and play chapters via the Star Map, then complete all five wizard modes.

steps.d: Shoot Port Royal, Chest, Maelstrom, Fountain of Youth or Devil's Triangle to qualify a chapter at the Star Map.

steps.t: Start a chapter at the Star Map
steps.d: Make the Star Map; the last target hit starts the chapter of that color.
Complete all flashing shots, from 1 to 12, for the completion bonus.
Five chapters of one color, plus its multiball, qualify that movie's mini-wizard mode.
Complete all five mini-wizard modes, then shoot the Captain's Quarters for the Final Wizard Mode (details TBA).

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Make all twelve combos to start the Treasure Horde hurry-up.

steps.d: Each of the 12 combos awards a different treasure.
Make every combo listed in the status report.
Make more combos for big points in the hurry-up.

jersey-jack/pirates-of-the-caribbean-jjp.s: Three plunges with different rewards, building up the top one.

steps.d: Plunge into the bumpers for 1k and a Mystery level.

steps.t: Make the ship popper skill shot
steps.d: Medium plunge into the ship popper for 5k and advance the Black Pearl.

steps.t: Make the Captain's Quarters skill shot
steps.d: Strong plunge to the upper flipper, then Captain's Quarters; add 2.5k per Fountain loop combo.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Pick a zone, hit checkpoints to the Goal Ring, then defeat Eggman to earn awards that feed the feature modes.

steps.t: Select a zone and plunge to lock it in
steps.d: Use the flippers and action button in the plunger lane to choose a zone, then plunge the ball to lock it in.
Make the lit zone shots (1x, 2x, or 3x expert shots) to save progress at each checkpoint.
In single-ball play, hit the center ramp (2x) or lab jump ramp (3x) to reach the Goal Ring and get your zone ranked.
Shoot the center or left ramp to reach the upper playfield and hit Eggman enough times; later bosses need lab shots to lower him.

steps.t: Win bosses to qualify feature modes
steps.d: Boss awards qualify Casino Night (bosses 2, 7, 10) and Boss Rush (bosses 4, 9, 12) and light extra ball (3, 13).

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Make the opening Lab Detour skill shot, then the locked-in and super skill shots on later balls.

steps.t: Make the Lab Detour skill shot
steps.d: On ball 1, plunge to the center or left ramp and shoot Eggman on the upper playfield within 20 seconds.
After the skill shot, shoot the upper playfield during 10 seconds of victory laps to add 5 rings per shot.
On later balls, lock in an award and hit a white shot on the right side.
Hit the moving pink shot to score the super skill shot award.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Light the mode with upper playfield shots, start it at the center ramp, and collect all 30 shards.

steps.d: Score 5 orbits, 5 targets, 5 of either ramp, and 25 spinner spins on the upper playfield (default settings).

steps.t: Start the mode at the center ramp
steps.d: Shoot the green-lit center ramp in single-ball play with no other modes active.
Hit lit green shots within 70 seconds to collect shards; hold the action button after 20 shards to reveal the rest.
Finish on the ball-holding shot (center ramp, lab jump ramp, or lockup) to recover the Master Emerald and boost bash dash scoring.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Win bosses to light Casino Night, earn tokens through three stages, and hit the final jackpot.

steps.d: Win 2, 7, or 10 boss battles to light the lockup for it.

steps.t: Start Casino Night at the lockup
steps.d: Shoot the lit lockup in single-ball play.

steps.t: Earn tokens and spin the slots
steps.d: Complete stage tasks to earn tokens, then hit the center ramp or lab jump ramp to spin and add awards to the prize bank.
Cash out during the mode before draining, or the bank is lost.

steps.t: Clear all 3 stages for the 100M jackpot
steps.d: Finish all three stages and spin the slots once more for the final jackpot.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Lock balls at the drop targets, start multiball, and collect all seven Chaos Emeralds.

steps.t: Lock balls with the drop targets
steps.d: Shoot the inline drop targets near the right ramp; the first multiball needs one lockup, later ones one more each, up to three.
Complete the required locks to start the multiball.

steps.t: Collect jackpots and a super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot lit orbits and ramps (upper playfield shots are 2x) and finish a set for the super jackpot.
Collect 1, then 2 & 3, then 4 & 5, then 6, then 7, each with its own shot requirement.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Complete a team of heroes through the HERO lanes, start the multiball, and score super jackpots.

steps.t: Collect heroes via the HERO inlanes
steps.d: Complete the HERO inlanes and use the action button to change the active team.

steps.t: Collect all three members of a team
steps.d: Finishing a team makes its shot score 1.25x and lights the left standup target.
Hit the left standup target; optionally press the action button during the intro to collect more teams first.

steps.t: Clear unique jackpots to light the super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot your team's jackpots to light the super jackpot at the left standup target.

steps.t: Score a bash dash-boosted super jackpot
steps.d: Use Bash Dash to multiply the super jackpots, especially with several teams completed.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Light extra ball at the center ramp through bosses, rings, or Froggy.

steps.d: Win 3 or 13 boss battles, collect 100 rings, or catch Froggy.

steps.t: Collect the extra ball at the center ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit center ramp.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Collect rings through combos to light kickback and then extra ball.

steps.d: Light rings via inlanes or repeated orbit shots, then shoot the yellow shots near them.
Collect 50 rings, then 25 more each time to light or add a kickback charge.
Collect 100 rings to light extra ball at the center ramp.

jersey-jack/sonic-the-hedgehog.s: Smaller scoring features: Advance Chao, Badnik Attack, Spin Dash, Find Froggy, and Tails Hurry-Up.

steps.d: Hit the far-left Chao target, then shoot repeated orbit shots for increasing values.
Complete all six battle zone targets around the center ramp.
Shoot the right ramp 5 times, then hit it again and time the action button in the green window.
Reach a zone checkpoint to light the Froggy target for a mystery award; collect all gear to catch Froggy.
Make 50 upper playfield spinner spins, then shoot the left inlane and hit the lit shot from the left flipper.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Collect soldiers to start jobs, cash them out, then play award modes to earn Rings.

steps.t: Collect soldiers to light Don's Office
steps.d: Make shots (2 soldiers), hit targets (3) and slingshots (1) to light Don's Office for the next job; certain influence levels also light it.

steps.t: Complete a job's shots and light the cash out
steps.d: Follow the display instructions for the job, then light Don's Office or the scoop for the cash out.
Press the action button to cash out for the completion benefits, or flip both flippers to continue for a bigger value.

steps.t: Play two adjacent jobs to qualify an award mode
steps.d: Play the two jobs next to a blue insert on the stained glass window, e.g. Wedding Favor and Dinner Specials for Tribute.

steps.t: Collect Rings in a Job Award mode
steps.d: Play Tribute, Turnpike, Raid or Boxing and score Rings; 1, 3, 6 and 12 Rings unlock perks.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Lock balls in the Compound to start the multiball, then score jackpots and the super jackpot.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the Compound
steps.d: Shoot the Compound directly or make the lock off a skill shot.
Lock a second ball in the Compound; shoot the compound target then the drop target to raise the jackpot value.

steps.t: Collect jackpots on the lit blue shots
steps.d: Collect 3 jackpots, plus 1 per super already scored, to light the Compound lock.
Shoot the lit Compound lock for a super jackpot worth the jackpot total.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Collect all three regions to start Sicily Multiball and score the Hideout super jackpot.

steps.t: Qualify and collect regions at the bumper
steps.d: Hit the targets around the bumper, and the bumper itself, to qualify the region target, then collect a region.
Repeat until all three regions are collected; a Fountain or Sicily super skill shot lights it instantly.
Shoot the target under the left ramp.
Shoot the targets to build the super jackpot, then collect it at the hideout.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Collect ventures, lock balls, then gather territories toward the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot all lit ventures, spotting them with the SPOT slingshot or bumper, to light the lock.
Shoot either the left or right orbit to lock the required balls (2 at start, up to 6).
Shoot the lower or upper 3-bank targets for jackpots and territories; relight jackpots with the orbits.
Collect enough ventures over multiple plays of Turf War Multiball to gather all 17 territories.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Defeat bad guys to start 5 Families Multiball, or defeat all eight to qualify Baptism.

steps.t: Start a fight with a bad guy
steps.d: Shoot the center drop target to start a fight; flippers change the qualified bad guy.
Send the ball behind the drop target into the spinning disc (or shoot an orbit for some) and use the flippers to deal damage, then land the hurry-up final blow.
Defeat one bad guy from each other family (four total), then shoot behind the drop target again.

steps.t: Score jackpots and the super jackpot
steps.d: Lock the jackpot with a drop target shot, score it five times at ramps or orbits, then shoot the bad guy 3 times.
Defeat all eight bad guys (two per other family), then shoot behind the center drop target.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Complete the stained glass window inserts to qualify and start Honor.

steps.d: Play every job at Don's Office.

steps.t: Play all four Job Award modes
steps.d: Qualify and play Tribute, Turnpike, Raid and Boxing.
Play Compound, Sicily, Turf War and 5 Families Multiball.
Shoot the lit Don's Office once all the window inserts are complete.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Complete every prerequisite to qualify the final wizard mode at Don's Office.

steps.d: Start both mini-wizard modes.

steps.t: Collect enough Rings from award modes
steps.d: Score Rings in the Job Award modes.
Collect all 17 territories through Turf War Multiball.

steps.t: Use a weapon at 10x playfield X
steps.d: Build weapons with the spinners and use one at 10x playfield.
Complete the VITO return lanes and collect combos to reach the Presidential level.
Shoot Don's Office once all requirements are met.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Progress from standard skill shots to collecting super skill shots and resetting them.

steps.d: Soft plunge into the bumper for Sicily progress or into the Compound for Compound progress.
Press the action button to select a super skill shot, then make it.

steps.t: Collect all 22 super skill shots or 12 Rings
steps.d: Doing either lets them all be collected again, each adding +1x.

jersey-jack/the-godfather.s: Light the extra ball and collect it at the bumper's "2" target.

steps.d: Cash out 3 jobs, defeat 3 bad guys, or reach Senator-level influence.
Shoot the "2" target behind the bumper without hitting the bumper.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Light the locks, lock three balls to start Road Trip Multiball, then build to the Super and Mega Jackpots, which complete the scene.

steps.t: Shoot the drop target to light the locks
steps.d: Hit the left drop target to light the 3 physical locks behind it. Each later multiball needs 1 more drop target hit per lock.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls to start Road Trip Multiball
steps.d: Lock 3 balls in the lock-up behind the drop target. This starts the multiball and qualifies the scene.

steps.t: Collect jackpots to light the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot lit shots for 1x-3x Jackpots, which build the Mega Jackpot. When enough are hit, the Super Jackpot lights at the drop target.
After the Super Jackpot, shoot the lit lock shot for the Mega Jackpot (starts at 1M plus jackpots collected). This completes the scene.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Qualify and start Buzz Quick Multiball, score jackpots, then the Super and Intergalactic Jackpot to complete the scene.

steps.d: Hit the Inner Voice saucer enough times to light it for Quick Multiball.
Shoot the lit Inner Voice saucer to start it and qualify the scene.
Shoot the ramps and captive ball for jackpots. Hit the bumpers to raise the multiplier by +.1x, up to 4x.
After 5 jackpots, shoot the Inner Voice saucer for the super jackpot.
Shoot the scoop during the hurry-up (starts at 500k) to complete the scene.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Complete FORKY, light the rescue, and finish the combo to complete the scene, which the wizard mode requires.

steps.d: Complete the FORKY targets to enable the kickback and light the left ramp for Rescue Forky.

steps.t: Rescue Forky with the ramp-to-scoop combo
steps.d: Shoot the Duke Caboom ramp followed by the scoop in one combo for 250,000 (+250k per rescue). Hit the roving FORKY targets to add 50,000 to the next rescue.
Later attempts start at the right ramp and need a timed left ramp, jump ramp, scoop shot. Scoring the final value completes the scene.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Play carnival games with tickets to light the locks, then start Carnival Multiball and score the Popcorn Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the ramps to score tickets, shown on the inserts below the jump ramp.

steps.t: Start and win a carnival game
steps.d: With a game lit, shoot the left ramp to spend tickets and start a game. Win it, then shoot the left ramp for character collect to add a perk to the multiball.
Play games to light locks at the scoop. The first multiball needs 2 games, and later ones need a third.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls to start Carnival Multiball
steps.d: Lock 3 balls at the scoop to start the multiball and qualify the scene.

steps.t: Score Super Jackpots through the stages
steps.d: Collect jackpots to light Caboom Jump for the Super Jackpot, then work through the later stages and victory laps.
Fill the popcorn meter with switch hits, then shoot the captive ball for the hurry-up. This completes the scene.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Fill both spinners to qualify the scene, then collect both super spinner jackpots.

steps.d: Collect enough spins at both the Woody and Bo Peep spinners to enable Super Spinners.
Rip the spinners to increase the jackpot value.
Shoot the captive ball once for Woody and once for Bo Peep to complete the scene.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Build jump ramp shots to qualify the scene, then score the Caboom Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the upper loop to enable the left inlanes to lower the jump ramp, then shoot it.
After a jump, shoot the flashing right ramp, then the left ramp and lock-up to score Caboom Collect.
Make 10 jump ramp shots in normal play to qualify the scene.
Shoot the jump ramp 3 times in a row to collect the Caboom Jackpot and complete the scene.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Start Super Loops from the wheel, qualify with upper loops, then complete with a 3-loop combo.

steps.t: Start Super Loops from the wheel
steps.d: Collect the Super Loops wheel award at the upper loop. The scene can't be qualified or completed without it.
Shoot 15 total upper loops to qualify the scene. Each later qualification needs 10 more.
Make a 3-loop combo during or after Super Loops to complete the scene and score a 100,000 bonus.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Light the wheel, collect all 8 awards, and start and score Take A Chance Multiball.

steps.t: Light the Take A Chance Wheel
steps.d: Spell ALIEN by shooting the captive ball. Shoot the captive ball or upper loop to change the lit award.
Make each award's shot once: Frenzy, Caboom, Kickback, Super Loops, Super X, Tiki Party, Hold Bonus X, and Light Extra Ball.
Shoot the scoop during single-ball play after all 8 awards are collected.
Collect jackpots to light the locks, then lock the final ball in the Tiki God saucer within 30 seconds.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Qualify or complete all seven scenes, play both Woody's and Buzz's paths, then reach Fireworks.

steps.t: Qualify or complete all seven scenes
steps.d: Play the scenes: Road Trip, Buzz Quick, Rescue Forky, Carnival, Super Spinners, Duke Caboom, and Bo Peep. Rescue Forky must be collected.
steps.sec: Meet Me At The Carousel (Wizard Mode):

steps.t: Start the wizard mode at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop, or use the ramps to pick a path. Each completed scene adds +1x to scoring, up to 7x.
steps.sec: Meet Me At The Carousel (Wizard Mode):

steps.d: Finish all 4 stages of Woody's or Buzz's path, collecting each stage's completion at the scoop.
steps.sec: Meet Me At The Carousel (Wizard Mode):

steps.d: Completing a path starts the 4-ball Fireworks multiball. Shoot the jump ramp for jackpots and added balls, up to 6.
steps.sec: Meet Me At The Carousel (Wizard Mode):

steps.d: Qualify or complete all seven scenes again and finish the other character's path to fully complete the game.
steps.sec: Meet Me At The Carousel (Wizard Mode):

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Hit the raised Gabby Gabby target to start the multiball and score its Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Raise and hit the Gabby Gabby target
steps.d: Make jump ramp shots, start Super X, or score Mystery hurry-ups to raise the target, then hit it for letters and hurry-up values.
Hit the target 5 times (8 for later multiballs).
Shoot the ramps for 25,000 Jackpots. After 5 Jackpots, the upper loop also lights the Super Jackpot.

jersey-jack/toy-story-4.s: Chain skill shots into a lit extra ball.

steps.d: Plunge the ball into the Woody saucer for tickets, points, and a +5x bonus multiplier. You get 3 attempts per ball.
After a skill shot, shoot the upper loop repeatedly for Super Skill Shot awards.

steps.t: Make three skill shots in a game
steps.d: Three skill shots light the extra ball at the scoop.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Light and start Factory Tour modes at the saucer, working through all 12 to earn the Factory Tour Golden Ticket.

steps.d: Shoot the right ramp (blue), a left or right orbit (purple), or the captive ball (orange) to light a mode if one is not already lit.

steps.t: Start a Factory Tour mode at the saucer
steps.d: Shoot the saucer to start the lit mode. Starting one mode of each type lights the spinner for Super Lock.
Keep qualifying and starting blue, purple and orange modes until all 12 have been started.

steps.t: Collect the Factory Tour Golden Ticket
steps.d: Starting all 12 modes awards the Golden Ticket.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Lock balls in the Most Secret Machine, run jackpots, and score five Gobstopper Jackpots for the Golden Ticket.

steps.t: Hit the Gobstopper target to open the lock
steps.d: Shoot the target blocking the Most Secret Machine; each hit also raises the Bonus Multiplier. The hits needed per lock increase each time.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls to start Gobstopper Multiball
steps.d: Virtually lock 3 balls through the hole in front of the Most Secret Machine.
Shoot the left and right ramps for Jackpots; the center ramp gives a Double Jackpot counting as two.
Shoot the lit hole in front of the Most Secret Machine for 5x a normal Jackpot.
Score five Gobstopper Jackpots, one for each Kid, to earn the Gobstopper Golden Ticket.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Qualify and collect the five kids, light Kid Multiball at the left target, and collect one of each jackpot for the Golden Ticket.

steps.d: Start Fizzy Lifting Drink Room (Charlie) or Golden Egg Room (Veruca), or progress Augustus, Violet or Mike.
Finish each kid's task: complete the mode for Charlie/Veruca, spinner then ramp-orbit for Augustus, GUM hurry-up for Violet, teal shots for Mike.
With a kid qualified or collected, shoot the lit captive ball for Collect Kid to light the left target.
Shoot the lit left target; each qualified kid adds a ball.
Collect 5 jackpots, then shoot the left lane for the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Collect one of each kid jackpot
steps.d: Collect one jackpot of each type to score the Kid Multiball Golden Ticket.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Collect 3 Super Locks, start Wonkavator Multiball, and win the Super Jackpot in all three waves for the Golden Ticket.

steps.t: Light the spinner for Super Lock
steps.d: Start one of each Factory Tour mode type, win the Light Super Lock Computer Award (all 3), or win the Captive Ball Mystery lock.

steps.t: Collect 3 Super Locks at the spinner
steps.d: Shoot the lit spinner; locks carry over between games on default settings.
Collect 6 Jackpots, hit the Gobstopper target to lock balls, then shoot the lit spinner once all but one ball is locked.
Collect five Jackpots, each shot only once, to qualify the Super.
Collect five roving-shot Jackpots, hitting the captive ball after each to light the next, then score the Super.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Collect Golden Tickets to unlock each wizard mode in order, ending at Pure Imagination.

steps.d: After one Golden Ticket, shoot the center loop when no other modes are running; collect 10 unique Jackpots for the Super Jackpot.
After two Golden Tickets, shoot the saucer and alternate left-right shots as directed.
After 3 Golden Tickets, it awards +100 Wonka Bars and +50 Candy Jar.
After 4 Golden Tickets, shoot the Gobstopper hole to start the 60 second mode and keep shooting it for jackpots.
Collect all 5 Golden Tickets, then shoot the lit saucer for the final wizard mode.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Progress from the simple saucer plunge to the Super Secret Skill Shot.

steps.d: Soft plunge into the saucer for points, 1 WONKA letter and +1 Candy Jar.

steps.t: Make the center ramp skill shot
steps.d: Soft plunge to the upper flipper, then shoot the center ramp to light the Computer Award.
Hold the left flipper, soft plunge to the upper flipper, shoot the center ramp then the saucer.

steps.t: Make the Super Secret Skill Shot
steps.d: Hold left flipper, plunge to the upper right flipper, then combo upper/center ramp, right ramp, left ramp, TV saucer.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Score Wonka Bars to qualify Computer Awards, and push toward Golden Bonus Levels and Ransom.

steps.t: Collect Wonka Bars at the ramps
steps.d: Left ramp gives 1, right ramp 2, center ramp 3.

steps.t: Collect a Computer Award at the saucer
steps.d: Reach the Wonka Bar threshold (5 + 1 per award) or make the center ramp skill shot, then shoot the saucer; use the upper standup to change the award.
Hit Wonka Bar thresholds such as 10, 25, 50 to hold the bonus.
Score 200 Wonka Bars, then shoot the roving ramp shot to add points to lit ramps.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Build ramp combos to collect mystery awards and cash out Scrumdidilyumptious.

steps.d: Shoot ramps to increase the number in front of the captive ball.
Shoot the captive ball when ? is lit.
Shoot combo shots to add letters to the word.
Shoot the Most Secret Machine; completing the full word gives a substantial increase.

jersey-jack/wonka.s: Light the extra ball by several routes and collect it at the saucer.

steps.d: Complete standup targets 3 times, or win Light Extra Ball from the Computer Award or Captive Ball Mystery.

steps.t: Collect the Extra Ball at the saucer
steps.d: Shoot the saucer while the Extra Ball is lit.

multimorphic/final-resistance-rulesheet-.s: Open the shield, lock three balls in the ship, then collect jackpots in the scoop.

steps.d: Hit the shield area with dangerous shots or use a Hack powerup to raise the shield in front of the right ramp and lock scoop.

steps.t: Lock three balls in the right scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop to the right of the right ramp, behind the shield, to lock balls in the ship.
Lock the third ball; the balls are fired back at you with a short ball save.
Lock back into the scoop for jackpots; hit it in succession to raise the jackpot multiplier. The right orbit gives a jackpot-like award.

multimorphic/final-resistance-rulesheet-.s: Spell LOCK and LOAD to light the drop target, then use the captive ball during a mode.

steps.d: Hit the left targets above the left flipper to spell LOCK.
Hit the right targets above the right flipper to spell LOAD.

steps.t: Hit the flashing drop target during a mode
steps.d: The ball is captive until a mode is running, then it is released with a short ball save.

multimorphic/final-resistance-rulesheet-.s: Play and complete all battles, replaying failed ones, to light the 9th battle, Annihilation.

steps.t: Light a battle at an orbit
steps.d: After a set time a battle lights at either orbit with a flashing blue arrow.

steps.t: Complete 4 sets of ramps for Pre-Emptive Strike
steps.d: Complete 4 sets of ramps so the battle starts with an advantage and the orbits light pink.
Succeed or fail, the game moves on to the next battle until all have been played.
The game cycles through the battles not successfully completed until all are won.
Successfully complete all prior battles to light the 9th battle.

multimorphic/final-resistance-rulesheet-.s: Reach the fifth battle, an 8-ball multiball, and hit a jackpot behind the shield.

steps.d: Swarm is always the 5th battle you face.
Hit orange-lit shots or use hacks to open the shield; it lowers again after about 15 seconds.

steps.t: Hit a jackpot behind the shield
steps.d: Jackpots are multiplied by balls in play; play continues until one ball remains.

multimorphic/final-resistance-rulesheet-.s: Make a skill shot, then its combo for the super skill shot.

steps.d: Hit the left ramp or the spinner loop without touching any other switch; this opens the shield.
Combo the right ramp after the left ramp, or the spinner again after the spinner skill shot.

multimorphic/final-resistance-rulesheet-.s: Build up the spinner display to 99 and cash in spins.

steps.d: Each hit advances the spinner display; it drops over time if you stop.
Reaching 99 awards Super Spinner.
Each spin scores the displayed value in hundreds until it counts down to 00.

multimorphic/final-resistance-rulesheet-.s: Earn powerups and use them to help in battles.

steps.d: Hit white lit shots to collect at the scoop, spell H-A-C-K in the lanes, or finish a battle.
Hit all yellow standup targets to light mystery at the scoop.
Select with the white buttons and activate with the launch button.
Win a certain number of battles; it awards all shots but turns off the solenoids until drain.

multimorphic/heist.t: Crew Modes to the Big Heist
multimorphic/heist.s: Recruit crew members through their shot modes, run Mastermind's heist, and finish with the Big Final Heist and 15 Car Monte.

steps.d: Hit a crew member's major shot once to qualify that member's mode.
Hit the same shot a second time to start the timed mode, complete it, then shoot the raised scoop to collect the MacGuffin.
With at least 2 crew members, qualify Mastermind via the left horseshoe.
Hit each lit crew shot (twice adds a ball), then shoot the scoop for the jewel before the timer ends.
Collect all crew members including Mastermind so the Big Final Heist is lit in the Jail, then shoot it.
Hit the 5 shots, then the lit side loop within 60 seconds to finish the game.

multimorphic/heist.s: Each crew member's mode has its own shot sequence ending in a MacGuffin.

steps.d: Hit left ramp, right ramp, left ramp, then shoot the left scoop for the MacGuffin.
Collect 20 spins from the right horseshoe, 10 from the left, then 10 from the right.
Spin the spinner to crack the password, then hit 4 shots across the left orbit, left ramp, right ramp and right orbit.
Hit left orbit, left horseshoe and right ramp, then make 1 pop bumper hit.
Hit 4 shots, dislodge the ball from the crane, then find the escape route in the 2-ball multiball.

multimorphic/heist.s: Free jailed crew members by shots or multiball.

steps.d: Hit a jailed character's shot to remove the bars on their icon until they escape.
Shoot the OCPD gate to qualify it.
Shoot the open OCPD building to start an N+1 ball multiball.
Hit each character's shot to free them until down to 1 ball.

multimorphic/heist.s: Qualify and complete side jobs to instantly qualify a crew mode.

steps.d: Collect all the side targets so the crane comes out.
Hitting the crane lights a side job at the OCPD building.
Shoot the OCPD building to start it and complete it to qualify that character's mode.

multimorphic/heist.s: Collect cash to light and play Crane Multiball.

steps.d: Hit the ATM targets or shoot the raised scoop when the armored car passes.
Shoot the lit right ramp.
Dislodge the ball held by the crane to start the multiball.
Collect ramp jackpots and bash the crane enough times to double jackpots.

multimorphic/heist.s: Light locks, start multiball, then advance through jackpot phases.

steps.d: Hit the police standup targets to light locks.
Shoot the lit left and right horseshoes; repeat for locks 2 and 3.
Hit both horseshoe jackpots, then shoot the lit jail to advance.
Collect the ramp jackpots in phase 2, then orbit jackpots in phase 3.

multimorphic/heist.s: Collect donuts for bonus and a police bribe.

steps.d: Roll over lit donuts in the lanes to increase bonus X.
Earn a police bribe so the next arrested character is set free.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Lock balls, start Secret Agent Multiball, score ramp jackpots and earn a wizard item with 25 jackpots, with a Super Duper Jackpot at 8 balls.

steps.t: Lock balls via LITE LOCK targets
steps.d: Complete the left and right LITE LOCK targets to light a lock, then lock balls in the saucer. Only available when not in a mode or multiball.
Shoot the saucer when it is not lit for lock to start the multiball (2-8 balls). Locks get harder after each multiball started.
Hit the left or right ramp for jackpots. One Agent is awarded per jackpot per ball in the multiball.

steps.t: Collect 25 jackpots for the super jackpot
steps.d: Reaching 25 jackpots awards the super jackpot and a wizard item.
In 8-ball multiball, hit the jackpot shot after all 8 balls have been served from the saucer and none have drained.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Qualify with the spotlight standups, start at the scoop, and play through both stages.

steps.d: Hit all spotlight standups twice. Only available when no other modes or multiballs are running.

steps.t: Start Lights Out at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop to start the 3-ball multiball.
Complete the first stage by knocking out all spotlights.
Play the second stage, the red, white and blue frenzy.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Use the secret hole hurry-ups to start a 2-ball multiball.

steps.t: Hit the secret hole behind the ship
steps.d: Shooting the secret hole starts a hurry-up for misc awards.
Complete two hurry-ups to start Doubleshot multiball.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Complete the white modes to earn wizard mode items.

steps.d: Select a mode with the yellow flipper buttons and shoot the right scoop from the home scene. The right ramp relights the scoop.

steps.t: Complete Warehouse, Swamp, Cabin and Lab
steps.d: Warehouse: break crates and collect hidden gears. Swamp: collect enough gas to fuel the ship. Cabin: assemble spaceship parts. Lab: disable energy beams and collect the weapon.
Each white mode completion awards a wizard mode item plus 500k.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Complete the red modes for permanent bonus effects.

steps.d: Select a mode with the yellow flipper buttons and shoot the right scoop.
In the four-ball no-hold-flipper multiball, hit the center standups. Awards double damage on aliens.
Shoot mugs to fill and chug. Awards seeing double, doubling secret agent jackpots.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Fight aliens from the left ramp, ending in a mini-wizard that awards a wizard item.

steps.d: Shoot the left ramp.

steps.t: Hit the indicated target to insta-kill
steps.d: The indicated target kills the alien for full value. If missed, shoot standups to damage it until defeated.
The last alien is a mini-wizard mode if not killed via hurry-up, and awards a wizard item.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Gather all wizard items from modes, multiballs and aliens to qualify the wizard mode.

steps.d: Complete each white mode to earn its wizard item.

steps.t: Earn the Secret Agent Multiball item
steps.d: Score 25 jackpots in Secret Agent Multiball.
Kill the last alien without the hurry-up to earn its wizard item.
Collect all items from modes, multiballs and alien-killing.

multimorphic/lexy-lightspeed-escape-from.s: Complete LEXY lanes repeatedly to raise the bonus multiplier.

steps.d: Use the white buttons to rotate lanes left or right and complete LEXY for the bonus multiplier and misc awards.

steps.t: Repeat to advance each bonus multiplier
steps.d: Multiple completions are needed per bonus x. Progression carries between balls but the bonus multiplier resets.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Start all seven test chambers to trigger the final wizard mode, then work through its phases to defeat GLaDOS.

steps.d: Hit the Elevator Call Button, then shoot the Elevator Scoop to start each chamber; each can be played once per game.
Shoot the Spinner enough times to reach Super Spinner level 4.
Knock malfunctioning turrets off the conveyor belt to add time before the timer runs out.

steps.t: Collect parts and call the supervisor
steps.d: Hit blue-lit shots to collect the needed items, then hit green-lit keypad shots.

steps.t: Re-install Reggie with the Core Switcher
steps.d: Hit green and orange shots, send both balls into the Core Switcher, then use the red shot to condemn Eggie to the Moat.
Hit yellow ball-icon shots to load a ball, then shoot the Faith Plate with at least two balls in play to lob balls at her.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Progress from a basic skill shot to the Super Duper Skill Shot at the start of each ball.

steps.d: Shoot the Upper or Lower Right Ramp at the start of the ball to feed the Repulsion Gel Kickback Scoop.
Shoot the Lower Right Ramp, then quickly hit it a second time.

steps.t: Make the Super Duper Skill Shot
steps.d: Hit the Lower Right Ramp a third time in quick succession.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Complete Hub objectives to raise the next test chamber's multiplier and score the Faith Plate hurry-up.

steps.d: Finish one of eight objectives in the Hub, such as three loops, three ramps, or one Moat jump.
Shoot the Faith Plate while the hurry-up (starting at 500,000) is running.
Each objective adds 0.5X to the next test chamber's multiplier; completing another during a hurry-up raises its value.
Finish all eight before starting a test chamber for 5X scoring.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Lock three balls with the Turret Lock target, then collect jackpots and the super jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the Turret Lock Standup Target in the Hub so the Turret Control Center Scoop lights red.
Shoot the red-lit Turret Control Center Scoop three times to start Turret Multiball.
Hit the red-lit standup targets during the multiball.
Shoot the lit Turret Control Center Scoop.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Lock a ball and release it with the Ramp Control Target, then score jackpots and the super jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the ESC Captive Ball to portal a ball into the virtual lock.
Hit the ESC Captive Ball again, then hit the Ramp Control Target before the virtual ball reaches the center of the display.
Hit the ESC Captive Ball; shoot the yellow orbits to raise jackpot values.
Shoot the ball sent into the L.O.F.T. into the scoop.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Light and make three Faith Plate locks, then collect jackpots.

steps.d: Enter the L.O.F.T. and push the cube back through the portal; locks light automatically at the start of ball 3.

steps.t: Hit three lit Faith Plate shots
steps.d: Fling balls off the Faith Plate toward the grating; the third starts the multiball.
Hit the lit Faith Plate; ramps light it and raise the base jackpot; quick hits give 2X or 3X.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Play Turret, Faith Plate, and ESC multiballs concurrently.

steps.d: It cannot be started while another multiball is running.
Start Aerial Faith Plate or Edgeless Safety Cube Multiball during Turret Multiball.
Start the remaining one; ESC only needs two captive ball hits, no Ramp Control Target.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Complete CAKE lanes to light and collect mystery awards.

steps.d: Light all CAKE inserts in the inlanes and outlanes; the flipper buttons cycle lit lanes.
Shoot the white-lit Turret Control Center Scoop (after any Turret lock).
Each additional award needs one more CAKE completion than the last.

multimorphic/portal-extended-edition.s: Build Super Spinner levels, which unlock the Turret Manufacturing mini-wizard.

steps.d: Spin the Spinner via the Left Orbit to a multiple of 100 to activate Super Spinner at 9,900 per spin.
Keep raising the Super Spinner level to unlock test chamber 7.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.t: Learn Fire and the Fire Multiball
multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Learn the Fire spell in the Workshop, then play the 2-ball multiball with wards and jackpots.

steps.t: Start the Fire spell mode in the Workshop
steps.d: Shoot the left loop from either side while in the Workshop with the Fire spell mode available.

steps.t: Reveal the path and find the fire spell
steps.d: All shots are lit on a black screen. Hit shots to reveal the path; one of them reveals the fire spell.

steps.t: Learn Fire to start the 2-ball multiball
steps.d: Hit the fire spell shot again to learn Fire and start the multiball. Lighting the whole room before learning it earns a resurrection.
Hit the ward shots on the left loop to break them and reveal a jackpot, then hit the jackpot to reveal a super jackpot.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.t: Learn Ice and the Ice Multiball
multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Learn Ice in the Bazaar, then play the 2-ball multiball with wards on the outer orbits.

steps.t: Start the Ice spell mode in the Bazaar
steps.d: Shoot the left loop in the Bazaar to start the mode. Three random shots are lit with 15 second timers.
Completing one shot resets the other timers to 15 seconds. Hit the captive ball to extend timers.
In the 2-ball multiball, hit the wards on the outer orbits, then the jackpot, then the super jackpot.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.t: Learn Lightning and the Lightning Multiball
multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Learn Lightning in the Dunes, then play the 2-ball multiball with wards on the ramps.

steps.t: Start the Lightning spell mode in the Dunes
steps.d: Shoot the left loop in the Dunes to start the mode. Three shots are lit with short timers.

steps.t: Learn Lightning by hitting the lit shots
steps.d: Timed-out shots are replaced by new random shots, so keep hitting the lit shots.
Hit the wards on the left and right ramps, then the jackpot and super jackpot.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.t: Learn Shield and the Shield Multiball
multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Learn Shield in the Oasis, then survive the Black Magic wards while scoring jackpots.

steps.t: Start the Shield spell mode in the Oasis
steps.d: Shoot the left loop in the Oasis to start the mode. Three random shots are indicated.
Repeats of the same shot are allowed. Completing them learns the Shield.
Use the shield against attacks from the Black Magic wards and hit the 2 lit jackpots, which recharge your shield.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Earn a key in a location, then unlock that location's chest to earn a gem that enhances a spell.

steps.t: Learn the two spells needed for a key mode
steps.d: Key modes unlock with a combination of 2 spells.

steps.t: Complete the key mode to earn the key
steps.d: Each of the 4 locations has a random key awarded for completing its key mode.

steps.t: Complete the chest mode with the matching key
steps.d: Chest modes also need 2 spells. Having the matching key unlocks the chest.
Unlocking the chest awards a gem that enhances one of your spells.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Light lock, lock 3 balls, then score jackpots to earn a resurrection.

steps.t: Shoot the side targets and hit the floatie
steps.d: Side target hits move a floating icon across the screen. Shoot it to light lock.
Shoot the scoop to lock a ball. The third lock starts the multiball.
Shoot the indicated shots; black magic counts as whatever shot you need.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Unlock the dungeon with three spell-shots on the right ramp, then defeat the Sorcerer.

steps.t: Shoot the right ramp with Fire
steps.d: In the Workshop, the dungeon is guarded by 3 wards. Break the first with the fire spell.

steps.t: Shoot the right ramp with Ice, then Lightning
steps.d: Hit the right ramp with the ice spell and then the lightning spell to unlock the dungeon.

steps.t: Damage the Sorcerer with matching spells
steps.d: Hit lit shots with the appropriate spell and use your shield against his attacks.

multimorphic/sorcerers-apprentice.s: Keep your health up, thwart the bandit, and earn resurrections.

steps.d: Collect herbs from standup targets in the Bazaar or Oasis, or use the inlane potion in the Workshop or Dunes.
Hit standup targets 3 times before time runs out to eliminate the bandit and keep your items.
Light one by completing Learn Fire or by scoring 5 jackpots in Black Magic Multiball.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Complete three escalating skill shot combos to earn As You Wish awards for Guilder battles.

steps.d: Hit the Center Ramp twice in a row, following the Westley icons.
Hit Center Ramp, Left Orbit, then Left Ramp.
Hit Center Ramp, Left Ramp, Right Orbit, then Upper Loop. Each combo awards one As You Wish.

steps.t: Play a Battle mode as As You Wish Multiball
steps.d: Use an As You Wish award to play a Guilder Battle mode as a two-ball multiball for untimed 2x scoring.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Spell TRUE LOVE, start multiball at Max's Hut, and score the kiss super jackpot.

steps.t: Spell TRUE LOVE at the side targets
steps.d: Complete TRUE on the left side targets and LOVE on the right side targets to light Max's Hut.

steps.t: Turn all letters red for extension
steps.d: Collect the letters again (pink to red) before starting to earn the extended multiball.
Shoot Max's Hut once it is lit.

steps.t: Collect jackpots and respell TRUE LOVE
steps.d: Hit lit shots for jackpots and collect letters; on default, 4 ramp jackpots start the first super jackpot phase.
Hit the right orbit or inner loop to hold a ball at the left orbit entrance, then kiss it with another ball into the scoop. Two held balls with 3+ in play gives a double.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Collect six glove shots, start PTDMB, and finish the Six-Fingered Duel super jackpot.

steps.t: Hit the captive ball to light gloves
steps.d: Hitting the captive ball spawns six-fingered glove shots on the playfield.
Collect the glove shots, tracked as # collected / 6 on the backbox banner.
Hit the Castle (left) ramp after collecting all 6 gloves.
Alternate glove shots to build and light jackpots, then hit the captive ball; the 2nd and 4th add a ball.
Complete all six shots in the 6-ball phase, then hit the captive ball for the super jackpot.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Play Cliffs of Insanity, then the Battle modes, to unlock the Fire Swamp mini-wizard.

steps.t: Qualify a Guilder mode at the Cliffs
steps.d: Hit the Cliffs shot the required number of times (2 for the first mode by default).
Hit three ramp shots to climb the cliff (left ramp worth more), then hit the popped-up scoop.
Hit three shots, switch hands, hit three more; the captive ball multiplies the next shot.
Make 5 alternating shots in phase 1, then shoot orange shots to bring Fezzik's health to zero.
Collect IOCANE letters, avoid the poisoned goblet, then shoot the highlighted goblet.
Play the Guilder mini-wizard and hit all 7 vine shots while surviving hazards.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Complete the Florin modes to unlock and finish the Miracle Max mini-wizard.

steps.d: Hit five Buttercup shots, then the escape shot at the Cliffs.

steps.t: Complete There Will Be Blood Tonight
steps.d: Hit three alternating ramps, then 25 spinner spins and the hut.
Move the sword with the side targets and hit the yellow scoop three times.
Pump the bellows, shoot lit shots, then hit each shot and target in Valerie Frenzy Multiball for a Miracle Pill.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.t: Castle Modes to To The Pain
multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Complete the Castle modes to unlock the To The Pain mini-wizard.

steps.d: Survive about 40 seconds of the two-ball mode without losing a ball to earn Pit of Despair or a Miracle Pill.
Collect six MAWIDGE shots, then hit the castle shot for the hurry-up.
Hit 4 roving scoops, then the left ramp.
Raise flipper power via side target banks and shoot each shot once.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Complete all three mini-wizards and fill character progress to reach the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Collect 4 segments of each character's progress via modes and multiball super jackpots.
Finish Fire Swamp, Miracle Max, and To The Pain.
Start the final wizard mode once the requirements are met.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Complete modes in story order to build bonus points.

steps.t: Complete a mode in narrative order
steps.d: Start a streak anywhere in the narrative list.

steps.t: Complete the next mode in order
steps.d: The second mode scores 25% in bonus, third 50%, fourth 75%.
The streak bonus caps at 100% and is multiplied by Bonus X.

multimorphic/the-princess-bride.t: Pit of Despair and Miracle Pills
multimorphic/the-princess-bride.s: Qualify second-chance awards and survive the Pit of Despair.

steps.d: Hit the side loop, complete Buttercup's Nightmare, or get it from a Mystery Award.
Drain and make the 3 required shots (Center Ramp, Left Orbit, Left Ramp) without losing a ball.
Complete Miracle Max, a mode from each region, a 5-way Unique Combo, or a Mystery Award.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Select a Hall, start a song mode from the Ticket Counter or a VIP Pass, and play through all 10 modes.

steps.t: Shoot a Hall shot to light that Hall
steps.d: Shoot the Left Ramp, Left Loop, Upper Loop, or a mini-loop entrance once to light that Hall as the next one to visit.

steps.t: Knock down the Ticket Counter drop target
steps.d: Hit the drop target guarding the Ticket Counter scoop so the scoop becomes accessible.

steps.t: Shoot the Ticket Counter scoop to start a mode
steps.d: Shoot the scoop to select one of the two modes in the lit Hall and start it.

steps.t: Make enough mode shots to light Exit
steps.d: Once you have made enough shots in a mode, the Ticket Counter scoop lights to end the mode early after the drop target is down.

steps.t: Play a song from every Hall
steps.d: Each song can only be played once per game. Playing all 10 is needed for Running With Scissors.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Complete V, I, P targets and redeem the pass at the raised scoops to pick any unplayed mode.

steps.t: Complete the V, I, and P standup targets
steps.d: Hit each of the three VIP standups to qualify a VIP Pass.

steps.t: Shoot the raised scoops within 10 seconds
steps.d: Shoot into the center pair of raised pop-up scoops to redeem the pass.
The pass lets you pick any unplayed mode of the 10, not limited to the lit Hall.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Light and make three Harvey locks to start the multiball, then spin the Wheel of Stupidity.

steps.t: Shoot the Harvey target to light the scoop
steps.d: Hitting the Harvey standup activates the moving scoop for about 20 seconds.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the Hamster Wheel
steps.d: Shoot the lit scoop, then the spiral ramp or right ramp to lock a ball.
The second lock needs 2 Harvey target hits and the third needs 3. Lock 3 balls to start multiball.
Shoot the lit mini-loop during multiball to get a gameplay modifier or instant award.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Break 27 items, start via the Supply Closet, repair Halls, and hit the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Break 27 items at the side targets
steps.d: Hit the side banks during single-ball play (not during Germs) to collect 27 Broken Items.
Shoot the Supplies Closet scoop when lit to start Hardware Store Multiball.
Shoot lit major shots to repair the Halls, and collect tools with minor shots for the Toolbox Jackpot.
After all Halls are repaired, shoot the lit Spiral Ramp.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Lock three balls in the UHF camera, then save the station and earn a Firehose ticket.

steps.t: Make the Super Duper Skill Shot or light the UHF lock
steps.d: Shoot the Camera Lock after a skill shot, or hit the UHF standup and reach the mezzanine skywalk via a meal ticket.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls in the UHF camera
steps.d: Lock three balls to start UHF Multiball.
In phase one, collect jackpots on all lit major shots to light the Supplies Closet.

steps.t: Finish phase one at the Spiral Ramp
steps.d: Shoot the Supplies Closet for a Firehose ticket, then the spiral ramp to complete the phase.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Chain skill shot variants from the spiral ramp to the camera lock.

steps.d: Shoot the Spiral Ramp right after the plunge for 250K.
Quickly shoot the mezzanine loop for a repeatable Super Skill Shot.

steps.t: Make the Super Duper Skill Shot
steps.d: Shoot the Camera Lock for 500K, which also locks a ball for UHF Multiball.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Collect food, start the sandwich mini-mode, and play it for You Make Me wizard progress.

steps.d: Collect food from lit inlanes or mezzanine targets to light My Bologna.

steps.t: Start My Bologna via the mezzanine
steps.d: Shoot the mezzanine via the lit Spiral Ramp or Right Ramp.
Shoot the mezzanine loop for consecutive bologna slices and hit condiment targets for other items.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Earn outlane saves and untimed ball saves to keep a ball going.

steps.d: Do this outside My Bologna or during Super Skill Shots to collect a Spatula Save.
Hit pop bumpers for shirts: 2 shirts award a Spatula save.
Collect shirts or get it as a Wheel of Stupidity or Supply Closet award.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Earn a ticket, then win the drain mini game to keep your ball.

steps.d: Complete enough shots in UHF Multiball or win it as a Supply Closet mystery award.

steps.t: Make 3 spiral ramp shots after draining
steps.d: Of 10 launched balls, make 3 spiral ramp shots with the upper left flipper to continue your ball.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Open the Gift Shop with orbit shots and hit pops to earn shirts that raise the playfield multiplier.

steps.d: This opens the Gift Shop.

steps.t: Shoot an orbit to drop into the pops
steps.d: The orbit magnet catches the ball and drops it into the pops.
Each of 17 shirts adds 0.1x to your playfield multiplier.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: String combos and Squeezebox Combos to raise End-of-Ball Bonus multipliers.

steps.t: Shoot major shots as a Combo
steps.d: Make Combos during single-ball play for a BonusX based on the longest streak.
Shoot an upper side loop as part of a combo, then alternate the upper flippers for a figure 8.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Play every song in the game to unlock the speed-run wizard mode.

steps.d: Play every song mode once.

steps.t: Play the 3 main multiballs and My Bologna
steps.d: Play DTBS, UHF, and Hardware Store Multiballs, plus My Bologna.
Play the You Make Me mini-wizard mode.
Shoot the Ticket Counter when ready to begin the speed-run.
Meet each mode's small requirement within its time and exit through an orbit, the Ticket Counter, or the Supplies Closet.

multimorphic/weird-als-museum-of-natural.s: Play a song from every Hall, then redeem the VIP targets to start the mini-wizard.

steps.t: Play one song in each of the 5 Halls
steps.d: Winning the modes is not required.
This raises the two center scoops.

steps.t: Start You Make Me and build value
steps.d: Shoot into a raised scoop, then use left and right side shots to build value.
Hit targets to collect the built value and earn the add-a-ball.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Light and win the four Alien film missions at the Air Lock to unlock the Self-Destruct wizard mode and its victory-lap multiball.

steps.t: Light the Air Lock for a mission
steps.d: The Air Lock is lit for the first mission; for later missions, roll through the left and right return lanes (WEYLAND and YUTANI) to relight it.
Complete Derelict Ship, Acid Burn, Find Jonesy or Tunnel Hunt by finishing its shots and then shooting the Air Lock.
Play every mission in the Alien set; after all four, the next mission will be Self-Destruct.
Phase 1: left orbit, left ramp, right ramp, right orbit, then Air Lock. Phase 2: any Xenomorph target, then Air Lock. Phase 3: Vent 1.
After winning phase 3, 4-ball multiball starts with Victory Laps; relight them by completing all major shots.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Win the four Aliens film missions to unlock the Loader Battle wizard mode and its victory-lap multiball.

steps.t: Light the Air Lock for a mission
steps.d: Roll through the left and right return lanes (WEYLAND and YUTANI) to light the Air Lock for further missions.
Complete Combat Drop, A-P-C, Bug Hunt or Queen’s Nest, finishing at the Air Lock.
Play every mission in the Aliens set; the next mission will then be Loader Battle.
Phase 1: left orbit, any Xenomorph target, right orbit. Phase 2: Vent 1, then Air Lock. Phase 3: four ramp shots, then Air Lock.
After winning phase 3, 4-ball multiball starts with Victory Laps; relight them by completing all major shots.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Lock balls at the hypersleep ramp, then play the multiball and its jackpots.

steps.t: Light the hypersleep ramp for lock
steps.d: Complete the APC drop targets on the far right.
Shoot the lit hypersleep ramp; the first multiball needs 2 locks, later ones need 3.

steps.t: Score jackpots on all seven red shots
steps.d: All shots are lit red; make all seven, then they relight. Raise value by completing APC drop targets, +1x if in order.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Collect ammo to light Vent 1, then build jackpots with spinners and cash in a super jackpot.

steps.d: Hit switches and shots to collect ammo; later attempts need 1000.
Shoot the lit Vent 1 to begin the multiball.

steps.t: Shoot spinners, then the Xenomorph jackpot
steps.d: Spinner shots light the Xenomorph targets for a jackpot based on the spinner count.

steps.t: Score the Air Lock super jackpot
steps.d: When the ammo on the display drops below 50, shoot the lit Air Lock.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Hit the Xenomorph targets to start Ambush, drive off the aliens, and collect the Vent 3 super.

steps.d: The first Ambush needs five target hits (more later); the shotgun counts as two hits.
On the final shot, the ball is held on the magnet and Ambush Multiball begins.

steps.t: Score jackpots and drive off all aliens
steps.d: Make playfield shots for the four attacking quadrants; if an alien reaches the center, shoot the center Xenomorph target to relight jackpots.
After all aliens are defeated, shoot the lit Vent 3 before the value decays.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Complete two Xenomorph lifecycles to start the three-phase Save Newt Multiball.

steps.d: Shoot in order: orbit (Egg), Vents (Facehugger), Host target (Chestburster), Xenomorph targets.

steps.t: Complete a second lifecycle to start Save Newt
steps.d: The final Xenomorph shot starts the 4-ball multiball, overriding Ambush progress.

steps.t: Shoot red flashing shots in Phase 1
steps.d: Use the plasma cutter for 1x jackpots that raise the base value, until Newt is abducted.

steps.t: Rescue Newt at the correct vent
steps.d: In Phase 2, shoot Vents 1, 2 or 3; the random correct vent scores 2x.

steps.t: Alternate targets and Vent 3 in Phase 3
steps.d: Shoot any lit target (1x) then Vent 3 (3x), repeating until the multiball ends.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Play all missions and multiballs in one game to unlock the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Play Hypersleep, Sentry Guns, Ambush and Save Newt multiballs in a single game.
Complete all missions in both sets, including both wizard missions.
When the center inserts and Xenomorph target flash white, shoot the Xenomorph target.
Make a shot to Vents 1, 2 and 3 during the multiball.
Shoot both orbits, both ramps, the Air Lock and the Xenomorph target for +1x.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Collect the five weapons in sequence to light the extra ball.

steps.d: Make a weapon skill shot, complete the four weapon standups, win a mission, or get one from Mystery.

steps.t: Use weapons with the launch button
steps.d: Select with the flipper buttons and press launch: handgun, shotgun, smart gun, pulse rifle, flamethrower.
Collecting all five lights the extra ball at the hypersleep ramp.
Shoot the lit hypersleep ramp.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Make skill shots, then win four missions to light Special.

steps.d: Plunge the ball; all shots are lit and awards depend on the shot made.

steps.t: Make three different skill shots in a game
steps.d: This awards the 5M Super Skill Bonus.
Winning 4 missions from any set lights Special at the right outlane.

pinball-brothers/pinball-brothers-alien.s: Spell DROP and SHIP to run and extend 2x scoring.

steps.t: Spell DROP at the left ramp
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp to complete DROP.

steps.t: Spell SHIP at the right ramp
steps.d: Completing both starts 2x scoring for 20 seconds.
Each later DROP and SHIP completion adds 20 seconds, to a maximum of 60.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Qualify and equip bigger weapons, stock ammo, and use it to reach the Minigun.

steps.d: Shoot the 3 GUN Targets in the middle of the playfield to qualify a weapon collect in the Camp Scoop.

steps.t: Collect the weapon in the Camp Scoop
steps.d: Shoot the Camp Scoop to collect the qualified weapon. Sweeping the GUN Targets collects and equips in one go.

steps.t: Equip it at the left Camp Reverso
steps.d: Change the weapon in the left Camp Reverso ramp to equip it.
Collect ammo in the A-M-M-O lanes and from the AMMO hurry-up triggered by the left inlane. Max 5 clips.

steps.t: Earn Bonus X with full ammo
steps.d: While fully stacked, every other A-M-M-O collect awards Bonus X.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Make a skill shot to light the Super Skill Shot at the right Helicopter Ramp.

steps.d: Hold the launch button for the timed launcher and release to hit the chosen skill shot; pick it with the flippers first.
Shoot the right Helicopter Ramp after scoring a skill shot.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Play hurry-ups to progress the map, earn an Extra Ball and Items.

steps.d: Hit the drop target behind the right ramp; after the first, also hit the Jungle Target next to the Wrist blade reverso.
Shoot the Scorpion Ramp (left ramp) to light the three tails and maximize the cash out.
Shoot the Jungle to cash out and win an Item, advancing the map.
Reach map step 4 to be awarded an Extra Ball.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Fight the Hunter in three increasingly difficult attacks.

steps.d: Hit the predator drop targets and collect at least one soldier.
Hit the empty drop bank to begin, find the Hunter in the Search Phase, and wound him enough in the Hunt Phase.

steps.t: Qualify If it Bleeds, We Can Kill It
steps.d: Hit the inner predator loops 6 times, complete the drops, and collect a soldier.
steps.sec: if it Bleeds, We Can Kill It

steps.d: Hit the inner predator loops 18 times, complete the drops, and collect a soldier; then hit the empty drop bank to begin.
steps.sec: El Cazador - Trofeo de los Hombres

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Qualify and win the missions, ending in the Hunter & Prey mode.

steps.d: Shoot white arrows; the scoop toggles the selected mission.

steps.t: Start the mission at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp when START MISSION flashes.
Shoot the spinners to ready soldiers, then use the right ramp to disembark them all.
Shoot both reversos, make the climb three times, then the right ramp.
Set 10 traps with the stand-ups, then shoot the lit left reverso.
Make a purple shot to let Anna escape, then catch her on the lit route.
Clear the 5 stages and shoot the Jungle to evade the Hunter.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Lock balls in the helicopter and play through the Jungle and River phases.

steps.d: Shoot the right ramp until LIGHT LOCK is lit.
Shoot the right ramp to lock ball 1, then again for ball 2 to start multiball.
Make all ramp and orbit jackpots, then the Super Jackpot in the Jungle before time runs out.
In Phase 2, shoot all the jackpots to qualify the Super Jackpot in the Chopper.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Build bumpers to start it, then blow up helicopters for the Mega Jackpot.

steps.d: Feed the Camp bumpers from below and above until 40 are built.

steps.t: Start at the left Camp Reverso
steps.d: Shoot the left reverso ramp once ready.
Collect reverso jackpots to light the timed Super Jackpot in the Helicopter.
Blow up three Helicopters, then shoot the lock magnet at the top before time runs out.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Lock three balls on the minigun and fill the Ol' Painless meter for the Super.
