steps.d: Down the GUN targets to light LOCK at the top magnet.
Shoot the left or right orbit to lock 3 balls and start multiball.

steps.t: Fill the ammo meter with jackpots
steps.d: Score jackpots to fill the Ol' Painless meter before it drops.
Shoot the left or right orbit toward the top magnet.
With Blain collected, shoot the left reverso.

pinball-brothers/predator-rulesheet-pinb.s: Collect the whole crew to play as the Hunter, killing then reviving soldiers.

steps.d: Collect the soldiers and Anna around the playfield; each adds 0.5x to missions.
Shoot the right Wrist Blade Reverso Ramp once qualified.
Hit the soldier shots for 5 million per kill.
Hit soldier shots to revive each one and complete the mode.

spooky/alice-cooper-nightmare-castle.s: Pick a monster, travel through the castle rooms, start the battle, then finish it and score the hurry-up.

steps.t: Select a monster at the entrance
steps.d: At the entrance, shoot the center 3 target to cycle through the available monsters.

steps.t: Lock in the monster with an outer orbit
steps.d: Shoot the left or right outside orbit when strobing to lock in your monster and move up into the first room.
Keep shooting the lit left/right orbits to climb the grid, or use a mystery award or the lit secret passage, to start the monster battle.

steps.t: Complete the mode objective for frenzy
steps.d: Complete the monster's objective to start the frenzy with unlimited ball save and the mode shots active.
After the frenzy ends, shoot the lit left target above the mystery scoop to collect the hurry-up before it counts down.

spooky/alice-cooper-nightmare-castle.s: Build mystery and light the secret passage to jump straight toward or into a monster battle.

steps.t: Build mystery in the middle scoop
steps.d: Shoot the middle scoop (left of the 3 center targets) until the left scoop arrow does a color cycle animation.
Collect it from the left scoop before it times out; awards include move 1 room, move 2 rooms, or advance to monster.
With a monster selected, shoot the center 3 targets three times (or get it from the skill shot or mystery).
Shoot the lit secret passage to the right of the left ramp to start a monster battle.

spooky/alice-cooper-nightmare-castle.s: Lock a ball in the crypt, start the multiball, and shoot jackpots; it can stack with monster battles.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the crypt
steps.d: Shoot the crypt from the lower playfield, or drop a ball in via the rightmost of the three upper lanes.
With the crypt lit, shoot it again from either playfield.
During multiball, shoot the crypt for jackpots; you can stack it with a monster battle.
After multiball, make repeated shots into the crypt from the lower playfield to reactivate the lock.

spooky/alice-cooper-nightmare-castle.s: Lock a ball via the left ramp, open the upper playfield, start Frank MB, and score jackpots and supers.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the Frank lock
steps.d: Shoot left left via the left ramp into the physical lock.
Get to the upper playfield, knock down the drop target, and shoot the upper left ramp behind it.
Shoot either lower ramp for jackpots; three of them light the upper right ramp (guillotine).
Shoot the lit upper right ramp (guillotine) for a super.

spooky/alice-cooper-nightmare-castle.s: Light and collect the extra ball on the upper playfield.

steps.d: Shoot the upper right ramp 10 times (chops), or start your third monster battle (including Frank).
Shoot the extra ball target on the left side of the upper playfield.

spooky/alice-cooper-nightmare-castle.s: Earn the skill shot and light the outlane ball save with the bottom lanes.

steps.d: Shoot the ramps, orbits, or crypt lock on launch; the right ramp counts even halfway up. This lights the secret passage and outlane ball save.
Complete all four bottom lanes to light the outlanes purple for 45 seconds for the magnet save.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Qualify a purple Beetlejuice mode, lock it in if desired, then start it at the Right Orbit.

steps.d: Shoot the purple-lit shots (Beetlejuice face inserts) three times to light the Mode Start. Not possible during a multiball or a Juno Mode.
Hit the Mode Change Switch to change the mode. When a purple mode is blinking, press the Launch Button to lock it in so slings can't change it.
Shoot the Right Orbit to begin the qualified mode.
Finish the objectives of the chosen mode, such as Grave Dig's 3 scoop shots, headstone, ramps and right orbit.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Spell SHOWTIME with yellow shots, start the multiball, and work up to the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Qualify a Beetlejuice mode without starting it
steps.d: Yellow shots are only available when a Beetlejuice mode is qualified but not yet started.
Shoot the yellow shots to spell SHOWTIME.
Shoot the Right Orbit to start, then press the Action Button (or say "Beetlejuice" three times).

steps.t: Score 3 (+1) jackpots and lock a ball
steps.d: Shoot 3 (+1) jackpots, then shoot the Right Orbit/Deadend to lock a ball.
Hit the Right Orbit Drop Target to ricochet the locked ball into the vari-target; the first Super Jackpot adds a ball.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Light locks via the Upper Loop, lock 3 balls on the couch, then collect jackpots and the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the Upper Loop from either direction around the couch to light the knock inserts, which light locks.
Shoot the Right Ramp to lock balls; the third lock starts the multiball.
Shoot green shots for Jackpots; hitting the Knock loop builds jackpot values.
Re-lock a ball on the couch to light the Super Jackpot at the Spinner/Juno Scoop.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Light and complete the camera targets to start a 2-ball multiball, then collect jackpots and add balls.

steps.d: Pass through the inlanes to light the center camera targets.
Hit each camera target once to start the 2-ball multiball.

steps.t: Collect ramp jackpots and add a ball
steps.d: Shoot ramps for jackpots and complete sets of flashing Camera targets to add-a-ball.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Progress the upper playfield number system into a Juno mode.

steps.d: Shoot the Juno Scoop.
Shoot the Couch targets to advance the number counter.
Shoot the Now Serving targets in the upper playfield.
Play Scare the Deetz or Ghosts in the Sheets, finishing Scare the Deetz with the Juno Scoop hurry-up.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Start Sandworm Battles, defeat worms to light an Extra Ball, and reach Sandworm Multiball.

steps.d: Hit the three Sandworm wall targets.
Lower the wall as the battle requires and shoot into the Worm's mouth until its health bar is depleted.
Defeat enough Sandworms to light an Extra Ball.
Shoot orange shots, find the door, then red shots, and finally shoot the Worm for Super Jackpots.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Make the skill shot, then follow up with the super skill shot combo.

steps.d: Time your launch when a point value is lit to feed the ball to the right flipper.
After a successful Skill Shot, quickly shoot the lit Left Ramp, Right Ramp, and Spinner combo.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Return Lost Souls to build and then start a playfield multiplier up to 5x.

steps.d: Hit the pop bumpers to spawn a Lost Soul.
Hit the randomly-lit Lost Soul shot, then shoot the center scoop's front door to add +1x and +30 seconds.
Repeat up to 5x, then go in the back door of the center scoop under the upper flipper.

spooky/beetlejuice.s: Earn awards from the Left Ramp wheel and the coffin's mystery awards.

steps.d: Repeatedly shoot the Left Ramp to light the Wheel, then shoot it to spin; stop it with the Action Button.
Hit the coffin to qualify Mystery Awards.
Shoot the Right Scoop to collect the mystery award.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Light modes with ramps, start them at the cellar under the right ramp, complete two for a mini-wizard and all four for the wizard mode.

steps.t: Shoot ramps to light a mode
steps.d: Hit the white-lit ramps to qualify a mode; the first needs one ramp and each later mode needs one more ramp than the last.

steps.t: Start a mode under the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot under the right ramp to start the lit mode. Press the action button to qualify a different mode if needed.

steps.t: Reach the frenzy phase to complete a mode
steps.d: Each mode has two phases; reaching the frenzy phase completes most modes.

steps.t: Complete two modes for the mini-wizard
steps.d: Completing two modes of your movie qualifies its mini-wizard mode.

steps.t: Complete all four modes for the wizard mode
steps.d: Finish all four modes of the chosen movie to reach its wizard mode.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Hit the cellar targets, escape Cheryl in frenzy and score a super jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the lit targets, which move left to right, four times.
This starts the 30-second frenzy phase.
Every four jackpots lights the cellar for a super jackpot and resets the timer.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Chain Linda, dig the grave and win the 2-ball multiball frenzy.

steps.t: Hit both ramps to chain up Linda
steps.d: Combo the two ramps quickly for a bigger speed bonus.

steps.t: Shoot the cellar and the lower loop
steps.d: Shoot the cellar, then hit the lower playfield loop to dig the grave and start frenzy.

steps.t: Score jackpots and finish the multiball
steps.d: Hit red shots for jackpots and necklace standups to raise their value; the mode completes when the multiball ends.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Collect deadite arrows and inlanes to start double deadite multiball, then reach deadite frenzy.

steps.d: Hit the orange deadite arrows.
After the arrows, hit both inlanes to pop up the deadites.
Start double deadite multiball and collect the jackpots behind downed deadites.
Complete deadites a second time to get deadite frenzy.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Load shells to open the cellar door, lock and load, then score purple jackpots.

steps.t: Load shells to open the cellar door
steps.d: Load the shells into the shotgun to qualify.

steps.t: Hit the lock and load shot
steps.d: In the basement (15 seconds or 3 drains), hit the lock and load shot.
Listen for ready, aim, fire and hit the launch button for bonus points.
Hit purple shots and load shells to light the action button for a new jackpot; the 2nd phase can add balls.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Drop the target and shoot into the lock mech.

steps.d: Knock down the cabin drop target.

steps.t: Shoot the ball into the lock mech
steps.d: Locks can be stolen.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Progress from the skill shot to the super skill shot.

steps.d: Plunge to hit the lit GROOVY target for 1M plus 500k per skill shot.
Hold the left flipper for a reduced-power plunge, then hit the random flashing shot within 5 seconds for 2x.

spooky/evil-dead-by-spooky-pinball.s: Spell GROOVY for mystery, and hit the hand for an extra ball.

steps.d: Complete GROOVY to light mystery on the right orbit.
Shoot the right orbit and press the action button to hit the moving award.

steps.t: Hit the hand for the extra ball
steps.d: Multiple hand hits (7, with 2 given at game start) light extra ball.

spooky/halloween.s: Complete drop targets to start main modes, win modes to light the extra ball, and reach Jack-O-Lantern Multiball and The Night He Came Home.

steps.d: Knock down the center drop targets, which also lights blood at three shots for about 20 seconds.

steps.t: Start a mode at the Jack-O-Lantern scoop
steps.d: Shoot the Jack-O-Lantern scoop and pick a main mode with the flippers.
Complete the mode's objective; collecting the end hurry-up on a hedge shot is optional but valuable. Six more blood shots then light.

steps.t: Win two modes to light extra ball
steps.d: Win two modes in a game to light the extra ball at the scoop. Each further mode on the same ball needs one more orbit shot to raise the drop targets.
After three modes are won, the next mode is a 4-ball multiball with drop targets lighting 250k jackpots, collected at any major shot.

steps.t: Qualify The Night He Came Home
steps.d: Start or complete the number of Jack-O-Lantern modes set in the game menu option.
steps.sec: The Night He Came Home (Wizard Mode)

spooky/halloween.s: Lock balls at the hedge shots, score jackpots on the scoops, then the super jackpot.

steps.t: Lock a ball at all three hedge shots
steps.d: Lock a ball at each of the three hedge shots to start Hedge Multiball.

steps.t: Collect jackpots at all three scoops
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp or a target next to a scoop to reveal Myers, then shoot that scoop within about 15 seconds. Repeat for all three scoops.
Shoot the lit middle scoop for the total of the jackpots; the first one also adds a ball.

spooky/halloween.s: Clear the middle playfield shots, then collect patient jackpots and the super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the middle playfield drop target, then the scoop behind it.

steps.t: Finish the four middle playfield shots
steps.d: Hit the two standup targets, then the drop target, then the scoop behind it. The multiball begins when the ball drains from the playfield.
Hit each of the six standup targets for a 225k jackpot in the 2-ball multiball.
Shoot the middle playfield scoop for the 500k super jackpot.

spooky/halloween.s: Qualify House Attack, defeat Myers, then score jackpots and the crossover super jackpot.

steps.d: Make five center ramp shots, or complete Hedge and Sanitarium Multiballs.
Start it instantly with a ramp shot passing through the left and right drop targets.
Shoot the two upper spinners enough within 60 seconds while avoiding drop target shots that drain Laurie's health; middle standups restore some.

steps.t: Defeat Myers to start House Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the drop target, then the crossover shot.
Collect orbit and ramp jackpots, then shoot the crossover for the super jackpot.

spooky/halloween.s: Score super jackpots in all three multiballs, then relock six balls to start the six-ball multiball.

steps.t: Score a super jackpot in each multiball
steps.d: Complete a super jackpot in Hedge, Sanitarium, and House Multiballs.

steps.t: Lock three balls at the hedge shots
steps.d: Phase 1: lock at Hedge 1, 2, and 3.
Phase 2: lock at the Jack-O-Lantern scoop and the Sanitarium scoop.
Phase 3: lock the final ball at the crossing shot.
Shoot the yellow and blue lit major shots after Loomis knocks Myers off the balcony.

spooky/halloween.s: Advance locations from Smith Grove to the Myers' House before fuel runs out.

steps.d: Start or complete the required number of Jack-O-Lantern modes set in the menu.
steps.sec: The Night He Came Home (Wizard Mode)

steps.d: Shoot the flashing white shot at each new location to lock in the jackpot value.
steps.sec: The Night He Came Home (Wizard Mode)

steps.d: Shoot lit knife inserts or drop targets; hitting a red blade scores a double. Each jackpot advances the location.
steps.sec: The Night He Came Home (Wizard Mode)

steps.t: Qualify and collect the super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the Judith Tombstone, then the target behind it. Only one per location.
steps.sec: The Night He Came Home (Wizard Mode)

steps.d: Keep fueled with spinners and drop targets and advance through all locations.
steps.sec: The Night He Came Home (Wizard Mode)

spooky/halloween.s: Make the skill shots, including the secret Tombstone lock.

steps.d: Pick a shot with the flippers before plunging; harder shots like the middle drop target score more. Drop targets must be hit exclusively.

steps.t: Make the secret Tombstone skill shot
steps.d: Plunge and immediately shoot the Judith Tombstone to lock the ball behind its drop target.
Release the locked ball to start Tombstone Multiball.

spooky/halloween.s: Collect blood and spend it at the scoop for scoring and an extra ball.

steps.d: Shoot lit blood shots after lighting or winning a Jack-O-Lantern mode.
Visit the lit Jack-O-Lantern scoop to buy 2x for the rest of the ball.

steps.t: Spend 12 blood on an extra ball
steps.d: Buy the extra ball at the blood store; it is awarded instantly.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Collect film reel segments to start episodes, finish them for encore bonuses, and light extra ball and special, ending at Duck Amuck.

steps.d: Hit the lit white arrows to collect three film reel segments; shooting the ACME Vault can light more arrows.
After three segments, hit the ACME Crate (center) or the ACME Vault (from the upper flipper), then pick an episode with the flippers and action button.

steps.t: Complete an episode and collect the encore bonus
steps.d: Finish the episode, then shoot the lit ACME Vault for the encore hurry-up; it is doubled if you hit no nearby targets first.

steps.t: Complete 3 episodes to light extra ball
steps.d: Completing 3 episodes lights extra ball at the right orbit.
Completing 6 episodes lights special at the outlanes.

steps.t: Play all episodes to start Duck Amuck
steps.d: After all episodes have been played, Duck Amuck can be started as the final episode.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Build combos at the right ramp to throw all three punches, unlocking Rabbit Punch and feeding Factory Mayhem.

steps.t: Score combos by hitting lit shots in succession
steps.d: Chain lit shots to build combo value toward the boxing maneuvers at the right ramp.

steps.t: Collect the jab, hook, and uppercut jackpots
steps.d: Hit the right ramp as each maneuver lights, in order: jab, hook, then uppercut.
With all three punches collected, Rabbit Punch is qualified the next time start episode is available.

steps.t: Land the knockout blow at the right ramp
steps.d: Deal damage with all shots lit, using combos to boost scoring, then hit the lit right ramp knockout.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Hit the spinner enough to start a Marvin mode at the left ramp, complete it, and earn its crate item.

steps.d: Make the required number of spinner hits at the left orbit to qualify an Area 51 & 3/4 mode.

steps.t: Start a mode at the left ramp
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp to start Space Modulator, Instant Martians, or Planet X; they are mutually exclusive.

steps.t: Complete the mode and claim its item at the crate
steps.d: Finish the mode to unlock its item, such as Martian Capsule or Integrating Pistol, earned at the crate.

steps.t: Start all Marvin modes for the Martian Bomb
steps.d: Starting every Marvin mode makes the Martian Bomb item available.

spooky/looney-tunes.t: Giant Rocket and Rocket Skates Multiball
spooky/looney-tunes.s: Shoot the captive ball to light the right orbit lock, lock three balls, and score jackpots to the super jackpot; the next play becomes Rocket Skates.

steps.d: Five strong captive ball shots count down the fuse and light the lock at the right orbit.

steps.t: Lock three balls at the right orbit
steps.d: Locking three balls starts Giant Rocket Multiball.

steps.t: Score five jackpots to relight the fuse
steps.d: Each jackpot at the major shots relights a fuse insert at the captive ball.

steps.t: Hit the captive ball for the super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the captive ball hurry-up quickly to score more.
Light the lock again with more captive ball hits, lock three balls, then try to lock extra balls at the left ramp, ACME Crate, or TNT lane.

steps.t: Score three 2x jackpots and the super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot yellow shots, then red shots for 2x jackpots; after three, shoot the open ACME Crate for the super jackpot.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Score Anvil Hurry-Ups to lock balls and start Anvil Frenzy, ending with a mega jackpot.

steps.t: Light and collect the Anvil Hurry-Up
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp to light it, then hit the ACME Crate to collect it.
Each hurry-up scored lights the virtual lock at the left ramp; two locked balls start Anvil Frenzy.

steps.t: Collect all jackpots for the super jackpot
steps.d: Collect jackpots at all major shots except the upper loops, then shoot the lit ACME Crate.
While the magnet holds the ball after the super jackpot, use the other ball to knock the captured ball into the ACME Crate.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Complete the TNT targets and shoot the hidden lane to add a ball and build the frenzy value.

steps.d: Finish the TNT targets at the bottom right to light the add-a-ball.

steps.t: Shoot the lane under the upper right flipper
steps.d: This adds a second ball and starts the frenzy.

steps.t: Hold a ball in the lane to double frenzy values
steps.d: Hold a single ball in the lane for up to 15 seconds to double all frenzy values.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Collect red shots from crate hits to fill the tornado meter, then play three phases of Taz-Mania.

steps.t: Hit the ACME Crate and collect red arrow shots
steps.d: Each crate hit spawns a red shot; collecting them advances the tornado lights.

steps.t: Complete the tornado lights and start Taz-Mania
steps.d: With the tornado complete and no mode running, shoot the ACME Crate or Vault.

steps.t: Phase 1: collect three jackpots and the super
steps.d: Collect three random jackpots, then the super jackpot at the ACME Crate.

steps.t: Phase 2: collect five jackpots and the super
steps.d: Collect five jackpots on the side Taz faces, then the super jackpot at the ACME Crate.

steps.t: Phase 3: slow Taz to a stop
steps.d: In the 60-second 3-ball multiball, hit major shots to build the super jackpot and slow Taz's spin.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Hit the upper loops to build MPH, raise bonus, light extra ball, and score the Roadrunner Jackpot.

steps.t: Shoot the upper loops to build MPH
steps.d: Each loop adds MPH, with consecutive loops boosting the amount; each 35 MPH raises the bonus multiplier.
Each loop shot lights one of the 12 inserts around the loop.
Shoot the loop in either direction, multiplied by consecutive loops without a miss.

steps.t: Reach 200 MPH to light extra ball
steps.d: Getting the Roadrunner's speed to 200 MPH lights extra ball.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Progress from the basic skill shot to the super skill shot at ball start.

steps.d: Time your launch so the ball hits the strobing ACME Vault target.
Press the action button before launching, then hit the upper left loop right after plunging.

spooky/looney-tunes.s: Use the hidden lane and return lanes to light and boost playfield X, and carrot targets for outlane ball save.

steps.t: Hit 5 carrot targets for outlane ball save
steps.d: Five carrot targets light the outlane ball saves; later ones need more targets.

steps.t: Light playfield X at the hidden lane
steps.d: Hit the hidden lane behind the upper left flipper, often via rebounds off the captive ball.
Roll through the lit return lane for 30 seconds of playfield X.
Hit the hidden lane again while lit to add +1x, up to 6x.

spooky/rick-morty.s: Lock two balls with Flooble Crank hits, start multiball at the scoop, then collect jackpots and super jackpots, and add a ball.

steps.t: Hit the Flooble Crank to light a lock
steps.d: One Flooble Crank hit qualifies either side of the Danesi Lock 2.0 for a lock.

steps.t: Lock a ball, then light and lock the second
steps.d: After the first lock, another Flooble Crank hit lights the remaining open side for the second lock.
With two balls locked, shoot the flashing green center scoop.

steps.t: Collect a jackpot to light the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Any jackpot lights the first Super Jackpot at the garage.
Shoot the left orbit to the garage or the right orbit for the first; later ones need the left orbit to garage. Each next one needs one more jackpot.
Hit the Flooble Crank three times during multiball to add a ball. Only one per continuous multiball.

spooky/rick-morty.s: Qualify with the ramps, start Adventures at the scoop, complete them for green stamps, and reach Morty's Choice on every 10th.

steps.t: Shoot a ramp to qualify an Adventure
steps.d: One ramp qualifies the first Adventure; later ones need both left and right ramps.

steps.t: Start an Adventure at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the lit scoop. Pickle Rick instead starts at a garage entrance.

steps.t: Complete an Adventure for a green stamp
steps.d: Finish the Adventure's completion condition; draining only gives a plain stamp.

steps.t: Complete 9 Adventures to reach Morty's Choice
steps.d: The 10th Adventure start brings up the selector, with multiplied scoring on uncompleted ones.

steps.t: Play Rick Potion No.9 on a full card
steps.d: It is only available from the selector on a full card.

spooky/rick-morty.s: Charge the portal gun, jump dimensions, collect Megaseeds for bonus, and light an extra ball.

steps.d: Hit the spinner and other regular shots to fully charge the portal gun, lighting both garage entrances.

steps.t: Enter a dimension via a garage entrance
steps.d: Make either garage entrance. The garage lights 5 megaseeds, the right orbit only 3.
Shoot the orange lit shots; each adds 5% of ball score to end of ball bonus.
Recharge the portal gun or collect all Megaseeds to light another dimension for an extra Megaseed.

steps.t: Visit 3 dimensions to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Collect the extra ball at the spinner loop.

spooky/rick-morty.s: Spawn and collect Meeseeks to start the 2-ball Meeseeks Mania and finish with the hurry-up.

steps.t: Hit the Meeseeks Box to spawn a Meeseeks
steps.d: A Meeseeks spawns on a lit blue shot.
Shoot the lit blue shots before they go bad; up to 3 Meeseeks give 2x-4x.

steps.t: Use enough Meeseeks to start Meeseeks Mania
steps.d: Use the total shown in the upper right of the score display.
Meeseeks are on every shot; hit the Meeseeks Box to add more and reset bad ones.
After draining to one ball, hit lit Jerry before hitting Beth or Summer.

spooky/rick-morty.s: Complete the left targets and shoot the scoop to collect Mystery.

steps.t: Complete BETH, SUMMER and JERRY targets
steps.d: Hit all three left standup targets to light Mystery at the center scoop.
Shoot the scoop while the blue lights are lit for an award like Light Lock or Charge Portal Gun.

spooky/rick-morty.s: Score the skill shot at ball start, then upgrade to the garage super skill shot and loop multipliers.

steps.t: Hit the Noob Noob target skill shot
steps.d: Hit the lit Noob Noob target with the upper flipper for 200k.

steps.t: Make the garage super skill shot
steps.d: Shoot the left garage entrance with the upper flipper for 400k, rising on later successes.

steps.t: Make the side loop to multiply the skill shot
steps.d: A full side loop shot multiplies the skill shot values.

spooky/rick-morty.s: Complete SLAM lanes to build the SLAM ring bonus and qualify the Slam Save.

steps.t: Complete SLAM at the return lanes
steps.d: Light S, L, A, M to qualify the Slam Save and light the SLAM RING.

steps.t: Complete SLAM again to raise the ring value
steps.d: There are five exponential bonus levels indicated by color.
Let a ball drain off a pop bumper hit while it is lit to get the ball back and a bonus.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Qualify cases at the Mystery Machine, collect clues, unmask villains, and complete all seven to light Would've Gotten Away With It.

steps.t: Qualify a case with fingerprint shots
steps.d: Shoot the flashing fingerprint shots; the first case qualifies after two clues, later cases need more. Lock in a case with the launch button.
Make the clue shots shown by the magnifying glass while keeping the Bravery Meter high, since it multiplies shots.

steps.t: Hit trap shots, then unmask the villain
steps.d: After the clues, a timer starts. Collect the villain's trap shots to boost the bonus, then shoot the Mystery Machine before time runs out.
Unmask all seven villains to light the center ramp for Would've Gotten Away With It.

steps.t: Start Would've Gotten Away With It
steps.d: Shoot the lit center ramp after completing all seven mysteries.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Qualify and play each character's mode to light The Gang's All Here wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot a character orbit to qualify that character's mode.

steps.t: Start the mode at the Left VUK
steps.d: Shoot the Left VUK; the last character qualified is the mode that starts.
Play the Daphne, Fred, Shaggy, Velma, and Scooby modes to light the center ramp.
Shoot the lit center ramp after playing all five character modes.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Light lock with the spinners, lock three balls, then score jackpots and super jackpots from the character orbits.

steps.t: Light the Mystery Machine for lock
steps.d: Shoot the two spinners (left ramp and Mystery Machine entrance) enough times.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start multiball
steps.d: Lock balls in the Mystery Machine; the third lock starts the multiball.

steps.t: Light jackpots at the character orbits
steps.d: Make each of the four character orbits three times to light its jackpot.

steps.t: Score super jackpots at the Mystery Machine
steps.d: Keep the orbit inserts synced to light the super jackpot, up to 3x; shoot the Mystery Machine to lock in progress.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Make the footprint shots, bash the helmet, and collect timed jackpots.

steps.t: Make each Captain Cutler footprint shot twice
steps.d: Hit all four footprint shots on the upper playfield two times each.

steps.t: Bash the diving helmet to start
steps.d: Hit the diving helmet between the shots to start the multiball.
Shoot the randomly lit Captain Cutler shots within about 10 seconds; value rises with each shot.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Complete the SD targets to enable the apron lock, lock two balls, and start multiball.

steps.d: Hit the SD targets next to the major shots on the lower playfield to enable the apron lock.

steps.t: Lock a ball on an apron lock
steps.d: Use the left VUK behind the snack drop targets or the upper playfield shot to the Scooby-Doo ramp.

steps.t: Complete the SD targets again and lock the second ball
steps.d: Finish all 4 SD targets again and lock on the opposite apron lock to start the multiball.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.t: Scooby Doo, Where Are You? Finale
spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Complete both feeder wizard modes to light the final wizard mode.

steps.t: Start Would've Gotten Away With It
steps.d: Complete all seven mysteries, then shoot the lit center ramp.
Play all five character modes, then shoot the lit center ramp.

steps.t: Start Scooby Doo, Where Are You?
steps.d: After both wizard modes are complete, shoot the lit center ramp.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Choose a skill shot target and hit it, then go for the secret skill shot.

steps.d: Hit the flashing red skill shot on the left drops, character orbits, or standup targets.
Select the left drops, then hit the lowermost drop target for 100k points.

spooky/scooby-doo-where-are-you.s: Use ball save features and the Green Ghoul hurry-up for points.

steps.t: Light both left outlanes for Ruh-Roh
steps.d: Light both left outlanes to save your current ball.
Hit the clue standups beside the center ramp, or hit each lit dog tag target by the left ramp and Mystery Machine.
Advance the clock with slings to midnight, then roll over a lit inlane.

steps.t: Hit two ghouls with one shot
steps.d: Shoot two Green Ghouls as they cross over to win a jackpot.

spooky/total-nuclear-annihilation.s: Qualify, start, overheat and destroy each reactor, repeating through all 9 reactors to reach the game-ending wizard mode.

steps.t: Fill the grid to qualify the reactor
steps.d: Hit the three yellow grid targets to advance the pink lights in each column until the whole keypad grid is pink, which qualifies the Reactor Start at the scoop.

steps.t: Shoot the scoop to start the reactor
steps.d: With the grid all pink, shoot the main scoop to start the current reactor.
Hit the spinners and the switches/slingshots in the upper reactor area until the display passes 99. Kicker sides advance it faster, and the 1,2,3 targets in order raise the value fastest.

steps.t: Hit the flashing targets to destroy the reactor
steps.d: Once critical, hit all the flashing white targets (RAD, Destroy, Pop Bumper) to collect the Reactor Bonus and reset the grid. Higher reactors need more targets.
Repeat the process through reactors 1-9 to complete Total Nuclear Annihilation, which ends the game.

spooky/total-nuclear-annihilation.s: Once a reactor is running, refill the grid in red to score jackpots worth a share of the reactor's value.

steps.d: Qualify the grid and shoot the scoop to start the reactor.

steps.t: Fill the grid with red to collect a Reactor Jackpot
steps.d: After the reactor starts the grid resets. Hit the grid targets to fill it with red, awarding 25% of the current Reactor Value.

spooky/total-nuclear-annihilation.s: Lock two balls, start the 3-ball multiball, collect escalating jackpots and the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the in-line lock drop target lane to lock balls; the targets reset to trap a ball behind the first two.

steps.t: Hit the Lock target to start multiball
steps.d: With two balls locked, hit the Lock target to release them for a 3-ball multiball.

steps.t: Hit the drop targets in order for jackpots
steps.d: Hit target 1 for a 1x, 2 for a 2x, and 3 for a 3x jackpot. The targets cascade back every 5 seconds if you don't get the next one.

steps.t: Shoot the lock scoop for the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the scoop behind the drop targets for a Super Jackpot (5x). Doing so immediately at multiball start, before the targets reset, also adds a ball.

steps.t: Add a ball for a 4x multiplier
steps.d: Put the ball in the scoop behind the drops during multiball to add a ball. With all other balls still in play this raises the playfield multiplier to 4x.

spooky/total-nuclear-annihilation.s: Progress from a regular skill shot to the Hands-Free skill shot and the secret lock skill shot.

steps.d: Move the lit rollover with the flippers after plunging, then land the ball in it for 50,000 points and a ball-save level.
Set the lit CORE rollover before plunging and land the ball in it to complete the grid, spot a ball-save level and score 100,000.
With fewer than 2 balls locked, full-plunge past the rollovers then flip the ball into the lock lane for 100,000 and a lock.

spooky/total-nuclear-annihilation.s: Complete the RAD targets and shoot the scoop to collect a mystery award.

steps.d: Hit the R, A and D white targets above the left inlane to qualify Mystery.

steps.t: Shoot the scoop to collect Mystery
steps.d: Shoot the main scoop to collect a random award such as points, locks, ball save or bonus multiplier.

spooky/total-nuclear-annihilation.s: Light the SAVE lanes to earn ball saves and complete the CORE rollovers to raise the bonus multiplier.

steps.t: Light the S, A, V, E lanes
steps.d: Pass over unlit inlane/outlane lanes (or cycle them with the flippers) to light three letters, which qualifies a ball save and flashes the 4th lane.

steps.t: Hit the flashing lane to activate the ball save
steps.d: Trigger the flashing lane to start a 10 second ball save. Extra levels can be stacked.
Complete C, O, R, E to increase the end-of-ball bonus multiplier.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Complete the center drop targets to light the Beta Capsule scoop, pick a kaiju battle, finish it, and re-arm the drop targets with orbits for the next battle.

steps.t: Complete the center drop target bank
steps.d: Knock down all three center drop targets to light the Beta Capsule scoop for a Quick Battle.

steps.t: Start a Quick Battle at the Beta Capsule
steps.d: Shoot the lit scoop, use the flippers to pick a kaiju and double flip to start. Easy, medium and hard battles are available.
Hit the shots illuminated during selection to complete the kaiju battle, such as Ragon's four flow shots or Pestor's five roaming shots.

steps.t: Shoot the scoop to finish off the kaiju
steps.d: After the final battle shot, shoot the scoop to defeat the kaiju and collect the bonus.

steps.t: Hit orbits to relight the drop targets
steps.d: The drop targets do not reset on their own. Shoot one orbit after the first kaiju, plus one more per kaiju completed that ball, to relight them.

steps.t: Complete two battles to start Dada
steps.d: Finishing two Quick Battles automatically starts the Dada expert mode.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Starts automatically after two Quick Battles, then alternates between jackpot shots and locks until Dada is defeated.

steps.d: Dada starts automatically after two Quick Battles are completed.
Hit the shot flashing blue within 15 seconds to light the flow shots for jackpots.

steps.t: Collect flow jackpots to lower Dada's health
steps.d: Each 250,000 jackpot lowers Dada's health.

steps.t: Shoot a physical lock, then repeat to defeat Dada
steps.d: After 20 seconds, shoot one of the physical locks to return to the blue insert phase. Repeat until Dada is defeated.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Qualify with Science Patrol Assists, defend Tokyo's power grid through three attacks, and score the Super Jackpot to end the mode.

steps.d: A minimum of three Science Patrol Assists qualifies Neronga. Extra assists let you restore offline sections.

steps.t: Restore power by shooting draining sections
steps.d: Shoot shots in the section Neronga is draining to restore its power. Keep power high everywhere for maximum scoring.

steps.t: Clear the drop targets during attacks
steps.d: When the drop targets rise, clear them to slow the power drain and score the remaining hurry-up value.

steps.t: Survive three attacks and shoot the Super Jackpot
steps.d: After three attacks, hit the lit crossing shot on the upper playfield for the Super Jackpot, which ends the mode.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Start the three-ball multiball at the left scoops, collect a jackpot at each scoop, and cash the Super Jackpot for an add-a-ball.

steps.t: Shoot each of the three Baltan scoops
steps.d: Shooting each scoop on the far left starts the three-ball Baltan Multiball.
Shoot the left ramp or the targets next to the scoops to swing a Baltan figure out for about 10-12 seconds.

steps.t: Collect a Baltan Jackpot at each scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop matching the revealed Baltan. Collect one at every scoop to light the middle scoop.
Shoot the lit middle scoop to resume the multiball with an add-a-ball. Only one ball is added.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Battle Bemular on the middle playfield, qualify the two-ball multiball, then collect jackpots and the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Start Bemular on the middle playfield
steps.d: Shoot the drop target and then the scoop on the middle playfield to start the single-ball mode.

steps.t: Complete the wheel targets, drop target and scoop
steps.d: After the scoop ejects the ball, hit the two wheel standup targets, then the drop target and the scoop again to qualify multiball.

steps.t: Exit the middle playfield to start multiball
steps.d: Multiball starts when the ball leaves the middle playfield. Ideally exit via the headlight shot to the shooter lane.

steps.t: Hit all six standup targets for jackpots
steps.d: All main playfield standup targets are lit for 225,000 jackpots. Collect all six to light the Super Jackpot.
Shoot the scoop on the middle playfield to collect the Super Jackpot.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Qualify Jirahs, defeat him with spinners on the upper playfield, then play a three-ball multiball ending in Super Jackpots.

steps.d: Complete Baltan and Bemular Multiballs, or do the dirty pool shot: lower only the center drop target, then shoot the center ramp through the gap.

steps.t: Shoot the center ramp to start the Jirahs battle
steps.d: Once qualified, the diverter opens to the upper playfield and the next center ramp shot starts the battle.

steps.t: Spin the spinners to drain Jirahs' health
steps.d: Hit the upper spinners while avoiding the red drop target. Restore Ultraman's health with middle playfield standups if needed.

steps.t: Hit the purple drop target and crossing ramp
steps.d: When Jirahs' health hits zero, shoot the purple drop target and then the crossing ramp to start the three-ball phase.
All orbits and ramps are lit for jackpots. Each jackpot raises the Super Jackpot by 250,000, and spinners add 25,000 per spin.

steps.t: Score the crossover ramp Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the crossover ramp, starting at 2,500,000. It resets the value and relights collected jackpots.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Progress from the chosen plunge skill shot to the Secret Skill Shot that locks a ball.

steps.d: Select the red-lit skill shot with the flipper buttons before plunging. The middle drop target is worth the most, and you must hit only that target.
Shoot the standup target behind the Science Patrol drop target to lock the current ball.

spooky/ultraman-wiki.s: Collect Spacium from lit standups and cash it in at the scoop, while chaining flow shot combos.

steps.t: Collect Spacium at the lit standups
steps.d: Spacium lights at the standup targets after completing the drop target bank or a Quick Battle. Hit them before it disappears.

steps.t: Cash in three or more Spacium
steps.d: Turn in at the scoop for awards such as points, extra tilt, or double playfield value.

steps.t: Complete combos on the flow shots
steps.d: Hit the left orbit, left ramp, center ramp and right orbit in combo. Each shot unlights once collected.

stern/007-60th-anniversary.s: Complete the MI6 drop targets to light the disc, play all six villain modes, then start Villain Multiball.

steps.t: Complete the MI6 drop target bank
steps.d: Complete the MI6 drop target bank to light the disc for villain mode selection.
With the disc lit, complete the MI6 bank again to start the selected villain mode.

steps.t: Complete MI6 during a mode for double scoring
steps.d: Completing MI6 during a mode adds time to the timer and doubles all scoring in the mode.
Finish Zorin, Trevelyan, LeChiffre, Blofeld, Oddjob and Jaws to qualify Villain Multiball.
Shoot the left saucer after completing all six villain modes; make all four spinners to restart the spinner sequence.

stern/007-60th-anniversary.s: Advance the gadget meter with BOND targets to earn Q gadgets, ending in Gadget Multiball.

steps.d: Complete the BOND drop targets to light the disc and advance the Gadget Meter.

steps.t: Fill the gadget meter to earn Q gadgets
steps.d: Each full meter awards the flashing Q gadget in order: Jetpack, Spy Camera, Gondola Hovercraft, X-Ray Glasses.
Collecting all four gadgets, ending with X-Ray Glasses, starts Gadget Multiball.

steps.t: Shoot the disc to score gadgets
steps.d: During Gadget Multiball keep shooting the disc to advance the meter and score gadgets from the films.

stern/007-60th-anniversary.s: Light the lock, start the 2-ball multiball, re-lock both balls for 3-ball, and score jackpots.

steps.d: Complete the inline drop targets, make the drop target hole skill shot, or press the action button after collecting the Spy Camera.
Shoot the lit right scoop eject to start the 2-ball multiball.
Shoot one scoop, then lock the other ball at the opposite scoop within 15 seconds, then plunge the third ball.
Lock a ball at either scoop to light the captive ball jackpot for 15 seconds; locks at both scoops give a double.

steps.t: Shoot the M target for the super jackpot
steps.d: After a jackpot, hit the M target before time runs out to score the super jackpot and restart the sequence.

stern/007-60th-anniversary.s: Collect all six Bonds at the left scoop to start Bond Multiball and award movies.

steps.t: Light the left scoop for Collect Bond
steps.d: Start a villain mode or complete the BOND targets to light the left scoop.
Collect six Bonds at the left scoop to light it for Bond Multiball.
Bond Multiball begins once all six Bonds are collected.
Shoot bumpers, loops, drop targets and disc to fill the movie meter for a Bond movie award and jackpot.

stern/007-60th-anniversary.s: Start the three main multiballs, then defuse the bomb to reach 007 Multiball.

steps.d: Complete all six villain modes and shoot the left saucer.
Collect all four Q gadgets.
Collect all six Bonds.

steps.t: Start 007 Mode at the left scoop
steps.d: With all three multiballs started, shoot the left scoop to begin the single-ball bomb defusal.

steps.t: Defuse the bomb to start 007 Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the three inline drop targets, then the right scoop before the timer expires; all shots are lit in the multiball.

stern/007-60th-anniversary.s: Score the start-of-ball skill shots and complete 007 lanes up to the extra ball.

steps.d: Plunge for the flashing top lane to score the lit back panel award.

steps.t: Make the drop target hole skill shot
steps.d: Hold the left flipper and shoot the hole behind the drop targets to complete them and light Mission Multiball lock.
Each completion scores the lit award; the second lights Collect Bonus and the third lights Extra Ball.

steps.t: Shoot the captive ball for the extra ball
steps.d: Hit the lit captive ball after the third 007 lane award.

stern/007-60th-anniversary.s: Score all eight unique loop-based combos, each increasing the next.

steps.d: For example Dr. No: center loop to center loop.

steps.t: Score different combos in a row
steps.d: Each unique combo increases the value of the next, using upper left loop, center loop, captive ball and inline drop target shots.
Make Dr. No, OHMSS, Moonraker, A View to a Kill, Living Daylights, Goldeneye, Skyfall and No Time to Die.

stern/aerosmith.s: Win song modes by making their lit shots, cash in the super features, and build toward Medley Multiball and Final Tour.

steps.t: Start a song and make lit shots
steps.d: Pick a song at the start of the ball and shoot its lit shots within 60 seconds; any lit shot lights Crank it Up at the left scoop.
Make the required number of shots for the song (e.g. 8 for Rats in the Cellar, 12 for Sweet Emotion) to win the mode.
Finish the shots required by the super feature (e.g. 100 spins, 10 ramps or 100 bumper hits) after winning the mode.

steps.t: Start three songs to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Starting three songs in a game lights extra ball at the left eject.
Score at least one award in every song and play both multiballs, then shoot the left saucer to start it.

stern/aerosmith.s: Shoot the toybox to light locks, start the multiball, and finish with the double super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the toybox to light lock at the lock saucer; up to 6 locks can be lit, and each later multiball needs more toybox hits per lock.

steps.t: Lock balls and start Toybox Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the lock saucer to lock balls; press the action button after at least 3 locks to start, or lock 6 for 2x base jackpots.
Make all 8 shots; the 8th is a super jackpot. Do this twice.
After two super jackpots, hit the lit roving shot for double jackpot, then the lock saucer for the double super jackpot to complete the multiball.
During the multiball, shoot the toybox then the lock saucer to re-lock 1 ball (2x) or 2 balls (3x) for 20 seconds.

stern/aerosmith.s: Light three elevator locks, start the multiball, collect each major jackpot and the elevator super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot both orbits (or the drop target on Prem/LE) to light a lock; later attempts need repeated orbit shots.
Lock three balls at the elevator to start Elevator Multiball.

steps.t: Collect jackpots at all major shots
steps.d: Shoot a lit major shot, then the Elevator for its jackpot; repeat for every major shot.
Shoot the Elevator after all major jackpots; a perfect attempt pays 100% of the jackpot total, completing the multiball.

stern/aerosmith.s: Complete the AEROSMITH targets to light mystery and shot multipliers, and cash in the awards.

steps.d: Complete the targets to light mystery at the left eject and the X inserts at the major shots.
Shoot the left eject for an award such as big points, elevator lock, smart missiles, extra ball or special.
Shoot a major shot with a flashing X insert to score double for the rest of the ball.
Qualify every X insert on a single ball to enable the roving X insert for 3x.

stern/aerosmith.s: Make the hidden skill shot, then the super skill shot, to earn smart missiles.

steps.d: Plunge lightly into the lock saucer for 500k and +1 smart missile.
Hold the left flipper, short plunge to the right flipper, then hit one of the three lit shots for 1M and +2 smart missiles.

steps.t: Use a smart missile in a song
steps.d: Press the action button during a song to spot a lit shot, prioritizing the left side.

stern/aerosmith.s: Light extra ball at the left eject through songs, Dead Shot Jackys or mystery.

steps.d: Starting 3 songs in a game lights extra ball.
During songs, shots that aren't lit add Dead Shot Jackys; scoring 5 plus other variable numbers lights extra ball.

steps.t: Collect the extra ball at the left eject
steps.d: Shoot the left eject while extra ball is lit.

stern/aerosmith.s: Start 2x playfield scoring and light the VIP Pass ball save.

steps.d: Hit all five targets behind the upper playfield flipper with backhanded shots.
Shoot the loop exit out of the upper playfield for 60 seconds of 2x scoring.
Collect the Double Scoring mystery award to start 2x scoring.

steps.t: Light the VIP Pass ball save
steps.d: Complete the two targets flanking the toybox enough times to light the right outlane ball save; completing them again raises its value.

stern/aerosmith.s: Qualify the mini-wizard, complete the song stages and score its super jackpot, which qualifies Final Tour.

steps.d: Score at least one award in all songs and play both multiballs.
Shoot the left saucer; earn 10M per completed song, or a 200M Perfect Bonus for all songs.
Finish the task for each uncompleted song to advance stages, adding a ball each time.
After completing all nine songs, shoot the left scoop for the super jackpot, ending the mode.
Complete all songs before starting Medley, or complete them all within it, to have Final Tour ready.

stern/aerosmith.s: Complete all 9 songs, then play through 24 cities to the 100M super jackpot.

steps.d: Complete every song in normal play or during Medley Multiball to qualify Final Tour.
Begin the frenzy and advance through cities by completing sets of 8 shots worth 10M, 20M, then 30M.
Finish all three sets of 8 shots to qualify the left scoop.

steps.t: Collect the Final Tour Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the left scoop for the 100M super jackpot, ending the mode.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Spell STRANGE, win a Gem Quest, collect and place the Gem, and keep progressing toward the Thanos battles.

steps.d: Spin the disc to light all letters of S-T-R-A-N-G-E; rolling the right inlane then hitting the disc makes each spin count 2x.

steps.t: Start a Gem Quest at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp (Pro) or the portal (Prem/LE), then pick any Gem Quest with the flippers and confirm.
Complete the quest's shots and score the Final Blow without draining while it is active.

steps.t: Collect the Gem at the right ramp
steps.d: Collect Gem lights at the right ramp and takes priority over further quests.

steps.t: Place the Gem on a flashing shot
steps.d: Shoot a flashing Gem shot to place it and enable its perk, then light the disc to qualify the next Gem Quest.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Light Portal Locks before a Gem Quest to boost it, then earn Victory Laps by finishing the quest with balls still locked.

steps.d: Make the Secret Skill Shot 1, make 4 combos, complete the first Hawkeye Challenge, or collect a Computer Grid award.

steps.t: Collect Portal Locks at the disc
steps.d: Up to 2 locks can be collected before starting a Gem Quest, enabling 2x/3x scoring.

steps.t: Complete a Gem Quest with locked balls in play
steps.d: Finishing the quest while the locked balls are still in play enables Victory Laps at all major shots.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Assemble all six Avengers to start the mini-wizard modes in order.

steps.d: Shoot each Avenger's shot enough times: Hulk spinner, Iron Man IRON, Captain America pops, Black Widow left ramp, Thor captive ball, Black Panther right orbit.
Keep shooting a collected Avenger's shot to reach level 1 and level 2; any level 2 earns a Trophy.
Shoot the right ramp, then hit 8 lit green shots without running out of flips.
Collect jackpot at the upper loop, spell STRANGE, and score the Super Jackpot at the pop bumper lane.

steps.t: Defeat the Black Order in Battle Royale
steps.d: Survive with your 6 Avenger lives and clear waves of lit shots to win the mode.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Progress through gems and mini-wizards to defend Gems and finally defeat Thanos.

steps.t: Get two Gems and the Soul Gem
steps.d: This qualifies Thanos Attacks at the lit right ramp.

steps.t: Defend all your Gems in Thanos Attacks
steps.d: For each Gem, shoot the Gem shot, left orbit, left ramp, right orbit, then right ramp within the timer.

steps.t: Attempt all six Gem Quests and all three mini-wizards
steps.d: This lights the right ramp for the final battle.

steps.t: Start Battle Thanos and deal damage
steps.d: Shoot the red and blue flashing shots in the four-ball multiball; hitting the disc rotates them.

steps.t: Score the Final Blow at the Tower
steps.d: Defeat Thanos to reach 6-ball Super Victory Laps.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Light locks, lock three balls, then clear jackpot phases for the super jackpot.

steps.d: Spell I-R-O-N at the return lanes (changed by disc spins) or collect Light Lock from the grid.
Lock three balls at the Tower to start the multiball.

steps.t: Collect both jackpots in a phase
steps.d: Two jackpot shots light at a time; collecting both qualifies the Tower super jackpot.

steps.t: Finish phase four and hit the disc super
steps.d: Collect the two phase-four jackpots, then spin the disc for the Super Jackpot and Trophy.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Hit the captive ball to start, then chain jackpots and Mjolnir Attacks to the super jackpot.

steps.t: Spell THOR at the captive ball
steps.d: Three captive ball shots start the first one (T and H are spotted).
Collect jackpots, then shoot the lit captive ball for a Mjolnir Attack; the sequence repeats.

steps.t: Score the Super Jackpot at the Tower
steps.d: After four runs through the sequence, shoot Avengers Tower for 20x jackpot and the Trophy.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Complete drop targets to fill grid lines, play all six Super Modes, then Computer Frenzy.

steps.t: Complete drop targets to collect grid awards
steps.d: Hit a drop target to lock the cycling award, then complete the rest of the targets.

steps.t: Complete a line to start a Super Mode
steps.d: Collect 3 awards in a line to start Hulk Rampage, Super Arc Reactor, Super Gauntlet, Super Targets, Super Combos, or Super Disc.
This qualifies Computer Frenzy Multiball.

steps.t: Start Computer Frenzy and score a bingo
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp, spot grid lamps with shots for jackpots, and complete a bingo for a super jackpot.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Build combos for awards, combo jackpots, an extra ball and Trophies.

steps.d: Shoot the white-flashing shots after a major shot to light a Portal Lock.

steps.t: Light and collect the Combo Jackpot
steps.d: At 8 combos, shoot a full right orbit to collect it.
Earn Bronze and Silver Trophies, then an Extra Ball and Gold Trophy at 50.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Complete bullseye targets to light and win Hawkeye Challenge at rising levels.

steps.d: One completion lights Hawkeye Challenge at Avengers Tower.
Hit the inner loop or bullseye target for a Portal Lock + 3M.
Hit the inner loop for an Extra Ball.
Hit the inner loop for an uncollected Gem + 10M.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Progress from the basic skill shot to the secret skill shots.

steps.d: Plunge softly into the top rollover near the pop bumpers.
Full plunge and shoot the Avengers Tower; the first one lights Mystery.
Plunge medium so the ball rolls back down the upper loop (lights a Portal Lock), or full plunge and shoot the center drop target.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Accumulate Captain Marvel shots for hurry-ups, Mystery, Trophies and an Extra Ball.

steps.d: Starts the Binary Hurry-Up and lights Mystery.
Shoot the left ramp or Captain Marvel, then the other shot for a doubled value.
Earn Bronze, Silver and Gold Trophies (540/960/1440 spins on Pro).

steps.t: Reach 50 ramps (1500 spins) for an Extra Ball
steps.d: Lights the Extra Ball at the Sanctum target.

stern/avengers-infinity-quest.s: Collect Trophies from across the game to reach the true wizard mode.

steps.d: Complete Gem Quests, multiballs, count-ups, Super Modes and mini-wizards at Bronze, Silver or Gold level.
This is the only way to qualify Trophy Mania.

steps.t: Start Trophy Mania at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp and collect Trophy Jackpots at the lit arrows.

steps.t: Fill the case and score the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collect 24 trophies in the case to light the Super Jackpot at Ant-Man.

stern/batman-66.s: Qualify villains, score the Bat-Phone hurry-up, play the villain modes, and arrest all four to unlock the Villain Escape wizard mode.

steps.d: Make the villain's shots until the turntable rotates to reveal the Bat-Phone: both ramps for Catwoman, Villain-Vision targets for Joker, scoop for Penguin, orbits for Riddler.
Shoot the Bat-Phone to start the qualified major villain mode. Qualifying more villains first raises the hurry-up value.

steps.t: Clear stages to light the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Complete each stage's shots to light the Super Jackpot at the scoop, then cash it in or keep going for +1x.

steps.t: Arrest two villains to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Capture two different major villains to light Extra Ball at the left orbit saucer.
Capture Catwoman, Joker, Penguin and Riddler to qualify Villain Escape at the left orbit.
Shoot the left orbit saucer to begin the timed build phase, where switch hits increase the Villain Value.

steps.t: Defeat all four villains in the multiball
steps.d: In the 4-ball phase, shoot each villain's lit shots once (Penguin: five crane positions then scoop) to light the Super Jackpot at the left orbit saucer.

stern/batman-66.s: Light the locks during a major villain mode, lock three balls, then score jackpots and the Atomic Pile Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Score the Bat-Phone hurry-up to begin a major villain mode.
Shoot the two targets on either side of the turntable during the mode to light the three locks at the right orbit.
Shoot the right orbit lock three times; a Gadget used as the ball exits the left orbit saucer also locks.
With all major shots lit green, collect 12 jackpots to rotate the turntable to the Batcave.
Shoot the Atomic Pile behind the Batmobile spinner. Each later Super Jackpot needs 2 more shots.

stern/batman-66.s: Complete the TV targets to play minor villains, capture one from each season, and choose a 6-ball wizard multiball.

steps.d: Finish the TV standup targets to light the left orbit for a minor villain.
Shoot the left orbit, pick a villain with the flippers, and confirm with the action button.
Complete all waves of Mad Hatter, King Tut or Bookworm within 45 seconds.
Win a Season 2 mode such as King Tut, Egghead, Mr. Freeze, Shame or Mad Hatter.
Win a Season 3 mode such as King Tut, Egghead or Shame.

steps.t: Start a Minor Villain Wizard Mode
steps.d: Shoot the left orbit and choose Batusi, Robin's Holy, or Gas Attack Multiball, each a 6-ball multiball.

stern/batman-66.s: Win specific minor villains for perks that last through the ball or game.

steps.d: Complete a Mad Hatter mode to be able to replay failed minor villain modes.
Complete Bookworm so minor villain awards last until the end of the game.
Each King Tut win after the first adds +1x to the main channel multiplier for the rest of the ball.
Complete Mr. Freeze to freeze all game timers.
Complete Shame to add a ball and +10 seconds of ball save to multiballs.

stern/batman-66.s: Build Batmobile spinner value, start Bat Turn at the Atomic Pile, and rack up hurry-up shots.

steps.d: Spin it 10 times; each spin adds 25,000 to the base value.
Shoot the lit Atomic Pile shot (blue insert at the turntable) to begin the 40 second mode.
Shoot the blue major shots, and spin the Batmobile spinner to relight them and reset the value.

stern/batman-66.s: Build playfield and shot multipliers to boost scoring.

steps.d: Hit the two standups flanking the Batmobile spinner, then shoot the Atomic Pile for 30 seconds of 2x.
Complete the targets again and shoot the Atomic Pile while 2x is running.
Hit the Commissioner Gordon target 3 times to light the white X inserts.
Make the next shot to apply the multiplier for the rest of the ball, up to 6x.

stern/batman-66.s: Progress from the basic skill shots to the Super Skill Shot at the plunger.

steps.t: Make the Top Lane Skill Shot
steps.d: Roll over the switch below the arrows when all three are lit.
Soft plunge into the Penguin scoop, or shoot the scoop quickly after a soft plunge.
Hold the left flipper while plunging and hit a flashing major shot within 5 seconds.

stern/batman-66.s: Earn gadgets and combos, which feed extra balls and mode progress.

steps.d: Complete the GADGET standup bank to award a Gadget.
Press the action button to spot a mode shot or gadget-lock a ball.
Shoot a ramp or full orbit, then a shot on the other side of the playfield.
Reach 20, 50, and 100 combos in a game to light Extra Ball at the left orbit saucer.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Qualify and win monster battles, boost them with Sword of Rage Power, and win all five to unlock the Black Castle wizard mode and Rage Multiball.

steps.t: Qualify the ramp with center shots
steps.d: Shoot any of the three center shots; the first mode needs one shot, the second two, and so on.

steps.t: Raise the shield and start a battle
steps.d: Shoot the ramp to raise the Black Knight's shield, then shoot the saucer behind it to start a battle.

steps.t: Charge the Sword of Rage and collect POWER
steps.d: Fill the sword meter with right drop target hits and center target shots, then shoot the lit POWER at the center target during a battle for 2x scoring and an easier mode.

steps.t: Win a battle to light extra ball
steps.d: Complete Mud Bog, Molten Fire, Burning Sands, Wicked Cavern or Deep Freeze to light extra ball at the saucer behind the shield.
Defeat every monster battle to qualify Black Castle.
Start Black Castle, hit all three center shots to light the four outer loops, and make each outer loop, with the center shots relighting between them.

steps.t: Defeat the Black Knight and start Rage Multiball
steps.d: After the four outer shots, shoot the lit saucer behind the shield to finish him off and begin the 6-ball Rage Multiball.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Lock three balls at the shield saucer, play through the jackpot phases, and collect the super jackpot for a KNIGHT letter.

steps.t: Light locks with the light lock target
steps.d: Shoot the light lock target to light the lock at the saucer behind the shield; later multiballs need more standup hits per lock.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls to start the multiball
steps.d: Lock balls at the shield saucer; three locks start Triple Knights Challenge.

steps.t: Complete the left spinner lane, ramp and shield saucer
steps.d: Make these three lit shots to defeat the skeletal knights and light the ramp hurry-up.
Shoot the ramp for the hurry-up (starts at 2M) to begin Phase 2 and set the jackpot value.

steps.t: Collect all jackpots and the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Complete all lit shots, then make a strong ramp shot for the 3x super jackpot and a KNIGHT letter.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Light and lock three balls in the upper playfield catapult, then collect super jackpots with multipliers.

steps.d: Hit the standup next to the catapult to light locks; the first Catapult Multiball has all 3 locks lit.
Lock three balls in the catapult on the upper playfield to start Catapult Multiball.

steps.t: Collect jackpots on the lower playfield
steps.d: Shoot the lit major shots on the lower playfield for jackpots.

steps.t: Build the multiplier and collect the super jackpot
steps.d: Hit the standup to raise the multiplier up to 4x, then shoot the Catapult to collect the super jackpot.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Collect KNIGHT letters to start KNIGHT Multiball, then complete the word again for The King's Ransom.

steps.d: Earn letters from battle shots, WAR hurry-ups and the Triple Knights super jackpot; K and N start lit, so four letters complete the first round.
After completing KNIGHT, shoot the left spinner lane to start it.
Collect six letters again and shoot the left spinner lane to begin The King's Ransom.

steps.t: Score jackpots in The King's Ransom
steps.d: Shoot the flail, either orbit, or complete the WAR lanes for jackpots during the 3-ball timed mode; it also adds +5x bonus and lights extra ball.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Start super modes, boost them, and cash them out as a Super Jackpot with the Magna-Save.

steps.t: Light SUPER with right spinner spins
steps.d: Spin the right spinner enough to light SUPER at the center target.

steps.t: Start a Super Mode at the center target
steps.d: Shoot the center target when SUPER is lit to start a random untimed Super Mode.
Shoot the left lane while Super Modes are running until their icons turn purple.
Press the action button as the ball is about to drain down the right outlane to save it and score the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Relight Magna-Save with the drop targets
steps.d: Complete the drop targets to relight Magna-Save after using it.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Complete the top lanes to start the three-shot hurry-up and finish it at the center target for a KNIGHT letter.

steps.d: Complete the top lanes to raise the bonus multiplier and light the three center shots for hurry-ups.

steps.t: Collect the flail, ramp and shield hurry-ups
steps.d: Hit the flail to shoot the ramp; the shield must be hit once to collect its hurry-up. Each is worth 3M up to 25M.

steps.t: Cash out at the center target
steps.d: After collecting all three, shoot the lit center target to finish the round and score a KNIGHT letter.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Make the standard skill shot, then the harder super skill shot.

steps.d: Plunge the ball into the lit top lane for 750k.
Hold in the left flipper and hit one of the three center shots (flail, center target, shield).
Shoot the light lock target under the catapult lock for 1M.
Lock a ball in the catapult on the upper playfield for 2M.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Earn extra balls and Mystery awards through RAGE, U-Turns, battles and the King's Ransom.

steps.d: Complete RAGE at the inlanes and outlanes to light Mystery at the saucer behind the shield.

steps.t: Make U-Turns to light extra ball
steps.d: Shoot orbit U-Turns without other shots in between; enough U-Turns light extra ball at the shield saucer.

steps.t: Collect the extra ball at the shield saucer
steps.d: Shoot the saucer behind the shield when extra ball is lit, from a battle win, U-Turns, The King's Ransom or Mystery.

stern/black-knight-sword-of-rage.s: Light and use the left outlane ball save through the add time targets.

steps.d: Hit the two add time standups on the left; the first ball save needs one completion, and more each time after.

steps.t: Use the left outlane ball save
steps.d: Let the ball drain down the left outlane while the ball save is lit.

stern/creating-a-rulesheet-for-sharkeys-.s: Lock three virtual balls to start multiball, collect jackpots, and cash in the super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the far right loop shot with the green lock insert, or the inner loop shot to its left that says Collect Combination.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start multiball
steps.d: Once you have 3 virtual locks, multiball begins and all 4 major shots light for 5m jackpots.

steps.t: Collect jackpots to light the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collect 5 jackpots the first time (the requirement rises by 1 each time, up to 10).
Send a ball through the inner right lane for a super worth 5x the jackpot. Jackpot value then rises by 1M, up to 10M.

stern/creating-a-rulesheet-for-sharkeys-.s: Win pool games, beat 5 characters, defeat Jeanette Lee in both games, then play The Web wizard multiball.

steps.d: In 8 ball, complete all 7 drop targets then shoot the 8-ball scoop. In 9 ball, hit the targets in order then shoot the left orbit.
Hit the two adjacent lit drop targets to raise the value by 1.25m each, up to 30m. Collect with the lock shot under the eight ball or the right orbit to begin the next pool game.
Complete 5 pool games to take on Jeanette Lee.

steps.t: Beat Jeanette Lee at 8 ball and 9 ball
steps.d: You must win both pool game types against her.
Four-ball multiball with a long ball saver where shots stay lit for your Winnings value. Complete five jackpot shots to earn an add-a-ball.

stern/creating-a-rulesheet-for-sharkeys-.s: Complete CUE to raise Bonus X and start Bumper Pool, then keep the bumper value growing.

steps.d: Complete the CUE lanes to advance Bonus X (starts at 5x, +3x each completion).
Spelling CUE or making the center top lane skill shot begins Bumper Pool, with bumpers worth 25k.
Shoot the hole near the bumpers or the middle blue target to reset the timer. Value rises to at least 1,000,000 per bump.

stern/creating-a-rulesheet-for-sharkeys-.s: Collect the Mystery award at the ramp, relight it with POOL, and earn post saves.

steps.t: Shoot the lit ramp for Mystery
steps.d: Mystery is lit at the ramp at the start of each ball. Awards include Extra Ball, Multiball, Multiple Millions, Light Post Saves, HurryUp and Jackpot.
Complete POOL at the inlanes and outlanes.
Spell PAYOFF behind the drop targets or get the mystery award to relight the post save.
Use the right post save so the ball launches up and lands in the shooter lane for 5m.

stern/creating-a-rulesheet-for-sharkeys-.s: Get 25 spinner spins and complete the hurry-up to light locks.

steps.d: Getting 25 spinner spins lights Black Widow.
The ball is held and served to the upper flipper.
Hit the drop target blocking the right lanes; spinner shots reset the value and timer to 10m. Completing it lights 1 or more locks.

stern/deadpool.t: Battles to Sauron and Clone Multiball
stern/deadpool.s: Win the three battles, play Sauron Multiball, replay the battles at level 2, then reach Clone Multiball.

steps.t: Light a Battle at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop at the start of a ball, or complete the DEAD targets if no Battle is lit.
Shoot the flashing shots to deal damage, then shoot the scoop within 10 seconds to finish each enemy.

steps.t: Qualify Team-Ups to help in battle
steps.d: Shoot a Team-Up shot twice during single-ball play with no major modes running to qualify that ally for battles.
After winning all three battles, shoot the lit scoop. Shoot the left and right ramps two times each for Jackpots, then the U-Turn to the Colossal Jackpot target for the Super Jackpot.
Replay the three battles, shooting both ramps once if Sauron resurfaces to deal damage to him.
Shoot the lit scoop, then make the blue shots, each of which must be relit by making a different blue shot.

stern/deadpool.s: Collect chimichangas to start the Quests, win both, and with Sauron Multiball played, fight the Megakrakolodonus Rex.

steps.d: Shoot the right orbit to light chimichangas at the major shots in orange.
Collect 3 chimichangas (+1 per Quest, max 8) to complete the punch card and light Quest at the scoop.
Drop the Lil' Deadpool targets with green shots, then make the hurry-up at the standup to throw bombs. After five bombs, shoot the scoop.
Shoot the flashing red shot 5 times to defeat the Megalodon, then shoot the scoop.
Win all three battles to light Sauron at the scoop. Playing it is needed to unlock the Rex.
Build the jackpot with blue shots, bash the Lil' Deadpool target while he is vulnerable, and land 15 shots to the target. Then shoot the scoop to finish him.

stern/deadpool.s: Expose and shoot the Lil' Deadpool target to play the three Lil' Deadpool modes in order.

steps.d: Shoot the OOF drop target bank in front of the standup.
Hit the standup 2 times (+1 per mode) and then the drop target bank to release the ball. Collect jackpots at the target, then 2x jackpots at the red shots.

steps.t: Complete a Battle or Quest to requalify
steps.d: Finishing a Battle or Quest qualifies the lock for the next Lil' Deadpool mode.
Score 100k per switch in the 60-second mode. Hit the Lil' Deadpool target to boost the switch value.
Hit three roving targets for a Lil' Deadpool target jackpot and +1 Playfield X for the ball.

stern/deadpool.s: Lock three balls at the right ramp, build jackpots, and score the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls at the right ramp
steps.d: The locks are lit at game start. After the first Ninja Multiball, relight them one at a time by completing POOL.
Hit bumpers to light blue shots and collect stars to raise the jackpot values. The Ninjapocalypse combo gives 10 at once.
Shoot all of the major shots to qualify the Super Jackpot at the right ramp.
Shoot the right ramp for the sum of the jackpots collected.

stern/deadpool.s: Spin the left spinner to start Disco Multiball and score its Super Jackpot.

steps.d: The count rises by 60 per activation. It starts Disco Multiball when no other modes are running.
Shoot the lit shots. A random shot in each wave starts the Super Jackpot round.
Shoot the left ramp to collect it, and spin the left spinner to raise its value.

steps.t: Loop the left orbit in Disco Loops
steps.d: On Premium/LE, Disco Loops replaces Disco Multiball at 60, 180, 300 spins. Loop the left orbit ramp as many times as possible.

stern/deadpool.s: Cash out weapons to light Mechsuit Multiball, then collect jackpots and the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Shoot white shots then the scoop
steps.d: Shooting the white shots and then the scoop cashes out weapons.
This lights Mechsuit Multiball at the scoop. It relights at 150, 250, 350 weapons.
Shoot the scoop while no other modes are running.
Shoot the lit shots, since each collected jackpot unlights its shot. After 5, the Super Jackpot lights at the scoop.
Shoot the scoop to score it, which also raises the base jackpot by 1 million.

stern/deadpool.s: Finish both mini-wizard modes and Mechsuit Multiball, then beat Mr. Sinister.

steps.d: Win both Quests, play Sauron Multiball, then defeat the Rex at the scoop.
Win all 3 Level 2 Battles, then play Clone Multiball.
Cash out weapons and shoot the scoop to start it.
Make them within the 45-second timed single-ball phase of the Final Battle.
Shoot blue shots for jackpots (Team-Up shots double them) and hit Final Shot in the last 15 seconds. This lights Special.

stern/deadpool.s: Progress from the lane skill shot to the Super Secret Skill Shot.

steps.d: Plunge into the flashing BAM! lane.
Hold the left flipper and shoot up the right ramp.
Hold the left flipper and shoot the right orbit then the right ramp combo.

steps.t: Make the Super Secret Skill Shot
steps.d: Hold the left flipper and shoot the SNIKT target then the right ramp combo, for +1 Playfield X.

stern/deadpool.s: Start Katanarama Time and Berserker Rage for big points.

steps.d: This starts the 30-second Katanarama Time mode.
Shoot the left orbit, left ramp, right ramp and right orbit, each scoring from 1 million and rising.
Shoot the center loop 4 times (+1 each time) to light it.
Shoot the flashing center loop, then rack up spinner spins in the 45-second mode.

stern/deadpool.s: Light and collect the Extra Ball, then light Special.

steps.d: Collect 25 weapons, collect 50 Ninja Stars, or win a rare Mystery award.
Complete the DEADPOOL targets to light Mystery at the scoop.
Win the Final Battle or get a rare Mystery award.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Travel between towns, clear the level 1 and 2 quests, then run the Town Dungeon and unlock the Darkhold bonus round.

steps.t: Travel to a city by hitting three blue shots
steps.d: In travel mode, hit three blue shots or kill all enemies in the battle to arrive at the selected location.
Shoot the yellow choose-action shot and finish the numbered quests at each location. Complete the color-matched level 1 and 2 modes in either order.
Once all leveled quests at a location are done, start its multi-phase Town Dungeon.
After each phase, hit the center spinner while the yellow arrow is lit to advance, and use green shots to heal if you have potions.

steps.t: Complete a Town Dungeon to qualify Darkhold
steps.d: Completing any Town Dungeon enables travel to Darkhold for its Goblin Portal bonus round.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Clear color-matched level 1 and 2 modes to unlock level 3 modes in Dragonspear Castle and Gauntlgrym and earn artifacts.

steps.d: Complete the level 1 and 2 modes of the same color (Orange, White, Blue or Purple) in either order.

steps.t: Travel to Dragonspear Castle or Gauntlgrym
steps.d: Travel to the castle or the Underdark city to reach the color-matched level 3 mode.
Complete Prison Break, Graveyard of Dragonspear Castle, Slaad Assassin or Acquire the Lifeblood Armor. Failing one loses its artifact.
Buy Artifact 2nd Chances from Fizmo to retry failed level 3 modes.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Spell DRAGON, start the multiball, defeat Rath to level up and roll into Town Celebration Multiball.

steps.d: Hit the 3-bank standup targets under Rath to collect letters.
Shoot the lit right orbit or side ramp (side ramp only when no other mode is running).
Score jackpots at the flashing shots (1x, 2x, 3x) and hit Rath before balls drain.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot at the upper loop
steps.d: After a 1x jackpot at each shot, shoot the upper loop for the super jackpot, which also damages Rath.

steps.t: Defeat Rath for Town Celebration Multiball
steps.d: Defeat Rath to gain a level, then shoot the orbits and ramps for jackpots and the side loop super jackpot.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Lock balls at the cube, start the multiball and collect jackpots through the side loop super jackpot.

steps.t: Lock a ball at the cube
steps.d: Shoot the left orbit to lower the ramp, then the left ramp. Repeat the required number of times with the same ball.

steps.t: Lock more balls or start multiball
steps.d: Release the locked ball to start, or shoot the right orbit to lock another and raise the hurry-up by 5M.
Hit the left ramp again as the final shot to add a fourth ball.

steps.t: Collect all jackpots and the super
steps.d: Score the four lit jackpots, then shoot the side loop for the 20M super jackpot.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Light and start the crawl, explore levels, and find treasure rooms for legendary equipment.

steps.d: Hit the Dungeon standup targets near the right orbit and side ramp, or spot targets with the center spinner.
Hit the spinner again within 15 seconds.
Hit the spinner to raise the ball capture, then hit the capture within 15 seconds.
Shoot orange shots to advance and purple shots to choose directions, and find the stairs down.

steps.t: Find a treasure room on levels 2-5
steps.d: Find the hidden treasure room to earn legendary equipment.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Start Dragon Multiball, Cube Multiball and a Dungeon Crawl to qualify and play the mini-wizard mode.

steps.d: Spell DRAGON and start Dragon Multiball.
Lock the required balls at the cube and start the multiball.
Light and start a Dungeon Crawl to complete the qualification.
Hit the center spinner when no other modes are running.

steps.t: Light jackpots and the super jackpot
steps.d: Hit the center Tavern shot three times for left ramp jackpots, then spell DRAGON for the add-a-ball and super jackpot at the upper loop.

steps.t: Light the super jackpot via the dungeon shot
steps.d: After hitting any dragon shot, hit the raised dungeon shot to light the super jackpot.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Qualify through Fizmo or by starting three modes, then build spinner value.
