steps.d: Buy from Fizmo in a town shop, or start three modes (numbered modes or town dungeons).

steps.t: Start it at the center spinner
steps.d: Shoot the center spinner once it is lit to begin the timed mode.

steps.t: Raise the dice and spin the spinner
steps.d: Hit lit shots to raise the die toward 20 and spin the center spinner up to 500k per spin.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Beat the Lich fight by going after the Scepter, then complete five dragon battles to unlock the Bard.

steps.t: Start The Lich of Dragonspear Castle
steps.d: Complete the Dragonspear level 3 modes and start the Town Dungeon.
Clear the Trolls, Skeletons, Abishai and Sammaster phases.
Defeat the wave of 3 Yugoloths to qualify Ritual of the Chosen.
Shoot the three lit blue shots: side ramp, center shot and right ramp.
steps.sec: Ritual of the Chosen (Wizard Mode - Bard Unlock)

steps.d: Lock balls with green shots, then hit 5 red shots in multiball for each of the White, Green, Blue, Black and Red dragons.
steps.sec: Ritual of the Chosen (Wizard Mode - Bard Unlock)

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Clear The Battle of Gauntlgrym, choose Nighdaar's path, then fight through seven phases to unlock the Barbarian.

steps.d: Complete the Gauntlgrym level 3 modes and start the Town Dungeon.

steps.t: Clear the Zhent, Slaad and Hobgoblin phases
steps.d: Defeat the Zhent Soldiers, Red Slaad and Hobgoblins in phases 1-3.
Defeat the wave of Minotaurs to qualify Rescue the King.
Shoot the three lit blue shots: side ramp, center shot and right ramp.
steps.sec: Rescue the King (Wizard Mode - Barbarian Unlock)

steps.d: Get through the stealth and battle phases, then beat Balinor, destroying the armor first if you failed the Lifeblood Armor.
steps.sec: Rescue the King (Wizard Mode - Barbarian Unlock)

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Take the Sammaster or Balinor path in a Town Dungeon, then complete the Undermountain phases to unlock the Ranger.

steps.t: Reach the end of a qualifying Town Dungeon
steps.d: Play The Lich of Dragonspear Castle or The Battle of Gauntlgrym to their final choice phase.
Select Stay and fight Sammaster and defeat him, or select Help King Raddok and defeat the Skeleton Minotaurs and Balinor.
Shoot the three lit blue shots: side ramp, center shot and right ramp.
Hit the lit eye stalk shots in order, normally or with a ranged weapon, for 5M a shot.
Battle him one more time to complete the wizard mode.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Progress from the basic skill shots to the super and MXV skill shots.

steps.d: Short plunge to the upper loop or the switch near the gelatinous cube.
Hit the left eject, then the side ramp, then the right ramp.
Hit the hidden temple shot behind the upper flipper.

stern/dungeons-dragons-the-tyrants-eye.s: Light the extra ball at the right ramp and use the hidden temple for 2x scoring.

steps.d: Start two map modes, find one in a dungeon crawl, play Dragon Multiball 3 times, buy one, or collect 50 gems.

steps.t: Collect the extra ball at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit right ramp to collect it.
Hit the secret door target or the hidden temple twice, with the second hit within 20 seconds.
Shoot the lit hidden temple for 20 seconds of 2x scoring, and extend it by hitting the secret door or temple again.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.t: Haunts to They Came From Space
stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Qualify and complete Haunts at the House to unlock the Haunt wizard modes, ending with They Came From Space.

steps.t: Qualify and start a Haunt at the House
steps.d: Shoot the House Entrance enough times until its RGB light flashes purple, pick a window with either flipper, then shoot the House to begin the Haunt.
Finish the final shot of the Haunt before the 45-second timer runs out. Completing two Haunts lights Extra Ball.
After a Haunt, shoot the lit House Entrance hurry-up. Hit one or both ramps first to raise the value to 75% or 100%.

steps.t: Play three Haunts to start House Party
steps.d: After three Haunts, House Party lights at the House. Start it and score jackpots, then the Super Party Jackpot at the House Entrance.

steps.t: Play six Haunts to start They Came From Space
steps.d: Play all 6 Haunts (or 5 plus a bonus Haunt), then start the 6-ball mode. Score 5 jackpots and a super jackpot in each of 6 phases.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Complete Haunts to rank up the B-Restorator and start Director's Cut, one of the tasks for Wild Market Value.

steps.t: Complete Haunts to rank up the B-Restorator
steps.d: Each completed Haunt advances your B-Restorator rank.

steps.t: Reach rank 4 and start Director's Cut
steps.d: After four Haunts the House Entrance lights to start Director's Cut.
Shoot the lit blue shots, then the Cellar to cash out each film. Repeat four times to score the 100M bonus.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Defeat Deadheads in the Crypt, earning Return and Extra Ball, up to the Super Head Shot.

steps.d: Hit the Crypt entrance 1 time plus 1 per defeated Deadhead to reveal the scoop.

steps.t: Hit the skull to wear down the Deadhead
steps.d: Shoot the skull 3 times plus 2 per defeated Deadhead, then shoot into the Crypt to finish it off. This lights Return.

steps.t: Defeat two Deadheads to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Defeating two Deadheads lights Extra Ball at the House.
The third Deadhead lights the Super Head Shot at the Crypt. Aim at the flashing target using the button.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Max out the Freak Fryer, start Gappa Angry!, and lock balls in order to reach 6-ball Gappa Angry Multiball.

steps.t: Advance the Freak Fryer to max level
steps.d: Every switch hit counts; reach level 5 at 1000 cumulative switch hits.
Shoot the lit House Entrance after the Freak Fryer maxes out.

steps.t: Clear the lock stages in order
steps.d: Make the flashing shots and lock balls in the House, Garage, Crypt, Trunk, then Garage again.

steps.t: Shoot the Cellar for Gappa Angry Multiball
steps.d: Collect the Super Jackpot and start the 6-ball multiball.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Complete the Gar-Goil targets to fill the gauge and start Gar-Goils Gone Wild.

steps.d: Complete them two times (rising up to four) to advance the Gar-Goil Gauge to max.
Complete the targets one more time.
Hit Gar-Goil targets, all four for a bonus, and orbits for more points.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Lock balls in the Garage to play Wild Women, Add-a-Zombie, then Attic Attack Multiball.

steps.t: Hit the Garage drop target to light locks
steps.d: One hit lights all locks for the first multiball; later ones need more hits per lock.
Lock three balls in the Garage, then score jackpots at all five shots and the House Super Jackpot.
Hit the drop target once per lock and lock three balls. Score jackpots at the lit shots.
Hit the drop target twice per lock and lock three balls. Score a Super Jackpot at the House after every 5 jackpots.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Collect Junk and lock balls in the Trunk to reach Trunk Multiball and Phone-A-Fiend Multiball.

steps.d: Hit a Trunk Target while the flashing insert cycles through the Junk.

steps.t: Light the Trunk and shoot the left ramp
steps.d: Complete the Trunk Targets, then shoot the lit left ramp to collect the Junk and lock a ball.
Lock 2 balls, then score jackpots and the left ramp Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Collect all the Junk to qualify Phone-A-Fiend
steps.d: Collect at least one of each Junk item.
Lock two balls in the Trunk again, then shoot the Trunk targets and the left ramp to score jackpots.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Start the timed side modes and use Double Trouble for 2x and 4x scoring.

steps.d: Make 5 (+2 per prior start) shots to either ramp.
Make 5 (+2 per prior start) shots to either orbit.

steps.t: Light an inlane and start Double Trouble
steps.d: Complete the Trunk targets and the Hand of Fate targets, then roll over the lit inlane for 2x scoring.
Qualify and start Double Trouble again while the 2x timer runs.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.t: Hand of Fate and Manos Wheel
stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Light Hand of Fate, collect wheel awards, and start Manos Wheel.

steps.d: Complete the right target bank to light the left outlane.

steps.t: Stop the wheel on an award
steps.d: Drain down the left outlane and press the action button to stop the wheel on an uncollected award.

steps.t: Collect all awards to start Manos Wheel
steps.d: Collect every award to complete the image.
Hit Hand of Fate targets to build the value, then collect the Jackpot at the left outlane.

stern/elvira-s-house-of-horrors.s: Complete the seven required tasks to light the final wizard mode and sell the house.

steps.d: Rank up the B-Restorator and start it at the House.
Complete the Super Head Shot at the Crypt.

steps.t: Start Phone-A-Fiend, Gappa Angry, and Gar-Goils
steps.d: Start Phone-A-Fiend multiball, Gappa Angry, and Gar-Goils Gone Wild.

steps.t: Start Attic Attack and They Came From Space
steps.d: Start Attic Attack multiball and They Came From Space.

steps.t: Start Wild Market Value at the Cellar
steps.d: Shoot the Cellar, then hit the wild market value spot target within 30 seconds to sell the house.

stern/fallout.s: Build HP with food, start a quest from the right scoop, and complete it to earn a Legendary Weapon.

steps.d: Shoot the lit yellow shot under the pip-boy (or the right ramp for the first 2 quests) to raise HP. You need at least 50 HP to qualify a quest.

steps.t: Start a quest at the right scoop
steps.d: Shoot the right scoop to start the quest shown by the blinking yellow insert under Quests. Hit the Junk stand-up to rotate to the next quest.
Make the final shot of the mode, or score the super jackpot in the 2-ball multiball quests. Quest timer equals your HP in seconds.
Each completed quest awards a Legendary Weapon perk for the rest of the game.

stern/fallout.s: Build jump ramp values and finish with the final blow to complete the quest.

steps.d: Select and start it from the right scoop with at least 50 HP.

steps.t: Hit lit shots to light the center jump ramp
steps.d: Any lit shot lights the center jump ramp for 2x value; other shots raise values.
Four center ramps light the final blow.

steps.t: Land the final blow with the Fat Man
steps.d: Load the ball into the fat man launcher, aim and hit the lit shot to complete the mode.

stern/fallout.s: Combo lit shots into killing sprees to qualify and score the super jackpot.

steps.d: Select The Kings quest and start it at the right scoop with at least 50 HP.
Combo lit shots to start a killing spree, advance the multiplier and score a jackpot.
Three killing sprees (or max multiplier) qualifies the super jackpot.

steps.t: Add a ball at the Deathclaw
steps.d: Make the red insert shots until Fire! is lit, then hit the Deathclaw.

stern/fallout.s: Rip the spinner through three tests to complete the quest.

steps.d: Select it and start it at the right scoop with at least 50 HP.

steps.t: Drop the spinner with lit ramps
steps.d: Hit lit ramp shots to lower the spinner for a limited time.

steps.t: Pass each test with enough spins
steps.d: Rip the spinner enough to advance a level; level 2 needs 50 spins.
Finishing the third test completes the mode.

stern/fallout.s: Cripple the Deathclaw, play three multiballs in order, upgrading the weapon between each.

steps.d: Hit the bash toy; when all four limb inserts and Fire! flash, the multiball is ready.
Build jackpot with red shots for 20s, then collect at the bash toy for 12s; super jackpot after 4 jackpots.
Shoot the scoop with enough junk to upgrade the weapon and enable the next Deathclaw multiball.
Charge your weapon with red shots, hit the bash toy for jackpots; 5 jackpots qualify super jackpot.

stern/fallout.s: Qualify the Fat Man, clear the shooting gallery to start Wasteland Multiball, then light and collect the super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the right 3-bank of stand-up targets to qualify the Fat Man.
Shoot the left loop to load the launcher, then hit the lit gallery targets.
Hitting all three targets starts Wasteland Multiball. VATS can spot a target once AP is full.

steps.t: Shoot lit shots to kill enemies
steps.d: Collect jackpots; kills required to light super jackpot are 2 in wave 1 and 3 in wave 2.

steps.t: Collect the super jackpot with the Fat Man
steps.d: Hit the red shot under the pipboy to load the fat man, aim at the blinking light and fire with the action button.

stern/fallout.s: Spell VAULT, open the vault, earn lunchboxes, and reach Vault Multiball and its super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the lit VAULT letter shots to light Open Vault at the center ramp.

steps.t: Bash the vault door to find a lunchbox
steps.d: Shoot the center ramp to hit the vault door to start Find the Lunchbox!; hit a blue shot, then shoot the scoop to open it.

steps.t: Start and complete a vault mode
steps.d: Shoot the ball past the opened vault door, then finish the vault mode and hit its final shot to collect a lunchbox.
Odd-numbered lunchboxes award Vault Multiball.

steps.t: Hit all jackpot shots in order
steps.d: Hit the jackpot shot from left ramp through the right orbit and last shot to light the super jackpot.
Hit the center ramp to bash the vault door (Pro) or go past it (Premium/LE).

stern/fallout.s: Kill radroaches, collect Radaway and finish the hurry-up.

steps.d: Hit the slowly blinking radroach stand-up; avoid hitting a killed one again to avoid RAD.
Hit the green shot at the ramps after being inflicted with RAD.
Shoot the flashing green shot under the Pip-Boy.
Shoot all 3 ramps, then hit the outer loop from the mutant flipper repeatedly within 10 seconds.

stern/fallout.t: Skill Shot, Caps and Extra Ball
stern/fallout.s: Smaller scoring features: skill shot, Cap Stash and extra balls.

steps.t: Make the Nuka Cola skill shot
steps.d: Plunge to the flashing Nuka Cola insert on the right inline, then rip the spinner.
Light both Nuka Cola inlanes, then roll over the flashing inline to drop the spinner.
Shoot 4, then 25 lit Radroach targets.
Hit the stand-up target at the side of the left ramp.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Light and complete city van modes to unlock Austin or D.C., then the other after six cities.

steps.t: Shoot white shots to light Start Van Mode
steps.d: Shoot the white shots spelling V-A-N (only one is needed for the first mode, up to three) to light the left ramp, then shoot it to start a city mode.

steps.t: Complete a van mode in one try
steps.d: Make up to 14 shots of progress (some shots count double) before the 50-second timer expires; finish at the Overlord. One-try completion scores more and is needed for the FooBot.
Fully complete three van modes to enable Austin and D.C. on the Van Modes map.
Select either mini-wizard. Austin: shoot red shots for jackpots and the blue shot for super jackpots. D.C.: shoot band member shots and complete the drops for super jackpots.

steps.t: Complete six van modes for the other wizard
steps.d: After completing 6 van modes, the other of Austin or D.C. is qualified.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Level up the van mods that boost van modes and D.C. jackpots.

steps.t: Knock down all three drop targets
steps.d: Complete the drop bank; the first drop hit locks in the cycling mod (engine, speakers, bomb).
Hit it within the 10-second timer to level up the mod, and keep shooting to advance the level.
Collect the second Bot Award, then shoot the paddle target to rapidly advance mods.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Qualify and play All My Life, Monkey Wrench and The Pretender in order, earning the FooBot left arm.

steps.d: Hit the targets on each side of the Overlord to light lock, then lock a ball and hit the captive ball 3 times.

steps.t: Score a super jackpot in All My Life
steps.d: Collect the lit jackpot sequence, then shoot the Overlord target for the super jackpot; this collects the FooBot left arm.
Shoot the Overlord twice, complete the side targets twice, shoot the Overlord twice to light lock, lock a ball, and hit the captive ball 5 times.
Shoot the Overlord 3 times, complete the side targets 3 times, shoot the Overlord 3 times for lock, lock a ball, and hit the captive ball 7 times.

steps.t: Score a super jackpot in The Pretender
steps.d: Shoot all unique shots at least once to light the super jackpot at the Overlord, which upgrades the left arm.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Progress through the right ramp to start Area 51 and score its super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the right ramp 5 times to start Area 51 multiball; later multiballs need 9 shots.
Shoot the right ramp to divert to the mini-playfield, complete the targets, then the spinner, the loop, and the secret files target.
All shots are lit for jackpots; collect 8 to enable the super jackpot.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot with the right ramp then captive ball
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp followed by the UFO captive ball as a combo to collect it and upgrade the FooBot head.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot at the Secret Files target
steps.d: After 8 jackpots the diverter raises revealing the Secret Files target; hit it for the super jackpot and upgrade the FooBot head.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Build and cash out combos to start Combotron multiball and earn the FooBot chest.

steps.d: Shoot lit shots marked with the Combotron symbol in quick succession, or shoot the side ramp to spawn them.

steps.t: Cash out 6 combos at the Overlord
steps.d: Shoot the Overlord while a combo is active to cash out; do this 6 times to light the side ramp.
Shoot the lit side ramp; it cannot be started during an Overlord multiball.
Score a red jackpot to light the Overlord for the Combotron Jackpot; scoring 25M upgrades the chest.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Score all six band member combos to start Toy Time and win a FooBot part.

steps.d: Make the Taylor, Dave, Nate, Chris, Pat and Rami combo shot sequences as part of Combotron sequences.
Shoot the left ramp once all six combos are scored (with the topper, progress carries across games; otherwise all six van modes are also required).

steps.t: Score jackpots at all six band shots
steps.d: Lock each band member shot, collect switch hits to light its jackpot, and score it.

steps.t: Score the Toy Time super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the FooBot target for the super jackpot, which awards or upgrades a FooBot part.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Destroy bots to earn ball save, MOD-ulator Frenzy and Bot Frenzy.

steps.d: Shoot the four standups to destroy bots and light the Bot Award target.

steps.t: Collect the first and second Bot Awards
steps.d: First lights right outlane ball save; second lights MOD-ulator Frenzy at the paddle target.
After the third Bot Award, shoot the lit left ramp; this awards the FooBot right arm.
Build the spinner value with standup hits and rip the spinner to upgrade the right arm.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Collect mystery awards to fill the radio dial, start Supersonic Radio, and score the radio jackpot.

steps.d: Complete the radio targets to enable a mystery award for a limited time.

steps.t: Collect mystery awards to max the dial
steps.d: Collect each mystery award at the targets in time to advance the dial until Supersonic Radio starts.
Shoot each gray shot once to turn it pink, then shoot again to score its value.
Boost every gray shot, then hit the lit Sonic Radio targets to upgrade the FooBot right leg.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Advance the Rock-O-Meter for timed multipliers and charge up Super Lightning.

steps.d: Plunge into the Rock-O-Meter lane when the top insert flashes to advance it most.
Roll through the lit Rock-O-Meter lane three times with the battery insert lit, or shoot the right orbit.
Qualify the multiplier again while 2x runs to reset the timer and reach 3x.
Collect 10 lightning target hits to light the ramps for 10x the built-up lightning value.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Collect all six FooBot parts to play FooBot Multiball, a prerequisite to the Final Battle.

steps.d: Start Combotron, Area 51, Bot Frenzy, Supersonic Radio, complete a van mode in one visit, and score an Overlord super jackpot or play Monkey Wrench.
Once all 6 parts are collected, shoot the lit left ramp.
Score all 6 band member jackpots, then shoot the Overlord for the super jackpot.

stern/foo-fighters.s: Complete cities, Overlord multiballs and FooBot Multiball, then beat the Overlord in four phases.

steps.t: Save all cities including Austin and D.C.
steps.d: Complete the city van modes and both mini-wizards.
Play All My Life, Monkey Wrench and The Pretender.
Assemble the FooBot and play FooBot Multiball, then shoot the lit left ramp.
Phase 1: hurry-ups to both ramps (3 each), then the Overlord. Phase 2: shoot the left crossover, side loop, side ramp and right orbit, then the Overlord.
Shoot lit shots to build the multiplier, shoot the Overlord to deal damage, and land the final blow within 100 seconds.
Make 40 shots in the 3-ball multiball, then hit the final blow at the Overlord within 150 seconds.

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Qualify and play house modes, building toward Extra Ball, Hand of the King, and finally the Iron Throne wizard mode.

steps.t: Qualify more houses with three shots each
steps.d: Shoot a house's shot three times (e.g. drop bank for Baratheon, left loop for Greyjoy) to qualify it at the left ramp. Your chosen house starts qualified.

steps.t: Start a house mode at the left ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit left ramp to start a house mode; you may stack two modes unless playing as Greyjoy.

steps.t: Complete three house modes for Extra Ball
steps.d: Completing three House Modes lights Extra Ball.

steps.t: Complete four houses to qualify Hand of the King
steps.d: Complete four modes while not currently challenging a house to light HOTK.
steps.sec: Hand of the King Mini Wizard Mode:

steps.t: Complete all house modes to qualify Iron Throne
steps.d: Completing all modes lights the mode start shot for Iron Throne.

steps.t: Defeat every castle in Iron Throne
steps.d: Complete sets of all 7 house shots, collect the Super Jackpot at the battering ram, and finish the victory lap shots.

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Light and lock three balls, start Blackwater, and collect jackpots and Super Jackpots at the ram.

steps.t: Light lock with the right standup targets
steps.d: Shoot the two green standup targets on the right to light lock at the left ramp.

steps.t: Lock a ball at the left ramp
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp to lock; you must lock a ball before lighting the next lock.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start Blackwater
steps.d: Lock 3 balls to begin the multiball; later locks need more target hits.

steps.t: Complete the five major shots for jackpots
steps.d: Complete the five major shots to collect Jackpots and light the Super Jackpot at the battering ram.

steps.t: Collect the Super Jackpot at the ram
steps.d: Hit the battering ram within 20 seconds; it can be collected repeatedly.

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Advance Wall progress, start the multiball, and collect ramp/loop jackpots and Super Jackpots.

steps.d: Complete the top lanes 6 times to enable Wall Multiball; Baratheon drop bank completions also advance it.
Shooting Castle Black 6 times enables Wall Multiball.

steps.t: Shoot the Dragon to start Wall Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the lit Dragon to begin the 3-ball multiball.

steps.t: Shoot the right loop to start Wall Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the lit right loop to begin the multiball.

steps.t: Collect 3 ramp jackpots to light the Super
steps.d: Shoot 3 ramp shots for Jackpots, which lights the Super Jackpot on the Dragon.

steps.t: Shoot 3 loops and the Dragon Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot 3 loops to light the Dragon again for the Super Jackpot.

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Start Winter is Coming hurry-ups four times to trigger the Winter Has Come mini-wizard.

steps.t: Light a house to ice over a shot
steps.d: Lighting a house ices over the shot you made to advance it.

steps.t: Start Winter is Coming with three iced shots
steps.d: Complete any combination of three iced-over shots or target banks.

steps.t: Collect the flashing white shot hurry-up
steps.d: Shoot the flashing white shot to collect the hurry-up value.

steps.t: Collect four hurry-ups to start Winter Has Come
steps.d: Four collected hurry-ups begin the four-ball Winter Has Come.
steps.sec: Winter Has Come Mini Wizard Mode:

steps.t: Clear Horde and Lieutenant phases for the Super
steps.d: Complete all seven Horde shots, then collect five Lieutenant shots for the WIC Super Jackpot.
steps.sec: Winter Has Come Mini Wizard Mode:

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Qualify HOTK by completing four houses, then finish sets with Super Jackpots and the large hurry-up.

steps.d: Complete four houses while not challenging a house.
steps.sec: Hand of the King Mini Wizard Mode:

steps.t: Complete all lit shots in a set
steps.d: Each set starts with four shots (7 with Baratheon).
steps.sec: Hand of the King Mini Wizard Mode:

steps.t: Collect the Super Jackpot at the ram
steps.d: Collect the Super at the battering ram to complete the set.
steps.sec: Hand of the King Mini Wizard Mode:

steps.t: Complete 3 sets for the big hurry-up
steps.d: Completing 3 sets (2 with Greyjoy) starts a larger hurry-up at the ram.
steps.sec: Hand of the King Mini Wizard Mode:

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Collect gold from standups, light Mystery, and spend gold on awards.

steps.d: Completing all gold standups lights the Mystery shot.

steps.t: Shoot the Dragon to collect Mystery
steps.d: Shoot the lit Dragon to open the award select.

steps.t: Shoot the right loop to collect Mystery
steps.d: Shoot the lit right loop to open the award select.

steps.t: Buy an award with your gold
steps.d: Choose one of the two gold-priced awards, such as Light Extra Ball.

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Raise playfield multipliers at the ram, then cash in or push higher with Swords.

steps.d: Three hits qualify the playfield multiplier.
Hit the ram again to begin a round of 2x playfield values.

steps.t: Complete a house to light a Sword
steps.d: Completing any house mode lights the right ramp to collect a sword, raising the multiplier cap.
Every 4 further ram hits adds 1x, and cash in with the action button.

stern/game-of-thrones-pinball.s: Use the upper playfield to progress toward Castle Multiball.

steps.t: Complete the three upper playfield targets
steps.d: Complete the set of 3 targets on the upper playfield.

steps.t: Shoot a back lane for Castle progress
steps.d: Collect Archers, Charge, Breach, then Castle Multiball in order.

stern/ghostbusters-pinball.s: Collect Ghosts to hit milestone awards, from Storage Facility locks up to Mass Hysteria Multiball at 100 Ghosts.

steps.d: Shoot flashing shots, pop bumpers, the center target or the right captive ball to collect or relight Ghosts. Each 10 Ghosts lights a Storage Facility lock at the left ramp.

steps.t: Light Tobin's Spirit Guide at 20 Ghosts
steps.d: Collect 20 Ghosts to light Tobin's Spirit Guide at the left scoop, then shoot it for 3 to 5 random awards.

steps.t: Play a video mode at 40 Ghosts
steps.d: Collect 40 Ghosts to light the video mode at the right scoop. Play Negative Reinforcement on ESP Ability or Don't Cross The Streams.
steps.sec: (40) Video Modes: “Negative Reinforcement on ESP Ability”/”Don’t Cross The Streams”

steps.d: Collect 60 Ghosts, then start the mode and loop the left ramp repeatedly within 21 seconds for Super Jackpots.
Collect 80 Ghosts, start the mode, and keep hitting switches to hold the multiplier up. Collect the jackpot at the right ramp.

steps.t: Start Mass Hysteria Multiball at 100 Ghosts
steps.d: Collect 100 Ghosts, then shoot the flashing shots with reversed flippers for Jackpots. Hit the right captive ball to toggle the flippers.

stern/ghostbusters-pinball.s: Light and lock three balls, collect Ghost Jackpots, and cash in the Super Jackpots.

steps.d: Complete the left captive balls award for three stacked locks, or collect 10/30/50 Ghosts to light one lock at the left ramp.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start multiball
steps.d: Lock three balls to begin Storage Facility Multiball.
All Ghost shots are lit for Jackpots, and each one spots a Ghost toward the awards.

steps.t: Capture all Ghosts for Super Jackpots
steps.d: Collect all the Ghosts to light three Super Jackpots, then collect them.

stern/ghostbusters-pinball.s: Complete Scenes to light We Came, We Saw, We Kicked It's, then We're Ready To Believe You, then Are You a God?

steps.d: Shoot a flashing left scoop, left ramp or right loop shot to begin a Scene. Each completed scene lights shots for the next one.
Completing 3 scenes regardless of ladders lights Extra Ball.

steps.t: Complete a ladder to light the mini-wizard
steps.d: Finish the top scene of a ladder, then start We Came, We Saw, We Kicked It's via the left ramp.
steps.sec: (Mini-Wizard Mode) We Came, We Saw, We Kicked It’s…

steps.d: Completing all the scenes lights We're Ready To Believe You, started via the left ramp.
steps.sec: (Wizard Mode) We’re Ready To Believe You!

steps.d: In the 4-ball multiball, collect 100 Ghosts in 60 seconds, ranking up as you reach checkpoints.
steps.sec: (Wizard Mode) We’re Ready To Believe You!

steps.d: Complete the combo and sequence levels, then collect the one billion bonus and play the 6-ball victory lap.
steps.sec: (Super Wizard Mode) Are You a God?

stern/ghostbusters-pinball.s: Defeat Slimer, clean up the slime, and qualify the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the center target once (it may take more hits depending on code revision) to lower Slimer onto the playfield.
Defeating him lights the Scenes at the three major shots. Each hit also slimes one shot.
Clearing all the slime from the playfield qualifies the Super Jackpot shot.
Hit the spinner to raise its value from 5M up to 30M before collecting it.

stern/ghostbusters-pinball.s: Use the right captive ball to light and start Book Stacks features.

steps.d: Hit the captive ball once to qualify a feature, then shoot again within 10 seconds to start it.
Hit both raised drop targets to light three Super Jackpots.

steps.t: Collect Terror Dog and Gozer hurry-ups
steps.d: Shoot the Terror Dog target or right ramp for a 4M hurry-up. Shoot the Gozer shot for a hurry-up of up to 14M.

stern/ghostbusters-pinball.s: Make the playfield and rollover skill shots for a score bonus and an award.

steps.t: Make the top rollover skill shot
steps.d: Hit the chosen rollover for 5% of your score plus an award.
Hit the chosen playfield shot for 5% of your score plus its award.

stern/ghostbusters-pinball.s: Hit the pop bumpers to get a mystery award.

steps.d: Hit them enough times to collect a mystery award such as Extra Ball, Special or Storage Facility.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Light the lock, lock balls at Groot, collect jackpots and super jackpots, then finish with the Double Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Light the lock and lock a ball in Groot
steps.d: Shoot Groot's mouth to light the lock, then shoot into the mouth to lock a ball. The first multiball is 3-ball; later ones are 4-ball and need more hits.

steps.t: Start Groot Multiball and collect jackpots
steps.d: All shots are lit for three jackpots each, starting at 300k and rising 25k per jackpot. Completed modes make their character shots worth 5x jackpots.
After the 9th and 18th jackpots, Groot lights for a Super Jackpot worth the jackpots collected so far, up to 25M.
After all 24 jackpots, shoot Groot's repeatedly opening mouth without using Hadron Enforcer to complete Groot MB.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Collect three Orbs, start Orb MB with a hurry-up, collect jackpots, then score the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the drop target, then the standup behind it, to collect an Orb. Orbs 1 and 2 can also come from Mystery.

steps.t: Start Orb MB and hit the drop target
steps.d: Hit the drop target naturally, not with Hadron Enforcer, while the hurry-up counts down from 2M. This locks in the jackpot value and frees the ball for 3-ball multiball.
Collect every lit jackpot. Shooting the Orb doubles the next jackpot for about 3 seconds. Completing them lights the Orb for a Double Jackpot.
Shoot the Orb drop target quickly during the hurry-up for a Super Jackpot worth the jackpot total. The first one adds a ball.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Start and complete modes to earn extra balls and qualify Cherry Bomb, Immolation Initiative and Save Xandar.

steps.d: Choose a mode with the flippers at ball start, or shoot the right scoop when no mode is running. Start 3 modes to light the scoop for Extra Ball.

steps.t: Complete a mode to reach its super mode
steps.d: Finish the mode's required shots to start its untimed level 2 super mode. The mode's character shot also becomes a 5x jackpot in Groot MB.

steps.t: Complete four modes for Cherry Bomb
steps.d: Complete four modes, not counting multiballs, to light the right scoop for Cherry Bomb Multiball. Completing 6 modes also lights Extra Ball.

steps.t: Reach 50% on all modes and start both multiballs
steps.d: Make it halfway through all eight modes and start Groot and Orb multiballs to qualify Immolation Initiative.
Complete all modes and both multiballs to light the right scoop for Save Xandar.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Qualify with four completed modes, then clear all flashing shots and score the Super Jackpot at Groot.

steps.d: Complete four modes, excluding multiballs, to light the right scoop red.
Shoot the red-pulsing right scoop to start the 6-ball, 60-second multiball with unlimited ball save.
Hit each flashing shot, which lights it solid. The first hit on each is worth 3M, rising 100k per flashing shot, and later hits 1M.

steps.t: Score the Cherry Bomb Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the moving-mouth Groot without Hadron Enforcer for a super jackpot worth the jackpot total.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Make 50% progress on every mode and both multiballs, then collect jackpots and repeated super jackpots.

steps.d: Make at least 50% progress on all eight modes and start both Groot and Orb multiballs.
Shoot the lit right scoop to begin this 3-ball mini-wizard mode.
Hit yellow shots, and make switch hits, to score jackpots until the super jackpot is ready.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot at Groot
steps.d: Shoot the moving-mouth Groot to score the jackpot total and add a ball. This can be repeated.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Complete every mode and both multiballs, then work through purple jackpots to the right scoop super jackpot.

steps.t: Complete all modes and both multiballs
steps.d: Complete all eight modes plus Groot and Orb multiballs to light the right scoop.
Shoot the lit right scoop to begin the 4-ball wizard mode.
Hit every purple jackpot shot to light the Super Jackpot at the right scoop.

steps.t: Score the Save Xandar Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the flashing right scoop for a huge super jackpot that adds a ball. This can be repeated.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Progress from a plain skill shot to the hands-free and super skill shots.

steps.d: Plunge into the flashing top lane for 250k plus 50k per skill shot.
Plunge without touching the flippers, even to change modes, for twice the normal skill shot value.
Hold the left flipper and full plunge around the loop, then hit the flashing white shot (Orb, right ramp or right orbit) quickly for 1M, rising 250k each time.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Build playfield and shot multipliers through RAMPAGE and Nova Corps.

steps.d: Hit the Rocket shot to collect letters. RAMP is spotted free, so three shots are needed to spell RAMPAGE and start 2x playfield scoring for 45 seconds.
Hit the Rocket shot while double scoring is active to add 10 seconds.

steps.t: Complete the five Nova Corps rollovers
steps.d: Finish the top right, left inlane and right inlane rollovers to light the shot multipliers.
Shoot pulsing shots to make them 2x for the rest of the ball. After all are 2x, shoot the strobing shot for 3x.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.t: Hadron Enforcer, Mystery and Ball Save
stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Use the standup targets, the Guardians target and the Groot-side targets for helpful awards.

steps.d: This lights the action button for 3 Hadron Enforcer charges, each of which spots one shot in a mode or multiball.
Hit the flashing Guardians target to spot letters and raise the end-of-ball bonus multiplier. Completing it lights Mystery at the right scoop.

steps.t: Light the right outlane ball save
steps.d: Hit the two standup targets to the left and right of Groot to light a virtual kickback on the right outlane.

stern/guardians-of-the-galaxy-pinball.s: Start modes and complete them to light the scoop for extra balls.

steps.d: Starting 3 of the 10 main modes or multiballs lights Extra Ball at the scoop.
Completing 6 modes lights Extra Ball at the scoop again.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Spell EDDIE to start a battle, win it and collect the Soul Shard, play all five to qualify 2 Minutes to Midnight.

steps.d: Shoot the white arrows to spell EDDIE; the Battle insert then lights at the Pharaoh center ramp. Shoot the left spinner beforehand to change the flashing mode.

steps.t: Start an Eddie Battle at the center ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit Battle shot at the center ramp to start the flashing mode; you are spotted two EDDIE letters toward your first mode.
Complete the mode's objectives (Aces High, Fear of the Dark, Rime of the Ancient Mariner, Hallowed Be Thy Name or Flight of Icarus) to light the bullseye.
Hit the lit bullseye target within 10 seconds of winning the battle.
Play all five Eddie Battles to qualify the sixth battle, 2 Minutes to Midnight.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Start the sixth battle, collect all five lit shots, and score the Super Jackpot for Soldier Eddie.

steps.d: Playing all five Eddie Battles qualifies 2 Minutes to Midnight.
Starting the mode awards the Soldier Eddie card at level 1.
Collect every lit shot once to light the Super Jackpot target. Shooting X targets adds 5 seconds once each.
Collect all lit shots again while the Super Jackpot is lit to raise its multiplier, then score it for Soldier Eddie at level 2.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Complete the Power Features, play Cyborg Multiball and score a 5x Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Make spinner, orbit, ramp, target and bumper shots to activate each feature, then keep hitting to bring its counter to zero.
This lights the bullseye target / center ramp for Cyborg Multiball.
Shoot the lit bullseye/center ramp; this lights the Cyborg Eddie card at level 1.

steps.t: Light and score the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Hit each Power Feature at least once to light the Super Jackpot at the Orb; each one raises the multiplier by 1x.
Keep scoring Super Jackpots to reach 5x for the Cyborg Eddie card at level 2.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Light and lock three balls, start Trooper Multiball, and raise jackpots toward Trooper Eddie level 2.

steps.t: Light Locks with the drop targets
steps.d: Complete the drop targets when Light Lock is flashing (twice the first time) to light the locks at the orbits.
Hit the green arrow orbit shots to virtually lock three balls and start Trooper Multiball.
Collect three lit jackpots to light the first Super Jackpot.
This awards the Trooper Eddie card at level 1 and relights jackpots at +1x.

steps.t: Get all Jackpots to 3x or score a 5x Jackpot
steps.d: Advance all jackpots to 3x (yellow) or score a single 5x (red) jackpot for Trooper Eddie level 2.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Light the Mummy Lock, spell MUMMY to start the multiball, then score Super Jackpots for Mummy Eddie.

steps.d: Shoot the Sarcophagus captive ball twice (5 times on later multiballs) to light the lock.

steps.t: Lock a ball at the Mummy Lock
steps.d: Shoot the center ramp on Pro or the left ramp on Premium/LE.

steps.t: Lock a ball at the Mummy Lock
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp on Premium/LE to lock the ball.

steps.t: Spell MUMMY to qualify the multiball
steps.d: Spell MUMMY at the captive ball with five more shots; the multiball starts on the next captive ball hit.
Score switch hits to qualify jackpots at the captive ball; each one spots a MUMMY letter. Spelling MUMMY lights the Super Jackpot at the bullseye.
The first gives Mummy Eddie level 1 and the second gives level 2; they need not be in the same multiball.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Collect all four Eddie Cards to qualify the wizard mode and defeat the Beast.

steps.d: Earn Mummy, Cyborg, Trooper and Soldier Eddie cards at level 1 or 2 through their respective modes and multiballs.
With all four cards collected, the wizard mode begins as an untimed single-ball mode with a 30-second ball save.

steps.t: Shoot a red arrow, then the bullseye
steps.d: Hit any of three red-arrow shots, then the bullseye within 5 seconds to light all shots yellow for 10 seconds.
Make 15 counter-attack shots, never the same shot consecutively, to win 100M plus Soul Shard values.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Light Tomb Treasures through objectives up to the tenth to start the super wizard multiball.

steps.d: Achieve objectives such as collecting Soul Shards, scoring a loop jackpot, a 6-Way Combo, and Mummy or Trooper Super Jackpots to light the Tomb.

steps.t: Collect Tomb Treasures at the Tomb
steps.d: Shoot the right loop on Pro or the left ramp on Premium/LE to collect awards in order.

steps.t: Win Number of the Beast and collect all level 2 cards
steps.d: These are among the objectives that light treasures; 10 different goals are needed.
This starts the 6-ball Run to the Hills.
steps.sec: Run To The Hills (Super Wizard Mode):

steps.t: Light and score the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collect one of each Power feature from top-left to bottom-right to light the Super Jackpot at the center ramp; spell MUMMY to add balls.
steps.sec: Run To The Hills (Super Wizard Mode):

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Progress from the basic skill shot to the Super Skill Shot at plunge.

steps.d: Soft plunge into the skill shot target for 1M, +1 EDDIE letter and extra ball saver.
Hold the left flipper and plunge to the inner orbit, then shoot the Super Jackpot target from the upper flipper.

stern/iron-maiden-pinball.s: Build loop value, collect the Loop Jackpot, and reach 30 loops for an extra ball.

steps.d: Shoot either upper loop to raise the loop value.
Make 5 (+2) shots to any loops until the red insert is lit.
Collect it within 12 seconds; it also lights a Tomb Treasure.

steps.t: Collect 30 loops to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Loop Jackpot shots do not count toward the 30 loops.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Light locks with the drop targets, lock three balls to start Bird One Multiball, collect jackpots and the super jackpot, and use it toward the Bond... James Bond mini-wizard.

steps.t: Hit the SPECTRE targets for jackpot value
steps.d: Shots to the rocket lane spot SPECTRE letters, and each target hit adds 25k to Bird One jackpot values.

steps.t: Complete drop targets to light lock
steps.d: Shoot the drop targets to light lock at the lane to the right of the drop targets, then shoot the lock.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start Bird One
steps.d: Bird One Multiball starts as soon as the third ball is locked. Locks are virtual on Pro and physical on Prem/LE.

steps.t: Score 3 double jackpots at the start
steps.d: Hit the two briefly lit upper flipper shots for double jackpots to qualify the multiball extension that relaunches 2 balls.

steps.t: Collect jackpots and score the super jackpot
steps.d: Collect three jackpots, then shoot the rocket for the super jackpot. Clear singles, doubles, then triples, then collect the super jackpot.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Shoot the left eject to light the left ramp, start Jetpack Multiball, and work up to the super jackpot.

steps.t: Shoot the left eject in single-ball play
steps.d: A left eject shot during single-ball play lights the left ramp to start Jetpack Multiball.

steps.t: Start Jetpack Multiball at the left ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit left ramp to start it; later starts need more left eject and left ramp shots.
Shoot the center lane to score the hurry-up and lock it in as the jackpot value.

steps.t: Score 5 jackpots, then the left ramp double
steps.d: Collect 5 jackpots at flashing shots, then shoot the left ramp for a double jackpot.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot at the roving shot
steps.d: Hit the roving shot moving right to left, starting at the DB5. The first super adds a ball.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot with the jetpack
steps.d: Shoot the Dragon Tank while the jetpack is over it. The first super adds a ball.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Play a villain, a henchmen, and both multiballs to qualify the mini-wizard, then score its super jackpot for an extra ball.

steps.d: Shoot the right ramp to start a villain mode.
Shoot the side ramp to start a henchmen mode.

steps.t: Start Bird One and Jetpack Multiballs
steps.d: Start both multiballs to complete the four tasks.

steps.t: Start the multiball at left eject and right ramp
steps.d: Once any current mode or multiball ends, shoot the lit left eject and right ramp. It can be played once per game.

steps.t: Shoot 10 lit shots, then the super jackpot
steps.d: Make 10 lit shots within 70 seconds to light the side ramp for the super jackpot and an extra ball.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Start and complete villain modes to feed the villain mini-wizard.

steps.t: Shoot the right ramp to start a villain mode
steps.d: Pick the mode with the bumpers or Goldfinger target, then shoot the right ramp.
Finish the mode's shot requirement within its timer.
Start all six to light a villain mini-wizard at the right ramp.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Start and complete henchmen modes to feed the villain mini-wizard.

steps.t: Shoot the side ramp to start a henchmen mode
steps.d: Pick the mode with the bumpers or Goldfinger target, then shoot the side ramp.
Finish the mode's shot requirement within its timer.
Start all six to light a villain mini-wizard at the right ramp.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Spell SPECTRE, play weapon hurry-ups for lasting perks, and play all six for a mini-wizard.

steps.t: Spell SPECTRE at the rocket lane
steps.d: Each rocket lane shot spots a SPECTRE letter. Completing them lights a weapon countdown at the Goldfinger target.
Wait for the lit weapon to cycle to the one you want, then shoot the Goldfinger target.

steps.t: Complete a weapon hurry-up for its perk
steps.d: Complete the countdown to earn a perk for the rest of the game.
Play all six to light a villain mini-wizard at the right ramp.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Qualify Q Branch gadget modes at the DB5 eject, convert them to multiballs, and play all six for a mini-wizard.

steps.t: Make enough shots to qualify a gadget
steps.d: For example, bumper hits, 6 right orbit shots, 3 DB5 ejects, 3 left ejects, 20 rocket shots, or 400 spinner spins.

steps.t: Start the mode at the DB5 eject
steps.d: Shoot the lit DB5 eject to start the qualified gadget mode.

steps.t: Complete the mode before time runs out
steps.d: Four modes become 2-ball multiballs when completed. Radioactive Reconnaissance and Q's Ring stay single-ball.
Score all jackpots in the multiball, then the lit super jackpot to end it.

steps.t: Start all six Q Branch modes
steps.d: Start all six to light a villain mini-wizard at the right ramp.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Finish any set of six modes to light a mini-wizard, play all four to reach the final wizard.

steps.t: Start all six of one mode type
steps.d: Start all six villain, henchmen, Q Branch, or SPECTRE Weapon modes to light the right ramp.

steps.t: Start a mini-wizard at the right ramp
steps.d: Choose with the Goldfinger target or bumpers: Chaos at Crab Key, Ahoy Mr. Bond, Goldfinger's Jackpot, or Duel on the Disco Volante.
Each can be played once per mode cycle.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Play all four villain mini-wizards, then advance through six film stages to MI6 Multiball.

steps.d: All four must be played to qualify the final wizard.
steps.sec: On Her Majesty’s Secret Service (Final Wizard Mode):

steps.t: Start it at the right or side ramp
steps.d: The side ramp start gives 100 flips instead of 50.
steps.sec: On Her Majesty’s Secret Service (Final Wizard Mode):

steps.d: Stages play in the order the films were completed, within a flip count.
steps.sec: On Her Majesty’s Secret Service (Final Wizard Mode):

steps.d: In the 3-ball MI6 Multiball, hit the six lit shots for each stage's total.
steps.sec: On Her Majesty’s Secret Service (Final Wizard Mode):

steps.d: After all six jackpots, shoot the lit side ramp for the super jackpot and +10 flips.
steps.sec: On Her Majesty’s Secret Service (Final Wizard Mode):

stern/james-bond-007.s: Progress from basic skill shots to super skill shots for smart missiles.

steps.t: Make the MI6 lane skill shot
steps.d: Plunge for the flashing MI6 lane for +1x bonus. Not changing it makes the Classified shot.
Hold the left flipper, plunge fully, then hit Undercover, Double O, Eyes Only, or Top Secret for a smart missile.

steps.t: Make the MXV super skill shot
steps.d: Full plunge, then shoot the right orbit, upper loop, and side ramp for 2 smart missiles.

stern/james-bond-007.s: Qualify and collect Bond Women, then cash them in for multiplied playfield scoring.

steps.d: Make enough shots, for example 25 bumper hits or 3 right orbit shots, to flash an insert at the upper loop.

steps.t: Collect Bond Women at the upper loop
steps.d: Each upper loop shot collects one lit woman, turning an insert solid.
Press the action button while pink for up to 7x playfield. Starting 7x also gives 30 seconds of ball save.

stern/jaws.s: Light and complete encounters at the five beach shots, then play all five to reach the 4th of July mini-wizard mode and the encounter challenges.

steps.t: Light a Shark Encounter at the bash boat
steps.d: Shoot the captive ball / bash boat 1 shot plus 1 per encounter already played to light the encounter modes at the five beach shots.
Shoot the boat/shark before starting a mode to light encounter boosts: more time, then 5M + gear, then 2x scoring. On Prem/LE, hit the shark bash toy; on Pro, shoot the captive ball once more.
Shoot a beach shot: left spinner for Night Swim, wave ramp for Beach Panic, center ramp for Scars, fishing reel spinner for Pond Attack, or right ramp for Raft Attack.

steps.t: Complete the encounter with the fin jackpot
steps.d: Make enough shots to qualify the encounter jackpot, then hit the fin drop target in time for the full percentage and +1x permanent machete.

steps.t: Play all five encounters to light 4th of July
steps.d: Start all five shark encounters to light the 4th of July mini-wizard at the center ramp.
Shoot the lit beach shots to keep the beaches open. After 25 fireworks, hit the captive ball / bash boat for the super jackpot.
After 4th of July, replay the encounters with 30-second timers and doubled scoring to raise the shot multiplier at each starting shot.

stern/jaws.s: Chum the water, attach barrels to Jaws, play all three Jaws multiballs, then take on Smile, You Son of A… and Super Celebration Multiball.

steps.t: Chum the water and fill the chum line
steps.d: Shoot the captive ball under the chum bucket, then hit the flashing red arrows to complete the chum line.

steps.t: Raise the fin and attach a barrel
steps.d: Shoot a lit yellow shot, then hit the shark fin to attach a barrel. After multiball 1, first complete the left target bank to light Ready Barrel.
With the required barrels attached (1, 2, or 3), make a shot that feeds the inlane posts.
Play Reel Him In!, The Chase, then Cage Dive. Multiball 1 needs 5 jackpots; 2 and 3 each build to a super jackpot.

steps.t: Start Smile, You Son of A… at the center ramp
steps.d: After Jaws Multiball 3, shoot the lit center ramp and choose the wizard mode rather than keep chumming.
steps.sec: Smile, You Son of A… (Wizard Mode)

steps.d: Finish Quint's Demise, Clash on the Mast, then Smile, You Son of A…, ending each phase with its hurry-up.
steps.sec: Smile, You Son of A… (Wizard Mode)

steps.d: Finishing the final phase starts a 6-ball multiball with perks from the modes already played.
steps.sec: Smile, You Son of A… (Wizard Mode)

stern/jaws.s: Rescue beachgoers to close beaches, then play Rescue or Search Multiball.

steps.t: Rescue beachgoers at the shark tower
steps.d: Hit the shark tower targets around a shot to light beachgoers. 8 rescued beachgoers award an extra ball and light gear.
steps.sec: Closing the Beaches / Beach Closed Hurry-Ups

steps.t: Close a beach with its hurry-up
steps.d: After 3 beachgoers at one shot, collect the Beach Closed hurry-up at that shot.
steps.sec: Closing the Beaches / Beach Closed Hurry-Ups

steps.d: Collect the fifth hurry-up with its ball saver. No encounter or multiball can be running.
steps.sec: Closing the Beaches / Beach Closed Hurry-Ups

steps.d: Choose Rescue or Search Multiball and complete it to start victory combos.

stern/jaws.s: Light and complete bounty hunts for four sharks, then qualify and play the Great White multiball.

steps.d: Spin the fishing reel or shoot the right ramp enough times, or get it from Quint's Shack, then start a hunt at the right ramp.
Make the shots listed on the display for Mako, Thresher, Hammerhead, or Tiger during single-ball play.
Shoot the fishing reel spinner to start the bounty hunt multiball.
Shoot green shots, then the captive ball / shark to weaken it. Shoot the final green shot, then the shark to capture it.
After the capture, shoot green arrows for jackpots, then the super jackpot at the captive ball.
Capture all four sharks or sell all gear to qualify the final hunt, finish its objectives, then hit the fishing reel for the 6-ball multiball.

stern/jaws.s: Light and collect all six gear pieces at the right ramp, then sell them to Quint to qualify the final bounty hunt.

steps.d: Make a level 2 or 3 skill shot, score a quickshot, rescue the 8th beachgoer, or use another listed source to light gear.

steps.t: Collect gear at the right ramp
steps.d: Cycle the lit gear with the right flipper, then shoot the right ramp to collect it.

steps.t: Find all six types of gear
steps.d: Collect Binoculars, Oxygen Tank, Tracker, Barrel Hook, Shark Cage, and Dart.
Shoot the right ramp again and sell the gear for a multiplied bonus. This qualifies the final bounty hunt.

stern/jaws.t: Fish Finder to Super Cast 'n Catch
stern/jaws.s: Qualify and score all five Fish Finder awards to light the Super Cast 'n Catch mini-wizard.

steps.t: Qualify Fish Finder at the left target bank
steps.d: On Pro, hit the stand-up targets (3 hits for the first award). On Prem/LE, solidly light all 3 arrows in front of the drop targets.
Roll through the lane directly above the mini-flipper.
Shoot a flashing left target to score the lit award. These are Super Buoys, Super Life Ring, Cast 'n' Catch, Shark Hunter video mode, and Night Search Multiball.

steps.t: Collect all five Fish Finder awards
steps.d: Score each of the five awards to light Super Cast 'n Catch at the center ramp.
Lock a ball at the mini-flipper, lock in the cast 'n catch award at the center ramp, and play the jackpot stage at least once.

stern/jaws.s: Score all five Orca wheel awards to unlock the Say Ah! mini-wizard on Prem/LE.

steps.t: Shoot the lookout tower to light a wheel award
steps.d: Make enough lookout tower shots to light a wheel award at the Orca steering wheel.
Press the action button when the dial is over the award you want.
Score Shark Ramps, Light Gear, +3x Machete, Shark Combos, and Super Spinner to unlock the sixth award.
Shoot the wheel for the sixth award, then the center ramp when no other modes are running.

stern/jaws.s: Progress the skill shot levels and chain quickshots to light gear and an extra ball.

steps.d: Plunge into the pop bumper for 5M.
Plunge into the lane above the mini-flipper without hitting the bumper.
Hit a flashing left target bank target with no other switch hits.

steps.t: Make the super secret skill shot
steps.d: Shoot the dead center of the captive ball area with no other switch hits.
Roll the right lane above the mini-flipper, then hit the fin shortly after the harpoon lane. Each one lights gear, and the third earns an extra ball.

stern/jaws.s: Advance ORCA at the wave ramp to reach Quint's Shack and Quint's Challenge, which build the bonus multiplier.

steps.t: Advance ORCA with wave ramp shots
steps.d: Make strong shots up the left wave ramp; sneak attacks don't count.

steps.t: Collect Quint's Shack at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit right ramp to collect an award.

steps.t: Complete ORCA to light Quint's Challenge
steps.d: Completing ORCA lights the right return lane, and a shot lit to start a combo.
Complete the lit combo sequence in time. Each knot raises the bonus multiplier and the gear sale award.

stern/john-wick.s: Light and start jobs, cash them out for perks, and play all seven factions to light a wizard mode.

steps.t: Light the right VUK for a job
steps.d: Shoot the weapons crate or right VUK to advance the blue lights until all three are lit solid.

steps.t: Pick a faction and start a job
steps.d: Shoot a faction's shot to light its insert, then shoot the lit right VUK to start the job.

steps.t: Cash out the job at the left eject
steps.d: Make the job's required shots, then shoot the left eject for 20% of the job score plus the faction perk.

steps.t: Start three jobs to light extra ball
steps.d: Playing 3 jobs in a game lights extra ball at the left eject.

steps.t: Play jobs for all seven factions
steps.d: Play a job for every faction to light a wizard mode at the left eject and crate.

stern/john-wick.s: Defeat enemies to light battles, build the escape jackpot, earn Be Seeing You, and play all five battles.

steps.d: Make shots in front of blue enemy circles during single-ball play to light the left eject for battle.
Shoot the lit left eject; hit the left standup targets or pop bumper to change which adversary is selected.

steps.t: Light the blood marker and escape jackpot
steps.d: Make enough lit shots (half of the Be Seeing You count), then shoot the blood marker to light the left eject.
Complete the battle's full shot requirement for 25M, 10M bonus, and an extra ball the first time in a game.
Play Viggo, Kirill, Cassian, Ares, and Zero to qualify a mini-wizard mode.

stern/john-wick.s: Bash the car to light and play car multiballs, building toward super jackpots and the all-multiball wizard requirement.

steps.t: Bash the car to light the left orbit
steps.d: Hit the car (two hits first time on Prem/LE, four on Pro) to light Car Chase Multiball at the left orbit.

steps.t: Rip the spinner to light the car
steps.d: On the Pro, the car must be lit by ripping the spinner first.

steps.t: Choose a car multiball and start it
steps.d: Hit the car to cycle between Helipad Showdown, Taxicab Chase, Motorcycle Pursuit, and Bagarre a L'Etoile, then shoot the left orbit.
Score four jackpots in the car multiball to enable the super jackpot.
Collect the super jackpot at the car or as directed by the multiball.

stern/john-wick.s: Raise the dance floor level, start Excommunicado, and score its super jackpot.

steps.t: Raise the dance floor level to max
steps.d: Shoot the Red Circle bumper and surrounding targets until the dance floor level is maxed.
Shoot the Red Circle directly or through the VIP lane.

steps.t: Build the jackpot in the 15-second phase
steps.d: Hit shots and targets during the single-ball build phase; short-plunge to lock balls on Prem/LE.
Hit the gold flashing shots during 2-ball multiball.
Shoot the lit Red Circle after all six jackpots.

stern/john-wick.s: Spell WINSTON, lock three balls, and chain jackpots into repeated super jackpots.

steps.t: Spell WINSTON with the captive ball
steps.d: Shoot the captive ball to light the lock at the center ramp (three shots for the first multiball).

steps.t: Lock three balls at the center ramp
steps.d: Shoot the center ramp to lock balls and start Deconsecrated Multiball.

steps.t: Score 7 jackpots on the green shots
steps.d: Shoot the green shots; 14 jackpots are needed for the 3rd+ super jackpot phase.
Shoot the captive ball to score repeated super jackpots for 15 seconds.

stern/john-wick.s: Play one of each qualifying feature to reach the mini-wizard, then clear all shots to finish it.

steps.t: Play one job and one adversary battle
steps.d: Start one job and one adversary battle.

steps.t: Play car, Deconsecrated, and Excommunicado multiballs
steps.d: Start one of each multiball type to light Red Circle Reckoning.
Shoot the lit left eject or crate to begin the 60-second 4-ball mode.
Make every shot; Red Circle bumper switch hits add 10 seconds.

steps.t: Hit the final Red Circle shot
steps.d: Score 30M plus 1M per second remaining and earn an extra ball.

stern/john-wick.s: Complete all of each task type to unlock the Staircase, the Duel, and finally Special Assignment.

steps.t: Complete all of one task type
steps.d: Play all 7 jobs, all 5 battles, or all 6 multiballs to light the next wizard mode.
Defeat enemies on three levels, finish each by shooting the lit center ramp, then repeat as 2-ball multiball.
Hit the shots per level, lock both balls within 10 seconds, and time action button presses; repeat 3 times, then finish the final four shots.
Clear enemies at all major shots with 60 flips, then find Iosef among the lit shots to end the game.

stern/john-wick.s: Progress from basic crate skill shots to the Baba Yaga, VIP, MXV and car skill shots.

steps.d: Plunge into the right VUK; hitting more than one switch scores the basic crate skill shot.

steps.t: Make the super crate skill shot
steps.d: Plunge into the right VUK hitting only one switch to advance the crate toward lighting a job.

steps.t: Make the Baba Yaga skill shot
steps.d: Plunge into the right VUK without hitting any switches to score 1.5M and start the lit job.
Plunge into the backdoor to the Red Circle club; it starts Excommunicado if lit.
Full plunge, then hit right orbit, right ramp, and left eject for 10M and 10 extra enemies.
Plunge the ball behind the car to advance the car toward the next car multiball.

stern/john-wick.s: Light extra ball via several progress goals across the game.

steps.d: Defeat 10 enemies in single-ball or multiball play to light extra ball.
Hit the gold coin targets to light shots for coins and score 10 over the game.

steps.t: Score the first Be Seeing You
steps.d: Earn Be Seeing You in an adversary battle for an instant extra ball.

stern/john-wick.s: Spell YAGA to enable Lights Out for doubled scoring.

steps.d: Cycle the lit inlanes to spell BABA, which also raises the bonus multiplier.
Collect YAGA letters at lanes where a BABA insert is already lit to light the action button.
Press the action button for 30 seconds of doubled scoring.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Enter and evacuate paddocks for each dinosaur, then light and play the Escape Nublar mini-wizard mode at the T-Rex.

steps.d: Hit a major shot (or the captive ball) 3 times to enter that dinosaur's paddock and light its shot.

steps.t: Launch smart missiles to boost evacs
steps.d: Light a smart missile with 5 target hits and launch it with a 6th shot; each launch adds 25,000 to every remaining lit paddock shot.
After entering a paddock, hit its lit shot 6 more times to evacuate the dinosaur.

steps.t: Evacuate 5 dinosaurs to light Escape Nublar
steps.d: Evacuate the 5 dinosaurs (Spinosaurus not required) to light Escape Nublar at the T-Rex.
Shoot the T-Rex to start this 4-ball mini wizard mode, then follow the flashing arrows and avoid solidly lit wrong-way shots.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Rescue workers until Restore Power lights, then play the timed single-ball wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot the lit rescue shots; the game starts with 2 lit and another lights after both are rescued.

steps.t: Complete Control Room for more workers
steps.d: Shoot the left control room target 3 times to add workers.
Reach 25 rescued workers to light Restore Power at the T-Rex.
Shoot the T-Rex to start the 120-second mode, then hit each feature a few times, focusing on one at a time before power drains.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Qualify and start the 2-ball multiball, then collect jackpots to reach the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Knock down the wall of drops
steps.d: Hit the drop targets to expose the T-Rex shot and qualify multiball.
Shoot the exposed T-Rex shot 3 times to begin the 2-ball multiball.
Shoot enough orange arrow jackpots, which light other shots for jackpot.
Shoot the lit Super Jackpot at the T-Rex.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Break down the raptor pen fence, start the 3-ball multiball, capture raptors and score the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Reduce the pen's fence integrity to 0%
steps.d: Hit the switches in the Raptor Pen in the lower right to lower fence integrity.
Shoot the Raptor Pen once the fence is at 0% to start the 3-ball multiball.
Shoot the flashing orange arrow jackpots; a timer spawns more raptor shots.
After capturing enough raptors, shoot the lit Super Jackpot at the T-Rex.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Shoot the captive ball to build and collect a hurry-up that captures Spinosaurus.

steps.d: Shooting the captive ball, hitting the pop bumper behind it, 10 times starts the hurry-up at 190,000.
Spin either spinner during the 15-second timer to add 7,500 per spin.
Shoot the captive ball again before time runs out to collect the hurry-up.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Evacuate dinosaurs to light and claim the game's single extra ball.

steps.d: Complete evacuations at two paddocks to light the extra ball.
Shoot the top raptor target to collect it.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Progress from the basic plunge to the harder flipper-assisted skill shots.

steps.d: Plunge to the center top lane for 10,000 points.
Hold the right flipper, full plunge, and deadbounce into the raptor pin.
Hold the left flipper, full plunge, and immediately hit the right ramp.

stern/jurassic-park-home.s: Build spinner value with spins and earn timed double scoring from the top lanes.

steps.d: Spin either spinner 20 times for a 25,000 bonus and higher per-spin value.
Every 5 spins beyond 20 awards another 25,000 and raises spin value by 150.
Complete the top lanes a second time to start 30 seconds of 2x scoring.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.t: Island Scenes to Crash the Gate
stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Light and complete the five island scenes, then play Crash the Gate and feed the 8th Wonder objectives.

steps.t: Light an island scene at the gong
steps.d: Shoot the gong to light a scene at the shot used to start it. On Pro models without a gong, collect island (blue) arrows instead.

steps.t: Complete an island scene in 60 seconds
steps.d: Make the required shots in time to earn a map segment. Hitting the gong once per scene adds 15 seconds.
Finish Save Ann, Cross the Chasm, Pterodactyl Attack, Stegosaurus Encounter and Escape the Swamp. This gives level 2 toward 8th Wonder.
Qualify it like the other scenes, with island arrows on Pro or repeated gong hits on Prem/LE.

steps.t: Score all 5 hurry-ups and the super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the five lit shots to start gong hurry-ups, then hit the lit biplane ramp for the super jackpot.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Light island locks by climbing, then use them to turn a scene into a 2-ball multiball with jackpots and a victory challenge.

steps.d: Complete climb arrow sets to reach 200 ft and 500 ft, each of which lights island lock.

steps.t: Shoot the lit right orbit lock
steps.d: The right orbit diverts into the sinkhole and the ball is sent to the right flipper.
steps.sec: Island Locks, Island Jackpots & Victory Challenge

steps.t: Start an island scene with a lock
steps.d: Starting a scene with a lock makes it a 2-ball multiball.
steps.sec: Island Locks, Island Jackpots & Victory Challenge

steps.t: Score the Island Jackpot at the pit
steps.d: Make a progress shot, shoot the cliffs ramp to light the jackpot, then shoot the pit.
steps.sec: Island Locks, Island Jackpots & Victory Challenge

steps.d: Complete the scene shots while still in multiball, collect all lit shots, then hit the gong for the victory jackpot.
steps.sec: Island Locks, Island Jackpots & Victory Challenge

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.t: Climb the Building and NYC Events
stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Climb the building for awards, then play NYC events and earn map segments.

steps.t: Complete a set of climb arrows
steps.d: Shoot the lit yellow climb arrows to climb one section and light the next set.
Complete all climb shots on the current level (300, 600, 1000 ft) to light the right orbit.

steps.t: Start an NYC event and pick a modifier
steps.d: Shoot the right orbit with no scene or multiball running, then choose a modifier with the left flipper. Each modifier can be chosen only once.

steps.t: Complete Stage Fright, Window Shopping or Manhattan Rampage
steps.d: Finish the event to earn a map segment.
Reach the top of the building for 30M.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Start Biplane Attack, destroy biplanes, and reach the 8th Wonder requirement.

steps.d: Make 3 shots to the side ramp for the first attack.

steps.t: Destroy a biplane with a ramp jackpot
steps.d: Build the jackpot with spinner hits, then shoot the lit side ramp within 30 seconds. Barrel roll and Chandelle combos add value.

steps.t: Destroy 6 biplanes for an extra ball
steps.d: Destroying 6 biplanes lights extra ball at the Kong Cave VUK.

steps.t: Destroy 5 biplanes or score 25M from one
steps.d: This is a requirement for 8th Wonder.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.t: Spell KING KONG to T-Rex Battle
stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Collect KING KONG letters to light and play T-Rex Battle, then spell it again for the Boss T-Rex.

steps.d: Earn letters from skill shots, the gong green bar, cliffs ramp shots, Pterodactyl Attack cave shots or a flawless super sweep.
Collect all eight letters of the first set to light T-Rex Battle.

steps.t: Start T-Rex Battle at the gong
steps.d: Shoot the gong in single-ball, non-mode play after KING KONG is spelled.
Shoot arrows, pummel each T-Rex twice, then hit the pit to defeat it. Defeating both gives level 2 toward 8th Wonder.

steps.t: Spell KING KONG a second time
steps.d: The second completion starts the Boss T-Rex 4-ball battle.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Light the locks, start multiball, collect jackpots and super jackpots.

steps.d: Complete the drop targets while light kong lock is flashing to light locks at the center ramp.
Make the third lock. On Pro it lights multiball to start at the right orbit.
Hit a drop target for the first jackpot round, then complete all drop targets in later rounds.

steps.t: Score a super jackpot at the side ramp
steps.d: Shoot the side ramp after a jackpot. Scoring the super jackpot counts toward the gate lights.
This earns Kong Multiball level 2 and a map segment.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Hit pit targets to play three pit multiballs, then the Spider Queen.

steps.d: Make four pit shots: three to light it and one to start it.
Play 2-Legged Lizard, Octopus Insect and Giant Spider, each needing two more pit shots.
The fourth pit multiball is a 3-ball Spider Queen. Playing it completes level 1 toward 8th Wonder.

steps.t: Score super jackpots in Spider Queen
steps.d: Hit lit major shots, then the pit super jackpot. Score at least 250M for level 2.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Make skill shots from basic to the ultra secret, adding KING KONG letters.

steps.d: Plunge the ball into the pit targets.
Plunge into the river lane near the mini-flipper.
Plunge into the inner left inlane, then the outer left inlane.

steps.t: Make the Mega Secret Skill Shot
steps.d: Plunge to the upper left flipper and reflex shot to the cliffs ramp. Follow up to multiply it.

steps.t: Make the Ultra Secret Skill Shot
steps.d: After the cliffs ramp, shoot from the upper right flipper into the river lane.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Earn map segments and Lost Temple treasures to unlock treasure perks, up to the 1 billion point award.

steps.t: Earn map segments to complete a map
steps.d: Complete objectives such as island scenes, climb awards and NYC events to fill the current map.
Make the randomly lit gold shots, ending at the Kong Cave, in single-ball play.

steps.t: Solve the Lost Temple glyph puzzle
steps.d: Light Lost Temple, shoot the right orbit and hit flashing drop targets.
Shoot the island treasure target behind the upper drop targets.
Collect treasures from both methods to unlock perks, ending with 1 billion points.

stern/king-kong-myth-of-terror-island.s: Build kombos, light the powerup target and chain longer combos for bigger awards.

steps.d: Clear the drop targets when the King Kombos insert is lit.

steps.t: Make a 2+ way kombo and hit the powerup target
steps.d: Hit the lit powerup target during the kombo to collect the bonus and start a timed powerup.
Each added shot upgrades the powerup, up to 2x KING KONG letter progress.
Sweep all four drop targets through the left orbit, then shoot the side ramp for 50M and a KING KONG letter.

stern/kiss-wiki.s: Light locks at the Demon, start Demon Multiball, work through jackpots to the Double Super Jackpot, which feeds Rock City progress.

steps.d: Complete the two green lock targets, or spell DEMON by shooting the Demon when Lock is not lit.
Complete 3 locks, physical or virtual. Starting it also flashes the Demon insert for KISS Army.
Shoot lit major shots, each usable twice before the Double Jackpot. The fifth jackpot makes the next lit shot a Super Jackpot.
Collecting two Super Jackpots lights a strobing shot for the Double Jackpot.
Complete the strobing shot, then shoot the Demon to score it. The Demon insert lights solid for Rock City.

stern/kiss-wiki.s: Fill the Starchild progress bar, start Love Gun, collect the hurry-up and jackpots, then the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Hit STAR targets in the Starchild mini-playfield until the progress bar fills, lighting the right ramp purple insert.
Shoot the right ramp or make a lucky bounce into the Starchild saucer. It starts as a 2-ball multiball.

steps.t: Hit the Starchild drop target for the Hurry-Up
steps.d: Shoot the Starchild drop target to collect the hurry-up, set jackpot value and add a third ball.

steps.t: Hit a STAR standup for the Hurry-Up
steps.d: Hit a STAR standup to collect the hurry-up and add the third ball.
Shoot all shots for Jackpots, then each again for Double Jackpots, to light the right ramp for the Triple Jackpot.
Shoot the right ramp, then hit any STAR target for the Super Jackpot. The Starchild insert lights solid for Rock City.

stern/kiss-wiki.s: Light all four band member inserts flashing to light KISS Army at the scoop and play it.

steps.d: Shoot the right ramp to light instruments and collect them; six makes the Spaceman insert flash.
Starting it makes the Starchild insert flash.
Starting it makes the Demon insert flash.
Light every bumper once via the right orbit to make the Catman insert flash.
With all four inserts flashing, shoot the lit scoop.

steps.t: Collect the KISS Army Super Jackpot
steps.d: Hit all shots for jackpots and double jackpots, then the Demon for the super jackpot.

stern/kiss-wiki.s: Light all four band member inserts solid to start the multi-phase Rock City wizard mode.

steps.d: Collect 12 instruments to light the Spaceman insert solid.

steps.t: Collect the Love Gun Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collecting it lights the Starchild insert solid.

steps.t: Collect the Demon Double Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collecting it lights the Demon insert solid.
Advance every bumper to purple to light the Catman insert solid.
Shoot the lit scoop and progress through phases: instruments, KISS ARMY, pops, DEMON, Starchild hits, spins.

stern/kiss-wiki.s: Complete the bonus grid to light and then play the mini-wizard mode.

steps.d: Fill all 16 lights (KISS, ARMY, pops, instruments) twice by default, adjustable down one.
Shoot the lit scoop.
Complete KISS and ARMY banks, shoot the 4 instrument shots, and shoot the right orbit into the pops.
Shoot the scoop once the grid is complete.

stern/kiss-wiki.s: Complete song modes to gain increasing playfield multipliers.

steps.d: Choose a song at the start of the ball.
Shoot the roughly 8-10 lit arrows or targets required by the song.
Pick a song you haven't completed yet.

steps.t: Complete more songs for higher multipliers
steps.d: Each completed song advances the playfield multiplier 2x/3x/5x/10x for the ball.

stern/kiss-wiki.s: Use target combos, hurry-ups and City Combos to score and light the Extra Ball.

steps.d: Roll the lit inlane and shoot the flashing target to complete the bank and start a hurry-up.
Collect the center ramp and left orbit hurry-ups to make the next shot worth 2x.
Make shot sequences like Chicago (center ramp - right ramp) to light the Extra Ball on default settings.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Collect gold records in each song, change songs, and push toward platinum on all 10 songs.

steps.d: After choosing a song mode, plunge the ball to hit the lit LED target for 500k and 5 seconds of ball save.

steps.t: Collect 5 gold records in a song
steps.d: Shoot the lit arrows during the song sections; each 100,000 record sales awards 1 gold record.

steps.t: Shoot the right orbit to Change Song
steps.d: After 5 gold records the right orbit lights for Change Song; it completes the song and awards 2 Band Boosts.
Collect 10 gold records in a song; 10 platinum records permanently lets you change songs instantly on that song.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Complete songs to qualify and play Mothership Multiball, then score super jackpots.

steps.d: Collect 5 gold records in each of five songs.
Shoot the right orbit so the ball lands in the eject.
Hit shots with no song award lit for jackpots; this lights super jackpots at song-award shots.

steps.t: Collect super jackpots and multiply them
steps.d: Shoot 5 more regular jackpots while super jackpots are lit to multiply them up to 3x.

stern/led-zeppelin.t: Top of the Charts to Celebration Day
stern/led-zeppelin.s: Complete all 10 songs, play Top of the Charts, and reach the final Celebration Day multiball.

steps.d: Complete every song to qualify Top of the Charts at the right orbit.
Shoot the right orbit so the ball lands in the eject.
Shoot the lit shots to add sales, then shoot the left eject to go platinum in each song not yet platinum.
With all 10 songs platinum, shoot the right eject to begin the ? multiball.

steps.t: Collect the super jackpot and earn a diamond record
steps.d: Collect the super jackpot at the side flipper shot; draining or timing out in the final phase scores a diamond record.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Qualify and complete tours, play their multiballs, and move on to World Tour Multiball.

steps.t: Qualify a tour with the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp an increasing number of times to flash the green arrow at the left eject.

steps.t: Start a tour and complete its objectives
steps.d: Shoot the left eject, choose a tour, and finish its objectives, each acting as a tour lock.
After all objectives are done, shoot the left eject to start the tour's multiball.

steps.t: Collect jackpots and the tour's super jackpot
steps.d: Score the tour's jackpots; Icarus target three times adds balls.
Play US 1975, US 1977, Earl's Court and UK 1971 multiballs to qualify World Tour at the left eject.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Play all four tour multiballs, then collect City Jackpots up to the super jackpots.

steps.d: Complete each of the four tour multiballs.
