Shoot the left eject for a six-ball multiball.
Collect a City Jackpot, gather miles to reach the next city, then collect another; every 2 add a ball and 5 light the extra ball.
Collecting all 10 lights super jackpots for the rest of the multiball.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Lock balls at the left ramp, start Zeppelin Multiball, and build the super jackpot.

steps.t: Shoot the left ramp three times
steps.d: Lock 3 balls to start Zeppelin Multiball; on later attempts, complete ROCK to light the locks.
Hit each red-arrow jackpot, and collect the timed double jackpots it lights.
After all jackpots and doubles are done, shoot the left eject or upper flipper shot; the side shot scores 2x.

steps.t: Raise the super multiplier with LED, ZEP and ROCK
steps.d: Complete all three banks while the super is lit for +1x, up to 4x.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Raise the Electric Magic spinner and charge it to start one of two multiballs.

steps.d: Complete both banks, then make any lit shot to raise the Electric Magic spinner.
Shoot the raised spinner to charge it up.
Shoot the charged spinner again to start Electric Magic Multiball or Frenzy.
Score the super at the spinner in Multiball, or spin the center spinner during the super phase in Frenzy.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Build target bank multipliers with combos, then light Icarus for the timed playfield multiplier.

steps.t: Make a combo and finish it at a target bank
steps.d: Shoot lit combo shots in quick succession, then hit any target bank or use a Band Boost.
Completing all banks lights the Icarus target.
Start the timed playfield X, 15 seconds plus 5 per side flipper shot.

stern/led-zeppelin.s: Shoot the side flipper shot for super features, leading to an extra ball.

steps.t: Shoot the side flipper shot for super features
steps.d: Each shot starts the next: Super Spinner, Pops, Slings, Ramps.
This lights the left eject for extra ball.

steps.t: Collect the extra ball at the left eject
steps.d: Other sources include 5 gold records, 4 songs, 2 Tour Multiballs, and 5 City Jackpots.

stern/metallica.t: Crank It Up to End of the Line
stern/metallica.s: Collect items to light Crank It Up at the scoop, play all four modes, then qualify and finish the End of the Line wizard mode.

steps.d: Collect Electric Chairs, Grave Markers, Snakes and Coffins by shooting their features or the matching inserts at the major shots. Coffins only come from direct captive ball hits.

steps.t: Start a Crank It Up mode at the scoop
steps.d: Once Crank It Up is lit and you are in single-ball play, shoot the scoop and choose a mode with the flipper buttons.
Make a direct shot to each of the four main features to light the scoop, then shoot it and press the left flipper to collect the jackpot.
Meet the mode's completion goal, such as lighting all 15 inserts in For Whom the Bell Tolls or making 12 Sparky shots in Battery.

steps.t: Play all four Crank It Up modes
steps.d: Each mode needs only to be played, not completed. Each later mode needs 1 more of each item.
Collect enough items to light the 5th Crank It Up mode, then shoot the scoop.

steps.t: Collect all 6 Super Jackpots and the final collect
steps.d: Collect a jackpot to light the roving Super Jackpot, repeat until all 6 are scored, then cash out at the scoop.

stern/metallica.s: Shoot Sparky to start the multiball, then build up to Super Jackpots and the all-Super-Jackpot state.

steps.d: Shots beside Sparky count 1 hit and the target between them counts 2. Each later attempt needs 2 more hits.
When the inserts strobe, shoot Sparky once more.

steps.t: Fill the power meter with jackpots
steps.d: Hit the flashing electric chair inserts on the left and right orbits and the Sparky shot.

steps.t: Score the Super Jackpot at Sparky
steps.d: With the meter full, shoot Sparky for the 1.5M Super Jackpot.
Collect 7 Super Jackpots to light the orbits, ramps and Sparky for super jackpots for the rest of the game.

stern/metallica.s: Knock down the drop targets, start multiball, and work up to the double jackpot and magnet Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Knock down the 3 inline drop targets
steps.d: Each hit raises the bonus multiplier and lights a grave marker insert.

steps.t: Hit the grave marker target to start
steps.d: Shoot the target behind the drops. Each later attempt needs 1 more hit.

steps.t: Collect jackpots at all five major shots
steps.d: Shoot the lit shots. The grave marker target spots a missing jackpot.
Once all five jackpots are made, shoot the strobing grave marker target to hold the ball on the magnet.

steps.t: Knock the ball off the magnet for the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collect jackpots while the ball is held to add to the Super Jackpot, which starts at 1M.

stern/metallica.s: Spell SNAKE, start 2-ball multiball, then score the Snake Combo for the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the lit Snake for each letter. Relight it by shooting lit Snake inserts at other shots.
With SNAKE complete, shoot the Snake.

steps.t: Collect jackpots at the major shots and Snake
steps.d: Each jackpot adds to the super jackpot and raises the Snake Combo multiplier, up to 3x.

steps.t: Score the Snake Combo Super Jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp or right orbit, then quickly shoot the Snake without making any other shot between.

stern/metallica.s: Hit the captive ball to lock three balls, then stack another multiball and side modes while scoring captive ball jackpots.

steps.d: Hit the captive ball 5 times. Left inlanes light it for 2 hits.
Each subsequent lock needs 10 captive ball hits. The Pro locks virtually and Premium/LE locks with the magnet.

steps.t: Start Casket Multiball and stack another mode
steps.d: The third lock starts it. Start one more multiball and any side modes during it.
Alternate the flashing red arrows with the captive ball. The 5th scores a Super Jackpot.

stern/metallica.s: Complete the pick targets during multiball for 2x playfield and an added ball, which count toward starting Blackened.

steps.t: Complete the four pick targets in a multiball
steps.d: This lights the Snake for a timed lock and 2x playfield for 20 seconds.

steps.t: Lock the ball at the Snake
steps.d: The first timed lock in a multiball adds a ball and a ball saver.
Complete the pick targets 10 times for the first Blackened. Add-a-balls count as completions.

steps.t: Complete pick targets to light Blackened shots
steps.d: During Blackened, finish the pick targets to light shots for points and shoot them, starting at 1M.

stern/metallica.s: Complete the FUEL targets to earn 2x playfield, then fill the gauge to start the FUEL frenzy.

steps.t: Shoot the FUEL targets four times
steps.d: This adds to the FUEL gauge and lights the dead end target for 2x Playfield.

steps.t: Shoot the dead end target for 2x Playfield
steps.d: This gives 2x scoring for 20 seconds, additive with the Snake add-a-ball multiplier.

steps.t: Fill the FUEL gauge and start the frenzy
steps.d: After three completions on the first attempt, shoot any FUEL target.

steps.t: Extend the frenzy and cash the jackpot
steps.d: Direct FUEL target shots add time and light the dead end jackpot, which caps at 500k.

stern/metallica.s: Spell METALLICA with ramp shots, then alternate sides to balance the scales.

steps.d: Each left or right ramp shot scores a letter. Mystery awards can also give letters.
With the word complete after 9 shots, shoot either ramp again.
Alternating sides scores 2x the displayed value and raises both values by 50k.

stern/metallica.s: Light Coffin Hurry-Ups at the major shots, collect all five, then play the Seek & Destroy mode.

steps.d: Light all three item inserts on one major shot, or earn it via a super skill shot.
Shoot the strobing shot to start each hurry-up, then collect it at the captive ball.

steps.t: Hit the seek shot, then the captive ball
steps.d: Make the randomly lit shot for the jackpot, then shoot the captive ball to score a super jackpot worth double.

stern/metallica.s: Plunge for the lit rollover, then try the super skill shot for bonus awards.

steps.d: Plunge for the flashing rollover. The right lane pays 2x.
Hold the left flipper and shoot any major shot. The Dead End Target qualifies 2x Playfield, the scoop awards Mystery, and a random shot qualifies a Coffin Hurry-Up.

stern/metallica.s: Light and collect extra balls through the captive ball, combos and Blown Pistons, and light Mystery with rollover lanes.

steps.d: Complete the 3 inlanes and 2 lanes above the pop bumpers to light Mystery at the scoop.
Shoot the captive ball 10 times, make 15 combos, or collect 10 Blown Pistons.

steps.t: Collect Extra Ball at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop once Extra Ball is lit.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Shoot Sparky to start Electric Chair Multiball, fill the power meter, and score super jackpots to level up James toward Blackened.

steps.d: Shots beside Sparky score 1 hit and the middle target scores 2 hits; Sparky taunts when one shot remains.
Shoot Sparky once more when all three inserts strobe. This levels up James.

steps.t: Fill the Jacob's Ladder with jackpots
steps.d: Hit the flashing orbit and Sparky jackpot shots; each jackpot counts as 10 switch hits toward filling the power meter.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot at Sparky
steps.d: Shoot Sparky once the power meter is full. Each super jackpot electrocutes one of seven Sparkys and levels up James.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Knock down the drop targets to start Grave Marker Multiball, then work through double jackpots to the magnet super jackpot.

steps.t: Knock down the 3 inline drop targets
steps.d: Each hit raises the bonus multiplier, advances Resurrection and lights a grave marker insert.
Shoot the grave marker target behind the drop targets once all 3 are down.
Hit the lit ramps and orbits for jackpots; the grave marker target then strobes for double jackpot.
Shoot the strobing grave marker target so the magnet holds the ball for 20 seconds. Hit 3 unique jackpot shots while held to raise the super multiplier.

steps.t: Knock the ball off the magnet for the super jackpot
steps.d: Release the held ball to score the super jackpot, up to a 5x multiplier.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Spell SNAKE to start Snake Multiball, then collect Snake Combos for the super jackpots.

steps.d: Shoot the lit Snake to collect letters, relighting it by hitting the snake mouth or a lit Snake insert shot.
Shoot the Snake after SNAKE is complete to start 2-ball multiball.
Hit other shots to add +1x (max 3x) to the Snake Combo, then cash it at the Snake.
Collect 5 Snake Combo jackpots to light all shots for super jackpots, which level up Kirk.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Hit the captive ball to lock three balls at the Coffin, then alternate shots for jackpots and the super jackpot.

steps.t: Light and complete the coffin locks
steps.d: Shoot the captive ball for 5, 10, then 15 hits to light the three locks; the left inlanes and combos add extra hits.
Lock the third ball to begin; this levels up Lars.

steps.t: Alternate captive ball and flashing shots
steps.d: Score jackpots by alternating between the captive ball and the flashing shots.
Make every flashing shot once, then shoot the captive ball for the super jackpot.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Play all four band multiballs to light Blackened, then blacken every shot for the super jackpot.

steps.d: Start Electric Chair, Grave Marker, Snake and Coffin multiballs in the same game.
Shoot the lit scoop; if Crank It Up is also lit, choose Blackened with the right flipper.

steps.t: Hit the purple jackpot shot repeatedly
steps.d: Hit the flashing purple shot to score the jackpot and blacken it; it moves right from the dead-end target.
Scores the super jackpot, awards a self-destruct button and a letter in UNFORGIVEN.

stern/metallica-remastered.t: Crank It Up to End of the Line
stern/metallica-remastered.s: Collect items to light Crank It Up, play all four modes, then play the End of the Line wizard mode.

steps.t: Collect items to light Crank It Up
steps.d: Collect 12 of each item (+1 per Crank It Up played) via direct shots, item inserts or self-destruct buttons, then return to single ball.

steps.t: Start a Crank It Up mode
steps.d: Shoot the scoop and pick an unplayed mode with the flipper buttons.
Make enough shots in the mode to earn the completion bonus, which adds a letter in UNFORGIVEN.

steps.t: Cash out the jackpot at the scoop
steps.d: Make all four main features during the mode to light the scoop, then collect with the left flipper.

steps.t: Play all four Crank It Up modes
steps.d: Play For Whom the Bell Tolls, Fade to Black, Battery and Enter Sandman; they need not be completed.
Collect enough items to light the 5th Crank It Up and shoot the scoop.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Fill item columns at shots, collect coffin hurry-ups at the captive ball, and start Seek & Destroy.

steps.t: Light all three items at a major shot
steps.d: Collect items by shooting features; lighting all 3 at one shot lights the coffin hurry-up there (a Blue Spider Arrow super skill shot or Mystery also qualifies one).
Shoot the shot with the strobing inserts, then collect the hurry-up at the captive ball.
Collect a hurry-up at each of the five major shots at the captive ball to start Seek & Destroy.

steps.t: Alternate seek shot and captive ball
steps.d: Hit the required shot, then the captive ball to destroy and score; repeat until the timer runs out.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Complete pick targets, run the 72-switch countdown, and score all four toy jackpots.

steps.d: Do this in single-ball play to light super spinner and qualify 72 Seasons.
Complete the countdown to start the mode; completing the targets again boosts the switch value by 25k.
Score all four pick-target jackpots within the 72-second timer to earn a self-destruct button use.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Hit the five hardwired shots to light the scoop, then score all hurry-ups including the Hardwired jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the ramps, orbits and grave marker targets in single-ball, non-mode play.
Shoot the lit scoop; extra hardwired shots first add 400k each to the hurry-up value.
Collect four hurry-ups, then the fifth shot for the jackpot, which awards a self-destruct button use.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Collect setlist combos during their matching modes to unlock Lux Aeterna, Frantic Multiball and an UNFORGIVEN letter.

steps.t: Collect setlist combos in matching modes
steps.d: Make a mode's listed combo while its song plays to earn a self-destruct button and progress.
Lights Lux Aeterna at the piston target, startable with no multiball or Crank It Up running.

steps.t: Collect 10 pairs and start Frantic Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the lit piston target, outside other multiballs, then match shot colors for jackpots.
Awards a letter in UNFORGIVEN.

stern/metallica-remastered.t: Lady Justice and And Justice for All
stern/metallica-remastered.s: Spell METALLICA with ramp shots to start Lady Justice, which can become And Justice for All Multiball with the topper.

steps.d: Shoot the left and right ramps (9 shots, or 2 letters per combo ramp shot); Mystery also gives letters.
Shoot either ramp once METALLICA is complete, then alternate left and right shots for bonuses.
With the topper installed and not in Crank It Up or a non-coffin multiball, hit flashing shots for 1 letter, or 2 if fast-flashing.
steps.sec: And Justice for All Multiball (Topper Exclusive Mode)

steps.t: Score the super jackpot in And Justice for All
steps.d: After three jackpots, shoot either ramp for the super jackpot, which adds a ball once per multiball.
steps.sec: And Justice for All Multiball (Topper Exclusive Mode)

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Spell UNFORGIVEN by finishing the game's major tasks to start the super wizard mode.

steps.d: Each band member at level 8 awards a letter.

steps.t: Score a Crank It Up completion bonus
steps.d: Earn the completion bonus in any Crank It Up mode for a letter.

steps.t: Collect 100M in Fuel, Lady Justice and Seek & Destroy
steps.d: Combined scoring in these three modes awards a letter.

steps.t: Score all 14 setlist combo pairs and 100 combos
steps.d: Each achievement awards a letter.
Awards the final letter.
Once UNFORGIVEN is spelled with no other mode running, the super wizard mode begins.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Complete the FUEL targets to light 2x playfield and build toward the FUEL frenzy.

steps.d: Shoot the targets four times to add to the gauge and light the dead end target for 2x playfield.

steps.t: Hit the dead end target for 2x playfield
steps.d: Lasts 20 seconds and can be reset by hitting it again.

steps.t: Fill the FUEL gauge and start the frenzy
steps.d: After three completions (first attempt), shoot any FUEL target to start FUEL frenzy.
Direct FUEL shots light the piston target for the fuel jackpot.

stern/metallica-remastered.s: Score skill shots and light extra balls at the scoop through captive ball hits, combos and blown pistons.

steps.d: Plunge for the flashing rollover; the right rollover pays 2x.
Hold the left flipper while plunging and shoot any major shot for bonus awards.
Shoot the captive ball 10 times, make 15 combos, or earn 15 blown pistons.

steps.t: Collect the Extra Ball at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the lit scoop.

stern/mustang-wiki.s: Advance gears with the drop targets, play a gear's multiball, then score the super jackpot as it grows with gear level.

steps.t: Complete the drop targets to advance a gear
steps.d: Start in first gear and complete a set of drop targets to advance to the next gear.

steps.t: Reach gear 5 or 6 with the standups
steps.d: For gear 5, complete the drops then hit one standup behind them within 5 seconds. For gear 6, hit the other standup within another 5 seconds.
Hit any drop target or mini-jackpot shot during multiball to light the first super jackpot, which has a generous timer.
Its base value is the sum of your gears. The first gear 6 super jackpot is worth 50M, then 21M after that.

steps.t: Relight the super jackpot and play another gear
steps.d: Hit more drops, orbit shots, or captive ball hits to relight it. Each gear's multiball can only be played once, so advance to a different gear next time.

stern/mustang-wiki.s: Qualify with captive ball hits, then find the girl, spell BURNOUT, and collect the growing combo jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the captive ball four times, or get the Qualify Burnout Mystery Ford award after completing one of the top three modes.
Shoot the left ramp, captive ball, and right orbit, each worth 200k.

steps.t: Find the girl at the captive ball
steps.d: Collect the 10 million main jackpot at the captive ball. The left ramp diverts to the cup to spell BURNOUT.

steps.t: Spell BURNOUT and collect the combo jackpot
steps.d: After every letter is collected, the left ramp feeds the left flipper to set up the 20 million combo jackpot at the captive ball.

steps.t: Relight with pop bumpers for bigger jackpots
steps.d: After enough pop bumper hits the sequence restarts. The combo goes to 40M and rises 20M per relight, and the main jackpot rises 5M per relight.

stern/mustang-wiki.s: Spell MUSTANG, start the 4-ball multiball at the scoop, and chain Mustang and Double Jackpots.

steps.d: Complete modes or collect Mystery Ford awards to spell MUSTANG and light the scoop.
Shoot the scoop during single-ball play to start the 4-ball multiball.
Hit any lit major yellow arrow shot. That shot then becomes a Double Jackpot and the others are disqualified.
Collect the Double Jackpot to relight all other shots for Mustang Jackpot, then repeat.

stern/mustang-wiki.t: Mode Completion to Drift and Stampede
stern/mustang-wiki.s: Start and light all six modes solid to reach Drift and Silverball Stampede at the scoop.

steps.d: Hit a shot on one side then the opposite side, then any of four shots, then the right orbit twice and left ramp twice. Only 8 shots in total.

steps.t: Complete Road Coarse and the other modes
steps.d: Hit all six lit shots for Road Coarse. Also finish Stunt Driver, Rally Race, Drag Race, and Cruisin' to light each mode solid.
First hit every shot once. Then restart it at the scoop and hit the first four shots in order, then chase the roving light four times.

steps.t: Start all 6 modes to prepare Drift
steps.d: Starting all six modes prepares Drift at the scoop.

steps.t: Light all 6 modes solid for Silverball Stampede
steps.d: Lighting all six modes solid prepares Silverball Stampede at the scoop.

stern/mustang-wiki.s: Hold the left flipper, trap the ball, and hit the lit skill shot targets in front of the gears.

steps.t: Collect the GE or RS skill shot
steps.d: Hold the left flipper while launching and hit the lit GE or RS target for 1 million.
A scoop shot awards 2 million for the super skill shot.

steps.t: Hit the lit A to advance two gears
steps.d: Hit the A while its light is lit to advance two gears, up to gear 4 at most.

stern/mustang-wiki.s: Complete the playfield Upgrades once for Upgrade Scoring and a second time for Upgrade Multiball.

steps.d: Complete every Upgrade on the playfield.

steps.t: Start Upgrade Scoring at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the scoop to activate Upgrade Scoring.

steps.t: Complete the Upgrades a second time
steps.d: This lights the scoop for Upgrade Multiball.
Shoot the lit scoop to start it.

stern/mustang-wiki.s: Complete the three right standups to light the spinner and boost target scoring.

steps.d: Hit all three standups on the right side of the playfield to light the spinner.
Each target bank hit is worth 2 million while the timer runs, and 4 million with N2O boost. Hit the bank again to restart the timer.

stern/pokemon.s: Play story modes at each level, which feed shot multipliers and extra balls, to light the right ramp for Lucario or Charizard.

steps.d: Hit a ramp or orbit (Bulbasaur, Squirtle, Pikachu, Charmander) three times during single-ball play.
Make 5 more shots to the same shot to begin that character's level 2 mode. Complete training targets to boost modes and add 20 seconds.
Completing a story mode qualifies a shot multiplier, and completing three story modes lights the extra ball.

steps.t: Play all four story modes of one level
steps.d: Play all four level 1 (or level 2) story modes to light the right ramp.

steps.t: Start Pikachu vs. Lucario or Charizard
steps.d: Shoot the lit right ramp and choose a mini-wizard mode while no other mode is running. After level 2, the unchosen one starts.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

stern/pokemon.s: Build jackpots in single-ball, lock balls, then play multiball and finish with a super jackpot.

steps.d: Play all four story modes of a level, then shoot the lit right ramp and choose Lucario.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

steps.d: Shoot the orbits and left ramp to add 250k each; after 3 build shots, the right ramp virtually locks a ball.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

steps.d: Drain or max locks to start multiball, then hit the two lit shots for jackpots.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

steps.d: Shoot the lit right ramp to complete the mode.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

stern/pokemon.s: Clear four shot phases in 4-ball multiball to reach the center lane super jackpot hurry-up.

steps.d: Light the right ramp by playing all four story modes of a level and choose Charizard.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

steps.d: Shoot a lit orbit or ramp, hit two lit shots, then hit the Pokedex captive ball to score the total.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

steps.t: Complete all four major shot phases
steps.d: Repeat the process once for each of the four major shots to light the center lane.
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

steps.d: Hit the center lane to win; the hurry-up maxes at 100M (200M with 2x playfield).
steps.sec: Pikachu vs. Lucario & Pikachu vs. Charizard (Mini-Wizard Modes):

stern/pokemon.s: Catch Pokémon, battle rivals and travel through all four biomes to unlock the final Arena Battle.

steps.d: Fill the gauge with top lanes and bumpers, scan the Pokémon at the captive ball, then spell CATCH! and shoot the left ramp.
Catch enough Pokémon to light the right scoop, defeat the rival's Pokémon, then shoot the left ramp for the victory bonus.
Catch a Pokémon, complete the training targets near the left orbit outside a story mode, and play a rival battle, then shoot the scoop to travel.
Repeat the process for the Forest, Lake, Desert and Mountain biomes.
Shoot the scoop and defeat six Pokémon: Ursaring, Sandslash, Talonflame, Gengar, Metagross and Salamence.

stern/pokemon.s: Lower the Meowth balloon, light and play multiball, and score super jackpots for shot multipliers.

steps.d: Shoot the BATTLE targets (center lane spots missing ones) or hit the center lane as a super skill shot.
Shoot the balloon 3 times (+2 per multiball), or sneak in through the lane below it to light it instantly.
In multiball 1, score 6 jackpots (8 on later cycles). In multiball 2, freeze shots and score jackpots at the balloon.
Shoot the lit lane or center lane for super jackpot, which qualifies a shot multiplier.
Complete the BATTLE targets, then press the action button while blinking green.

stern/pokemon.s: With the topper, catch Pokémon to spell MAGIKARP and play through Magikarp and Gyarados multiballs.

steps.d: With the topper installed, each Pokémon caught lights one letter; all 8 start the mode.
Make blue shots to light and build the Magikarp jackpot at the captive ball.
Shoot the lit left ramp to start the 6-ball Gyarados phase.
Collect 10 jackpots, then score four super jackpots at the left ramp (scoop on Prem/LE).

stern/pokemon.s: Complete TEAM lanes to run boosted TEAM features and light mystery.

steps.d: Complete the lanes to light a TEAM feature.
Make a shot to start it: Pikachu, Squirtle, Charmander, or Bulbasaur in order, boosting that shot.
The first mystery needs one TEAM completion, later ones two.

stern/pokemon.s: Light the extra ball at the town scoop through several progressions.

steps.d: Complete three story modes, collect 50 Poké Balls, or hit the captive ball 25 times.
Shoot the town scoop once the extra ball is lit.

stern/pokemon.s: Progress from the basic skill shot to the super and Psyduck skill shots.

steps.d: Full plunge and hit the flashing lane to raise the bonus multiplier.
Hold the left flipper and full plunge; the center lane completes BATTLE, the scoop lights mystery.
Get the super secret skill shot worth 3x.

stern/spider-man-rulesheet-wip.s: Light locks with the Light Lock target, lock three balls at the orbits to start multiball, then clear jackpots and super jackpots.

steps.t: Hit the Light Lock target to light locks
steps.d: Hit the Light Lock target 1+N times (N = Black Suit Multiballs already played) to qualify the lock at either orbit.

steps.t: Lock three balls at the orbits
steps.d: Shoot the green-lit orbits to lock balls; the third lock shot immediately begins Black Suit Multiball.
Two jackpots are lit at each major shot. Hitting the pop bumpers raises the jackpot value.
After all 12 jackpots, shoot the left ramp (4x each) and side ramp (8x each) Super Jackpots, then the sequence restarts.

stern/spider-man-rulesheet-wip.s: Shoot the saucer to lower Doc Ock and play progressively harder multiball rounds with jackpots and super jackpots.

steps.d: Shoot the saucer once to lower the Doc Ock target and start a 2-ball multiball with a free jackpot.

steps.t: Light and collect the Fusion Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collect five Jackpots to light the saucer for a Super Jackpot worth 5x the Jackpot.
Shoot the saucer three times, knock the ball off the magnet, shoot all lit Jackpots, then collect the Super Jackpot at the saucer.
In the 4-ball multiball, collect the instant Jackpot and then Super Jackpots at the saucer, which require more shots each time.

stern/spider-man-rulesheet-wip.s: Defeat the four villains in waves to earn Extra Ball, Battle Royale, and the Special.

steps.d: Complete the 3-bank or hit the moving target, hit the required inner targets or Sandman, then shoot the center hole.
Complete the five green targets, hit any again to start, then hit the flashing targets the required number of times.
Make side ramp shots to start Venom, then shoot the ramps the required number of times.

steps.t: Complete the first wave for Extra Ball
steps.d: Completing the first wave of villains lights Extra Ball at the left orbit.

steps.t: Complete the second wave to light Battle Royale
steps.d: Completing the second wave lights both orbits for Battle Royale.
Shoot all four villain shots, then the right ramp to collect the Royale Jackpot and advance rounds.

steps.t: Complete the third wave for the Special
steps.d: Completing the third wave lights the Light Lock target for a Special.

stern/spider-man-rulesheet-wip.s: Complete white arrows to start timed modes and multipliers, with all five started qualifying Super Hero.

steps.d: Shoot every major shot with a white spider arrow: both orbits, three ramps, and Doc Ock.
After all arrows strobe, the next shot gets a 2x multiplier until the ball ends.

steps.t: Start a timed mode at an orbit
steps.d: Use the lit orbits to start one of the five 40-second timed modes.
Completing a timed mode boosts the multiplied shot to 3x.
Start New Goblin, Daily Bugle, Amazing Spider-Man, Bonesaw, and Rescue MJ to qualify Super Hero.

stern/spider-man-rulesheet-wip.s: Make the WEB lane skill shot, or the harder side ramp super skill shot.

steps.d: Plunge into the flashing WEB lane for points, +5x bonus multiplier and doubled jet bumpers.
Plunge weakly to the upper right flipper and shoot the side ramp.

stern/spider-man-rulesheet-wip.s: Complete the Spider Sense targets and collect the lit lane awards.

steps.t: Complete the Spider Sense targets during a mode
steps.d: Hit the three standup targets while a mode is active to light the lane.
Collect all lit awards, including an Add-A-Ball during multiballs.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Start a Level I mode, optionally push into Galactic Away Team, then complete Levels II and III to earn a permanent 2X shot.

steps.t: Start and play a Level I mode
steps.d: Shoot Mission Start (far left eject hole) or the Away Team shot and choose a mode, then hit the matching colored shots before the timer runs out.
Hit any lit mode shot, then shoot the Away Team rollover under the upper right flipper to add 20 seconds and change the objectives.

steps.t: Earn medals and finish Level I
steps.d: Every 3rd shot awards the next medal: bronze at 3, silver at 6, gold at 9. Shoot the final shot to complete the mode.
Start Level II after finishing Level I. Make the required number of shots, using multi-color arrows for silver and gold medals.
Start Level III after finishing Level II and finish it to light one shot for permanent 2X scoring for the rest of the game.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Complete three same-level modes in a line to enable the Captain's Chair and its super award.

steps.t: Complete modes at the same level
steps.d: Finish modes at the same level (e.g. Level I) so they line up.
Completing three same-level modes in a line enables the Captain's Chair (Super Pops, Super Ramps or Super Spinner depending on the line).
Finish the enabled Captain's Chair award. It stays active across balls and can be earned once per rack.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Light and lock three balls with the green standups, then collect jackpots up to the Double Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Complete the 3 green standups to light locks at the left scoop and Vengeance.

steps.t: Lock 3 balls to start Klingon MB
steps.d: Lock balls at the left scoop and Vengeance. Locking the 3rd ball starts multiball. Stack it by starting it just after a mode.

steps.t: Collect jackpots to the Super Jackpot
steps.d: All shots are lit for jackpots starting at 200K. The 7th jackpot is a 6.25M Super Jackpot.
The 14th jackpot is another Super Jackpot worth 10M, followed by a traveling Double Jackpot.
Shoot the lit warp ramp for 20M and a gold medal.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Keep shooting the warp ramp to climb warp levels for an extra ball, double scoring and an added ball.

steps.d: Make 4 warp ramp shots to earn an Extra Ball.
Make 10 warp ramp shots for 2X scoring for 60 seconds.
Make 18 warp ramp shots for 2X scoring plus a second ball added to single ball play.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Hit Vengeance repeatedly to progress through Vengeance Multiball, Vengeance Scoring and Vengeance Battle.

steps.d: Complete the torpedo standups to add 3 torpedoes, then press the fire button to score Vengeance hits.
Hit Vengeance enough times (or use torpedoes) to light the mode. Hit the magnet-held ball to add a ball.
Complete 10 shots, then shoot Vengeance to earn 5M.
Make 5 shots in the hurry-up to destroy Vengeance and earn an extra ball.
Shoot Vengeance 5 times to raise the drop target, shoot it down, then hit Vengeance for 10% of your score.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Complete all Level I modes to light Vengeance for the first wizard mode.

steps.t: Complete all six Level I modes
steps.d: Finish Level I of every colored hexagon mode, collecting medals.
Shoot the white-lit Vengeance shot to collect medal bonuses and begin a 2-ball multiball.
Each shot needs two hits, the second scoring by your Level I performance. Clear them all to continue in single ball play.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Complete all Level II modes, then beat six rounds of switch hits and score the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Complete all six Level II modes
steps.d: Finish Level II of every mode.
Shoot the white-lit Vengeance shot to collect medal bonuses and start a 2-ball multiball.
Make the required switch hits to add a ball and light a final shot, then repeat with higher requirements through the 6th round.
After the 6th round, shoot the lit Vengeance shot to continue in single ball play.

stern/star-trek-wiki.s: Complete all Level III modes to light Vengeance for the final wizard mode.

steps.t: Complete all six Level III modes
steps.d: Finish Level III of every mode, which also earns permanent 2X shots.
Shoot the white-lit Vengeance shot to collect medal bonuses and begin a 4-ball multiball.

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.t: Rebel Missions to Not a Jedi Yet
stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Light and play Rebel missions with FORCE targets, earn extra balls, and qualify the Not a Jedi Yet mini-wizard.

steps.t: Light Rebel missions with FORCE targets
steps.d: Shoot the flashing FORCE targets to light all eight character shots for Rebel missions.

steps.t: Play and complete a Rebel mission
steps.d: Hit four blue shots to progress, with the final shot at the Luke VUK completing the mission.
After completing a character's mission, shoot their shot again while no other modes are running to start the Bonus Mission.

steps.t: Play missions for four different characters
steps.d: Playing a mission for four unique characters lights the left scoop blue; each completed Bonus Mission reduces the number needed by 1.
Clear 6 waves of shots, then shoot the left scoop for the final hurry-up.

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Advance the Falcon through its modes in order to the Never Tell Me The Odds mini-wizard.

steps.d: Shoot the center ramp when the Falcon engines are lit; the first mode always gets progress from the center ramp.
Shoot the timed center ramp during Lightspeed Escape to begin the 2-ball multiball.

steps.t: Play That's No Moon, Dogfight and Cloud City
steps.d: Play the Falcon Features in order, shooting the lit shots in each. Qualify the center ramp via the right ramp (Pro) or the raised target (Prem/LE).

steps.t: Start Never Tell Me The Odds
steps.d: After the first three Falcon Features, light the engines with right ramp shots and make enough center ramp shots with no other mode running.
steps.sec: Never Tell Me The Odds (Mini-Wizard Mode):

steps.t: Complete Never Tell Me The Odds
steps.d: Score four jackpots in phase 1, light shots red in phase 2, score a jackpot, then make the center ramp escape shot.
steps.sec: Never Tell Me The Odds (Mini-Wizard Mode):

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Open the Sarlacc Pit, play all three Jabba Events, then take on the Sarlacc Escape mini-wizard.

steps.d: Shoot the Salacious Crumb drop target twice, then shoot the Sarlacc Pit ramp.
Finish Luke's Gift, Jabba's Palace or Rancor Battle to light extra ball.
Play Luke's Gift, Jabba's Palace and Rancor Battle to qualify Sarlacc Escape.
Shoot the drop target repeatedly and then the Sarlacc Pit ramp to start the multiball mini-wizard.
Score four Sarlacc Pit jackpots, then shoot the left scoop for the hurry-up super jackpot.

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.t: Vader Modes to Dark Side Multiball
stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Qualify and complete Vader modes, build Dark Side Scoring, and finish Dark Side Multiball.

steps.t: Qualify the left scoop for a Vader mode
steps.d: Complete the return lanes so they light the left scoop (they alternate with Dark Side Mystery) during single-ball play.
Shoot the lit left scoop, then hit one of the lit shots to start an untimed mode.
Hit enough shots to complete the scene, then hit the Vader scoop.
Hit the roving purple shot 5 times to light extra ball.
Hit the roving purple shot 10 times to light the Vader scoop for Dark Side Multiball.
Play the 3-ball multiball, then shoot the left scoop for the final hurry-up.

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Light locks, play Hoth, spell AT-AT, and score the super jackpot.

steps.t: Light three locks with the Droids target
steps.d: Shoot the droids target to light virtual locks at the Luke VUK, then score the locks.
Lock the third ball at the Luke VUK to begin the multiball.
Score a jackpot, then shoot the droids target for a letter jackpot; repeat to spell AT-AT.
After AT-AT is spelled, shoot the Luke shot for the super jackpot.

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Lock balls at the Death Star, destroy the first Death Star, then take on Death Star II.

steps.t: Lock three balls at the Death Star
steps.d: Shoot the Death Star ramp to open the lock, then shoot it again to lock a ball; repeat until three are locked.
steps.sec: Death Star & Death Star II Multiballs:

steps.d: Hit lit jackpot shots in Death Star Multiball; a made shot stays unlit until a different one is hit.
steps.sec: Death Star & Death Star II Multiballs:

steps.t: Score the Death Star super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the Death Star ramp to open the toy and score the 20M super jackpot.
steps.sec: Death Star & Death Star II Multiballs:

steps.d: Lock three more balls to progress toward defeating Death Star II.
steps.sec: Death Star & Death Star II Multiballs:

steps.t: Score the Death Star II super jackpot
steps.d: Score the 2x jackpot and the roving 3x jackpot, then shoot two balls through the center ramp for the 12x super jackpot.
steps.sec: Death Star & Death Star II Multiballs:

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Make combos at characters to power up multiball jackpots and start untimed super modes.

steps.d: Shoot any shot, then hit a flashing yellow Name insert shot to pulse that character's Name insert.

steps.t: Make a second combo at the same character
steps.d: Complete a second combo to light the Name insert solid and start the super mode.
Keep hitting the shots for that character's super mode until its required count is reached.

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Plunge for the skill shot, then go for the super skill shot with a perk.

steps.d: Plunge the ball and hit any flashing shot to score the skill shot and its unique perk.
Hit the flashing shot within only 3 switch hits for 2x the value.

stern/star-wars-fall-of-the-empire.s: Stormtrooper hurry-ups, TIE fighter awards and JEDI ball save.

steps.t: Collect Stormtroopers and start the hurry-up
steps.d: Shoot the far right standup target to collect 2 Stormtroopers and start the hurry-up at that target.
Collect it for +1x end-of-ball bonus and a bigger next award.

steps.t: Collect 5 TIE fighters for Hyperspace Loops
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp, then build and cash out the hyperspace jackpot; extra balls light at 10, 30 and 60.
Rip the spinners to spell JEDI and light both outlanes for ball save.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Meet all five prerequisites to light Jedi Multiball at the left ramp, then defeat the Emperor over four phases.

steps.d: Complete every blue standup target within about 30 seconds repeatedly to advance Jedi Training through Youngling, Padawan and Jedi to Master.
Collect TIE Fighters and mash the action button during the hurry-up to destroy them; 100 total qualifies Jedi Multiball.
Finish the sequence of five hurry-ups after completing four white arrow combo shots.
Help all three allies escape using blue shots, then shoot the right loop to win.

steps.t: Start all four final planet multiballs
steps.d: Attempt the final multiball mode of every planet.
Shoot the lit left ramp; medals from Victory Multiball set the starting bonus.
Complete four phases of blue shots, or one red shot when the timer expires, without draining your last ball.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Qualify planets with three shots each, play their modes, finish the final mode and start Victory Multiball.

steps.d: Shoot a planet's shot three times: left mini-loop (Death Star), left ramp (Endor), right mini-loop (Hoth) or right scoop (Tatooine).
Shoot a qualified planet's shot to choose a mode and complete its objectives; two modes from different planets can run at once.

steps.t: Complete all of a planet's modes
steps.d: Finishing every mode for that planet qualifies its final multiball mode.
Finish the final mode objectives, played on its own, to start Victory Multiball.

steps.t: Complete 6 major shots and earn medals
steps.d: In Victory Multiball, make 6 major shots and collect bronze, silver and gold medals to boost Jedi Multiball's start award.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Complete FORCE targets repeatedly for escalating awards, ending with Lightsaber Duel.

steps.d: Complete the FORCE targets to light Mystery at the right scoop.

steps.t: Complete FORCE for Escape and Video Mode
steps.d: The 2nd completion lights Escape (ball save) and the 3rd lights Video Mode at the right mini-loop.
Complete FORCE a 4th time to double shot multipliers until the timer expires.
Complete FORCE a 5th time with no other modes active to light the left ramp.
Shoot blue shots to help allies escape and red shots for time, then shoot the right loop.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Collect TIE Fighters to light the hurry-up, destroy enough TIEs and score the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Collect enough TIE Fighters (5 the first time, then 10, 15...) by shooting the red targets.
Shoot the TIE Fighter target, then mash the action button during the 7-second timer.
Destroy 35 TIE Fighters (110 subsequently).
Shoot all major shots lit for 750k jackpots.
Shoot the left ramp, building it with the red 3-bank targets.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Collect Hyperspace Hurry-Ups to start the multiball and score jackpots.

steps.d: Complete the inlane rollovers to light the right ramp and left loop.
Shoot the left mini-loop for the hurry-up value; two collects start the multiball.
Pro: knock the ball out of the left mini-loop. Premium/LE: send more balls into the hyperspace wireform.
Shoot yellow shots for jackpots, then enough to light the left mini-loop for another hurry-up.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Make the bonus and FORCE skill shots at ball start.

steps.d: Shoot the flashing target for Bonus X; the middle target scores the most.
Shoot it to spot the next FORCE award, before any wrong drop target is hit.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Build shot multipliers and use them on high-value shots.

steps.d: Hit 3-bank targets for +1x each, up to 20x.
Earn the fourth FORCE award for up to 40x.

steps.t: Play Video Mode on a multiplied shot
steps.d: Light it with 3 FORCE completions and shoot the right mini-loop with the multiplier placed there.

stern/star-wars-stern.s: Light the extra ball at the left ramp through planet modes or TIE Fighters.

steps.d: Win enough planet modes (starts at 3) or destroy 80 TIE Fighters.
Shoot the lit left ramp.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Light and play Kaiju Battles, win them to conquer cities, and earn extra balls and perks.

steps.t: Light Kaiju Battle at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot either ramp twice for the first battle; later battles need a shot to both ramps.
Shoot the scoop and choose a 60-second battle (Ebirah, Titanosaurus, Gigan or Megalon) with the flippers and action button.

steps.t: Win the battle to conquer the city
steps.d: Fully complete the battle to conquer the city, gaining its perk, +1 Bonus X and a Super Spinner. Reaching halfway lights an Ally.
Use City Select at the scoop to move to a new city and collect the Carnage Bonus.
In the new city, complete at least half of a Tier 1 battle to unlock Tier 2 battles.

steps.t: Conquer 2 cities for an Extra Ball
steps.d: Winning 2 Kaiju Battles awards an extra ball.

stern/stern-godzilla.t: Planet X and Final Wizard Modes
stern/stern-godzilla.s: Play all four city objectives to reach Planet X, then work toward King of the Monsters and Monster Island Madness.

steps.d: Start a Tier 2 Kaiju Battle, Tesla Strike, Bridge Attack Multiball and Tank Attack Multiball, even across multiple cities.

steps.t: Choose Planet X at City Select
steps.d: Select Planet X to collect the Earth Bonus and start Planet X Multiball.

steps.t: Defeat the Xiliens in Planet X
steps.d: Make the shot sets in order, ending with the scoop hurry-up within 20 seconds.

steps.t: Light and start King of the Monsters
steps.d: After playing Monster Zero or Terror of Mechagodzilla and Planet X, reach Power-Up #8 or #11, select Light King of the Monsters, then shoot the building.
steps.sec: King of the Monsters (Final Wizard Mode)

steps.t: Win the Planet X Victory Challenge
steps.d: Win the timed Victory Challenge after Planet X, or collect all ten secret combos instead.

steps.t: Defeat King Ghidorah, then play Monster Island Madness
steps.d: Collect the Ghidorah Bounty in King of the Monsters to start the 75-second 6-ball Monster Island Madness.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Destroy the building, start the multiball, score the super jackpot and light Monster Zero.

steps.d: Shoot the ramps or building for the upper and middle floors; lower floors need building shots.
Shoot the building once more to start it.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start Godzilla Multiball
steps.d: After reaching 0%, shoot the building three times to lock balls; the third lock starts the multiball.
Hit lit shots to advance jackpot levels and light the Super Jackpot at the building.
Shoot the building to collect it; this is required to qualify Monster Zero.
Choose Light Monster Zero from Power-Up level 4 or 8, then shoot the building.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Bring Mechagodzilla online, start the multiball, score the super jackpot, and unlock Terror of Mechagodzilla.

steps.d: Shoot the right spinner 20 times (+10 per activation), then once more to deploy him.
Shoot all three targets (on Pro, the two standups and the right spinner).
Shoot the right spinner, or use the jump ramp on Prem/LE.

steps.t: Collect jackpots and the target bank
steps.d: Collect the three lit-shot jackpots, alternating with the target bank, to light the timed super jackpot.
Build it with spinner hits, then collect it at the Tail Whip lane (3x) or right spinner lane (1x).

steps.t: Light and start Terror of Mechagodzilla
steps.d: Choose Light Terror of Mechagodzilla from Power-Up level 4 or 8, then shoot the building.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Destroy the bridge through Bridge Attacks and play the multiball through to super jackpots.

steps.d: Score 50 switch hits (+25 per activation) to light Bridge Attack at the Magna-Grab captive ball.
Score Bridge Attack four times, each removing 25% integrity, until Bridge Out! flashes.
Shoot either ramp while Bridge Out! flashes (always the right ramp on Pro).

steps.t: Score double jackpots and the super jackpot
steps.d: Collect 3 jackpots, then 2 double jackpots at the captive ball, to start the timed right-ramp super jackpot round.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Destroy tanks to light the multiball, then clear tanks to reach its super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the two lit TANK shots; 10 tanks (+5 per activation) light Tank Attack Multiball at the scoop.
Shoot the lit scoop; it overrides the Kaiju Battle selection screen.
Hit the flashing tank shots before they reach the captive ball.
After enough tanks are destroyed, shoot the Maser Cannon target.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Complete Powerline targets, run Powerline Attack, then win Tesla Strike.

steps.d: Complete all 3 Powerline targets twice (+1 per activation) to start Powerline Attack.
Hit the flashing Powerline target 5 times (+2 per activation); the final shot starts Tesla Strike.
Rip the center spinner, then collect 5 unique blue shots.
Shoot the strobing Powerline target after Tesla Strike ends.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Destroy saucers at the pop bumper for extra balls, then play Saucer Attack Multiball.

steps.t: Destroy 3 saucers for an Extra Ball
steps.d: Hit the saucer bumper to light Saucer Attack, then shoot it.
This qualifies Saucer Attack Multiball.
Shoot the flashing pop bumper; it can be played once per game.
Complete the white inserts, shoot the Maser Cannon target to lock on, then shoot the bumper within 15 seconds.

stern/stern-godzilla.t: Jet Fighter Attack and Monster Rampage
stern/stern-godzilla.s: Side modes that award extra balls and feed the Destruction Jackpot.

steps.d: Collect 6 missiles at the flashing inlanes.

steps.t: Destroy 10 jets for an Extra Ball
steps.d: Shoot roving red arrows to destroy jets; 5 jets light an Ally and 15 add +1x Destruction Jackpot.
Collect letters at the left spinner when Adv. Rampage is lit; two are spotted at the start.
Shoot the single lit shot repeatedly; 12 cumulative shots award an Extra Ball.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Light the Destruction Jackpot and collect it to boost bonuses.

steps.d: Start any city objective, or reach a saucer, loop, tail whip, train or Rage Combo milestone.

steps.t: Shoot the building to hold the ball
steps.d: The Magna-Grab post holds the ball and drops it to the upper flipper after about 9 seconds.

steps.t: Shoot the upper loop to collect it
steps.d: Collect it to boost Annihilation Bonuses and light the left spinner for Rampage.

stern/stern-godzilla.s: Progress from regular skill shots to the super secret skill shot.

steps.d: Short plunge to a switch or the bumper, or plunge into the left spinner lane.
Plunge to the upper flipper and shoot the upper loop, or plunge into the left inlane.

steps.t: Make the Super Secret skill shot
steps.d: Make the left spinner lane skill shot, then immediately shoot the scoop for 10M, +2 Power-Ups and an Ally.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Spell MAP, enter a Paddock, rescue staff, set the trap and capture the dinosaur, building toward the Visitor's Center.

steps.t: Spell MAP to light Advance Paddock
steps.d: Shoot the lit white arrows to spell MAP. The first Paddock needs one arrow shot; later ones need three.

steps.t: Enter a Paddock via the left ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit left ramp to advance to the next Paddock. Shoot the truck to change between the left and right paths.

steps.t: Rescue staff at the red shots
steps.d: Hit the flashing red Rescue shots before the dinosaur reaches them, until the minimum rescues for the Paddock are made.
Hit the lit Set Trap targets beside the truck (and the Helipad on harder Paddocks).
Shoot the flashing yellow/green shot to capture it and gain its perk. Capturing your first dinosaur lights Control Room.

steps.t: Respell MAP after a Level 4 Paddock
steps.d: After leaving either Level 4 Paddock, spell MAP again to light the left ramp for Visitor's Center.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Capture the Spinosaurus to qualify and play a switch-based multiball with rising jackpots.

steps.d: Advance through the Paddocks to the Level 3.5 Spinosaurus Paddock.
Rescue 3 staff, hit the left then right Set Trap targets, and capture it to light King of the Island Multiball at the left ramp.

steps.t: Start King of the Island Multiball
steps.d: Shoot the lit left ramp to start the 3-ball multiball; it must be played before the next Paddock.
Collect switch thresholds, then shoot lit major shots for jackpots up to 5x, re-shooting prior shots to requalify.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Spell T-REX to play all four T-Rex Events, then qualify and win the Museum Mayhem mini-wizard.

steps.d: Shoot the truck to complete T-REX and light the left ramp for a T-Rex Event.

steps.t: Play Feed T-Rex and collect the hurry-up
steps.d: Shoot orange arrows to raise the hurry-up, then shoot the left ramp to collect it and start T-Rex Multiball.
Shoot all 5 lit CHAOS jackpots, then collect the Super Jackpot at the left ramp.
Finish each remaining T-Rex Event; each single-ball one awards a Fossil.

steps.t: Spell T-REX again to qualify Museum Mayhem
steps.d: After all four events, spell T-REX once more to light the left ramp for Museum Mayhem.
Defeat both raptors, make the truck, then the left ramp for 75M and play the victory multiball.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.t: Control Room to Secure Control Room
stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Light the Control Room, play all three modes, then play Secure Control Room.

steps.d: Capture your first dinosaur, spell CHAOS twice, get a Raptor Tri-Ball jackpot, or make 15 tower shots.
Shoot the lit Control Room and pick Virus Attack, Restore Power or System Boot; completing one awards a Fossil.

steps.t: Play all three Control Room modes
steps.d: Complete each of the three modes; played ones are greyed out.
Shoot the Control Room again after all three modes have been played.
Collect hurry-ups on each major shot in fixed order, then the Control Room lane to finish.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Spell CHAOS, play the multiball, and collect super jackpots to open phase 2.

steps.d: Collect the five lettered shots in sequence to light the pops target; later attempts need two completions.
Hit the lit pops target to start the 3-ball multiball.
Shoot jackpots on one side of the truck, hit the truck to switch sides, and collect super jackpots at the amber target.
Across attempts, light all five letter shots for phase 2 jackpots, which award a Fossil.
After all five letters, hit the lit pop bumper target for the combined value.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Capture a raptor, weaken the fence, and play the four-phase Tri-Ball.

steps.d: Complete the Raptor Pen standup targets twice (+1 each later attempt); a dead-end lane shot counts as all of them.
Shoot the lit center target to capture a raptor.
Shoot the enclosure and dead-end lane until integrity is 0%; the lightning bolts flash.
Make a last shot to the dead-end lane.
In phase 3, shoot the right ramp or upper loop for a super jackpot and a Fossil.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Clear the Paddocks, qualify the Visitor's Center, and lock both raptors in cold storage.

steps.d: Capture the Pteranodon or Raptor Paddock.

steps.t: Spell MAP to light Visitor's Center
steps.d: Shoot the white arrows again to light the left ramp.
Shoot the lit shots toward the Raptor Pen, stun a raptor there, then make the C lane for the second.
Knock the locked balls to put both raptors in cold storage before the hurry-up expires.
Shoot every flashing target to light the Control Room for a jackpot and add-a-ball.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Finish the three mini-wizards, escape the island, and earn the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Complete the Visitor's Center mini-wizard.
Complete the Museum Mayhem mini-wizard.
Complete the Secure Control Room mini-wizard.
After all three mini-wizards, shoot the left ramp.

steps.t: Navigate Paddocks and hit the Helipad
steps.d: Rescue staff, find safe paths through each Paddock, then shoot the Helipad hurry-up to escape the island.

steps.t: Play When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth
steps.d: With all four modes completed, play the timed 6-ball multiball with all shots lit for jackpots.
steps.sec: When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth (Ultimate Wizard Mode)

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Make the combo skill shot sequence, then the secret and MXV variants.

steps.t: Make the left ramp skill shot
steps.d: After a full plunge, shoot the left ramp first to begin the sequence.

steps.t: Complete the full skill shot sequence
steps.d: Follow with right ramp, side ramp, then right orbit for Super, Double Super and Ultra Super values; lights escape at the left outlane.
Hit the upper loop right before the side ramp in the Double Super sequence for 8X.

stern/stern-jurassic-park.s: Earn Fossils across the game to complete sets and all eleven.

steps.d: Complete a T-Rex Event or Control Room mode to collect Fossils.
Collect every Fossil in a set for its award, such as Set 2's Extra Ball.
Complete all four sets for the 500M award.

stern/stern-rush.s: Collect years to upgrade the Time Machine, play both Cygnus X-1 books, then start the final 2112 wizard mode.

steps.t: Collect years to earn Time Machine upgrades
steps.d: Gain years from planet modes, super jackpots, combo jackpots and more; every 10 years lights the Time Machine green for an upgrade.

steps.t: Play Cygnus X-1 Book 1 - The Voyage
steps.d: Start all six multiball modes to light it at the Time Machine.
Complete all six planet modes to light it at the Time Machine.
With 100 years collected and both books played, shoot the Time Machine to start 2112.

stern/stern-rush.s: Collect records to start planet modes, complete them for years and rainbow records, and win all six to light Hemispheres.

steps.d: Hit flashing record shots to qualify the Time Machine; the solidly lit record colors determine the mode.

steps.t: Start a planet mode at the Time Machine
steps.d: Shoot the Time Machine to start one of six untimed song modes; matching record colors score 2x, all six matching gives 3x.
Complete it for +5 years (+10 if you score 80M+) and a rainbow record to place on a shot.
Winning all six lights Cygnus X-1 Book 2 - Hemispheres at the Time Machine.
Finish all five flipper-configuration phases, then shoot the Time Machine for the Super Jackpot.

stern/stern-rush.s: Shoot the Time Machine ramp to start Red Barchetta, Subdivisions or Fly By Night, collect super jackpots, and feed Cygnus Book 1.

steps.t: Power up the Time Machine ramp
steps.d: Shoot the ramp through the Time Machine 3 times (+6 per multiball, -1 per decade); use the dead end shot to pick which multiball is lit.
Shoot the ramp once more to start the lit multiball with 2 balls.

steps.t: Collect jackpots toward the super jackpot
steps.d: Red Barchetta: redline the RPMs; Subdivisions: light every shot; Fly By Night: dim the lights for the strobing blue shot.
Earn years (+2 Red Barchetta, +5 Subdivisions/Fly By Night) toward 2112.
Start all six multiball modes in one game to qualify Cygnus X-1 Book 1.

stern/stern-rush.s: Light and lock balls for Far Cry, score 15 jackpots and the super jackpot, then play One Little Victory laps.

steps.d: Shoot the LIGHT LOCK standup targets near the right ramp to light the lock at the top scoop.
Collect the second lock at the top scoop or the bottom scoop; later activations need more shots, such as the ramp.
Hit the colored shots before they time out; higher multipliers time out faster.

steps.t: Shoot the Time Machine for the super jackpot
steps.d: Collect the Super Jackpot for +5 years (+10 for a flawless one with no jackpots timed out).
In One Little Victory Laps, hit an upper flipper shot to light a roving super jackpot; each needs one more victory jackpot.

stern/stern-rush.s: Advance the drum clock to midnight, start Headlong Flight, and chain jackpots into Super, Mega and Ultra jackpots.

steps.t: Advance the Drum Clock to 12 am
steps.d: Hit the pop bumpers to advance the clock from 5 pm; drumsticks and Drum Solo speed it up.
steps.sec: Drum Clock, Drum Bonus & Clock Bonus

steps.d: Shoot the right orbit once it is lit; it can start at any time and stack with other multiballs.

steps.t: Score side loop and side ramp jackpots
steps.d: Jackpots are worth 1M x the current clock hour; the right ramp also lights as a jackpot.

steps.t: Combo the side loop into the side ramp
steps.d: Score the Super Jackpot worth 3x the jackpot value for +5 years.

steps.t: Score a Mega or Ultra Jackpot
steps.d: Hit both side shots, then the right ramp for Mega (Ultra if a Super was scored).

stern/stern-rush.s: Collect all three instruments, start Freewill, and score super jackpots at shots of your choice.

steps.d: Complete the drop target bank repeatedly to collect Bass, Guitar and Drumsticks.
Shoot the instrument lane after collecting all three instruments; on Premium/LE this locks a ball first.

steps.t: Score a super jackpot of your choice
steps.d: Hit any lit jackpot shot to turn it into a Super Jackpot, then collect it.
Every 3 unique super jackpots adds +5 years.

stern/stern-rush.s: Make 1-2-3 combos to collect albums, then the combo super jackpot, extra ball and Weapon.

steps.d: Hit the three flashing shots in order to light the Combo Jackpot at the Time Machine.
Shoot the Time Machine to collect the jackpot and a unique album for each combo made.
Shoot the lit side ramp after the Combo Jackpot for 2x its value.
With a matching album, hold the lit action button to spot shots or add a ball.

steps.t: Collect five albums for the extra ball
steps.d: Five albums light the extra ball; all ten adds +1x to combo jackpots.

stern/stern-rush.s: Complete the RUSH targets, start Bastille Day and collect all four hurry-ups.

steps.d: Hit the R-U-S-H standup targets; each Bastille Day start requires more completions.
Shoot the right ramp to start the hurry-ups at the RUSH targets.
Collect all four additive hurry-ups; shoot the right ramp to add 2M to values.

stern/stern-rush.s: Score upper flipper skill shots from the plunge, up to the 3x upper scoop.

steps.t: Make the side loop skill shot
steps.d: Shoot the side loop for a 1x skill shot.

steps.t: Make the side ramp skill shot
steps.d: Shoot the side ramp for a 2x skill shot.

steps.t: Make the upper scoop skill shot
steps.d: Shoot the upper scoop for a 3x skill shot, or combo the side loop into the scoop or ramp to double.

stern/stern-rush.s: Make ramp shots to hold values for the next ball and light the extra ball.

steps.d: Hold the guitar (spinner) value to the next ball.

steps.t: Light the extra ball at 8 ramps
steps.d: Make 8 ramp shots to light the extra ball.
Shoot the under-flipper shot or the upper scoop; slingshots change which one collects it.

stern/stern-the-beatles.s: Light and start modes with F-A-B and F-O-U-R, advance them, and cash in the Super Jackpot for completed modes.

steps.d: Complete the F-A-B and F-O-U-R drop target banks to prepare the next mode start.

steps.t: Shoot the upper magnet to start a mode
steps.d: Pick the lit mode with the flippers (it alternates every 5 seconds) and shoot the upper magnet to start the 60-second mode.

steps.t: Complete the mode objective to advance its level
steps.d: Do the objective shown above the flippers (loops, drop banks, spinners or pops) to raise the mode level, up to level 5.

steps.t: Complete a mode to light Super Jackpot
steps.d: Finish a mode to light Super Jackpot at the target behind the F-A-B drop targets; it unlights if you drain.
Shoot the target behind the F-A-B drops; completing several modes without collecting multiplies it, up to 5x.

steps.t: Play the four modes to add All My Loving
steps.d: After the four other modes have been played (or on ball 3), All My Loving joins the rotation as a 2-ball multiball with a jackpot at the upper magnet.

stern/stern-the-beatles.s: Reach level 2 in every mode to start a multiball with a Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Advance every mode to level 2 or higher (level 3 on Competition Mode).

steps.t: Shoot the upper magnet to start
steps.d: Start with 30 seconds of single-ball play where each completed drop bank raises the jackpot by 50k.
Complete F-A-B and F-O-U-R to light the jackpot at the top magnet and collect it.
Complete all three drop banks (FAB, FOUR, 1964) to light the Super Jackpot behind the F-A-B drops.

stern/stern-the-beatles.s: Max out all five modes to unlock the Taxman 4-ball multiball with all modes running.

steps.d: Take every mode to level 5.

steps.t: Shoot the upper magnet to start Taxman
steps.d: Starts 4-ball multiball with all four single-ball modes active.

steps.t: Add a ball with the Beatles standups
steps.d: Complete the 4 Beatles standup targets to add a ball.
Complete F-A-B and F-O-U-R to light the jackpot at the top magnet.
Complete all three drop banks to light the Super Jackpot behind the F-A-B drops.

stern/stern-the-beatles.s: Progress from the easy plunges to the 100k and secret skill shots.

steps.t: Short plunge to the star rollover
steps.d: Worth 10k.

steps.t: Upper right flipper then upper loop
steps.d: Short plunge to the upper right flipper, then shoot the upper loop for 25k.

steps.t: Hit the top Pop Bumper from the plunge
steps.d: Plunge into the hole below the Top Magnet and hit the top Pop Bumper for 100k.
Roll through the left inlane in normal play, then hit the lit star rollover in time for 50k.

stern/stern-the-beatles.s: Drop target banks lead to the extra ball, then a bonus, while Bonus X leads to Special.

steps.t: Complete all 3 drop banks on one ball
steps.d: Complete FAB, FOUR and 1964 on a single ball to light extra ball at the left inlane.
Hit the lit inlane before draining; it alternates with slingshot hits.
Complete the drop bank with the lit Advance Multipliers insert to add +1x, up to 7x.
Shoot the lit outlane Special, which alternates with slingshot hits.

stern/stern-the-beatles.s: Spell BEATLEMANIA with loop shots to collect upper magnet awards.

steps.d: Shoot the upper loop or right orbit to spot a letter in BEATLEMANIA.
Complete all letters to light the upper magnet.
Awards go in order: 2x Spinners, 5x Loops, Collect Bonus, 10x Loops.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Light and start Episodes at the Pizza Parlor, play 4 for Team-Up Multiball, then play all 8 to light Final Battle.

steps.d: Shoot the left and right ramps to light Start Episode at the Pizza Parlor.
Shoot the lit Pizza Parlor. Use the Dimension X targets to choose which episode insert is flashing.
Shoot the required lit shots to light the Turtle Shots, then hit a Turtle Shot to collect the Completion Bonus.

steps.t: Play 4 Episodes to light Team-Up Multiball
steps.d: After playing any 4 episodes, Team-Up Multiball lights at the Left Ramp.

steps.t: Play all 8 Episodes to light Final Battle
steps.d: Play all 8 episodes (won or lost) to light Final Battle at the left ramp.
Get through the three phases, then make the final Left Ramp shot to win.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Qualify with right ramp shots, start it, build Mondo Jackpots and cash the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the right ramp three times; the next right ramp shot starts it. Donatello's level 1 perk lights it instantly.
Shoot the green shots for jackpots to light Mondo Jackpot at the upper loop.

steps.t: Collect Mondo, Double and Triple Mondo
steps.d: Repeat upper loop shots for Double, then Triple Mondo Jackpot before they time out.
steps.sec: Mondo Jackpots and Jackpoto Grande Values:

steps.d: Collecting a Mondo Jackpot lights the Lair for the Super Jackpot; shoot it.
steps.sec: Mondo Jackpots and Jackpoto Grande Values:

steps.d: Shoot all 4 Turtle Shots to light Turtle Power at the Right Ramp for an Add-A-Ball.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Lock balls at the Pizza Parlor with toppings, defeat Foot Soldiers, then collect Mondo and Super Jackpots.

steps.t: Shoot the Pizza Parlor three times
steps.d: Lock balls and start Ninja Pizza Multiball; use the Pizza Targets to pick toppings first.
Shoot lit shots (Left Ramp 3, Krang Loop 2, Center Ramp 2, Pizza Parlor 1, Right Ramp 1) to light Mondo Jackpot at the Krang Loop.

steps.t: Collect Mondo, Double and Triple Mondo
steps.d: Repeat Krang Loop shots before the timers expire.
steps.sec: Mondo Jackpots and Jackpoto Grande Values:

steps.d: Shoot the lit Lair shot for the Super Jackpot after a Mondo Jackpot.
steps.sec: Mondo Jackpots and Jackpoto Grande Values:

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Spell LAIR to run Training, level up your turtle and unlock Neutrino Pizza Party.

steps.t: Spell LAIR at the LAIR Target
steps.d: The first LAIR completion lights the Lair Lane for Training.
Shoot Right Ramp then Left Ramp in time to reach Level 2.
After a Training Mode, complete both Dimension X targets to light the Left Ramp for Neutrino Pizza Party.
Shoot red shots to build blue shot value, and collect blue shots in 30 seconds.
Complete the longer shot sequences to reach Levels 3 and 4.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Spell LAIR a second time to start and extend 2x playfield scoring.

steps.d: Every even-numbered LAIR completion lights the center 2X target.
Shoot the center target for 30 seconds of 2x scoring.
Shoot the center target while it runs to add 5 seconds.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Light it after 4 episodes, rescue the turtles, and reach Pizza Party Victory Laps.

steps.d: Lights Team-Up Multiball at the Left Ramp; each completed episode adds a perk.
Shoot both orbits and the ramps and Krang Loop during the Rescue Phase.
Shoot a lit Turtle Shot to collect each; a Shredder Hurry-Up at the Right Ramp comes before the final one.
Completing all 3 Rescue Hurry-Ups starts Pizza Party; shoot lit shots for awards.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Complete the six requirements and play Final Battle to qualify the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot the upper loop up to three times, then cash out at the center ramp.

steps.t: Collect Jackpoto Grande and a Triple Mondo
steps.d: Collect both during either main multiball.
Make the skill shot, roll over the lit Weapon inlane, and shoot the lit orbit.

steps.t: Collect 5 April Hurry-Ups and complete 1-2-3 Foot
steps.d: Cash out April Hurry-Ups at the Right Ramp; complete the 1-2-3 Foot combo.
Final Battle is the last requirement for Cowabunga.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Make skill shots and cash in Weapon and April hurry-ups.

steps.t: Make the top lane skill shot
steps.d: Plunge into the flashing right top lane to add +1x bonus multiplier.
Hit the lit shot for your turtle within 15 seconds to score 250k and light a Weapon inlane.
Roll over the lit Weapon inlane, shoot the lit orbit, then the center ramp.
Spell APRIL an even number of times, then shoot the Right Ramp.

stern/stern-tmnt.s: Collect pizza slices for the Eating Contest and extra balls.

steps.t: Start 2 Episodes to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Light the extra ball and collect it at the pizza parlor.
Shoot the Pizza Targets in normal play or Ninja Pizza Multiball.
Shoot a strobing Pizza Target, then mash the action button for 6 seconds.
This lights an extra ball.

stern/stranger-things.s: Light all six center-playfield objectives, then shoot the left ramp to start the Final Showdown wizard mode.

steps.d: Shoot five qualifying shots in a row, each within a few seconds of the last, to solidly light the 5-Way Combo insert.
Play all 6 Season 1 chapters, then shoot the left ramp to start Send it Back.
Play all three Demodog Attack modes to solidly light the Demodog! insert.
Play all five Demogorgon Modes to solidly light the Demogorgon! insert.
Play all 6 Season 2 chapters, then shoot the left ramp to start Light the Fire.
Collect the Super Jackpot in Telekinesis Multiball to solidly light its insert.
With all six objectives solidly lit, shoot the left ramp. The start awards 10M per drawing collected.

stern/stranger-things.s: Start chapters from the orbits and ramps, complete them for drawings, and unlock Total Isolation, Send it Back and Light the Fire.

steps.d: Complete the three inserts under the left orbit, left ramp, right ramp or right orbit. Left shots start Season 1, right shots start Season 2.
Finish the chapter's shots for 1 drawing, or meet its special restriction for 2 drawings.
After 4 chapters, with the inserts collected, the next left ramp shot starts Total Isolation 1.
Play all six Season 1 chapters to qualify Send it Back at the left ramp.
Play all six Season 2 chapters to qualify Light the Fire at the left ramp.

stern/stranger-things.s: Qualify Total Isolation 1 and 2 through chapters, then score jackpots and the center Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Play 4 chapters and collect each shot's three inserts.
Shoot the left ramp to start the multiball.

steps.t: Collect jackpots and the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Collect 3 jackpots, doubled when shot as a combo, then shoot the center scoop for the Super Jackpot.
Play 8 chapters, then shoot the left ramp to start Total Isolation 2.

steps.t: Score the Total Isolation 2 Super Jackpot
steps.d: Hit each flashing shot, then hit it again for a double jackpot. Do this for all lit shots to light the center Super Jackpot.

stern/stranger-things.s: Light locks, lock three balls, then collect jackpots and the Super Jackpot for a drawing.

steps.d: Complete the green standup targets on each side of the left ramp. The first multiball needs one completion for all three locks.

steps.t: Lock balls at the left ramp
steps.d: Shoot the left ramp to lock balls. The 3rd lock starts the multiball.
Shoot 5 lit jackpots to light the Super Jackpot at the left saucer.
Shoot the left saucer for 6M to light the insert and earn a drawing.

steps.t: Lock a ball to double the Super Jackpot
steps.d: Lock a ball at the left ramp within 20 seconds to double the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Lock up to two balls on the magnet
steps.d: Lock balls on the magnet for a 2x or 3x Super Jackpot.

stern/stranger-things.s: Spell words at the drop targets to play all five Demogorgon modes, lighting the Demogorgon! objective.

steps.d: Complete the drop targets to spell the word. Each mode needs one more completion than the last.
Shoot up the middle once the drops are lowered and the purple arrow strobes.
Collect the hurry-up and jackpots in Trap 'Em!, then kill 3 Demogorgons in What's That?.
Lock in the jackpot, collect the drop target jackpots, then collect the Super Jackpot at the Demogorgon.
Collect the red jackpots, then collect Super Jackpots at the Demogorgon mouth before the timer runs out.

stern/stranger-things.s: Spell DEMODOG and shoot the left standup to play all three Demodog Attack modes.

steps.d: Hit the DEMODOG standup targets directly (or the saucer for the first mode) to light the left standup lane.
Hit 15 DEMODOG targets to complete the mode and earn a drawing.
Play through all three phases for a drawing at phase 3.
Shoot all eight lit shots for a drawing. Starting it lights the Demodog! insert.

stern/stranger-things.s: Progress from the plunge skill shot to the combined MXV Super Skill Shot for a drawing.

steps.d: Plunge for the flashing drop target.
Soft plunge towards the flippers, then shoot the kicker.

steps.t: Make the MXV Super Skill Shot
steps.d: Make both skill shots on one plunge by rebounding off the flashing drop target into the kicker.

stern/stranger-things.s: Shoot the Burn it Back loop to earn extra balls, Spell of Protection and 2x Scoring.

steps.d: Make 1-10 loops to light Extra Ball, and again at 50 loops.
Reach 3, 12, or 25 loops, then every 14 after, to light the left outlane save.
Reach 7 or 18 loops, then every 14 after, and shoot the lit saucer for 60 seconds of double scoring.

stern/stranger-things.s: Light and collect extra balls through chapters, drawings, loops and mystery.

steps.d: Starting 3 chapters lights Extra Ball at the left standup lane.
Starting 6 chapters lights Extra Ball again.
Collect 11 drawings in one game to light an extra ball.

stern/the-mandalorian.s: Hit the center Razor Crest target to start each multiball and hurry-up, and play all three to qualify Precious Cargo.

steps.t: Pick a multiball with BOBA and FETT targets
steps.d: Hit the BOBA and FETT standups when no multiball is lit to change the flashing numbered green insert.
Hit the center Razor Crest target with enough strength for enough direct hits, then shoot all the way around the center ramp. Each later feature needs one more hit.
Complete the multiball's jackpot phase (Ice Spider: all purple shots; Jetpack: build it, collect after multiball; Pirates: complete Wave 3) to light the Super Jackpot at the U-Turn.

steps.t: Complete a Hunter to relight Razor Crest
steps.d: After a multiball, complete a Hunter mode to relight the Razor Crest for the Hurry-Up. It also relights after a drain.
Hit the Razor Crest target the required number of times before time runs out. Each active playfield multiplier adds 2 required shots.

steps.t: Play all three multiballs for Precious Cargo
steps.d: Play Ice Spider, Jetpack and Pirates Multiballs in one game, then shoot the Razor Crest enough times to start Precious Cargo.

stern/the-mandalorian.t: Missions to I Like Those Odds
stern/the-mandalorian.s: Light and complete missions at the scoop; all five lead into the I Like Those Odds mini-wizard.

steps.d: Shoot both the left and right ramps to light a Mission at the scoop. The 2x targets by the right ramp change the qualified mission.
Shoot the left scoop, then make all flashing yellow shots within 60 seconds, usually ending at the scoop. A timer bonus is scored.

steps.t: Start 2 Missions to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Starting two missions lights the extra ball at the left scoop.
Play Find the Asset, Deceive the Magistrate, Destroy the Imperial Base, Defeat the Mudhorn and Infiltrate the Freighter.
It starts as the 6th mission. Finish both shot phases and the 4-ball multiball by making every major shot, then enjoy the 60-second frenzy.

stern/the-mandalorian.t: Encounters to You Have What I Want
stern/the-mandalorian.s: Light Encounters from left ramp shots, clear them on the mini playfield, and complete all three to reach You Have What I Want.

steps.d: Shoot the left ramp until the insert in front of it flashes red: 1 shot for the first, plus 2 more per further Encounter.
Shoot the left ramp to send the ball to the mini playfield. It waits until other active modes finish, unless a Mission is running.
Hit the yellow flashing targets on the mini playfield for each of three waves.
After three waves, shoot targets in the timed Bonus Level for 2 million plus points per target made.

steps.t: Complete all three Encounters in order
steps.d: Finish all three Encounters in order to qualify You Have What I Want.

steps.t: Start You Have What I Want
steps.d: After all three Encounters, shoot the left ramp 7 times.

stern/the-mandalorian.s: Start all three mini-wizard modes, then make every major shot and the left scoop to play the wizard mode and earn your Signet.

steps.d: Play all 3 Razor Crest Multiballs, then shoot the Razor Crest enough times.
Play all 5 Missions; it then starts as the 6th mission.

steps.t: Start You Have What I Want
steps.d: Play all 3 Encounters, then shoot the left ramp 7 times.
After all three mini-wizards, make all six major lit shots followed by the left scoop.

steps.t: Complete three rounds and earn the Signet
steps.d: Alternate single-ball phases (5 shots to qualify the multiball) and Multiball Bonus Rounds through three rounds for 10 million, a Signet and a permanent +1x playfield multiplier.

stern/the-mandalorian.s: Start the three +1x multipliers, stacking up to 6x playfield.

steps.d: Start a 30-second +1x multiplier. It is the only one that can be started during multiball.
