Light Scope by making the U-Turn, left 2x target and right ramp, then hit a lit arrow within 5 seconds for a 75-second +1x.
Complete the left standup bank, roll through a lit inlane, then shoot the flashing orbit and the opposite orbit for a 75-second +1x.

steps.t: Run all three multipliers at once
steps.d: Having all three active awards +5x for a total of 6x playfield, ideally before starting a multiball.

stern/the-mandalorian.s: Collect Beskar through Hunter, Scope and Child awards, then spend it at the Foundry for equipment and features, up to Beskar Bonanza.

steps.d: Complete the left standup bank, roll through a lit inlane, then shoot the flashing orbit and the opposite orbit for at least 250 Beskar.
With Beskar collected, shoot the lit Foundry at the left scoop and buy up to two adjacent items.
Collect 20,000 Beskar (carries over between games) with the topper connected to light the Foundry.
Shoot the Foundry to award one of every item.

stern/the-mandalorian.s: Fill the six-icon topper grid to start the topper-exclusive Mandalorian Madness.

steps.d: Win a Mission, score a Super Jackpot, complete an Encounter and a Hunter, collect a Scope award, and cash out an Ambush.
With all six icons lit and no other modes running, shoot the Razor Crest.

steps.t: Score Super Jackpots to reach the 4-ball multiball
steps.d: Complete a set of the lit shots to light the U-turn Super Jackpot. Each one adds a ball.

stern/the-mandalorian.s: Make the regular skill shot, then the super skill shot sequence for a mode start.

steps.d: Plunge into the CHILD lanes, using the C lane or a lit cycling lane, for 1M plus Bonus X, a lit Child and a Super Pop.
Hold the left flipper until the ball passes the C lane, then hit the U-Turn and right ramp, each within 5 seconds.
Hit the left scoop, left ramp or center ramp to start the lit Mission, Encounter or Razor Crest feature.

stern/the-munsters.s: Start each family member's mode once to qualify the scoop, then play the wizard mode through its stages.

steps.t: Start a level of every Family Member
steps.d: Start Herman, Spot, Lily, Grandpa and Raven at least once; simply starting a mode counts as completing a level.

steps.t: Start Munster Madness at the scoop
steps.d: After completing one level for all Family Members and finishing any mode in progress, shoot the lit scoop for the 4-ball wizard mode.
Shoot Herman, Raven, Lily three times each within 15 seconds each; later cycles add Spot and Grandpa.
Shoot the scoop to collect the Hurry-Up value based on points scored in the previous stage.
Complete a family member to reach stage 2, then collect Jackpots at the four lit major shots before the timer runs out.

steps.t: Complete all seven areas and collect Hurry-Ups
steps.d: After all seven areas are done, hit the Hurry-Up shots in order: left ramp, right orbit, right ramp, left orbit.

stern/the-munsters.s: Shoot Herman for a hurry-up, capture the magnet ball, play multiball and qualify the Herman Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot Herman enough times (only once the first time) to start the hurry-up.

steps.t: Shoot Herman to capture the ball
steps.d: Shoot Herman again, for up to 500k, to capture the ball on the magnet.
Collect the Monster in the Park Hurry-Up at 2x to start Herman Multiball with three balls instead of two.
Hit lit major shots and shoot Herman to relight collected Jackpots; four Jackpots qualify the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Collect the Super Jackpot at Dragula
steps.d: Shoot the Dragula Lane to cash in the stacked Super Jackpots.

stern/the-munsters.s: Spell SPOT to start Spot's mode, then qualify and collect the Spot Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the lit red left or right ramps for letters, and hit Spot when raised for bonus letters.
Completing SPOT starts the mode and counts as a level.

steps.t: Hit Spot four times in Stage 1
steps.d: Complete all four shots to qualify the Spot Super Jackpot.
Shoot the blue-lit left orbit or right ramp to raise Spot again and hit him for increasing points.

stern/the-munsters.s: Complete LILY to start the stackable frenzy and reach 100 switch hits for the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Complete LILY at the right target
steps.d: Hit the LILY targets before progress resets to start the frenzy mode.
Make 100 switch hits during the mode, ideally stacked with a multiball; hits carry over if you fall short.
Shoot the Dragula Lane to collect the qualified Super Jackpot.

stern/the-munsters.s: Collect chattering teeth to light the scoop, then play Enlarging Ray or Grandpa's Laboratory to the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Collect chattering teeth at purple targets
steps.d: Hit purple targets (flashing ones twice for 2 teeth) to reach 12 teeth for Grandpa's Laboratory on Prem/LE, or 48 for Enlarging Ray.

steps.t: Start Enlarging Ray at the scoop
steps.d: Shoot the lit scoop to start the mode.
Hit standup targets or shots to turn them purple and collect the Jackpots; four qualify the Super Jackpot.
Shoot the lit scoop and activate the Machine by shooting both outer orbits, then the Machine.
Shoot all flashing lower playfield shots for Jackpots, then the Machine Jackpot to qualify the Super Jackpot.

stern/the-munsters.s: Complete other family member levels, shoot the left ramp three times, and work Raven Multiball to its Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Complete a level of another member
steps.d: Finishing a level of Herman, Spot, Lily or Grandpa qualifies the left ramp for Raven advances after the mode ends.
Collect three Raven advances at the left ramp.
Shoot the left ramp three times during the multiball to raise Jackpot values; keep shooting it to extend the timer.
Hit the left orbit, left ramp, right ramp and right orbit to qualify the Raven Super Jackpot.

stern/the-munsters.s: Qualify Super Jackpots from many features and collect them stacked at the Dragula Lane.

steps.t: Qualify one or more Super Jackpots
steps.d: Complete a feature such as a mode, Eddie, Marilyn, Zap, Mystery Award or chattering teeth milestones.
Shoot the unlit scoop to raise the base value and hold the Zap Button at Dragula to keep stacking.

steps.t: Collect stacked Super Jackpots with Playfield X
steps.d: Shoot the Dragula Lane while a playfield multiplier is active for bigger value.

stern/the-munsters.s: Complete family member levels to light Kitty and raise the playfield multiplier.

steps.d: Starting any member's mode qualifies the Kitty target.
Advance the playfield multiplier from 2x to 3x to 6x.
Hit Kitty again while active to reset the timer and earn bonus multipliers.

stern/the-munsters.s: Progress from the basic skill shot to the Super and Double Super Skill Shots.

steps.d: Plunge into the right lane, or short plunge to the right flipper and shoot the left ramp.
Hold the left flipper button and shoot the right ramp for 500k.

steps.t: Make the Double Super Skill Shot
steps.d: Hold both left flipper buttons, shoot the scoop, then the saucer in Grandpa's Laboratory for 1M.

stern/the-munsters.s: Score Eddie Loops and boyfriend departures to light their Super Jackpots.

steps.d: Shoot an unlit orbit or roll the flashing inlanes to qualify the opposite orbit, making successive loops.
Every 5 Eddie Loops qualify the Super Jackpot.
Roll the flashing inner left inlane, then shoot the lit right ramp.
Every 2 departures award super pops, spinner or loops and light the Super Jackpot.

stern/the-munsters.s: Use chattering teeth, family levels and mystery awards to light extra ball and Secret Mania at the scoop.

steps.d: Reach 90 chattering teeth to relight the Mystery award.

steps.t: Collect 110 teeth to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Shoot the scoop to collect the Extra Ball; completing enough family levels also lights it.

steps.t: Collect 130 teeth to light Secret Mania
steps.d: Shoot the scoop to play the mode that lights all seven family areas.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Light and start a mission, complete it, survive the Future to earn a perk, then finish all 8 missions for the mini-wizard.

steps.t: Hit white shots to light a mission
steps.d: Hit the lit white shots (one for the first mission, more for each mission completed) to light missions at the midtown center ramp or subway right loop.
Hit any blue shot (midtown ramp or subway loop) to start the selected mission. Reach danger room level 1 first to double mission scoring.

steps.t: Complete an easy mission to start the Sentinel Future
steps.d: Complete an easy mission to start the 40-second Future, then defeat 6 Sentinels at the lit shots.

steps.t: Escape the Future for a perk
steps.d: After 6 Sentinels are defeated, shoot the lit center ramp or subway ramp to return to the past and earn the mission's perk.

steps.t: Complete a challenging mission and escape Nimrod
steps.d: Complete a challenging mission, make the 3 red shots in Escape Nimrod, then shoot the lit center or subway ramp to earn the perk and 4 sentinels.
Finish all 8 missions to light the center and subway ramps for Save Senator Kelly.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Complete all 8 missions, then work through the phases of the mini-wizard and capture Mystique.

steps.d: Finish every mission to light the center ramp and subway ramp.
Shoot the lit center or subway ramp to start the single-ball mini-wizard with 40 seconds of ball save.

steps.t: Clear the green, yellow and orange phases
steps.d: Hit 2 green shots then the three Cerebro shots, then clear 3 yellow shots and 4 orange shots.

steps.t: Clear six red shots and shoot Cerebro
steps.d: Within 60 seconds, clear all six red major shots and shoot Cerebro to capture Mystique. Build a high combo for a bigger multiplier.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Spawn and defeat the giant Sentinel, then score jackpots and super jackpots.

steps.d: Hit the giant sentinel head 3 times (+2 per multi).

steps.t: Defeat the giant Sentinel to start multiball
steps.d: Keep hitting it until its mouth opens, then defeat it. A Fastball Special advances it a stage instantly.
Shoot the lit yellow jackpots; the danger room exit ramp raises them to 2x then 3x.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot at the Sentinel head
steps.d: Hit the head for the super jackpot, 2x with a shot to the open mouth. More jackpots are needed for each later one, up to six.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Hit every major ramp and loop shot, start the multiball, light jackpots and spin for the super jackpot.

steps.t: Hit each of six major shots three times
steps.d: During single-ball play, hit X-Jet, Downtown, Uptown, Midtown, Subway and Highway three times each.
Shoot the lit midtown center ramp or subway right loop when no other modes are running.
Hit the matching features (loops, ramps, targets, spinner, bumpers) to light and score each jackpot once.
Shoot the lit X-Jet ramp, then spin the danger room spinner within 15 seconds for 1M per spin.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Advance Cerebro three times to start the multiball, then score jackpots and super jackpots.

steps.d: Make Cerebro skill shots or hit the Nightcrawler targets 5 times.

steps.t: Collect Cerebro three times to start
steps.d: Shoot the uptown or highway ramp while Cerebro is lit, three times.

steps.t: Score six jackpots on blue shots
steps.d: Hit six lit blue shots to summon X-Men; the same shot can't repeat consecutively.
Shoot the left ramp for the super jackpot, or the danger room exit ramp for the 2x super jackpot.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Defeat 35 Sentinels to light Berserker, then build jackpots into repeated super jackpots.

steps.d: Destroy Sentinels during Sentinel Facility Raid, the Future, Escape Nimrod, and Sentinel Multiball.
Shoot the lit uptown ramp when no other modes or multiballs are active.
Hit yellow shots, including the sentinel head, without repeating a shot until another is made.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot and 2x super
steps.d: Shoot the X-Jet ramp for the super jackpot, then the lit danger room exit ramp for 2x.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Level up the danger room to boost missions, the Future and multiballs, earning the Cyclops perk.

steps.d: Hit the spinner, targets, ramp and bumper in the danger room to fill the progress bar; this doubles the next mission.
Keep leveling to need one less sentinel to light the escape shot in the Future.
Level up again so Future sentinels count double and Nimrod's final shot gets 5 extra seconds.

steps.t: Complete 3 danger room levels in one game
steps.d: This earns the Cyclops perk, which increases combo timers.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Build combos to light Sentinel Attacks and raise Beast's Lab awards up to an extra ball.

steps.t: Shoot lit X shots in succession
steps.d: Chain combo shots; value starts at 200k and rises 200k per combo to 1M per shot.

steps.t: Complete 6 combos to start Sentinel Attack
steps.d: Shoot the lit uptown, midtown or highway ramp, then hit two red shots for hurry-up values.

steps.t: Hit the Beast's Lab captive ball
steps.d: Collect a context-sensitive award; combos raise its level.

steps.t: Score a level 3 Beast's Lab award
steps.d: The first level 3 award lights extra ball; the second qualifies Beast for the future.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Make the four different skill shots at the start of each ball.

steps.d: Soft plunge into the lane near the highway ramp entrance for 200k and +1 bonus X.
Hit the left ramp to spot progress toward To Me, My X-Men.

steps.t: Hit the X-Jet shot, then the super skill shot
steps.d: Feed the X-Mansion ramp via the X-Jet for +3 bonus X, then hit the danger room exit ramp.
Hit the downtown shot repeatedly for 5 shots, then the left ramp for +15 seconds of ball save.

stern/the-uncanny-x-men.s: Light and collect extra balls at the right inlane.

steps.d: Light extra ball at the right inlane; first mission cycle only.
Light extra ball again at the right inlane; first mission cycle only.

steps.t: Score the first level 3 Beast's Lab award
steps.d: This also lights extra ball.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Kill Walkers with lit shots up to 115 to light the main wizard mode, then play it through to its completion bonus.

steps.t: Kill Walkers at lit crosshair shots
steps.d: Make the white crosshair major shots (3 lit at a time, never the same shot twice in a row) to raise the Walker kill count.

steps.t: Reach 115 Walker kills to light Last Man Standing
steps.d: Accumulate 115 total kills to light Last Man Standing at the Woodbury shot.
Shoot the Woodbury shot to start the 4-ball wizard mode, which cancels other active modes.

steps.t: Kill 115 more Walkers to complete it
steps.d: Count down from 115; shots with all five inserts lit kill 5 Walkers, and add-a-balls come every 10 kills. Finishing awards a 100M bonus.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Qualify and play the five Dead Feature modes, which leads into the Escape Terminus hurry-up mode.

steps.t: Complete the drop targets to light a Dead Feature
steps.d: One completion lights the first mode, then 2 completions for each further mode.

steps.t: Start a Dead Feature at its shot
steps.d: Shoot the flashing shot: Barn (left orbit), CDC (left ramp), Riot, Tunnel, or Arena (right ramp).

steps.t: Build the mode and trigger a Multi-Kill
steps.d: Make shots not lit for progress to add 500k to the mode value, and make the mode's Multi-Kill shot count.
Once all 5 have been played, the next Dead Feature becomes Escape Terminus.
Shoot any flashing Dead Feature shot after relighting them via the drops.
Shoot each lit shot in turn to collect all five hurry-ups; Dead Features then reset.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Light all six Multi-Kill inserts to qualify the Horde mini-wizard at Woodbury, then survive its waves.

steps.d: Complete a Multi-Kill objective such as 3 left orbit shots in Barn, 10 drop target completions, or 10 combos.
Each qualified Multi-Kill lights one insert; the 14 objectives include modes, multiballs, and features.
With the Horde insert strobing, shoot Woodbury during single-ball play to start the 2-ball mini-wizard.

steps.t: Clear waves and collect super jackpots
steps.d: Kill the required Walkers each wave (3, then one more each wave) before they reach you to score a super jackpot and an add-a-ball.
After enough waves with one ball left, shoot the lit Woodbury lane and press the right flipper to take the escape value.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Spell PRISON, clear the prison yard, play Prison Multiball and its phases, and do it twice to light Siege.

steps.t: Shoot the prison doors to spell PRISON
steps.d: Hit the closed prison doors until PRISON is spelled (3 shots the first time, 7 later) to start Clear the Prison Yard.
steps.sec: Prison Multiball / Clear the Prison Yard:

steps.t: Clear the prison yard and spell PRISON again
steps.d: Make lit shots to kill Walkers, then spell PRISON again and hit the lit Walker head to start Prison Multiball.
steps.sec: Prison Multiball / Clear the Prison Yard:

steps.d: Hit the doors or a major shot for a 2x cell block jackpot, then the Walker head for a 1x jackpot.
steps.sec: Prison Multiball / Clear the Prison Yard:

steps.d: After six Walker head jackpots, shoot the lit Riot shot for the super jackpot to begin phase two.
steps.sec: Prison Multiball / Clear the Prison Yard:

steps.t: Fully spell PRISON in 2 Prison Multiballs
steps.d: Doing so lights Siege.
steps.sec: Prison Multiball / Clear the Prison Yard:

steps.d: Score jackpots at the left orbit, Prison, and right ramp, then in phase two all shots, and finish with any lit shot.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Spell WELL to summon the Well Walker, start the multiball, and finish with the super jackpot.

steps.d: Spell WELL 4 times, then a 5th time to engage the magnet and start Well Walker mode.
Shoot the strobing WELL shots; the 5th shot collects the combined value and starts Well Walker Multiball.
Make switch hits (20, 25, 30, 35) to light each jackpot at the Well Walker.

steps.t: Score the Well Walker super jackpot
steps.d: Shoot the Well Walker after the fourth jackpot to start phase two with lit ramps.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Collect a full set of supplies at the drop targets, start Blood Bath, and score its super jackpot.

steps.t: Collect supplies at the drop targets
steps.d: Hit a drop target to lock the lit supply and complete the bank to collect it.

steps.t: Collect a full set of supplies
steps.d: Collecting all supplies makes the Blood Bath insert strobe.
Complete the drop target bank again to start the 2-ball multiball.

steps.t: Clear the drops for jackpots and add-a-balls
steps.d: Each drop bank clear collects the jackpot and raises switch value; the first two clears add balls.

steps.t: Collect all supplies for a super jackpot
steps.d: Collect all supplies during Blood Bath to score the super jackpot and an add-a-ball.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Light and fire the crossbow three times to start the Crossbow Frenzy mini-wizard.

steps.d: Complete the drop targets while the weapons supply is lit to light the right ramp for Crossbow.

steps.t: Shoot the right ramp and fire the crossbow
steps.d: Press the action button when the ball is cradled to fire for 1.5M-2.5M.
This starts a Multi-Kill and activates Crossbow Frenzy.

steps.t: Clear all lit yellow shots in Crossbow Frenzy
steps.d: Hit every lit shot before Walkers drain your health; the final shot scores up to 200M.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Light and collect the extra ball at the Woodbury lane through Walker kills, Tower shots, or Woodbury awards.

steps.t: Choose a route to light extra ball
steps.d: Kill about 10% then 60 Walkers, score 10 lit Tower shots, or get it as a Woodbury award.

steps.t: Shoot the Woodbury lane to collect it
steps.d: The drop target lowers automatically when extra ball is lit.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Complete fish tanks to build Woodbury awards, ending in Multi-Kill and Fish Tank Frenzy.

steps.t: Shoot the right ramp to light fish tank heads
steps.d: Complete a tank (1 head first, then one more each time up to 3) to light Woodbury.
Plunge and hit the lit rollover or lane within 5 seconds to collect an award.
This starts a Multi-Kill and adds feature awards like bit, outlane save, and extra ball.

stern/the-walking-dead-remastered.s: Small scoring features: make the skill shot and the Bicycle Girl hurry-ups.

steps.d: Plunge through the lit rollovers, then into the flashing lane, cycling with the flippers.
Kill 5 Walkers (then every 20) to light the left ramp, and shoot it.
Hit the under-ramp target each time; the first 3 start a Multi-Kill.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Start missions at Megatron's scoop, play two to light One Shall Fall, and complete all five to light Rescue Optimus.

steps.t: Start a mission at Megatron's scoop
steps.d: Knock down the three drop targets in front of Megatron, then shoot the scoop to start the flashing mission. The first two missions need one scoop shot; later ones need two.

steps.t: Make enough lit shots to light final blow
steps.d: Make the required lit shots within 60 seconds to light the final blow at Megatron. Completing the mission only needs the required shots, not the final blow.
Hit the lit final blow at Megatron to apply a 2x shot multiplier to a random shot, which activates when a tech spec is lit there.

steps.t: Play two missions to light One Shall Fall
steps.d: Playing two missions, even without completing them, lights the right ramp to start One Shall Fall.
Complete all five missions to light the VUK for Rescue Optimus. Playing all five also lights an extra ball at the space bridge.
Shoot the lit VUK once no other modes are running, then work through the three 70-second phases to the final multiball phase and build the super jackpot at the space bridge.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Light the duel after two missions, build its value, and defeat Megatron at the scoop.

steps.d: Play two missions to light the right ramp for One Shall Fall. You can keep playing missions to make it more valuable and easier to win.

steps.t: Start One Shall Fall at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the lit right ramp to begin the duel. Hit purple shots to damage Megatron and avoid red shots.

steps.t: Make enough purple shots to light the hurry-up
steps.d: Enough purple shots light the final hurry-up at Megatron's scoop, which is blocked by the drop targets.
Clear the drop targets and shoot the scoop before the hurry-up expires. The targets return after a few seconds with more time.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Play Dinobot missions to score Dino Jackpots, then start Dinobot Desertion or Super Dinobot Desertion.

steps.t: Light the left orbit for a Dinobot Mission
steps.d: Shoot the Grimlock targets gating the left orbit to light it and start a Dinobot Mission (War, Island or S.O.S.).

steps.t: Score 3 Dino Jackpots in a mission
steps.d: Hit the shots shown on the right side of the display to light the Dino Jackpot at the left orbit, and score 3 in one mission.

steps.t: Start Dinobot Desertion at the VUK
steps.d: Shoot the lit VUK. Phase One builds the jackpot, and shooting Megatron without draining triples it. Phase Two scores it at the left orbit and Grimlock targets.

steps.t: Score 3 Dino Jackpots in all 3 missions
steps.d: Score 3 Dino Jackpots in each Dinobot mission so the VUK starts Super Dinobot Desertion instead.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Lock three balls via Optimus and the VUK, then score jackpots and the super jackpot.

steps.t: Shoot Optimus to light a lock
steps.d: Hit Optimus to light the lock. Later multiballs need 4, 6, etc. hits per lock, and extra hits when lit raise the jackpot by 250k.

steps.t: Lock three balls in the center VUK
steps.d: Shoot the lit center VUK to lock a ball. Locking 3 balls starts Transformers Multiball.
Hit the same shot 3 times as it goes purple, red, then flashing red/white to score a jackpot, multiplied by the number of jackpots lit.

steps.t: Score the super jackpot at the side ramp
steps.d: Collect three jackpots to light the super jackpot at the side ramp.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Collect Combiner parts, complete three Combiners, and score jackpots and a super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the side ramp to earn Combiner parts, or score 3 tech specs of the same color. Each Combiner has five parts.
Complete 3 Combiners to light the space bridge for Combiner Multiball.
Shoot the lit space bridge when no other modes are running. Pressing the action button instead delays it until the next Combiner is completed.
Select a completed Combiner with the spinner or action button to light jackpots, then score 2 in a wave.
Shoot the lit side ramp and space bridge for the super jackpot. It also gives add-a-ball and resets the Combiner selection.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.t: Tech Specs and Tech Spec Mania
stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Score tech specs to earn an extra ball and start Tech Spec Mania, then score its super jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the standup targets near major shots to light nearby shots for tech specs. Cassette combos can light the action button to light all shots for 15 seconds.
steps.sec: Tech Specs, Action Button & Tech Spec Mania:

steps.t: Collect 15 tech specs for an extra ball
steps.d: Collect 15 tech specs of any color to light extra ball at the space bridge.

steps.t: Collect 3 tech specs of each color
steps.d: Collect 3 of every color with no other modes running to instantly start Tech Spec Mania, a 3-ball multiball.
steps.sec: Tech Specs, Action Button & Tech Spec Mania:

steps.t: Collect one of every color in the multiball
steps.d: Collect one tech spec of each of the five colors during Tech Spec Mania to light the super jackpot at the side ramp.
steps.sec: Tech Specs, Action Button & Tech Spec Mania:

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Make the upper flipper skill shot, then the secret skill shot for higher values.

steps.d: Short plunge to the upper flipper and hit the Optimus target, side ramp, or space bridge for 500k, 5M or 8M plus extra ball save time.
Short plunge to the lower right flipper, hit the left orbit at Grimlock, then hit a normal skill shot from the upper flipper. The space bridge pays 15M.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Build BUMBLEBEE for 2x scoring, then boost it to 3x with add-a-ball in a multiball.

steps.t: Hit lit captive balls to add BUMBLEBEE letters
steps.d: Each lit captive ball hit adds three letters.
After 3 lit captive ball hits, the next captive ball starts 30 seconds of 2x scoring.
After the multiball ball save expires, shoot the lit space bridge to hold the ball, then shoot the captive ball within 10 seconds for 2x scoring for 30 seconds.
Bring Bumblebee 2x into a multiball with add-a-ball and shoot the held ball at the captive ball to start 3x scoring.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Use the inlanes and cassette target to start hurry-ups and combos.

steps.d: Roll the left inlane to light the Cassette target, then chain white shots up to right ramp/scoop, left ramp, Cassette target for a 3-way combo.
After completing the Megatron drop targets, roll the lit left inlane twice without the right inlane, then shoot the left ramp and the three pink shots.
After completing the Megatron drop targets, roll the lit right inlane twice without the left inlane, then shoot the right orbit for 30 seconds of fast scoring.

stern/transformers-more-than-meets-the-e.s: Load Megatron's cannon and chain it into a combo and the cannon jackpot.

steps.t: Load the cannon at the right ramp
steps.d: At the start of each ball, shoot the lit right ramp to score 1M and fire the ball to the left flipper.
Quickly hit the right ramp again for 5M, which fires the ball to the upper flipper.

steps.t: Hit Optimus for the cannon jackpot
steps.d: Hit Optimus from this feed with either flipper to score the 14M cannon jackpot.

stern/venom.s: Complete mini-mode columns and reach level 10 to fight minor bosses, then level up to face Grendel and finally Knull.

steps.d: Shoot a flashing arrow, then quickly make the same-colored shot that times out, for all three colors in your host's column. Unlockable hosts need two columns.

steps.t: Reach level 10 and start a minor battle
steps.d: With the path complete and at least level 10, shoot the center ramp to start a battle against Riot, Agony, Phage, or Lasher.
Deplete both of the boss's health bars, or score a Mayhem Multiball super jackpot to defeat one. Unlockable hosts must defeat two.
Complete the mini-mode path again, shoot the center ramp, and beat Grendel.
Start Knull from the center ramp and defeat him through his health bars, including the 2-ball phase.

stern/venom.s: Light locks, lock balls, play both phases, and score super jackpots to defeat bosses and qualify Toxin Team-Up.

steps.d: Complete mini-modes to light locks, one more needed for each lock up to three. Some hosts start with locks lit.
Shoot the green lock shots to lock balls in the left or right canister. Locks can't be collected while a battle is lit.
With one ball in play, alternate between the left ramp and the scoop for quick jackpots, up to 9.
Make all the lit jackpot shots to light and score the super jackpot, which completes a battle brought into the multiball.
After starting Mayhem Multiball, shoot the lit scoop to start the mini-wizard mode.

stern/venom.s: Lock Carnage in Ravencroft via the captive ball to play Carnage Multiball, Hurry-Up, and Blood Lust in order.

steps.d: Shoot the captive ball enough times to lock Carnage away, then send it all the way back to light the center ramp.
Shoot the center ramp, lock Carnage again to light the scoop super jackpot, and build it with jackpots and Infected targets.
Get Carnage all the way back to Ravencroft to score the hurry-up, raised by ramp or captive ball shots.
Light the third Carnage mode and play it, keeping flips up with center ramp loops plus captive ball or bell tower shots.

stern/venom.s: Defeat Infected to trigger Doppelgangers, beat three to light Rampage, and on Prem/LE reach Quick Doppelganger Multiball.

steps.d: Shoot a flashing red target, then shoot it again quickly. Doppelganger attacks every few Infected.
Shoot the left loop on Pro, or the flyaway targets on Prem/LE (more targets needed each time, max four).
With no other mode running, shoot the lit center ramp, build value with blue shots, then hit Doppelganger as many times as possible.

steps.t: Lock a ball for Quick Doppelganger Multiball
steps.d: As Gwen Stacy or Venomized Wolverine, shoot the right loop 8 times to lock a ball.

steps.t: Collect all four jackpots and the super
steps.d: Start by shooting the 180 ramp, hit the Doppelganger targets for the hurry-up value, make four jackpots, then take the scoop super jackpot.

stern/venom.s: Defeating Infected unlocks bonus X, Sleeper, extra ball, and Scream video mode.

steps.d: Defeat Infected by shooting a red target twice; every 4 adds bonus X.

steps.t: Defeat 15 Infected to light Extra Ball
steps.d: Extra ball lights at the scoop at 15 Infected.
Shoot the lit scoop to play the Scream video mode.

stern/venom.s: Loop the center ramp to light the bell tower, raise playfield multiplier, and trigger Bell Tower Frenzy.

steps.t: Shoot the center ramp to light the bell tower
steps.d: The first lit bell tower needs two ramp shots, then three for the second, and so on.
Each lit hit adds +1x playfield for a limited time, up to 7x.
Shoot the center ramp at least four times before hitting the lit bell tower.

stern/venom.s: Unlock Hybrid, Sleeper, and Miles Morales team-ups to use at the start of multiballs and battles.

steps.t: Defeat all four minor bosses for Hybrid
steps.d: Beat Riot, Agony, Phage, and Lasher, by battle or Mayhem super jackpots.
Defeat every 10 Infected with Flash Thompson as the first host.
Score a 4-way combo, or start with Peter Parker as the first host.

stern/venom.s: Start Toxin Team-Up, score its super jackpot, then complete a host's signature combo for Host Hurry-Up.

steps.d: Start Mayhem Multiball, start Carnage Multiball, or defeat a Doppelganger to light the scoop.
Make the three lit shots twice each, shooting Carnage to multiply by 2x or 3x.
Shoot the scoop for 25M, adding a ball for 2-ball multiball.
Complete your host's signature combo to light the scoop, then complete it again before time runs out.

stern/venom.s: Complete every major objective to light the final wizard mode, then clear its 16 hurry-up shots.

steps.t: Start Rampage, Blood Lust, and Toxin Team-Up
steps.d: Start Rampage, the third Carnage mode Blood Lust, and Toxin Team-Up.

steps.t: Start Scream, Bell Tower Frenzy, and complete a Host Hurry-Up
steps.d: Play Scream video mode, start Bell Tower Frenzy, and finish a Host Hurry-Up.
Win the final battle against Knull.
Shoot the lit center ramp once all objectives are done.
Hit the lit left ramp, center ramp, scoop, and right orbit through all 4 stages before time runs out.

stern/venom.s: Score the standard or host skill shot, or the hidden Secret Hideout.

steps.t: Make the rollover lane skill shot
steps.d: Plunge into the flashing rollover lane for +2 bonus X.

steps.t: Score a Secret Hideout Skill Shot
steps.d: Plunge the ball into the saucer at the apex of the orbit for 3M and +4x bonus.

stern/venom.s: Complete the bottom lanes to light Mystery at the scoop and collect its awards.

steps.t: Complete the bottom lanes three times
steps.d: Each later Mystery needs two more completions than the last.
Shoot the lit scoop with no Doppelganger active to take an award.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Spell PRISON, clear the prison yard to start Prison Multiball, collect jackpots through two phases to light Siege.

steps.t: Spell PRISON by bashing the prison doors
steps.d: Hit the closed prison doors until PRISON is spelled; the first few letters are spotted for you.
Make each lit major shot once to advance PRISON letters again; shots to the exposed zombie head clear a shot and letter.
Spell PRISON a second time and hit the lit zombie head to start the 3-ball multiball.

steps.t: Collect 6 jackpots and the Riot super jackpot
steps.d: Open the doors, hit the zombie head to score jackpots; after six, shoot the lit Riot shot for the super jackpot to begin phase two.

steps.t: Collect 6 more Prison jackpots in phase two
steps.d: Shoot the ramps to build the jackpot, then shoot the Prison to collect it; six collects bring the total to 12 and light Siege.
Shoot the Prison when lit to start Siege, then score its jackpots through both phases.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Spell WELL and hit the Well Walker 10 times to start multiball, then build and collect jackpots through two phases.

steps.t: Spell WELL and hit the Well Walker
steps.d: Spell W-E-L-L, then hit the Well Walker while the WELL inserts flash.
Hit the Well Walker 5 more times while the WELL inserts strobe.
Hit switches to relight each letter, then hit the walker to collect each jackpot.

steps.t: Collect the Well Walker super jackpot
steps.d: After all WELL jackpots, hit the walker again to recollect all of them.

steps.t: Build ramp jackpots in phase two
steps.d: Shoot the lit ramps to raise the jackpot, then hit the Well Walker to collect it.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Collect all supplies with the drop targets, start Blood Bath, and score its super jackpot.

steps.t: Collect First Aid, Weapons and Food supplies
steps.d: Complete the drop target bank to lock in each lit supply in sequence.

steps.t: Clear the drop bank once more
steps.d: With the Blood Bath insert strobing, clear the bank to start the 2-ball multiball.
Clear the drop target bank to collect the jackpot built from switch hits.

steps.t: Score the Blood Bath super jackpot
steps.d: Collect all supplies during Blood Bath for a super jackpot and unlimited add-a-balls.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Play all five Dead Features via the drop targets to qualify and complete the Escape Terminus hurry-ups.

steps.d: Complete the drop target bank once for the first mode, then twice for each further mode.

steps.t: Start Barn, CDC, Riot, Tunnel and Arena
steps.d: Shoot the left orbit, left ramp, Riot shot, Tunnel and right ramp respectively to start each mode.
Start every Dead Feature, then relight them via the drops to qualify Escape Terminus.
Shoot any flashing Dead Feature shot to start, then collect all five hurry-ups.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Qualify Multi-Kills across game objectives to light all inserts and start Horde.

steps.d: Make the required shots in a mode, multiball or feature, e.g. 3 Barn shots or 3 CDC shots.
Shoot the lit yellow shot to award 2 walkers and 1/20th of your mode points.
Qualify Multi-Kills until every insert is lit to qualify Horde.
Shoot Woodbury when the Horde insert strobes; kill walkers to complete waves and earn super jackpots.
After enough waves with one ball left, shoot Woodbury and choose ESCAPE to collect the escape value.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Light Crossbow with the Weapons supply, hit its shots, and reach Crossbow Frenzy.

steps.d: Complete the drop targets when Weapons is lit to light the Arena ramp for Crossbow.

steps.t: Start Crossbow at the right ramp
steps.d: Shoot the right ramp to start Crossbow with five shots lit for 1M+.
Make three lit crossbow shots to start Crossbow Frenzy.
Shoot the right ramp to load the Crossbow and hit lit shots for Fibonacci-style values.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Kill 115 walkers to light and complete the four-ball Last Man Standing.

steps.d: Accumulate walker kills across modes and multiballs to light Last Man Standing at Woodbury.
Shoot the lit Woodbury shot to start the four-ball multiball.
Count down from 115 using shots, collecting add-a-balls at checkpoints, for the 100M completion bonus.

stern/walking-dead-wiki.s: Smaller goals: skill shot, Bicycle Girl, pops jackpot, 2X playfield and the Premium spinner jackpot.

steps.d: Shoot the lit lane and lit rollovers; values grow with each successful skill shot.
After 5 zombie kills, shoot the CDC ramp, then make three CDC ramp shots.
Complete the top lanes, hit the pop bumpers, then shoot the Tunnel when the rail road insert strobes.
Hit the stab targets to light it, then shoot the Tower standup for 20 seconds of 2X.
Hit the Woodbury drop target, rip the spinner to build the jackpot, then shoot Woodbury.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Guess consonants and vowels with the contestants, bank wheel prizes, and solve the puzzle to collect the flashing contestant's prize bank.

steps.d: Hit any of the three contestant targets to guess a consonant; the value of that contestant's wedge goes to the flashing contestant's bank.
Collect all of the available consonants in the puzzle to award a 1 million bonus.

steps.t: Buy a vowel at the scoop
steps.d: Once enough letters are guessed, shoot the scoop to collect a vowel, which costs 25k from the contestant's bank. Collecting all vowels awards 2 million.
Shoot the center ramp to spin the wheel to new values and change the flashing contestant; wheel spins can add Extra Ball, Special, or Trip to a prize bank.
Solve the puzzle at the scoop to collect the prize bank of the flashing contestant, the last one you hit.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Complete the MULTIBALL targets, start the three-ball multiball at the scoop, and work up through the Jackpot sequence to the Super Jackpot.

steps.t: Spell MULTIBALL with the nine targets
steps.d: Hit the MULTIBALL standups (M, U, L, T and the BALL bank) to complete the letters; later rounds need each letter hit once, then twice.
Shoot the lit scoop to start the three-ball multiball.
Shoot the four lit left-side shots for Jackpot, Double, Triple, and then the Super Jackpot (5x).
After the Super Jackpot, hit a contestant target to light all six major shots for half Jackpot value; complete them to relight four more shots.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Earn a Trip by solving a puzzle with a Trip banked or a Prize Puzzle, then collect the four-step Jackpot wave.

steps.t: Add a Trip to a prize bank
steps.d: Land a Trip wedge or get a Trip from the Wild Card for a contestant's prize bank.
Solve a puzzle with the contestant holding a Trip, or solve a Prize Puzzle.
Shoot the lit left ramp, scoop, center ramp, and right ramp for Jackpot, then the remaining shots for Double and Triple.
Finish the wave with the Super Jackpot, which raises the base Jackpot by 100k.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Spell BONUS with the major shots, start a random Bonus Wheel mode at the scoop, and cycle through all seven.

steps.t: Spell BONUS via the major shots
steps.d: Light BONUS letters by shooting the left loop, left ramp, center ramp, right ramp, and right orbit.
Shoot the lit scoop to stop the spinning Bonus Wheel inserts and start the mode you land on. Not possible during multiballs.
Score more than the quota (starts at 5M) before time runs out to complete the mode.
Start all modes (V5.0) or complete all modes (V6.02) to reset them and play through again.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Make the plunger skill shot, then cash in the scoop Hurry-Up.

steps.d: Plunge strongly but not all the way so the ball goes around the Toss-Up loop for 1M plus 1M per successful skill shot.

steps.t: Shoot the scoop for the Hurry-Up
steps.d: Shoot the scoop to collect a Hurry-Up starting at double the Skill Shot value.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Hit the three right-ramp drop targets to light Free Spin, Big Money, and Wild Card, then collect them.

steps.t: Hit the first drop target for Free Spin
steps.d: Light the Free Spin outlane rollovers (two per hit); a drain down a lit lane relaunches the ball.

steps.t: Hit the second drop target for Big Money
steps.d: Light the center drain lanes; draining down a lit one spins the wheel for a value with a multiplier growing 5x each time.

steps.t: Hit the third drop target for Wild Card
steps.d: Light the Wild Card lane and shoot it for a random award plus the bumper-built Wild Card value.

steps.t: Combo both ramps with drops down
steps.d: With all three drop targets down, shoot the left and right ramps in a combo so the next shot is quadrupled.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Earn an Extra Ball via ramp shots or by banking one on the wheel and solving the puzzle.

steps.d: Make 10 ramp shots to light the Extra Ball.

steps.t: Bank an Extra Ball and solve the puzzle
steps.d: Add an Extra Ball to a prize bank from the Wild Card or wheel, then complete the puzzle with that contestant.

stern/wheel-of-fortune-rulesheet-wip.s: Build left loop and bumper features into Super Loops, Super Bumpers, and hold awards.

steps.t: Light Super Loops via right inlane
steps.d: Make the right inlane to light the left loop for Super Loops, worth 125K up to 250K per shot, doubled, for 5 seconds.

steps.t: Light Super Bumpers via left inlane
steps.d: Make the lit left inlane to start Super Bumpers, worth 25K rising 1K per hit.
Make every 4 left loop shots to get a hold award such as Hold Bonus Value or Hold Bumper X.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Advance hold 'em hands via ramps to win tournaments, ending at the WPT World Championship wizard mode.

steps.d: Hit the Left or Right Ramp (Flop, Turn, River) or make the Advance Hold 'Em skill shot to progress the hand.
Finish the River to score the main pot times the hand strength; this lights Poker Corner and progresses tournaments.
Complete one hold 'em hand for 1M; the second needs two hands, the third three, then four hands each after that.

steps.t: Win your 2nd tournament for Extra Ball
steps.d: Extra ball is lit after winning your 2nd tournament (and again after the 6th).
Keep completing hands to win six tournaments, which begins the WPT World Championship.
Hit ramps repeatedly for Flop, Turn and River awards; hitting drops increases hand awards. Collect 10M to complete.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Complete hands to light Poker Corner, earn trophies in modes, and play all six to reach Poker Wizard.

steps.d: Complete a hold 'em hand to light Poker Corner at the scoop.
Shoot the scoop (not during a multiball); this also relights the Ace in the Hole lock.

steps.t: Earn a trophy by completing a mode goal
steps.d: Reach the mode's goal within 30 seconds, e.g. two Big Blinds, three flashing shots, or 8 shots in Change Gears. Each trophy scores 1M.
Play through Steal the Blinds, Play the Button, Know Your Outs, A Chip and a Chair, Spot the Tell and Change Gears.
Start it at the scoop; jackpots grow with trophies earned.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Open the jail, lock a ball, hit the captive ball to start multiball, then collect jackpots up to the super jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the jail on the mini-playfield to open the bars for a ball lock.

steps.t: Start Ace in the Hole Multiball
steps.d: Hit the captive ball 3 times to release it and start multiball.

steps.t: Collect jackpots at the jail and ramps
steps.d: Hit the jail and the ramps for jackpots; after 3 the jail reopens to lock a ball and add another.

steps.t: Score the captive ball super jackpot
steps.d: After 10 jackpots and a ball locked in the jail, each captive ball hit is a 1.5M super jackpot.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Build the main pot with spinners and hands until it hits the All In value to start multiball.

steps.t: Raise the main pot with orbit spinners
steps.d: Spin the left and right orbit spinners; completed hands also increase the pot.
Reach the All In value (starts at 750K) with the main pot.

steps.t: Collect jackpots on the main shots
steps.d: Hit any main shot except the orbits for jackpots starting at 150K.
Hit the orbits during a multiball; 10 side pots lights Extra Ball.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Light and collect locks with the left standup, then score jackpots and bank multipliers.

steps.d: Hit the left standup target three times to light locks at the VUK or scoop.

steps.t: Lock three balls to start No Limit Multiball
steps.d: Collect the lit locks at the VUK or scoop; the third lock flashes.
Hit the left ramp for a 1M jackpot and complete drop target banks for multipliers.

stern/world-poker-tour.t: Drop Target Poker and Poker Hands Multiball
stern/world-poker-tour.s: Make poker hands with the drop targets to light every insert and start the mini-wizard.

steps.t: Make a poker hand with the drops
steps.d: Hit drop targets to match cards and light a hand insert, such as two Qs for One Pair.
After completing a hand, triple scoring lights on an inlane; switch it with the flipper button.
Complete every hand type, up to Royal Flush, to start Poker Hands Multiball.

steps.t: Score the 5M Poker Hands super jackpot
steps.d: Collect 9 jackpots (starting at 1M, raised by spinners) to light the 5M Super Jackpot.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Hit flashing chip trick shots to build to Super Trick and an extra ball.

steps.d: Hit flashing chip trick shots, lit by left orbit/right inlane for the left side and right orbit/left inlane for the right.
Spot your fifth Chip Trick, then hit flashing chip trick shots within 10 seconds each.

steps.t: Light Extra Ball with Super Trick
steps.d: Hit all flashing chip trick shots during Super Trick and collect before draining.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Hit mini-playfield standups to start hurry ups and earn an extra ball.

steps.d: Hit the white standups on the mini-playfield three times.
Hit the slot that exits to the pops while it runs.
Finish ten hurry ups to light Extra Ball.

stern/world-poker-tour.s: Win the WPT World Championship and score 25M in each category to start the final wizard mode.

steps.d: Complete your 6th tournament and collect 10M in the championship.
Score 25M each in Ace in the Hole, No Limit, Pot, Targets, Hurry-ups and Poker Corner.
Collect a Cut the Cards award at the VUK once the tasks are finished.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Complete rollover lanes to light Mystery, then Villain, and choose a villain to battle at the Blackbird scoop.

steps.d: Complete the rollover lanes; the first Blackbird completion lights Mystery.
Shoot the Blackbird scoop when Mystery is lit for awards like Extra Ball, Ball Save, bonus or Start Nightcrawler.
Complete the rollover lanes again (second completion lights Villain; afterward two completions light Mystery, two more light Villain), or hit the qualified Hellfire/Brotherhood targets.
Shoot the scoop with Villain lit and pick which villain to battle.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Make the skill shot, then the super skill shot from the plunge.

steps.d: Plunge without hitting the Phoenix switch, then hit Storm or Rogue with the upper flipper.
Hit the Xavier shot after plunging without hitting the Phoenix switch.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Chain combos to hire Deadpool and light Extra Ball through unique hero combos.

steps.d: Extend combos into further shots; each chained shot adds 25k to the award.
Make different hero-to-hero combos such as Beast to Xavier; each after the first raises the base combo value by 50k.

steps.t: Light Extra Ball with 10 unique combos
steps.d: Shoot 10 different unique combos to light Extra Ball.
Make 10 combos to activate Deadpool, who helps progress villain modes (not the last shot).

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Complete heroes or hit Mystery to ready Nightcrawler, then finish it to light Extra Ball.

steps.d: Complete 3 heroes and 6 heroes to ready Nightcrawler, or get Start Nightcrawler from Mystery.
Hit the big pop-up targets blocking the ramps a number of times.
Make the 2-3 shifting red arrow shots: Xavier scoop or Storm ramp on the left, Iceman ramp on the right.
Completing Nightcrawler lights Extra Ball; collect it at the Blackbird.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Pop bumpers start a hurry-up that you collect with a Beast combo.

steps.t: Hit pop bumpers to start Gambit
steps.d: Chain pop bumper hits to count down the Gambit Hurry-Up activation.
Shoot the Beast shot and combo to the right pop bumper with the upper right flipper for up to 15M.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Lock balls, start Magneto Multiball, and defeat Magneto with the Super Jackpot.

steps.d: Hit the upright targets to the right and left of Magneto.
Shoot Phoenix, Rogue, or Magneto, whichever lock is flashing.
Lock 4 balls, or after the first lock hit the captive ball 7 times (9 the second time).
Shoot lit hero shots (started heroes do more damage) and hit Magneto to recharge them until the damage meter hits zero.
Shoot the lit Magneto lock once damage is zero.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Start and complete heroes, repeating for bigger awards, building toward Danger Room.

steps.d: Shoot a hero shot twice (not Wolverine) to start that hero.
Finish the hero's objective, such as Iceman ramp twice or Rogue with 3 hero shots, for 2-3M and +3x bonus.
Restart a hero with 6 shots the second time and 9 the third for up to 2x and 3x awards.

steps.t: Complete all heroes for Danger Room
steps.d: With Hero Stacking Off, complete all heroes to light Danger Room.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Navigate the path through guards to the boss and exit door.

steps.d: Shoot the lit red shots to advance, stackable on villain modes.

steps.t: Fight through guards to the boss
steps.d: Shoot the right path and armed guards; the boss is lit at Xavier/Magneto/Cyclops.
Shoot the boss shot twice, then hit Wolverine for 2M plus 2M per previous completion.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Qualify the villain multiballs with standup targets, start them and defeat the final boss.

steps.d: Hit enough left (Hellfire) or right (Brotherhood) standup targets.
Choose the qualified villain at the Blackbird scoop.
Shoot lit red shots through the waves (Hellfire) or Toad, Blob, Pyro, Avalanche (Brotherhood).
Hit the final shot to complete the mode.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Beat every villain to light the Dark Phoenix wizard mode.

steps.d: Light Villain at the Blackbird and choose villains, using Deadpool, Magneto or Weapon X to help.

steps.t: Defeat Sabertooth, Shadow King and Omega Red
steps.d: Finish each with their final shots at Wolverine or Xavier.
Remove Juggernaut's helmet and shoot Professor X; destroy 4 Sentinels.
Complete both villain multiballs.
Shoot the lit Dark Phoenix at the Blackbird scoop after defeating all villains.

stern/x-men-stern-2012.s: Qualify Danger Room and survive its levels through the Danger battle.

steps.d: Complete all heroes (Stacking Off), or with Stacking On start all heroes, play a 4-ball Magneto Multiball and earn the Super Jackpot.
Shoot lit shots then the Blackbird; level 2 is two-ball.
Shoot the lit shots and Hellfire and Brotherhood targets, then the Blackbird in three-ball.
Shoot Storm, Rogue, Xavier and Iceman for 4M-8M and the targets for 1M.

williams/barracora-williams-1981.s: Complete the drop target banks to light the ball locks, lock balls in the left saucers, and start two or three ball multiball.

steps.t: Complete the B-A-RR left drop bank in sequence
steps.d: Complete the left drop targets in sequence to light the lower left saucer for ball lock.

steps.t: Lock a ball in the lower left saucer
steps.d: Shoot the lit lower left saucer. A new ball goes to the shooter lane.
Plunge the new ball. Two ball multiball begins several seconds later.

steps.t: Complete the A-C-O-R-A right drop bank
steps.d: Complete the right drop targets in sequence to light the upper left saucer for ball lock. Complete both banks for three ball.

steps.t: Lock balls in upper then lower left saucer
steps.d: Shoot the upper left saucer first, then the lower left saucer, to lock both balls.
Plunge the new ball. Three ball multiball begins several seconds later. Locks cannot be relit during multiball.

williams/barracora-williams-1981.s: Clear the drop banks to build the bonus multiplier and super bonus toward the 25x maximum.

steps.d: Hit inlanes, drop targets, top lanes and the BARRACORA lane switch to raise bonus up to 29k.
Complete either drop target bank to advance the orange bonus multiplier.
Clear both drop target banks. Super bonus is awarded after the bank with the unlit green insert is completed, and it carries between balls.
Keep clearing both banks until the bonus and super bonus multipliers reach the 25x maximum combined.

williams/barracora-williams-1981.s: Complete the top lane sets to raise saucer and target values, light bonus collect, and collect bonus in the upper left saucer.

steps.d: Use the right flipper to change lanes. Completing 1-2-3 advances the left saucer value 30k, 60k, 90k.
Use the left flipper to change lanes. Roll through a lit 1-2-3 insert to claim an unlit 4-5-6 insert. This advances the upper right stand up target 20k, 40k, EB.
Complete both 1-2-3 and 4-5-6 to light collect bonus and the upper left saucer.

steps.t: Collect bonus in the upper left saucer
steps.d: Shoot the lit upper left saucer to collect bonus. Full collects at max are worth 725k.

williams/barracora-williams-1981.s: Raise the center target value and multiplier, then collect them at the upper right u-turn, repeating at max.

steps.d: Hit the left center touch target to advance 5k, 10k, 15k, 20k, 25k.
Hit the right center touch target to advance x2, x3, x4, x5, x10.
Shoot the upper right u-turn to score the lit value and multiplier.

steps.t: Repeat the collect with matched levels
steps.d: With score and multiplier at the same level, shoot the u-turn again to collect the same value again.

williams/barracora-williams-1981.s: Light the spinner for 1k a spin with drop bank completions and collect the lit special at the outlanes.

steps.d: Complete either bank to light the spinner for 1k a spin for a short time.
Spin the spinner while lit for 1k a spin instead of 100.
Roll an outlane when special is lit to collect it.
